world.title: Ancient Guidance Palace
world.introText: The Guidance Ancient Palace (指引古宫, Zhǐyǐn Gǔ Gōng), also known as the Golden Dao Palace or Chaotic Ancient Palace, is an ancient and mysterious supreme relic that exists beyond ordinary understanding. Appearing within the depths of the cosmos surrounded by chaotic energy and endless void, the palace is connected to some of the greatest mysteries of the ancient eras.
world.appearance:
The Guidance Ancient Palace appears as a vast golden palace floating within the void, surrounded by terrifying spatial cracks, chaotic energy, and ancient power. Its existence gives off an aura of timelessness, as if it has existed since the earliest eras of the universe.

The palace is often accompanied by ancient battlefields and arenas where outstanding talents from different factions compete. These places serve as gathering grounds for geniuses and supreme inheritances, with many powerful cultivators seeking opportunities related to the palace.

However, ordinary cultivators are unable to understand its true nature. Even extremely powerful beings can only glimpse fragments of its mysteries.

world.title: Ancient Immortal Cave
world.introText: Found within the Desert of Fire Province. The Immortal Cave is opened once every ten thousand years and a former dwelling of an  Unmatched Immortal King and his loyal creature the Seven Colored Immortal Gold Metal Man. This was an innately nourished divine core, originally a piece of Seven Colored Immortal Gold, in the end gaining sentience and enlightenment from the immortal king turning into human form. Only after endless years, was this heaven-defying creature born. It was unknown just what age this happened. The lord of the cave went to participate in a great battle, but then never came back, the soul lamp he left behind also going out, signifying that he fell in battle

Qi Daolin told Shi Hao the immortal cave was part of the reason he established the Supreme Being Dao Rite in this location as he's been waiting for the reopen of the cave. Qi Daolin had previously stolen from hundreds of clans, and he had plundered a bone fragment that had a few secret rumors recorded on it. Through it, he was able to discover omens of the Immortal Mine’s emergence.

During their exploration of the cave they first notice sword marks left all over the wall of Origin Stone, a stone normally associated with True Immortal, strong enough for refinement of weapons. it were too large for them to remove but across the room a huge piece of the Origin Stone split off and Qi daolin urge shi hao to collect it.

Shi Hao Found Symbols that place him into a trance which the Chaotic Flame appeared thereafter and help him mirror himself  which led him to further comprehend his Kun Peng Technique,  Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique and others better. They later found an area with many rare Ancient Treasure but they were all illusion apart from one which look like an ordinary piece of Black Stone which took him hundred of thousands of years to fully understand and eventually use.

Later chapter 1984 of the series When he became a powerful Half-Immortal Emperor, he used that dark stone as an important ingredient to refine Three powerful Half-Immortal Emperor weapon to protect Immortal Court, the  Five Bird Fans, Time Immemorial Gourd and Five Elements Banner .

Inside the cave was also a True Immortal being spirit (Seven Colored Immortal Gold Metal Man) that cannot leave the cave due to recovering and cultivation purposes. they saw it at the entrance before it closes, that scene had been left out in the Donghua .

During the Cultivation-less area and Darkness Calamity Shi Hao needed strong people to help protect Immortal court, in chapter 1913 shi Hao returned and that spirit being creature was one of many powerful spirit he seek help from thus making a deal with it.

world.title: Blackwater City
world.introText: Blackwater City is one of the foreign realm's ten great cities, built directly above the underground Blackwater Prison. It served as Shi Hao's first destination after being marched through the transport formation into the true ancient realm, and later became the site of his public provocation of the assembled clans  first hung and displayed at the city gates, then brought into the city's largest arena to fight successive waves of challengers, including eighteen old kings in a single sitting. The city also drew the four Emperor Clan youths (Mo Xian, Wu Kun, Yu Yu, and Qing Kun) who came to assess Shi Hao in person.

world.title: Blackwater Prison
world.introText: An extremely secure, ancient heavenly prison beneath Blackwater City, dark and damp with no sunlight, holding creatures far more powerful than typical captives. Its deepest cells are guarded by seals releasing a corrosive black liquid capable of dissolving flesh and bone entirely if a prisoner's magical force runs out. Shi Hao was detained in its most secure cell, adjacent to the cage of a mysterious, apparently deceased ancient figure who had hung motionless, bound by his own hair, for over a great era. Rather than succumb, Shi Hao used the prison's corrosive environment to deliberately temper and reconstruct his own body over the course of ten days, an unprecedented feat that shocked the prison's overseers.

world.title: Broken Sky City
world.introText: Broken Sky City was an ancient city scarred by time, but it was still very prosperous.
world.history:
Broken Sky City was an ancient city scarred by time, but it was still very prosperous.

There was endless traffic within the city and there were shops along both side of the streets. The voices of people trading constantly rang out. Apart from the things that people needed everyday, there were also all kinds of items  that cultivators needed, such as rare beast bones, fully grown medicine, as well as weapons and bone books.

This was an ancient land which had been vibrant with life in the past, but gradually declined after countless battles. According to Tao Ye, there was once an incredibly glorious ancient country situated here that controlled millions upon millions of li of land; however, it had scattered like ashes through the passage of time.

Origin Ancient Artifact - There are two of these one in Foreign Realm and the other in the Burial Domain, this was refined by the four dark Half-Immortal Emperor  back in or before the Age of Emperor Collapse. It came into contact with a corpse in Burial Domain and gave it life thus a new primordial spirit[Soul] was born within that individual which henceforth became an Golden Undead Knight and a Burial King, afterwards would reproduce the later generations. In the foreign Realm the opposite happen it came into contact with a normal living person and its spirit also got replace and his power skyrocket into becoming an undying king.

Fyi: To be more Precise the darkness’ corrosion will bring away those creatures’ Original primordial spirits, nurture their flesh, and produce new primordial spirits. This newly produced primordial spirit is still theirs, not another creature coming in and occupying them. It is just that they no longer has their past memories, becoming different from before. The corrosion of darkness sometimes cannot bring away all of one’s soul, there would still be a bit leftover  as such with Meng Tianzheng after being taken by the darkness and spirit replaced if not for him having a ruined spirit, why would had help Shi Hao kill those true immortals?

It is said that  after the Main antagonist the Corpse Immortal Emperor recruited the Four Half Fallen Emperors he instructed them to refined the Origin Ancient Artifact which was intended help him recover from his injuries by farming souls after many Era's at a time via Primordial Spirit[Soul] Imprisonment inside Guidance Ancient Palace[Void Prison] for later usage. world.title: Dam World
world.introText: Dam World is a remote, ancient region marking the outermost boundary between the Nine Heavens Ten Earths and the true edge of Realm Sea. At its heart is a massive dam also referred to as a dike described as towering like a steel stream, extremely imposing, that physically separates the world explorers can reach from an inconceivable, boundless sea lying just beyond it. This is one of the very few known physical thresholds where Realm Sea can be directly perceived, rather than reached only through Guidance Ancient Palaces or similar passages, and it stands as one of the most dangerous and dao-rich locations. Shi Hao first visited the region first as a comparatively weaker cultivator alongside Sanzang and Shenming.
world.appearance: Dam World is a remote, ancient region marking the outermost boundary between the Nine Heavens Ten Earths and the true edge of Realm Sea. At its heart is a massive dam also referred to as a dike described as towering like a steel stream, extremely imposing, that physically separates the world explorers can reach from an inconceivable, boundless sea lying just beyond it. This is one of the very few known physical thresholds where Realm Sea can be directly perceived, rather than reached only through Guidance Ancient Palaces or similar passages, and it stands as one of the most dangerous and dao-rich locations. Shi Hao first visited the region first as a comparatively weaker cultivator alongside Sanzang and Shenming.
world.history:
Walking along the dike itself, travelers encounter the remains of powerful ancient beings who apparently crawled back from the other side after suffering fatal injuries, dying right where they fell. On Shi Hao's first exploration of the region, he and his companions found five such corpses in a row, spanning what were clearly different eras and largely unidentifiable species among them a being with a third vertical golden eye and silver scales, tentatively linked by Sanzang to the long-extinct true bloodline of the Three Eyed Divine Clan, and another with skin of solid gold and a body Shenming likened to an extreme "Vajra Unbreaking Body," said to have been capable of collapsing realms with a flash of anger while alive.

On a later visit, at least two further immortal-blooded corpses were found in the same state half their bodies still hanging limply over the dam itself, as if they had died mid-crawl trying to return.

Every one of these bodies shared a common, unexplained trait: though completely withered and dead, with their own essence energy fully scattered, the blood spilled from them before death remained undiminished, still radiating power strong enough to split the void, collapse surrounding space, and threaten to tear the world apart on approach. On both visits, the group found that merely drawing close to this residual blood even without touching the bodies themselves was enough to rupture skin and crack bone; on the earlier trip, Shenming took just half a step too close and was nearly torn apart, while on the later trip even the physically formidable Heavenly Horned Ant was scorched black and staggered backward by similar unseen force radiating from nearby immortal blood.

A set, invisible boundary distance from the dike seemed to shield onlookers from the worst of these fluctuations, as if some formless wall cut off the pressure beyond a certain range. Massive star remains, apparently knocked loose from the heavens by the deaths of such powerful beings, were found scattered near the dam on both occasions.

Faced with this graveyard of beings far more powerful than themselves, the group on the first expedition seriously debated whether to continue at all, reasoning that if creatures capable of surviving long enough to crawl back with immortal-grade blood still ultimately died here, going further seemed close to suicidal. They eventually found a stretch of the dike clear of bodies and bloody residue to make their attempt from instead.

world.title: Dao Comprehension Mountain
world.introText: An enormous, metallic-surfaced holy mountain famed throughout the foreign realm for its Dao Comprehension Tea Tree, an immortal medicine whose leaves mature only once every several hundred to over a thousand years, drawing millions of aspiring cultivators to a grand "tea ceremony" gathering whenever harvest occurs. Ascending the mountain is done on foot out of respect, with only the most powerful clans and geniuses able to reach the metallic, spacious summit near the tree itself. It was here that Shi Hao intervened to save a human grandmother and granddaughter, killed an Emperor Clan "son-in-law" for eating captured human children, and successfully claimed one of the tree's three thousand mystical leaves.

world.title: Darkness Prison
world.introText: Darkness Prison is a mysterious place that exists outside the normal flow of time and space. It is depicted as an endless void filled with countless prison cells drifting along the River of Time. Rather than holding physical bodies, the prison primarily confines primordial spirits, allowing prisoners to remain conscious while being trapped for millions of years. Because of its unique nature, Darkness Prison is considered one of the most inaccessible and dangerous places in the deepest Sea Ream in the Land of Darkness .
world.appearance:
The Darkness Prison (黑暗监牢, Hēi'àn Jiānláo) is the specific site within the Land of Darkness where primordial spirits are locked away one after another, across the long river of time. It rises and falls with the passage of time much like a land of reincarnation, and imprisons an untold number of creatures within it, some of them beings of unimaginable power who have endured there, imperishable, since ancient times.

Almost nothing about it is understood by the wider cultivation world. What little has surfaced comes from fragmentary ancient records, rare survivors' accounts, and the direct testimony of beings old enough to have witnessed its workings  chief among them the Golden-Haired Woman who guards one of many Guidance Ancient Palace atop the World Tree.

world.title: Demon Dragon Sect
world.introText: Demon Dragon Sect is one of the major powers among the Three Thousand Provinces of the Upper Realms they are one of the sect tasked with subduing sinners in the Sin Province.
world.history:
Demon Dragon Sect is one of the major powers among the Three Thousand Provinces of the Upper Realms they are one of the sect tasked with subduing sinners in the Sin Province.

They decided, along with other factions including Luofu True Valley, Fire Cloud Cave, and Sword Valley, to send their weakest Supreme Experts to take the test and gain access to the Immortal Ancient in the Sin Province. This decision aimed to secure more available spots for them, given the weakness of the local inhabitants. However, their misfortune was marked by the intervention of a young man who proclaimed himself the Sin Blood Guardian, preventing anyone from accessing the Supreme Ancient Altar test.

During this event, the Dragon Demon Sect suffered the most severe losses. When the sect members saw that a young man had managed to reach the ninth level of the Supreme Ancient Altar and seize the Supreme Elixir, they decided to attack him in the Spirit Realm, even involving the Heavenly Deities. Unfortunately for them, one of the powerful elders of the clan, Yun Meng, was struck by a Soul Shattering Needles and killed.
world.trivia:
Only Donghua: the Celestial Clan, Dao Protector fell ill after trying to deduce their clan and Shi Hao future, he then call for Mo Luo to get in contact with the demon dragon sect and Sword Valley to deal with Shi Hao.

Etymology
妖龙道门" (Yāolóng Dàomén) could be translated as the "Gate of the Demon Dragon Path."
"妖" (Yāo) often translates to "demon" or "monster," referring to supernatural entities with varying degrees of malevolence or otherworldly characteristics.

"龙" (Lóng) means "dragon," a powerful and mystical creature in Chinese mythology often associated with both auspicious and malevolent traits.

"道" (Dào) can mean "path," "way," or "road," carrying connotations of a spiritual or philosophical journey.

"门" (Mén) translates to "gate" or "door," indicating an entrance or access point.

world.title: Desolate Border
world.introText: The Desolate Border is a significant and mysterious location, often described as ancient, dangerous, and deeply associated with war and conflict. It serves as a critical boundary between worlds, lying beyond the Three Thousand Dao Provinces and serves as the crucial boundary between the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths and the foreign realm. Its stability is of utmost importance, as great calamities have historically been tied to this region. At times, it is depicted as an endless forbidden area, patrolled and protected by powerful forces to prevent incursions from hostile realms.
world.appearance:
The Desolate Border is a significant and mysterious location, often described as ancient, dangerous, and deeply associated with war and conflict. It serves as a critical boundary between worlds, lying beyond the Three Thousand Dao Provinces and serves as the crucial boundary between the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths and the foreign realm. Its stability is of utmost importance, as great calamities have historically been tied to this region. At times, it is depicted as an endless forbidden area, patrolled and protected by powerful forces to prevent incursions from hostile realms.

The environment of the Desolate Border is harsh and desolate, characterized by lifeless lands, ruins, broken walls, and debris. The air is often deathly still, yet occasionally filled with the howls of malevolent spirits. The ground is littered with the remnants of countless battles—corpses, blood, and shattered bones from past conflicts bear witness to its violent history.

Historically, the Desolate Border has been the site of unending battles and turmoil, dating back to the Immortal Ancient Great Era. It was fiercely defended by the Seven Great Kings and their clansmen, whose sacrifices were immense and tragic. Ancestors of prominent clans fought here, attempting to repel foreign armies that consistently sought to breach the border. The region’s strategic importance made it a focal point of war and conflict for generations.

To protect the border, a massive Imperial Pass, also known as the Emperor City, was constructed. It is considered one of the most powerful defensive positions in history, with walls imbued with stars and fortified by unmatched immortal dao symbols and magical formations. Beyond the Imperial Pass lies an even older, mysterious ancient city, a place that has existed for countless eras and serves as an impenetrable suppression zone, preventing enemies from entering this world.

The Desolate Border is extremely dangerous, earning a reputation as a land where even supreme beings could fall. Traversing it has been described as a "path of nine deaths, one life," highlighting its lethality. Creatures from other realms have occasionally crossed over, causing catastrophic incidents and testing the defenses of the mortal and immortal cultivators stationed there.

In later eras, although major battles eventually ended with immense losses, new formations were established to seal the border’s paths and maintain temporary stability. Nevertheless, the peace was fragile, as new threats, including creatures from the Realm Sea, emerged and foreshadowed further conflict. Over time, the Imperial Pass and other defensive structures fell into ruin, leaving the area scarred and desolate.

world.title: Divine Medicine Sect
world.introText: Divine Medicine Sect is located within the medicine capital and around medicine valley in the Eight Regions (Lower Realm).
world.history:
Divine Medicine Sect is located within the medicine capital and around medicine valley in the Eight Regions (Lower Realm).

In the Past ancient Era there was the  Pill Cauldron Sect an extremely ancient sect that went back even further than the Divine Medicine sect  It used to be extremely splendid, and in the ancient past, whenever the two words ‘pill cauldron’ were mentioned, everyone would know what it was associated with. Under the endless stream of time, anything could happen. They gradually declined, and today, they were simply a ruined sect within the Medicine Capital, on the verge of becoming forgotten.

Rumor has it that since the ancient times, there were only four people who have successfully refined the Nine Reincarnations Pill. The Pill Cauldron Sect’s first ancestor was one of them. Upon ingesting the divine pill, one could immediately become a Heavenly Deity and ascend to the heavens.

Their descendant  who possesses great natural talents ever since childhood, the descendant has wanted to bring back the Pill Cauldron Gate’s ancient glory, and as such has left home for many years in search of the lost inheritance.

With the pill cauldron sect decline, Divine Medicine Sect  now dominates the market within medicine capital they have become so powerful that they even attract the interest of the Double Pupils Woman as a guest elder. The first ancestor was known to be a capable person and even had the World Treasure Box and capable of finding and sealing the Emperor Butterfly within.

At the heart of the Medicine Capital was a short mountain, and this place was known as this area’s most sacred place. The ancient medicine god ancestor became a deity in this place. It is rumored that immortal energy swirls underneath the ground and fiery light burns in that place. This was a ‘gate of life’ within this world. The Divine Medicine sect occupied the medicine capital’s most sacred place. This sect belonged to the medicine god, and so did the small mountain  The ancient well on the small mountain possessed endless vitality, it was a place where immortal energy surged. This was one of the ‘gates of life’ that were extremely rare in this world. This is where the Double Pupils Woman female sat cross-legged on the ground in an extremely calm manner to refine a mysterious cauldron and cultivate.

Lin Kun is the descendant of the medicine god and now the grand elder of the sect with his leadership the sect continue to flourish until his conflict with Shi Hao and his death. The Medicine Capital was established by Divine Medicine sect, and are one of the parties that drafted up many rules, some corrupt, one of which is to charges high taxes  for using their cauldron within the capital. It was unknown if the sect was still flourishing there after his death but later after ten of thousands of years when shi hao return to the lower realms it was stated that because of the darkness calamity one tenth of the population only survived and the sects were all destroyed, it could be said that divine medicine sect was no longer around.

world.title: Eight Regions
world.introText: In the setting of Perfect World, the Eight Regions are regarded as the Lower Realm. This area is divided into eight realms; the sky and the earth are dark and yellow, and the universe is primitive. Each of these regions has vast territory, and an ordinary person cannot traverse a region in the course of their life. The Lower Realm is utilized as a prison for ancient criminals and their descendants, descendants of the seven kings of the ancient Wildlands, true descendants of the Immortal Kings. Their ancestors were imprisoned due to a misunderstanding and condemned as "Sin Blood" The laws of heaven and earth are severely lacking. Additionally, every few years, the leader of the upper realm arrives in the Lower Realm and captures powerful men above the Venerable realm, leaving the Lower Realm godless.

world.title: Forbidden Zones
world.introText: The Forbidden Zones are isolated, self-contained territories that exist beyond the ordinary reach of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, sealed off from the rest of the world and shrouded in mystery. They are extremely dangerous, ancient beyond reckoning, and often house terrifying creatures or the unimaginable remnants of past great eras, true dragon pools, tiger nests, and other entities so perilous that even the mightiest experts of the Nine Heavens dare not tread there, as entry frequently means certain death. Some of these zones are so ancient and so powerful that they have withdrawn entirely from involvement with the outside world, lying isolated and deathly still across countless eras, holding secrets tied to the very origins of the world that even the Nine Heavens Ten Earths does not fully understand.
world.appearance:
The Forbidden Zones are isolated, self-contained territories that exist beyond the ordinary reach of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, sealed off from the rest of the world and shrouded in mystery. They are extremely dangerous, ancient beyond reckoning, and often house terrifying creatures or the unimaginable remnants of past great eras, true dragon pools, tiger nests, and other entities so perilous that even the mightiest experts of the Nine Heavens dare not tread there, as entry frequently means certain death. Some of these zones are so ancient and so powerful that they have withdrawn entirely from involvement with the outside world, lying isolated and deathly still across countless eras, holding secrets tied to the very origins of the world that even the Nine Heavens Ten Earths does not fully understand.

These regions function as self-contained worlds where ancient survivors and remnants of past era withdrew, either out of disillusionment or necessity.

world.title: Foreign Realm
world.introText: The Foreign Realm is one of the most powerful and ancient worlds in existence, standing in contrast to the damaged Nine Heavens Ten Earths. It is described as vastly larger than the Nine Heavens Ten Earths combined, possessing a complete and intact great dao system. Unlike the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, whose natural laws were damaged during ancient catastrophes, the Foreign Realm retains perfect heavenly laws, allowing its cultivators to develop under a far more complete cultivation environment.
world.appearance:
The Foreign Realm is one of the most powerful and ancient worlds in existence, standing in contrast to the damaged Nine Heavens Ten Earths. It is described as vastly larger than the Nine Heavens Ten Earths combined, possessing a complete and intact great dao system. Unlike the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, whose natural laws were damaged during ancient catastrophes, the Foreign Realm retains perfect heavenly laws, allowing its cultivators to develop under a far more complete cultivation environment.

Because of its complete laws, the Foreign Realm possesses an abundance of heaven and earth essence energy. Its rivers and springs contain spiritual energy far beyond ordinary water, while its mountains are filled with ancient medicines and rare treasures. However, these perfect laws also make the realm difficult for outsiders to adapt to. Creatures born in a damaged world, such as the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, cannot easily absorb the Foreign Realm’s natural laws, as forcibly reshaping their bodies with them can cause severe backlash.

The realm's dominant culture is explicitly warlike, prizing individual combat strength and battle accomplishments above nearly all else. Paths of cultivation centered on non-combat pursuits, such as medicine refinement, are looked down upon and comparatively unpopular, even though such practitioners can be extraordinarily powerful. Reputation, especially reputation earned through decisive victories over rivals, carries enormous social weight  public humiliation or defeat, even by proxy through one's underlings or captives, is treated as a matter of significant honor and can provoke entire clans to mobilize in response.
world.history:
This is a world infected with strangeness and unknowns. Their minds have changed, and they believe that the upper world is a demon and are determined to attack them. During the Immortal Ancient Period (the era in which Liu Shen lived), the Upper Realm repelled the Foreign Realm and paid a heavy price. The world was destroyed, the Immortal King fell, and the combat power against the Foreign Realm decreased. Blocked by an abyss, the original imperial city was built by the powers of the upper world to protect it. The ancient and legendary congregation came to guard this city.

The Foreign Realm is an unimaginably vast, ancient, and terrifying world that stands in fundamental opposition to the Nine Heavens Ten Earths and the Immortal Domain. The foreign realm is described as vastly larger than the Nine Heavens Ten Earths  "many times larger... added together. It is a realm born from darkness, shaped by endless war, and inhabited by beings whose existence defies conventional cultivation systems. Throughout history, it has been one of the greatest sources of calamity in the cosmos, driving epoch-spanning conflicts and nearly destroying entire civilizations.

The Foreign Realm is widely believed to be a descendant of primordial darkness, originating from the Land of Darkness near the edge of the Realm Sea. Unlike realms that merely suffered corruption, the Foreign Realm was fundamentally formed and nurtured by darkness itself. Its earliest ancestors were beings eroded by dark matter, who gradually adapted, evolved, and ultimately thrived within it.

Because of this origin, darkness is not viewed as a curse within the Foreign Realm, but as a source of evolution and transcendence. Many of its strongest entities—such as undying kings and ultra-evolved beings—achieved their peak strength precisely because they endured and assimilated this corruption. Over countless eras, this led to the emergence of bloodlines and lifeforms entirely incompatible with the natural Dao systems of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths.

The Foreign Realm itself is said to be many times larger than the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, containing countless territories, burial grounds, secret regions, and ancient battlefields where civilizations rose and fell.

The foreign realm creatures believe that the Nine Heavens Ten Earths were originally their homeland, but that more than half of their lands were forcefully occupied by the creatures of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. From their perspective, they are victims who were driven out by "devils" (the Nine Heavens Ten Earths’ inhabitants). This has led to strong resentment and a belief that the Nine Heavens Ten Earths are filled with demons and enemies, creating a distorted or "twisted" version of history from their point of view .

Brainwashing and Differing Narratives:  Foreign realms descendants are influenced by darkness and have been "corroded" by it. Their memories and beliefs are shaped by this darkness, contributing to a conflicting narrative. They are described as being full of sorrow and grievances, viewing themselves as victims, while considering the Nine Heavens Ten Earths’ people as invaders or devils. This is not just a matter of differing history but also of psychological and spiritual influence from darkness, which may have "brainwashed" or deeply affected their perception.

When people become corrupted by darkness, their primordial spirits and bodies undergo profound changes due to the influence of darkness matter. This corruption results in a loss of their original memories and personalities, causing them to change entirely and become different beings. The darkness matter corrodes their primordial spirits, nurtures their flesh, and produces new primordial spirits that are no longer the same as before. Although their new primordial spirit still belongs to them, it lacks their past memories, fundamentally altering their identity and consciousness .

Becoming a darkness being involves exposure and assimilation of darkness matter, which is a powerful and pervasive force originating from the Land of Darkness. When a person is deeply contaminated by this darkness blood or matter, their body and primordial spirit are transformed. This process can lead to rapid evolution, producing ultra-evolved beings or darkness supreme beings with terrifying power. However, many who undergo this transformation lose their original selves and become cold, cruel, and indifferent, often no longer recognizing their former friends and killing them on sight.

The transition involves a life-and-death challenge within the darkness corrosion, where the primordial spirit may burn and be replaced or altered by darkness flames. This corruption can be so complete that the body rots or changes into a new form sustained by darkness energy. Some beings, like the ultra-evolved darkness creatures, gain immense strength rapidly, far surpassing ordinary cultivators, but at the cost of their original identity.

The Foreign Realm contains many beings who originally came from the Nine Heavens Ten Earths and the Immortal Ancient Era. However, they have been corroded by darkness over time and are no longer the same as they once were. Although their identities, forms, and abilities may appear unchanged, their nature and essence have been fundamentally altered by darkness

Foreign Realm Origin's

Origin Ancient Artifact - There are two of these one in Burial Domain and the other in the Foreign Realm, this was refined by the four dark Half-Immortal Emperor  back in or before the Age of Emperor Collapse. It came into contact with a corpse in Burial Domain and gave it life thus a new primordial spirit[Soul] was born within that individual which henceforth became an Golden Undead Knight and a Burial King, afterwards would reproduce the later generations. In the foreign Realm the opposite happen it came into contact with a normal living person and its spirit also got replace and his power skyrocket into becoming an undying king.

Fyi: To be more Precise the darkness’ corrosion will bring away those creatures’ Original primordial spirits, nurture their flesh, and produce new primordial spirits. This newly produced primordial spirit is still theirs, not another creature coming in and occupying them. It is just that they no longer has their past memories, becoming different from before. The corrosion of darkness sometimes cannot bring away all of one’s soul, there would still be a bit leftover  as such with Meng Tianzheng after being taken by the darkness and spirit replaced if not for him having a ruined spirit, why would had help Shi Hao kill those true immortals?

It is said that  after the Main antagonist the Corpse Immortal Emperor recruited the Four Half Fallen Emperors he instructed them to refined the Origin Ancient Artifact which was intended help him recover from his injuries by farming souls after many Era's at a time via Primordial Spirit[Soul] Imprisonment inside Guidance Ancient Palace[Void Prison] for later usage. The Origins Ancient Artifact would become the main lore and plot throughout the entire series.

world.title: Fufeng City
world.introText: Fufeng City is a town situated in the Fire Province, in the Three Thousand Provinces of the Upper Realm. It stands as an enigmatic locale, bereft of regulations, where crime proliferates and residents dwell in a perpetual state of insecurity.
world.history:
Fufeng City is a town situated in the Fire Province, in the Three Thousand Provinces of the Upper Realm. It stands as an enigmatic locale, bereft of regulations, where crime proliferates and residents dwell in a perpetual state of insecurity.

Upon Shi Hao's arrival in this urban center, he found himself taken aback by the unusual hush that pervaded the assembled throngs, gathered to heed the discourse of select representatives from the Goddess Academy. These individuals sought to enlist fresh talent for their esteemed institution. Among them was Yue Chan in disguise, assuming the alias of Qing Yi.

world.title: Goddess Academy
world.introText: Tianxian Academy, located on the outskirts of a Heavenly Immortal Province, is a renowned and prestigious institution that stands as a beacon of cultivation and knowledge in the Upper Realm. The academy's magnificence is unparalleled, occupying a vast expanse of land that surpasses even the grandest of cities.
world.appearance:
Tianxian Academy, located on the outskirts of a Heavenly Immortal Province, is a renowned and prestigious institution that stands as a beacon of cultivation and knowledge in the Upper Realm. The academy's magnificence is unparalleled, occupying a vast expanse of land that surpasses even the grandest of cities.

Surrounded by ethereal clouds and majestic architecture, Tianxian Academy boasts a breathtaking landscape, adorned with spiritual mountains, cascading waterfalls, and a majestic river running through its grounds. Its reputation extends far and wide, earning it fame across the Three Thousand Provinces, representing the pinnacle of cultivation traditions.

Within the academy, rare treasures and ancient relics are exchanged in bustling markets, attracting cultivators and treasure-seekers from far and wide. The external area of the academy is dotted with satellite cities, forming a vast urban sprawl that rivals even the academy itself in size.

The academy's gates, guarded by twelve colossal stone pillars engraved with auspicious symbols, lead to sacred sites, halls of heavenly teachings, and chambers of enlightenment. It is believed that within these hallowed halls lie the secrets of cultivation passed down through the ages.
Tianxian Academy is not only a center for learning but also a hub of power and influence. Many prominent families send their most talented offspring to study here, hoping to unlock their full potential and attain enlightenment.

The academy is not without its trials, however. Only the most exceptional individuals are granted entry through the legendary Heavenly Stairway, a test of strength, wisdom, and virtue. Those who ascend the stairway become revered disciples, gaining access to the academy's most sacred teachings and rarest treasures.

Intrigue and competition abound within Tianxian Academy, as students vie for recognition, status, and the favor of esteemed masters. Yet, amidst the bustling activity and noble aspirations, there are also whispers of hidden dangers and forbidden knowledge lurking within the academy's depths, tempting those who dare to tread its hallowed grounds.

Overall, Tianxian Academy stands as a bastion of enlightenment and aspiration, drawing seekers of wisdom and power from across the realms to its illustrious halls in pursuit of greatness.
world.history:
After leaving Celestial City, Shi Hao finds himself in the Fufeng City, located in the Fire Province. Here he encounters Yue Chan, who goes by the name Qing Yi, as she recruits new members for the Tianxian Academy. He learns about the existence of the Holy Pool within the academy, housing the Divine Lotus, which could aid him in absorbing the Golden Bodhi Fruit, thus granting him the Magic Power Immunity.

Determined, he presents himself at the Tianxian academy's entrance, confident that he won't be recognized since he has never encountered any Tianxian academy members in the Yuan Tian Secret Realm. However, he is interrupted by an imposing figure referred to as the True Immortal Heritage. Curious, Shi Hao seeks explanations from the guards at the entrance, including Chen Lin, but is ridiculed for his ignorance of the True Immortal Heritage. Rejected, Shi Hao inquires if there is another way to enroll, only to be informed that the sole option is to overcome the trials of the Heavenly Stairway. Only then can he become a disciple of the Tianxian academy and gain access to the Holy Pool, where he can bathe alongside the ten fairies.

world.title: Grand Daoist Temple
world.introText: Grand Daoist Temple is located in many areas as the resting platform that host and protects the contestant body after their spirit leaves for the Spirit Realm. The eight million contestants who needs to qualify for the competition enters the spirit realm but their body cannot be left unattended thus this temple were created.

world.trivia:
Etymology
"巨大" (Jùdà) means "huge" or "vast."

"道场" (dàochǎng) refers to a "Daoist temple" or a "place of Daoist practice and cultivation."

world.title: Great Scarlet Heaven
world.introText: This location is known as Great Scarlet Sky or also called Hate Parting Heaven, a vast and ancient border realm marking the boundary of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. It is a place of ancient city ruins made from immortal bones, surrounded by chaotic energy and malevolent forces. It was once a cultivation holy land but is now a battlefield where formidable foreign creatures from the other shore wage war against the defenders of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. It contains powerful artifacts like the Ten Realms Diagram and the Immortal King Corpse Wrapping Cloth. The border is adjacent to primal chaos and the Desolate Border, which is a critical pass between worlds. Its history is marked by deep regrets and hatred due to ancient wars among true immortals, with the current conflict threatening the fate of the realm
world.history:
The Great Scarlet Sky, also known as Hate-Parting Heaven, is an ancient and expansive domain within the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. Steeped in tragedy, mystery, and immense historical weight, this realm has long stood at the center of cosmic conflict. Its name alone evokes sorrow, hatred, and sacrifice, reflecting the countless calamities that have unfolded across its land.The Great Scarlet Sky lies at the outer border of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, directly adjacent to Primal Chaos. This borderland is filled with ancient remains, rare and twisted lifeforms, and the remnants of what was once a flourishing cultivation holy land. In the present era, it has degenerated into a desolate wasteland of shattered walls, broken terrain, and endless debris—mute testimony to the devastation accumulated over countless ages.At its heart once stood an ancient city constructed entirely from immortal bones, designed as an impregnable pass guarding the realm. This city has long since collapsed, leaving behind a vast and terrifying abyss. Black, endless, and unfathomable, the abyss connects to the heavenly dome and stretches into the boundless unknown, looming over the desert depths like a wound carved into reality itself

The Great Scarlet Sky bears the weight of eternal regret and deep-seated hatred from past epochs. Its original name, Hate-Parting Heaven, originated from the countless True Immortals who perished there. Their skeletons once piled high across the battlefield, embodying the unresolved grievances and fury of ancient beings. Later generations gathered these bones to construct the bone city, transforming tragedy into a final defensive bulwark meant to seal a great crack in the world.Throughout history, the region served as a battlefield for True Immortals and other supreme existences. The repeated devastation turned it into a cursed and restricted zone, feared by later cultivators. Even now, rumors persist of unfathomable secrets and horrors buried beneath its ruins, waiting to awaken.

In recent times, the Great Scarlet Sky has once again become the stage for catastrophic warfare between the forces of the Nine Heavens and foreign invaders from the Other Shore. The domain witnessed a series of apocalyptic events, including the total collapse of the bone city and the complete emergence of the giant abyss.Foreign creatures poured into the region, unleashing indiscriminate slaughter that caused mountains to tremble and the earth itself to split apart. Stars and moons were shattered, rivers dried up, and chaotic energy surged like a raging sea, erasing nearly all traces of the past. Defenders deployed supreme treasures such as the Ten Realms Diagram and the True Dragon Horn in desperate attempts to stem the invasion.Despite these efforts, the invaders ultimately breached multiple strategic defenses, signaling a dire and worsening situation for this ancient realm.

world.title: Heaven Abyss
world.introText: Heaven Abyss is a mysterious barrier of natural law described as a "sea of natural laws" and "power of unmatched judgment." It lies beyond New Imperial Pass on the great desert and serves as the primary force preventing undying beings and undying kings from crossing into the Nine Heavens Ten Earths.
world.appearance:
Heaven Abyss serves a crucial protective function for the Nine Heavens Ten Earths by preventing the passage of undying beings from the foreign side into the realm. It acts as a sea of natural laws and a curse-like barrier with immense power to suppress and corrode undying kings and other unmatched existences attempting to cross it. The abyss is not naturally formed, but rather a reflection of countless unmatched laws and great dao traces, created by the Immortal kings in the ancient past. It is connected to the Immortal Domain and functions as a gathering place of great dao patterns and natural laws, locking down the boundary between realms, Foreign Realm and Nine Heavens and Ten Earths

The abyss inflicts a curse-like effect on undying beings, continuously corroding and suppressing them for many years after they attempt to cross. This effect is powerful enough that even formidable undying kings such as Anlan have suffered severe physical damage — including having portions of their body reduced to bare bone — upon crossing. Despite this, some have dared to challenge Heaven Abyss, paying a tremendous price to force a path through.

Heaven Abyss is also the site of massive battles involving undying kings and supreme beings, where natural laws and divine chains of order interweave to suppress and combat these powerful opponents. The abyss can be temporarily damaged or disrupted during such confrontations, yet it remains a formidable and essential barrier protecting the Nine Heavens Ten Earths from foreign incursion.

Heaven Abyss is an ancient, heavily guarded natural law sea and curse-like boundary, playing a vital role in the defense and stability of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths by preventing undying and supreme beings from crossing over into the realm.Without it the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths could have long been fallen and invaded by the Foreign Realm, due to their world being natural weaker with broken heavenly law.

When Shi Hao Escaped with Shen Ming and San Zang from Foreign Realm and went to another isolated Realm. they traveled through Immortal Domain, Lightning Abyss and near Dam World( Sea Realm) ,  There he  found Willow Deity Branch which guided them to the Original Emperor City (located above Heaven Abyss).  When they arrived and found this place was a battlefield with millions and millions of corpses and unknown just how many beings had died because of war. .Shi Hao had always thought that the city the Desolate Border Seven Kings protected was definitely Imperial Pass. However only when he personally entered Imperial Pass did he sense that the True Emperor was somewhere else.

Later Shen Ming and San Zang reveal the truth about the Legendary City

'The clan who has matchless contributions, glory flowing through their blood, the imperishable imprint pointing at Shi Hao imprint'

“This original Imperial Pass has great power. Even if its size isn’t comparable to the new Emperor City that towers into the heavens, its sturdiness and strength exceeds the latter. It had previously been soaked in the blood of true immortals and undying existences, even undying kings falling on the city walls and immortal kings dying in the city.”

According to legend, in the most glorious era, the most resplendent times, Emperor City was bathed in the divine splendor of the heavens, supporting the fates of all clans. There were heroic guests who frequented from Immortal Domain.

Heaven Abyss's power is directly tied to the True Emperor City and, through it, to Immortal Domain, which helped arrange aspects of its power before severing open contact with the lower realms. Controlling the true Imperial Pass city grants control over Heaven Abyss's suppressive power  this is the central reason the Seven Kings' surviving remnant continues to defend the ancient city at all costs: as long as the city and its last living King endure, Heaven Abyss's power holds, and the foreign undying army is kept from advancing further.

However, this power is finite and has been sustained for endless generations partly through the Kings' self-immolation after death and partly through Immortal Domain's original arrangements both of which are described as running low by the time of the present story. This looming exhaustion is a major reason the city's inhabitants believe a final, decisive battle is imminent.

Outside observers in the Nine Heavens, including the people of New Imperial Pass, are generally unaware of Heaven Abyss's true nature or its dependence on the hidden city  they know only that undying beings and kings do not cross the desert, without understanding why.

world.title: Heaven Mending Pavilion
world.introText: Heaven Mending Pavilion is a pure land of cultivation, desired by many young geniuses of various clans. The sect was created by Wu Tianchong, an expelled member of the Heaven Mending Sect from the upper realm.
world.history:
Heaven Mending Pavilion is a pure land of cultivation, desired by many young geniuses of various clans. The sect was created by Wu Tianchong, an expelled member of the Heaven Mending Sect from the upper realm.

The sect was destroyed in Shi Hao's younger years and then revived after he became emperor of the Stone Country. Five hundred thousand years later, during the cultivation-less years and darkness calamities , Shi Hao stopped by the Three Thousand Provinces (lower realms) on his way to the burial region, only to reminisce on old times. The Three Thousand Provinces was in ruins and empty, and the lower realm was totally destroyed, with only one-tenth of the population remains. The Heaven Mending Pavilion was also in rubbles, long been a thing of past history.

world.title: Heaven Mending Pavilion/Holy Land
world.introText: A small world rich with Divine Aura, this place is a courtyard that holds temples with secrets of the Heaven Mending Sect, mending the sky technique. This is a place only one genius of all geniuses from the lower realm is selected to cultivate and has to officially or verbally join the sect before entering.
world.history:
A small world rich with Divine Aura, this place is a courtyard that holds temples with secrets of the Heaven Mending Sect, mending the sky technique. This is a place only one genius of all geniuses from the lower realm is selected to cultivate and has to officially or verbally join the sect before entering.

Shi Yi was chosen to enter and received personal tutorship from a top master (Shi Yi's Teacher) of the sect. After the destruction of the Heaven Mending Pavilion Shi Yi were seen exiting here with Double Pupils Woman.

world.title: Heaven Mending Sect
world.introText: Heaven Mending Sect, the Lower Realm had the Heaven Mending Pavilion, Three Thousand Provinces had Heaven Mending Sect, while the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths above had Heaven Mending Dao  At the same time, there was also a Sky Severing Dao in the nine heavens above! From pavilion to sect, then to dao, it was just as the names implied!
world.history:
Heaven Mending Sect, the Lower Realm had the Heaven Mending Pavilion, Three Thousand Provinces had Heaven Mending Sect, while the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths above had Heaven Mending Dao  At the same time, there was also a Sky Severing Dao in the nine heavens above! From pavilion to sect, then to dao, it was just as the names implied!

There was a legend in the nine heavens above that Heaven Mending Dao had a type of long life medicine. Perhaps it couldn’t be called a medicine, perhaps an immortal stone, immortal core, but it could mend the heavens, able to nurture all living things.

Heaven Mending Sect overall has a fast growing reputation and been around for over 10,000+ years, it is said that one of the reason they were rooted and steadfast in the upper realm for such a long time was due mostly to their  Heaven Mending Technique an ability that touch up on time and space and others such as Earth Withdrawal great technique a speed technique develop by the human race comparable to the kung peng.

Sky serving sect is a rival of the Heaven Mending Sect as Yue Chan and Witch fought or argue at every and any chances that arise, Both sect tried to win over Shi Hao and Shi Yi in the lower real, in the end both went to Heaven Mending pavilion. In later chapters during the darkness calamities where all sect and clans tired to escape to immortal domain, the requirement was that only the clans and sect with outstanding individuals were able to enter so once again both sect tried to recruit Shi Yi and Shi Hao.  Clans and sects where arranging marriages to recruit talent  Yue chan were send to recruit Shi Hao and witch send to Shi Yi.

world.title: Heavenly Immortal Province
world.introText: One of the Sates in the Three Thousand Provinces of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths in the Upper Realm and is where the Goddess Academy is located.
world.history: One of the Sates in the Three Thousand Provinces of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths in the Upper Realm and is where the Goddess Academy is located.

world.title: Hundred Shattered Mountains
world.introText: That place is an area that made ancient saints shed tears, and it is a place of carnage. Opens once every hundred years. The time is not set in stone, and it is incredibly mysterious. With a  Dao Law suppression which only allowed those under a certain cultivation level to enter it seems to also allowed those that grows in strength inside, without leaving they can exceed that dao law suppression limit as with the likes of the Demonic Cattail Tree.
world.history:
That place is an area that made ancient saints shed tears, and it is a place of carnage. Opens once every hundred years. The time is not set in stone, and it is incredibly mysterious. With a  Dao Law suppression which only allowed those under a certain cultivation level to enter it seems to also allowed those that grows in strength inside, without leaving they can exceed that dao law suppression limit as with the likes of the Demonic Cattail Tree.

A powerful enough individual such as grown up Shi Hao at the Supreme being level and Little Pagoda could easily enter as the law suppression became null, even when the likes of the Fire Emperor a Venerable Realm but battle power of a Divine Flame Realm, he was able to knock back the dao law chains at the entrance when he came to save the geniuses from the monkey king Hu Sun.

The Hundred Shattering Mountains was known as a mountain, but in actuality, it was a small world. After the ancient saints shed tears and blood here, the mountain began to protect itself by pushing out people that could cause huge damage. After so many years, the people concluded that the rejection had something to do with the relationship between age and cultivation.

The Hundred shattered mountain was seal or made by a Powerful Supreme Being from ancient times, thus a complex seal was added and the mountain open once every hundred years.

The mountain had many treasures and wonders inside which included the Little Pagoda who went there to hide and regain its health after being injured also one  of the ten Immortal Spring  from ancient times was also there that were crave by True Immortals, along with a few rare hidden treasure and medicine stalk that even Supreme Being would shed blood for, shi hao only found them deep within the center of the mountains  Sentience Flower, Psychic Flower and  Three stalk rare Holy medicine but the most precious treasure found were one of the six damage Reincarnation disk lost from ancient times, a powerful treasure which now one of each held by Shenyan Samsara and another Master from the upper realm, but all six was originally owned by Six Dao Reincarnation Immortal King.

world.title: Immortal Ancient
world.introText: The Immortal Ancient, a Immortal Dao Flower adorned with 3,000 petals, blooms throughout this era, brimming with unparalleled Natural Luck. Only those below the Venerable Realm can venture into its inner sanctum, as outsiders are barred from entry. Legend foretells that the pinnacle of Natural Luck will manifest only upon the bloom of its 3,000th petal.

world.title: Immortal Domain
world.introText: The Immortal Domain is a realm of incomprehensible scale and power, a boundless territory formed from the merging of countless ancient cosmos into a single, vast expanse. It is a place where the very structure of reality is magnified; what were once independent universes now exist as interconnected starry seas, each governed by its own immortal city.
world.personality:
They have complete laws and the same general environment as the Foreign Lands, which make them suitable for cultivation. However, they rely on their detachment and believe that the upper Realm is infected by the restlessness of a Foreign Land and are unwilling to interact with it. They close the door to the fairy world and would not act if it were not for the life and death of the Upper Realm. There is a road that leads here to paradise, the legendary Imperial Road. All the best experts here go to Jiehai to find a way to become emperor.

Immortal Ancient Great War

During the Immortal Ancient Great Era, the gates of the Immortal Domain remained closed. Even when the Imperial Pass was breached and the armies of darkness invaded, causing the creatures of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths to face near annihilation, the Immortal Domain still refused to open its gates and provide assistance. Only after the situation had already reached its most desperate point did some beings from the Immortal Domain finally take action.

However, by then, the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths had already been devastated, countless lives had been lost, and the outcome of the war had essentially been decided, making their intervention far too late. Furthermore, the cultivators and experts who had participated in that final battle were later forbidden from returning to the Immortal Domain, despite their sacrifices and contributions. Many of these abandoned supreme beings eventually became the masters of the Forbidden Zones beyond the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, isolating themselves from the world and leaving behind a complicated legacy tied to both their past glory and resentment toward the Immortal Domain.

Even after the events of the Immortal Ancient Great Era, the connection between the Immortal Domain and the outside world remained severed. The Immortal Gates were almost always closed, and without their opening, even those who had reached the realm of immortality could not freely enter the Immortal Domain. The separation between the two worlds became an established rule, with the creatures of the Immortal Domain maintaining strict control over access to their realm.

By the era of Shi Hao, this isolation had continued for countless years. When the Immortal Gates  opens again, it became an extremely rare and shocking event, as such occurrences had become almost unheard of after the connection between the worlds was cut.

During the Immortal Ancient Great Era, the gates of the Immortal Domain remained closed. Even when the Imperial Pass was breached and the armies of darkness invaded, causing the creatures of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths to face near annihilation, the Immortal Domain still refused to open its gates and provide assistance. Only after the situation had already reached its most desperate point did some beings from the Immortal Domain finally take action.

However, by then, the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths had already been devastated, countless lives had been lost, and the outcome of the war had essentially been decided, making their intervention far too late. Furthermore, the cultivators and experts who had participated in that final battle were later forbidden from returning to the Immortal Domain, despite their sacrifices and contributions. Many of these abandoned supreme beings eventually became the masters of the Forbidden Zones beyond the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, isolating themselves from the world and leaving behind a complicated legacy tied to both their past glory and resentment toward the Immortal Domain.

Even after the events of the Immortal Ancient Great Era, the connection between the Immortal Domain and the outside world remained severed. The Immortal Gates were almost always closed, and without their opening, even those who had reached the realm of immortality could not freely enter the Immortal Domain. The separation between the two worlds became an established rule, with the creatures of the Immortal Domain maintaining strict control over access to their realm.

By the era of Shi Hao, this isolation had continued for countless years. When the Immortal Gates  opens again, it became an extremely rare and shocking event, as such occurrences had become almost unheard of after the connection between the worlds was cut.
world.trivia:
Endless  years ago, the Immortal Domain was connected to the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, allowing cultivators and powerful beings to freely travel between the two worlds. However, after a series of major events, this connection was severed, cutting off the passage between them. At the same time, the Immortal Domain itself underwent a profound transformation, resulting in significant changes that altered its relationship with the outside world.

The Immortal Domain is formed from countless vast Great universes(Cosmoses) that have gradually merged together to form a single, incomprehensibly large territory. Its scale is so immense that entire universes can exist between individual Immortal Cities, meaning that the distance separating two major cities can span several vast cosmic regions. This makes the Immortal Domain far larger than a conventional universe or world; its Immortal Cities effectively function as vast territorial centers, each overseeing enormous stretches of merged cosmoses. Even powerful cultivators cannot easily traverse these distances by flight, which is why the Immortal Domain relies on large-scale transportation formations within its Immortal Cities to travel between distant regions.

Immortal Cities are colossal beyond the scale of ordinary cities, with some spanning territories comparable to entire cosmic regions. Their sheer size is such that the sun, moon, and countless stars can appear to revolve around them like tiny decorations. The greatest Immortal Cities are built upon enormous ancient continents floating within the cosmos, with their boundaries so vast that their full extent cannot be seen from a single vantage point.

world.title: Imperial Pass
world.introText: The Imperial Pass (帝关, Dì Guān), also known throughout its history as the Desolate Border (边荒, Biānhuāng), is a colossal fortress-city of world-ending significance in the Perfect World. It serves as a massive fortress and the primary defensive stronghold for the inhabitants of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths against invasions from the Foreign Domain. This pass is situated at the Desolate Border, a treacherous and uninhabited region that acts as a buffer zone between the two realms. The structure is depicted as an immense city built from immortal materials, fortified with ancient formations, and guarded by powerful cultivators, making it a symbol of resistance and survival in the face of existential threats
world.appearance: Forged in the chaos of the Immortal Ancient Era, the Imperial Pass was constructed as a bulwark to halt the relentless invasions of the Beings and other supreme entities from the Foreign Realm. Its primary purpose is to seal the connection between the two realms and prevent the corrupting laws and devastating armies of the invaders from sweeping across the Nine Heavens. The Pass is a grim, desolate, and awe-inspiring place, perpetually soaked in the blood of countless cultivators and permeated with the killing intent of ages past. For the inhabitants of the Nine Heavens, it is a symbol of both unending sacrifice and enduring resilience.
world.history: The origins of Desolate Imperial Pass trace back to the aftermath of the Immortal Ancient War, a cataclysmic conflict where the Foreign Domain invaded and destroyed the Immortal Ancient era.

world.title: Land of Darkness
world.introText: The Land of Darkness (黑暗之地, Hēi'àn zhī Dì) is a vast, endless void and boundless dark territory that lies beyond the reach of ordinary cultivation, a place living creatures cannot normally set foot in and survive. It is the ultimate source of darkness matter and the location of the Darkness Prison, where primordial spirits are locked away across the long river of time, likened by those who know of it to a land of reincarnation.
world.appearance:
The Land of Darkness (黑暗之地, Hēi'àn zhī Dì) is a vast, endless void and boundless dark territory that lies beyond the reach of ordinary cultivation, a place living creatures cannot normally set foot in and survive. It is the ultimate source of darkness matter and the location of the Darkness Prison, where primordial spirits are locked away across the long river of time, likened by those who know of it to a land of reincarnation.

Almost nothing about the Land of Darkness is understood by the wider cultivation world. What little is known has been pieced together only through the rare survivor, fragmentary ancient records, and the testimony of beings old enough to have witnessed its workings firsthand — chief among them the Golden-Haired Woman who guards the Guidance Ancient Palace atop the World Tree.

world.title: Lightning Abyss
world.introText: Adjacent to the Dam  World  lies the Lightning Abyss, a perilous and dangerous place on the edge of the Realm Sea. The entire abyss is filled with endless lightning, countless bolts of heavenly lightning descending from the void, continuous and unbroken, as if all the calamities of past eras have converged here. Within the abyss float enormous lightning pools, some ordinary gray pools, others special pools flowing with immortal energy.
world.appearance: Adjacent to the Dam  World  lies the Lightning Abyss, a perilous and dangerous place on the edge of the Realm Sea. The entire abyss is filled with endless lightning, countless bolts of heavenly lightning descending from the void, continuous and unbroken, as if all the calamities of past eras have converged here. Within the abyss float enormous lightning pools, some ordinary gray pools, others special pools flowing with immortal energy.
world.personality:
During the Dharma End Age and Nine Heavens and Ten Earths devoid of Great Dao where everything became Stand Still. Shi  Hao asked the Lord the Restricted life region to send them there.

When Shi Hao was still in the Supreme Realm, he brought members of the Imperial Court here to temper themselves, even placing the three Thunder Spirits within the abyss so that they could absorb the endless lightning and evolve.

As for Mu Qing as he was one with Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique became the best training ground for him

For powerful beings such as the Heavenly Horned Ant and the Crimson Dragon, who were born with innate flaws, the primordial energy contained within the Thunder Abyss offered an opportunity to repair their origins and make up for their deficiencies. Yet every opportunity here comes with the risk of death.
world.history:
The Lightning Abyss was not meant to suppress a single behemoth or demon. Rather, it served as a natural seal and containment vessel for the chaotic heavenly tribulations surging from the collapsing of thousandth of world within Realm Sea and the dissipating primordial source of lightning. Its purpose was to prevent the disordered DAO laws within the Realm Sea from leaking outward and to keep the raging lightning from eroding the outside world through the cracks in the dam.

As the Realm Sea continues to collapse, the shattered Great Dao will transform into endless lightning power flowing outwards. The Thunder Abyss acts as a natural container, imprisoning this out-of-control lightning within, preventing it from transforming into boundless calamities that sweep across all realms. If the abyss's suppression fails, a massive amount of heavenly tribulation will pour out, instantly turning the world near the dam into scorched earth, annihilating countless lives under the endless lightning punishment, and even shattering the very foundations of the Great Dao.

Sealed within these pools is the essence of the Dao of Lightning; each pool, when it erupts, possesses the power to severely injure even a Supreme Being, True Immortals and even Immortal Kings need to be cautious. From time to time, the lightning Pool deep within the abyss erupts without warning, unleashing terrifying torrents of lightning. Ancient slaughter weapons, including the Immortal Slaying Guillotine, are also hidden within the thunderous depths.

The surging lightning resembles ocean waves, evolving into lifelike lightning dragons that roam the abyss, permeated with an aura of destruction. Yet, deep within, a wisp of primordial life force was hidden. Destruction and life coexist contradictorily here. It is precisely because of this unique characteristic that this place can both obliterate the powerful and heal the innate Dao injuries of living beings.

The Lightning Abyss has existed since ancient eras, and that the lightning accumulated here included traces left behind by the great tribulations of civilizations that have long since vanished.

The most frightening feature of the abyss is its Lightning Sea.

The entire abyss is filled with enormous waves of thunder that surge endlessly through the darkness. Occasionally, the lightning condenses into enormous creatures.

The Thunder Spirit Clans Originated from the Lightning Abyss until they moved to Immortal Domain in the wake of the Lightning Emperor who controlled the Heavenly Tribulation anywhere he wanted.

⚡ Lightning Pools

( in the novel) Upon the Lightning Abyss region , Shi Hao was shocked to see as many enormous Lightning Pools Scattered throughout the abyss .

They appeared deceptively calm compared to the surrounding Lightning Sea but this calmness is extremely dangerous and each pool contains the condensed essence of the Dao of Lightning.

There were also 3 grades of Lightning : Earth , Heaven and Immortals.

Although the Lightning  Abyss was extraordinarily dangerous, it was also a rare sacred ground for cultivation and enlightenment.

From time to time, the Thunder Pool deep within the abyss erupts without warning, unleashing terrifying torrents of lightning. Ancient slaughter weapons, including the Immortal-Slaying Guillotine, are also hidden within the thunderous depths. Even beings of the Supreme Realm can lose their lives there.

world.title: Luofu True Valley
world.introText: Luofu True Valley is documented as a major ancient inheritance located in the Higher Realms. Recognized as a powerful and formidable sect whose name has resonated throughout the vast Higher Realms, it is an influential force, particularly in matters concerning the entry trials for the realm known as Immortal Ancient.
world.appearance:
Luofu True Valley is one of the major powers among the Three Thousand Provinces of the Upper Realms they are one of the sect tasked with subduing sinners in the Sin Province.

They decided, along with other factions including Demon Dragon Sect, Fire Cloud Cave, and Sword Valley, to send their weakest Supreme Experts to take the test and gain access to the Immortal Ancient in the Sin Province. This decision aimed to secure more available spots for them, given the weakness of the local inhabitants. However, their misfortune was marked by the intervention of a young man who proclaimed himself the Sin Blood Guardian, preventing anyone from accessing the Supreme Ancient Altar test.
world.history:
During the initial phase of the Immortal Ancient selection, the forces of Luofu True Valley allied themselves with other powerful sects, including the Phantom Drake Dao Gate and the Fire Cloud Cavern. This alliance exerted significant pressure on the participants from Sin Province, notably attempting to usurp entry slots from those identified as possessing the "sinner's blood". This suppression positioned Luofu True Valley as a staunch opponent of the descendants of Sin Province.

The hostility escalated into direct confrontation when Luofu True Valley forces encountered Huang (Shi Hao) in the Spirit Realm trials. The resulting battle was marked by intense fighting. Despite the Valley's power, Huang's devastating abilities led to the rout of their disciples, who were ultimately defeated and forced to flee individually from the contest.

Following the defeat, Luofu True Valley became a prime target for Huang’s escalating vengeance. Huang vowed to locate and dismantle the sect's strongholds. The sect’s leaders were extremely anxious about this threat, openly fearing Huang's intentions to follow through with his promise to eliminate them. As conflicts and chaos continued to escalate in Immortal Ancient, Luofu True Valley remained among the sects dedicated to capturing or killing Huang, often engaging in secret cooperation with other hostile powers.
world.trivia:
Etymology
"罗浮真谷" (Luófú zhēn gǔ) could be translated as the "Luofu True Valley"
"罗浮" (Luofu) refers to Mount Luofu, a mountain in southern China located in the Guangdong Province. It is known for its natural beauty and historical significance, often associated with Taoism and Chinese mythology.

"真" (Zhen) can mean "true," "real," or "authentic."

"谷" (Gu) typically means "valley" or "gorge."

world.title: Nest Realm
world.introText:
Nest Realm one of the many Small Worlds that make up the complex and vast universe of the Immortal Ancient.
Nest Realm, within a primitive forest. The tree leaves above the ground were extremely thick, already gathering several feet, so the ground was rather soft to walk on. The forest carried a decaying aura.
world.appearance:
Nest Realm one of the many Small Worlds that make up the complex and vast universe of the Immortal Ancient.
Nest Realm, within a primitive forest. The tree leaves above the ground were extremely thick, already gathering several feet, so the ground was rather soft to walk on. The forest carried a decaying aura.

Old trees were densely packed, towering into the sky. Lush and flourishing branches formed an enormous expanse of tree shade, many places not receiving any sunlight all year round as a result. Once fruits or other things fell, they would quickly grow mold. Nest Realm, this place obtained its name from being the nest of one of the Archaic Vicious Ten. The death toll was rapidly climbing by the day. It was all because this was the nest of one of the Archaic Vicious Ten, a place that had astronomical natural luck. It made people crazy, all of them flocking over like moths to a flame.

Currently, they were quite deep into the mountain region. Ancient trees covered the sun, enormous vines wrapped around mountains. Beasts roared, ancient birds took to the skies. There was a wild and savage feel to this place. There were quite a few prehistoric creatures. For example, Two-Headed Dragon Bird, Ancestral Crocodile, Sky Swallowing Snail, and others.

Even Shi Hao felt like he had to back off. Some of these creatures’ cultivation levels were terrifyingly high. These were the primitive creatures of Immortal Ancient. They lived in this special region, and normally speaking, wouldn’t leave their respective dwellings, but they wouldn’t tolerate the provocations of others either.

On a mountain that was several hundred zhang tall, not a single blade of grass grew. It was quiet, without sound. There were quite a few spiritual medicines nearby, their fragrance wafting about.
The spiritual essence within Immortal Ancient was just too rich. These medicinal herbs flourished, with medicines that were several tens of thousands of years old appearing quite frequently. This was why there were Holy Medicine that were produced.

world.title: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths
world.introText: In the Perfect World setting, the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (九天十地) are considered part of the Upper Realm. Before the end of the ancient era, the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths comprised a single domain known as the Ancient Kingdom of the Immortals. However, during the war between the upper realm and the foreign lands in the Immortal Era, the continent was divided into nineteen pieces. Since then, this kingdom has been split into two regions: the Nine Heavens and the Ten Earths.

world.title: No Man's Land
world.introText: The No Man's Land, known as the region that opens the doors to men for the Immortal Ancient through the blossoming of the Immortal Dao Flower Bud, is a vast and boundless uninhabited territory. Typically, outsiders do not have access, as it is rich in precious medicines and treasures. It is said to also be rich in immortal material, a precious element that, if found, could ensure the personal attention of the ancient sect masters.
world.history:
The No Man's Land, known as the region that opens the doors to men for the Immortal Ancient through the blossoming of the Immortal Dao Flower Bud, is a vast and boundless uninhabited territory. Typically, outsiders do not have access, as it is rich in precious medicines and treasures. It is said to also be rich in immortal material, a precious element that, if found, could ensure the personal attention of the ancient sect masters.

This place is a veritable paradise for seekers of natural fortune. When Shi Hao arrived there, he did not expect to find more than fifty million people, discovering that the other provinces could accommodate a number greater than the ten thousand allowed by the Sin Province. The No Man's Land is divided into three thousand regions, each delimited by a wall of transparent.

"无" (wú) means "without" or "no."

"人" (rén) means "person" or "people."

"区" (qū) means "area" or "zone."
