world.history:
Palace of Double Pupil is located above the Medicine sect within the Eight Regions (Lower Realm). At the heart of the Medicine Capital was a short mountain, and this place was known as this area’s most sacred place. The ancient medicine god became a deity in this place.

It is rumored that immortal energy swirls underneath the ground and fiery light burns in that place. This was a ‘gate of life’ within this world. The ancient well on the small mountain possessed endless vitality, it was a place where immortal energy surged. This was one of the ‘gates of life’ that were extremely rare in this world.

The palace floats above the short mountain within the clouds over the gate of life that possessed endless vitality and some immortal energy. The palace could be speculated to be some sort of treasure house one that could expand or shrink base on the Perfect world Dao Law method. The Palace is owned by the Double Pupils Woman.

world.title: Pan King City
world.introText: Pan King City (盘王城, Pán Wáng Chéng), also known as Pan King's City or Pan King Immortal City, is one of the oldest and most powerful cities in the Immortal Domain. It is an ancient Immortal King city governed by Pan King, one of the most powerful and ancient Immortal Kings of the Immortal Domain.
world.appearance:
Shi Hao entered Pan King City after arriving in the Immortal Domain.

Shi Hao stayed at the Primal Chaos Inn.

Shi Hao fought Jin Xu, the Nine-Headed Lion descendant, within the Primal Chaos Arena.

Shi Hao defeated numerous experts of the Mortal Dao Domain and obtained large quantities of immortal resources.

Shi Hao's repeated victories caused his reputation to spread throughout Pan King City.

Pan Yi emerged from seclusion and met Shi Hao.

Members of the Aocheng Immortal King Clan arrived in response to Shi Hao's appearance.

Qing Yi arrived in Pan King City after learning that Shi Hao had entered the Immortal Domain.

Ao Gan arrived and confronted Shi Hao over his relationship with Qing Yi and the All Dao Tree.

Qing YI Declared herself As Shi Hao's Woman

The Peaches of Immortality Distinguished Meeting was held in Pan King Manor.

Numerous True Immortals arrived in the city.

Immortal Kings descended upon Pan King City, producing extraordinary heavenly phenomena throughout the surrounding cosmos.

Three Immortal Kings Wanted and attempted to Kill Shi Hao.

Realm Eradication Incense Stick lighted in Immortal Domain.

Mu Qing, Ge Gu and the survivals generals from Nine heavens and Ten Earths took refuge.
world.personality:
The Primal Chaos Arena is a gigantic combat arena located within the Primal Chaos Inn.

The arena is constructed from extraordinary ancient stone and surrounded by enormous stone railings covered in interweaving Dao symbols. These formations protect spectators from the techniques unleashed by the combatants while preventing the arena itself from being destroyed.

The arena is powerful enough to withstand battles between True Immortals.

During his stay in Pan King City, Shi Hao repeatedly fought within the arena, using the battles to obtain large quantities of immortal resources.

He defeated numerous experts from the Mortal Dao Domain in succession, eventually winning eighteen consecutive battles before the fighting was halted.

His actions caused his reputation to spread rapidly throughout Pan King City and attracted the attention of the great immortal clans.
world.history:
Pan King City has existed for countless eras and is closely associated with Pan King, one of the Immortal Domain's oldest and most powerful Immortal Kings.

Pan King is regarded as an unmatched existence who overlooks the Immortal Domain and possesses extraordinary strength. His reputation is such that even the great clans of the Immortal Domain must take his authority seriously.

The city has therefore remained one of the safest and most important strongholds of the Immortal Domain throughout the ages.

world.title: Purple Gold Immortal City
world.introText: Purple Gold Immortal City (紫金城) is an ancient immortal city located within the Immortal Domain. It is one of the many eternally enduring immortal cities scattered throughout the immense territory of the Immortal Domain and serves as both a major stronghold and a transportation hub connecting distant regions.
world.appearance:
Purple Gold Immortal City is situated within one of the vast cosmic regions of the Immortal Domain. The distance separating it from other major immortal cities is extraordinarily large, with entire universes and vast starry regions lying between some cities.

The city itself is surrounded by stars and immersed in chaotic and immortal energy. Its immense structure and ancient foundations make it resemble a permanent cosmic fortress rather than an ordinary city.

world.title: Radiant City
world.introText: The renowned Radiant City stood in the heart of the Radiant Realm, a Small Worlds of unparalleled fame located within the Immortal Ancient. This enchanting city was the hub of trade among visitors from outside the Immortal Ancient, an attraction that had led many of the most influential factions from the Three Thousand Provinces to establish their representations here.
world.history:
The renowned Radiant City stood in the heart of the Radiant Realm, a Small Worlds of unparalleled fame located within the Immortal Ancient. This enchanting city was the hub of trade among visitors from outside the Immortal Ancient, an attraction that had led many of the most influential factions from the Three Thousand Provinces to establish their representations here.

Within these borders, security reigned supreme compared to the outside, as an unspoken pact ensured that any disruptor would inevitably incur the collective wrath of all factions present in the city.

Shi Hao had an appointment with Luo Dao and Lan Yichen in Radiant City, but unaware of its location, he explored various small worlds in search of the city. When he finally arrived, he discovered that his two servants had been hunted down by numerous factions eager to seize the Octadic Treasure Qilin they had found. Shi Hao was seized by fury, not so much for the unique properties of the ingredient, but because it was said to have one of the best flavors.

As Shi Hao sought information on the factions involved, he encountered Lu Yi, a vendor from Radiant City. The latter revealed to him that among the factions hunting Luo Dao and Lan Yichen were the Immortal Palace and the followers of the Divine Dark Child . Despite the city's rules, Shi Hao attacked these two factions without hesitation. However, he faced no consequences as no one dared to oppose such a powerful figure after witnessing his action.

world.title: Sea Realm
world.introText: Realm Sea is a vast, otherworldly ocean formed from the piled-up wreckage of destroyed worlds and universes. It looks like a sea on the surface, but its true nature is far stranger each rising and falling wave contains an entire ruined world within it, remnants of countless civilizations and small realms that have faded from existence since the Age of Emperor Collapse. It's unknown just how many worlds, some nearly as vast as Immortal Domain or the foreign realm, have been reduced to nothing more than part of this sea.
world.history:
Sea Realm or Realm Sea  is a boundless sea with countless islands and small worlds previously with civilization before the darkness. It is connected to Immortal Domain and the Foreign Realm. There are two sections of Sea Realm the outer borders and inner, This sea is extremely special and strange. Moreover, because it varies from person to person, there are some creatures who have traveled for several great eras, yet only made it halfway. Meanwhile, there are creatures who were close to reaching the other side in just a few hundred thousand years via secret paths.” Of course, comparatively speaking, apart from the oddities in the sea, the stronger the creature, the shorter the time!

It was rumored to be where the ultimate mysteries lied, the chance to take a step further in one’s cultivation. Some of history’s most ancient recordings pointed there. If one wanted to become an emperor, perhaps Sea Realm was the final choice. That was why these kings set out, not fearing life and death, one falls, the next follows. Generation after generation of people departed from their respective worlds, crossing this terrifying sea. There was no lack of immortal kings, undying kings and even burial kings among them! They came from different worlds, but their objectives were the same, to become emperors! Even the foreign realm was no exception, to the extent where they were even more moved. All types of signs pointed that their power and their inheritance came from darkness. This meant that they were even more vigorous on this matter, wishing to cross Sea Realm, pay homage to the darkness holy land, wishing to break through and become an emperor! Of course, at this level, undying kings all had their own thoughts. They called it a pilgrimage, but it was really that they wanted to become emperors. They didn’t carry much reverence inside. To put it simply, Sea Realm was the sea of emperor ascension!

From past until now, among those who wanted to cross Sea Realm, ninety percent of them went because they wanted to become emperors. This was the mainstream! Nine Heavens, Immortal Domain, Burial Earth, foreign realm and other places, different civilizations, different clans, there would naturally be a great clash when they encountered each other like this. When this accumulated to a certain degree, there would then be turmoil! Once this type of turmoil spread, it would extend into all realms, the effects widespread and profound, from this erupt into a world shocking bloody battle. This was a struggle between kings, blood flowing at every corner, corpses in the millions and millions. Even worlds with brilliant civilizations would be destroyed one after another. The limits of Sea Realm, there are all types of changes that will take place from time to time. For example, when a storm sweeps about and reaches this side of the sea, even immortal kings could be crushed!. The storm were made from a law power stronger than immortal kings, to be precise its when the Corpse Immortal Emperor who's in recovery takes a small or large breath of exhale once every millions of years, it would cause catastrophic and reputable damage and even the lingering vibration would kill normal kings. Normally  the creatures of Sea Realm would definitely choose to withdraw, return along the path they came from, but sometimes creatures would be lost and fell into darkness due to how difficult it is to navigate a return path. At the very end is where the Five Fallen Emperors exists.
world.trivia: Sea Realm were a boundary within Dam World , Both ware created by the 10 Progenitors Sacrifice to the Dao Realm ( Sacred Ruins Mains Antagonist). They done this to sever  the Great Dao and to prevent new  Half Immortal Emperor and Immortal Emperor to be Born. In the Process they Used Corpse Immortal Emperor breakthrough to turn him into a Darkness Puppet and made him Guard the entrance of the Eerie Plateau.

world.title: Silver Polish Mountain
world.introText: Silver Polish Mountain is located in the Radiant Realm, one of the many Small Worlds that make up the complex and vast universe of the Immortal Ancient.
world.appearance:
Silver Polish Mountain is located in the Radiant Realm, one of the many Small Worlds that make up the complex and vast universe of the Immortal Ancient.

Silver Polish Mountain, a radiant and silvery place, looked like a snow-covered and luminous peak. It was brilliantly white and spectacular. This mountain range, metallic in nature, was primarily composed of pure silver essence. The peaks rose and fell in a wavy panorama. Although it was just simple silver essence, their accumulation created an extremely impressive effect.

At the center of this landscape stood a huge, rather unusual mountain. With its bizarre shape, resembling a millstone, it stood out from the other peaks. This peculiarity gave it its name: Silver Polish Mountain.
world.history:
Lan Yichen used this place as a refuge from the eight experts in the Divine Flame Realm  who were pursuing him to steal the Octadic Treasure Qilin. Thanks to his ability to merge with metals, he easily found shelter in this mountain, but he was unable to escape as the eight experts were lying in wait for him.

As soon as Shi Hao learned of Lan Yichen's location, he hurried to the scene to rescue him. Upon arrival, he found himself facing the eight experts, whom he easily defeated, thus saving Lan Yichen and retrieving the Octadic Treasure Qilin.

Since ancient times a total of Thirty Clans were group as primary and secondary sinners. Stone Clan, Fire Nation and others was class in the primary group with stone bloodline being the most guilty.

The sinners clan were said to have been traitors during the ancient wars and darkness calamity they committed crimes that weren't forgivable, in reality these clan especially the Stone Clan were plotted against by those having contact with the Fallen Ones mainly Wind Clan, Sword Valley etc. The Stone Clan could've  been exonerated of their crimes had the Immortal Palace. Ruined True Immortal and others had come forward to testify but instead stood with the others plot.

It was stated that during the era of the Seven Kings a glories title bestowed on those  clans with matchless contributions given the title of Kings. As long as one was the head of a clan, then they could receive the title of King. As such, in the past, there was the Vermilion Bird King, Human King, Dragon King..Moreover, there were more than one Human King, they were divided into three surnames. There were two or three individuals who were called kings, but now, their clans have most likely been eradicated.

In the past, the title of King was a type of acknowledgment, a type of brilliant inheritance, something obtained with the blessing of all clans.  That is why that type of imprint is a type of glory.the original kings had great divine abilities, received the blessing of all clans, thus forming even more powerful divine abilities. The glory was merged into their bones, forming patterns These patterns were a type of blessing, having immeasurable abilities. When they were completely activated, they could protect the clans’ people. Apart from this, there were other inheritances, as well as unmatched great divine abilities!

During one of the battles some of the leading clans were infected with the darkness, they ask the stone clan and others to behead them. In earlier and later chapters Shi Hao came in contact with a ship drifting throughout the Void for millions of years, in one of the cases he entered a void tunnel due to almost being killed by darkness creatures while cultivating his Immortal Energy Strand  and landed on the black ship, there were huge jars of dark blood and many heads, immortal blood everywhere this was the place the event took place.

Around that era the Three Ruined True Immortals from Immortal Palace, Sword Valley, and Demon Dragon Sect had just killed the Kun Peng after colluding with the Foreign Land, and that when they decided to twist the truth, many expected Immortal palace to defend stone clan but after colluding and killing the kun peng their decision was already made.
Some of the sinners were wipe out  and the rest group together in one provinces that came to be known as Sin Province Later on a group of clans and sects more than ten were put in place to  suppress and oversee them. Those clans were Demon Dragon Sect, Fire Cloud Cavern, Luofu True Valley, sword valley and others. The reasons why they weren't all wipe out was because the overseers weren't sure if the  The New Seven Kings from the Old Imperial pass from desolate boarder were still alive and afraid one day they would return and if such was the case and they went too far they would all be annihilated

During the ancient turmoil, three Immortal Kings AoCheng King (related to Immortal Palace) , Taishi King and Yanchu King attacked Sin Province because they wanted to suppress one the Kun Peng King who killed some of there people infected by Darkness . One of them used a massive hand imprint to tear away a portion of Sin Province and that fell into the Eight Regions. Their goal was to suppress the descendants of the sinners, seize their ancestral guardian spirit , strip away their natural luck and there strong Core Inheritance. To protect the people, Liu Shen (Willow Deity) confronted the attack. However, because she had already been gravely weakened from previous battles and under going Nirvana, she could not stop the Immortal Kings completely. Instead, she opened a passage to the Lower Realm, allowing the survivors to go down , avoid their complete bloodline annihilation and herself to escape, where she later took root in Stone Village.

The Void God Realm and the Spirit Realm were  separated by a  Giant Golden gate and either side could interact or enter the other side without force entries or specific clearance from the overseers of each realm. The spirit realm also corresponded with the real world aka three thousand provinces so the geographic locations are vast with many provinces.

This world was built for the purpose of training the next generations, even heavenly deities enters there, But your real body is not really here, and it is only the will of your Primordial spirit that is here. And this is precisely the mysterious aspect of the spirit realm, and it is also where its value lies. When your spirit is trained here, upon returning to the real world, it will bring all that the spirit has learned back into its flesh, transforming itself together. It's the same as if your real body trained here.

On the flip  side or things it also hold some dangers, those that  received serious injuries in Spirit Realm with specific treasure for example a Soul Shattering Needles one primordial spirit will die or after they returned, their foundational energies received great damage.  Even a powerful Heavenly Deity were killed by shi hao inside the spirit realm using those needles.

Etymology

world.history:
Stone Village, nestled within a vast mountain range, lay in the heart of the Stone Country, within the Eight Regions (Lower Realm). Surrounded by towering peaks and deep ravines, the landscape was dominated by an endless succession of majestic mountains. Despite its modest size, the community of Stone Village boasted around three hundred inhabitants of various ages and genders, residing in dwellings constructed from imposing blocks of stone, simple and in harmony with the surrounding environment.

The surrounding mountains represented an extremely hostile environment, populated by wild and dangerous creatures, both animal and avian. Every hunting expedition was inherently linked to mortal risk, making food an extremely precious resource that could not be squandered. From a tender age, every child was instructed on the vital importance of food preservation and the necessity of facing the challenges of survival in such a hostile environment. Hunger, hunting, life, and blood were concepts indissolubly linked in the mindset of the inhabitants.

Preferring to avoid venturing into the mountains, considered places of sacrifice and imminent danger, the inhabitants found security in their village protected by a guardian spirit, Liu Shen, a tree struck by lightning many years before. This tree, once mighty and vigorous, had been reduced to a stump a few meters high after the celestial impact, but still represented a form of protection and guidance for the community.

The village was animated by a lively community, led by influential figures like the village headman Shi Yunfeng, a middle-aged man of imposing stature and proud spirit, dedicated to the welfare and education of the village youth. Among these youths stood out Shi Hao, a child raised among the village inhabitants after being abandoned by a young couple (Mother: Qin Yining; Father: Shi Ziling) in search of a cure for his infantile wounds. Years passed, and the child grew, at the age of about 1 or 2 years. After learning to walk for just a few months, he had already begun training with all the others. Of course, he went alone and mingled with the older children, and it was clear that he should not have appeared in that group.

The villagers, clad in the hides of fierce beasts and endowed with powerful musculature, approached every expedition with a silent prayer to the guardian spirit, seeking protection and safety for those venturing into the wild lands in search of food and resources.
world.trivia: After dealing with all four forces that attacked Stone Village, the willow left a message for the villagers to prepare because  a great calamity was approaching.

world.title: Supreme Ancient Altar
world.introText: Supreme Being Ancient Altar located in upper realm Three Thousand Provinces inside the Spirit Realm  and there several areas during the Immortal Ancient trial the altar were found. They would be place at the final trial as a prize. Victory and defeat would be decided in one go there.
world.appearance:
It had been over eighty thousand years since someone managed to ascend to the ninth level of the Supreme Ancient Altar before Shi Hao, but this didn't mean that this date coincided with the last person who succeeded in obtaining the Supreme Elixir, as due to the pressure of the ninth level, many people collapsed before reaching the stone bowl.

Etymology
"至尊" (zhì zūn) means "supreme" or "utmost reverence," indicating the highest level of respect or honor.

"古" (gǔ) translates to "ancient," denoting something old or from a distant past.

"坛" (tán) refers to an "altar," typically used for religious or ceremonial purposes.
world.history:
Supreme Being Ancient Altar located in upper realm Three Thousand Provinces inside the Spirit Realm  and there several areas during the Immortal Ancient trial the altar were found. They would be place at the final trial as a prize. Victory and defeat would be decided in one go there.

The Supreme Ancient Altar consists of nine levels, with the pressure exponentially increasing at each level. Surpassing these levels is extremely challenging. During the trials that would allow ten thousand individuals to access the Immortal Ancient out of eight million, those who reached the third level would have been assured their inclusion among these select few, as it was practically impossible for more than ten thousand people to ascend so high.

Shi Hao effortlessly surpassed the initial eight levels but began to feel the pressure as he ascended to the eighth level, setting a record that had not been broken for thirty thousand years. He persevered until the ninth level, the pinnacle of the altar, an achievement unmatched for eighty thousand years. Here, a shimmering ancient monument appeared, a glorious divine stele. Those who reached the ninth layer of the altar could engrave their own name upon it. Shi Hao decided to inscribe the symbol of Sin, declaring that it represents honor, merit, and accomplishments, as well as glory, and that eventually the truth will come to light. The stone monument bore the names of extraordinary experts from ancient epochs, some of whom had already become giants in their respective fields, while others had remained buried for hundreds of thousands of years.

The pressure in the ninth layer was many times greater than in the previous ones. Even an individual with a robust constitution like Shi Hao could feel his bones resonating and vibrating. Shi Hao approached the stone bowl containing the Supreme Elixir, but at that moment, another stone stele appeared. Although others had reached the ninth layer of the altar, they had failed to reach this point, ultimately collapsing in regret. However, Shi Hao succeeded, arriving directly at the central region. As soon as he obtained the Supreme Elixir, inscriptions appeared warning the possessor that they would not be able to return in the future to obtain a second bowl, as this was a unique opportunity.

world.history:

They decided, along with other factions including Demon Dragon Sect, Luofu True Valley, and Fire Cloud Cave, to send their weakest Supreme Experts to take the test and gain access to the Immortal Ancient in the Sin Province. world.title: Three Thousand Provinces
world.introText: The Upper Realm is a vast territory divided into Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, one of these ten Earths being the Three Thousand Provinces (三千道州), a realm that has been divided into three thousand provinces, each of which represents a significant portion of territory, larger than the combined lower realms.
world.history:
The Upper Realm is a vast territory divided into Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, one of these ten Earths being the Three Thousand Provinces (三千道州), a realm that has been divided into three thousand provinces, each of which represents a significant portion of territory, larger than the combined lower realms.

The laws of heaven and earth in the Upper Realm are more potent than those of the lower realms, bestowing upon those who reside there greater combat power. The geographical vastness of the Upper Realm is immense. The laws here are incomplete, but their strength is remarkable.

The territory is so vast that many people might spend their entire lives without ever leaving their hometown, and many might never travel through neighboring states. In addition to the states, there are also prefectures covering extensive areas, further contributing to the complexity and immensity of the Upper Realm.

world.title: True Emperor City
world.introText: The city Shi Hao discovers is the original, true Imperial Pass, the actual site the legendary Desolate Border Seven Kings once protected. What's called "Imperial Pass" in the current era (New Imperial Pass) is actually a replacement city built later, after the original was cut off and abandoned as a forward bridgehead during a war so severe that it was trapped by an unmatched sealing formation reaching into the heavens.
world.appearance:
The city Shi Hao discovers is the original, true Imperial Pass, the actual site the legendary Desolate Border Seven Kings once protected. What's called "Imperial Pass" in the current era (New Imperial Pass) is actually a replacement city built later, after the original was cut off and abandoned as a forward bridgehead during a war so severe that it was trapped by an unmatched sealing formation reaching into the heavens.

It sits on a floating island/continent, smaller in scale than New Imperial Pass, but far older and more "battle-tested"

It's located above Heaven Abyss, near where the Lightning Abyss and the great desert converge

Only true immortals can approach or enter it, Shi Hao himself only gets in because of his bloodline connection

A realm separation wall surrounds the whole floating landmass, impenetrable even to the Golden Undead Knights' abilities

In its most brilliant era, the city was "bathed in divine splendor," hosting honored guests from Immortal Domain itself. This was the age of the original King Clans, not just seven kings, but many more, including the Vermilion Bird King, multiple Human Kings (three surnames), the Dragon King, and others. Being named "King" was a formal title bestowed by the collective clans for matchless contribution, and it came with:

A physical glorious imprint/pattern on the bearer's forehead, a blessing containing immeasurable protective power

Access to the clan's divine treasury, the highest extreme arts and inheritances

The imprint being possibly the source of unique bloodline talents (Shi Hao speculates this explains his own Supreme Being Bones and Shi Yi's dual pupils)

The original kings eventually died out over enormous stretches of time (measured by the undead knights in half-great-eras), and successors inherited the King titles, this is likely why there's ambiguity about whether the "Seven Kings" Shi Hao heard of on the black ancient ship were the originals or later generations.
world.personality:
As Anlan advanced across the great desert toward the center of Heaven Abyss, the imperial bell of his war chariot tolled, and in response the true Emperor City itself rose into the sky above the battlefield, casting a shadow that covered the sun. Imperial Pass' elders recognized it immediately as "the legendary true Emperor City," a place spoken of only in legend up to that point. The city shone with immortal light and dao symbols, powerful enough to "shake the past, present, and future" yet even at full power, it could not stop Anlan. He reached out a single hand and simply held the entire city at bay, an act of such overwhelming strength that the city's full defensive light poured down on his palm without forcing it back even slightly.

With the city unable to repel Anlan by force, the sole surviving King of the original Seven Kings already withered and dying exerted the last of his strength to funnel Heaven Abyss's most powerful natural law force directly at Anlan, in an attempt to halt his advance. Shi Hao, watching from Imperial Pass' walls, recognized what was happening and felt the pain of it directly, knowing the "weak and old" king was sacrificing everything he had left.

Simultaneously, the city's remaining elders  including the single-armed elder who had earlier sheltered Shi Hao — made a desperate, coordinated final act: gathering the restrained bone-flames of bound undying creatures sealed beneath the city, they hurled themselves directly at Anlan's supporting hand like "moths into a flame," hoping the combined detonation would break his grip. The rescued children of the city, now watching helplessly from Imperial Pass' walls (having sensed the danger and begged to be brought to see it), watched their guardians die in a spray of blood-colored fireworks  the elders' bodies and the borrowed undying bone-flames both consumed in the blast — without moving Anlan's hand in the slightest.

Anlan then manifested five undying king "decrees" behind him representing the sealed, imprinted power of other undying kings who could not risk direct exposure to Heaven Abyss themselves and together with his own hand, struck at the sky dome above the city. The resulting confrontation was described as being beyond what "normal people could understand," shaking the long river of time and briefly bringing the entire battlefield to a frozen standstill: Anlan's hand immobile, the five decrees locked in place, and the beam of light at the heart of the ancient city similarly frozen, as though the world itself had paused. Everyone present understood this deadlock was temporary and that "when that time came, the world itself would crumble."

This standoff was broken by the unrelated arrival of the mysterious expert through a rupture in the long river of time, during which Anlan briefly disengaged from directly supporting the city to confront the newcomer.During this period the city remained suspended but unattended, its fate paused while the two unrelated time-displaced combatants fought and eventually parted ways.

Following the mysterious expert's departure, Shi Hao  empowered by the sudden activation of the Embodiment Transformation Great Method — engaged Anlan directly, at one point forcing Anlan to release his supporting hand from beneath the city entirely, as the pressure of fighting three simultaneous embodiments left him unable to maintain his grip. The undying king Shutuo was forced to personally support the ancient city and resist Heaven Abyss in Anlan's place during this period, sustaining corrosive damage to his own arm in the process.

As Shi Hao's three-bodied assault drove Anlan into a critical, near-fatal state — at one point removing his head and nearly refining him inside the great cauldron and nine-layered pagoda Heaven Abyss itself began to buckle under the accumulated strain of the battle. In its final act, the shattered original Emperor City, together with the spirit of its last King, made the deliberate choice to "destroy indiscriminately": detonating itself entirely to trigger a full collapse of Heaven Abyss's sealed power, dragging both Anlan and Shutuo down with it rather than allow the city's fall to be for nothing.

This resulted in Heaven Abyss erupting into a churning, blood-red sea of natural law energy, which submerged and severely corroded both undying kings — Anlan's arm was reduced to bare bone, and Shutuo suffered comparable damage while rendering the passage impassable to undying beings for an estimated several hundred years. The original Emperor City itself was consumed in this final explosion, ending its unbroken, generations-long defense of Desolate Border.

In the aftermath, as Shi Hao stood alone before the ruined Heaven Abyss, he witnessed the city's remnants still burning within the collapsed sea of natural laws  the last king's indistinct figure seated within it, chanting sutras, growing dimmer until it vanished entirely.

The city's own war-cries and the shouts of its undying heroic spirits could still faintly be heard rising from the flames one final time before fading "like smoke into thin air." The rescued children on Imperial Pass' walls, watching this final scene, understood it as absolute: the city that raised them, and every remaining clansman inside it, was gone. As their creed had always held "as long as the city still stood, the people would remain; when the city fell, then the people went down with it"  that promise was now fulfilled in full, and the legend of the Kings came to its permanent end.

Imperial Pass' cultivators noted afterward that the true Emperor City had, for the entire duration of its existence, always stood as the very front line holding back the foreign army; without it, "the great army would have invaded a long time ago." Having endured for as long as it did was, in their own words, "already not easy," and its fall was accepted as the closing chapter of an entire age.
world.history:
The True Emperor City  also known as the Original Imperial Pass, was the birthplace of countless legends. Since time immemorial, every unrivaled genius and supreme existence who had shaken the heavens engraved their names upon its ancient walls with their own blood.  The inhabitants had unmatched merits and extraordinary powerful inheritance engraved in through there flesh, bloods. bones and eyes.

During its golden age, the True Emperor City stood as the heart of the myriad worlds. Its prosperity surpassed the imagination of ordinary beings. Immortals, Immortal Kings, and even reclusive ancient ancestors from the Immortal Domain crossed boundless realms to gather there. They exchanged supreme treasures, debated the Great Dao, comprehended profound heavenly laws, and forged alliances.

The True Emperor City was guarded by Seven Immortal Kings and with the Immortal Domain who did want to be tainted with Darkness corrosion. Together they joined forces to establish the Heavenly Abyss, an insurmountable barrier separating the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths from the Foreign Realm. Within its endless depths, they carved countless peerless immortal formations and supreme killing arrays.

These formations intertwined with the laws of heaven and earth, creating an eternal fortress that even a Foreign Realm Undying/Undying King could not cross by force. Any invader who dared set foot within the Heavenly Abyss would face the wrath of the Seven Kings and the countless immortal arrays.
world.trivia: The movie Nine Tribulations Burning the Heavens featured The True Emperor City and Heaven Abyss.

Void God Realm was a Prison for convicted Immortal King Primordial Spirit and it had the  same function as its Counterpart Darkness Prison. It was guarded and administrated  by two powerful immortal King Number Two Under Heaven and Ecliptic Immortal Gold that had casted forgotten spell on themselves to avoid any unfortunate problem from happening.

Immortal King Primordial Spirits that could not be completely destroyed.

Immortal Kings who had been corrupted, tainted, or consumed by darkness.

Powerful prisoners sealed away because killing them outright was impossible or too dangerous.

Bird Grandpa and Coin Uncle memories started to return after there true bodies were in contact with Shi Hao in the Upper Realm, After the Border War with their help Void God Realm would become a harsh Training Ground for Shi Hao's Supreme Being, his Disciple Ge Gu and the True Emperor City children's ascension.

Void God Realm Prison was also place where the most Precious Immortal Technique and Inheritance were being kept the True Phoenix Treasure Technique. Even People from Immortal Domain were coveting this technique and clashing with Shi Hao, Bird Grandpa and Coin Uncle.

The Void God Realm is a magnificent place located in the eight regions of the Lower realm, though grand and profound it is much smaller than the Upper Spirit Realm. It was said to be less realistic as well, this was due to the natural dao law in the lower realms being incomplete.

The Void God Realm is a realm of profound mystique and ancient grandeur, shrouded in the echoes of forgotten gods and primordial beings. It exists as a desolate expanse, where crumbling ruins bear witness to the passage of time and the remnants of once-majestic palaces lay in ruins amidst debris.

Within this ethereal domain, an aura of antiquity permeates the air, evoking a sense of awe and reverence. It is a place where time seems to stand still, yet whispers of ancient events resonate through its empty corridors.

At the heart of the Void God Realm lies a profound paradox—a merging of the spiritual and the material, where the boundaries between reality and illusion blur. Here, one's spirit traverses vast expanses while the physical body remains elsewhere, a testament to the realm's enigmatic nature.

Amidst the desolation, the realm teems with hidden mysteries and untold secrets waiting to be unraveled. Legends speak of a great upheaval that shattered its once-glorious civilization, leaving behind only remnants and ruins as a testament to its former glory.

Yet, despite its desolation, the Void God Realm remains a sacred ground for spiritual cultivation and enlightenment. Here, beings from distant realms converge, drawn by the allure of its mysteries and the promise of transcendence.

Within its bounds, time seems to flow differently, and the laws of the physical world bend to the will of the spiritual. It is a realm where one's spirit undergoes metamorphosis, emerging stronger and more attuned to the mysteries of existence.
world.history:
The Willow Deity opened a passage in the sky and was transported together with Shi Hao. Upon arriving there Shi Hao found himself surrounded by a hazy fog, and it was as if the primitive chaos were looming around him, after moving ahead the fog dispersed, and the scene gradually became spacious and empty, and seemed incomparably desolate and ancient, as if it were a piece of an abandoned world.

Everywhere Shi Hao could only see a desolate area. There was wreckage around it, and the once magnificent palaces were completely destroyed, and there was an ancient and distant aura, as if everything had changed over time.

This place was Void God Realm. And according to the Willow Deity there was a rumor that this was the world into which one entered after becoming God. But there were also other people claiming that the supreme beings that the early natives worshiped - the Gods, combined their efforts and used the thoughts of their minds to build this strange world.

This world was built for the purpose of training the next generations. But your real body is not really here, and it is only the will of your spirit that is here. And this is precisely the mysterious aspect of Void God Realm, and it is also where its value lies. When your spirit is trained here, upon returning to the real world, it will bring all that the spirit has learned back into its flesh, transforming itself together. It's the same as if your real body trained here.

Its true roots, branches, and leaves are said to be large enough to physically support stars and stellar rivers, and its branches extend into many of the realm's lands, releasing the richest concentrations of heaven and earth essence energy wherever they reach. It also serves as the formal channel through which the realm's undying kings issue binding decrees.

characters.title: Ancient Shi Hao
characters.introText: The Ancient Shi Hao was a manifestation of Shi Hao that emerged as one of the ominous events that happened to those who didn't follow the conventional path in their journey towards the Divine Flame, in the Immortal Ancient.
characters.appearance: He bore the semblance of Shi Hao, albeit with features weathered by time. Clad in the ancient garb of the immortals, he exuded an aura both ancient and majestic, lending him an ominous air. Shi Hao sensed there might be a karmic bond between them; were it not for the fact that the man's eyes had turned ashen gray, their temperaments would have been remarkably alike.
characters.history:
When Shi Hao resolved to continue his arduous journey, searing his body with further Dao flames, the Void Sky Divine Vine warned him that anyone undertaking an unconventional path towards the divine flame would encounter strange changes, as had happened to his predecessors in Immortal Ancient. But Shi Hao paid no heed; he would face whatever came as he always had. When he managed to channel a thousand flames, he was engulfed by a dense mist and assailed by a colossal Scarlet Eye; yet, Shi Hao overcame this event and pressed on with his process, until he reached fifteen hundred flames.

Instantly, the air froze, and a figure emerged on the horizon, approaching with strides that resonated like the beat of a divine drum, a rhythm that pierced the hearts of onlookers. If it had been an ordinary individual who had just attained divinity, faced with such occurrences, they would probably have coughed up blood and fled without hesitation. But this figure seemed like a fusion of heaven and earth, exuding an aura of terrifying power. It approached slowly, employing the Earth-in-Inches Technique, now only a hundred zhang away, shrouded in a gray mist that concealed its true form. Only a pair of eyes peered through the gray mists, emitting a cold luminance, with no visible pupils, just a gleaming silver iris.

Shi Hao couldn't fathom these strange changes. Despite feeling a certain fear, he still wished to understand what was happening. He attempted to address the figure, but all was in vain; he received no response, and the creature's eyes became even more unsettling. The humanoid figure in the gray mist was extraordinarily impassive, devoid of any sense of life but with a constant intimidating pressure. As its right arm moved, a portion of the gray mist dispersed, revealing its weapon: an ancient spear mottled with green rust, laden with the aura of time.

Shi Hao observed that spear, feeling his mind stir. That weapon was clearly ancient, with a presence suggesting an origin far more remote than any artifact he had ever seen before, as if it had existed forever since ancient times.

An intense conflict erupted between the two, starting with halberd strikes that relied solely on their physical strength. Shi Hao found himself facing a formidable opponent, capable of matching his physical prowess. Both began to bleed from their hands due to the powerful impacts of their halberds, but Shi Hao was astonished to see that the creature's blood was of a dark black color. They fought fiercely at close quarters, moving with the speed of lightning, so fast that they eluded the gaze of onlookers. Only the sound of their weapons clashing was audible, with sparks flying from the collisions between the two halberds.

Shi Hao decided to employ the Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique, but his opponent not only managed to easily counter the lightning but also wielded the same technique, with the only difference being that the lightning was black. Shortly after, Shi Hao used his Kun Peng Technique, but his opponent also employed the same precious technique. Immediately after, they exchanged two thousand moves. His body was dripping blood, exhausted, and his strength depleted. Shi Hao was now embroiled in a bitter struggle between life and death. His mind was shaken, finding it difficult to calm down. Now, he was certain that the other individual had mastered the Lightning Emperor's precious technique, as well as the Kun Peng technique, and his proficiency in them was no weaker than his own!

Shi Hao thought that no matter what technique he used, his opponent would be able to instantly copy and master it. Therefore, he decided to employ the power of his Supreme Bone, but was astonished to see that the runes of reincarnation power also appeared on his opponent. The reincarnation magic the entity executed was different from Shi Hao's: dark and terrifying, emanating a cold black light. No one understood the magic of reincarnation better than Shi Hao, knowing its terrifying nature and the difficulty in confronting it, but he also knew how to deal with it.

Shi Hao reacted promptly, using Magic Power Immunity to protect his body and prevent the Reincarnation Treasure Technique from affecting him. At the same time, he utilized the inscriptions on his bones to slowly disintegrate the opposing energy. This dual strategy worked, directly blocking the attack of the Reincarnation Treasure Technique. In the next moment, Shi Hao activated the true essence of his runes, which transformed into a divine sword to suppress the enemy.

When the enemy was slain, the mist dispersed, and Shi Hao was able to see the appearance of that person; it was very similar to his own, except for the clothing and the aged look. Seeing this, Shi Hao felt a sense of desolation in his heart. Was his previous life that of an old man who met a tragic end in the ancient immortal era? Shi Hao couldn't believe that if he truly had a past life, it would be so pathetic. An old man with gray, disheveled hair, with black blood flowing over his body, was killed by a younger self with the same appearance. Shi Hao was confused. He thought too much about reincarnation, the previous era, and then the shocking world. Suddenly, Shi Hao became vigilant. He felt that his mood had been influenced by an inexplicable force. He was determined and unyielding. According to common sense, he would never be disturbed.

characters.introText: Her true name is Yue Chan, utilizing a secret technique by separating her Dao Core into two, thereby giving life to two entirely identical entities. The first of them chose to dedicate itself to cultivation in the Upper Realm, emerging as the most powerful of the two and hence considered the main body. Meanwhile, the second embarked on a journey to accumulate valuable experiences.
characters.appearance:
Qing Yi is gentle and loves to smile, and there is always a faint smile on her flawless face. She has a good temper, is as gentle as water, calm and peaceful, bright and brilliant, confident and calm, cautious and meticulous, shady, and thin-skinned when it comes to love affairs between men and women.
Qing Yi is the purest creature in the world. Her dark eyebrows are curved, her eyes are extremely smart, like mist, blurred and moving, her red lips are beautiful, and her black hair is loose, she is extremely beautiful and graceful. Her body is full of fragrance, her temperament is so holy that people can't bear to blaspheme, and people want to get close but can't bear to get close. Her smile is bright and bright, ethereal and friendly, making people feel like they are bathed in the spring breeze, and her moving brilliance can eclipse the sun and the moon.
characters.history:
Qing Yi is the second body of Yue Chan. Yue Chan was born in the Three Thousand Provinces, one of the Ten Lands, with extraordinary signs in the sky. Being a congenital Dao fetus, she became the Saintess of the Butian Sect and was sent to the mortal realm for cultivation from a young age. She practiced the primary and secondary body techniques, dividing her divine fetus into two parts: the main body and the secondary body. The main body focused on cultivation, while the secondary body traveled the mortal world.

Divine Signs at Birth
When Qing Yi was born, a multitude of auspicious signs manifested. Radiant lights soared into the sky, celestial stars shimmered in her honor, and even the sun dimmed in comparison. This spectacle caused a sensation in the upper realms, leading to her being recognized as the Holy Maiden of the Heaven Mending Sect. At the moment of Qing Yi's birth, Shi Hao's mother, Qin Yining, went to visit her at the Heaven Mending Sect.

Early Life
As the Holy Maiden of the Heaven Mending Sect in the upper realms, Qing Yi's birth was accompanied by the detection of an inexplicable power within her divine consciousness. A prominent figure sealed this power, gradually unlocking it as Qing Yi grew older. From a young age, she was sent to the lower realms, traversing the Eight Realms, to temper herself and cultivate her Dao.
Most members of the Heaven Mending Sect in the lower realms were from the Eight Realms, and they only knew of Qing Yi's high status, revering her as the Holy Maiden without understanding the specific circumstances. Qing Yi, immersed in the mortal world, journeyed through the realms of Heaven, Earth, Mysteriousness, Yellow, Universe, Vastness, Flood, and Desolation. She sought opportunities, explored ancient ruins and sacred places, enhanced her own cultivation, and immersed herself in the diverse cultures of the Eight Realms. Encountering talented young heroes, she sincerely recruited them into the Heaven Mending Sect.

characters.history:
His parents left him on Stone Village while they were searching for medicine to cure him. When they left him, he looked like he was just a few months old due to his weak body, but he was a 1-year-old boy. His parents took care of him in the village for a while until they were sure that he wouldn't die, after that they left.

Since then, Shi Hao grew up in the Stone Village, all of the people in the village loves and considers him as their blood-relative.
characters.trivia:
In his advance to the Heavenly Passage Realm, he advanced simultaneously the first three levels being instantly promoted to the Heavenly Passage’s mid-stage.

Shi Hao was dead for a year and 3 months altogether.

Because his first Supreme Being Bone was taken away from him, his second Supreme Being Bone had the mysteries of Reincarnation in it, and it’s because of that, that when he decided to self Implode and kill Huang Yu it instead brought him a great chance and allowed him to experience death and reincarnation.

He gave his second Supreme Being Bone to his brother Qin Hao.

The mysterious Five-Colored Sparrow that Shi Hao used to chase around while he was young, and then when Shi Hao planted precious medicine in Stone Village stole some to make a nest, is what allowed Shi Hao to experience reincarnation by using Yin-Yang land and Undecaying Grass.

During his advancement through Divine Flame Realm he had to repeatedly fight a mysterious ghostly energy, which at one point resembled Shi Hao himself who seemed confused at his defeat and death. The sect master level people know what is this energy. It also seems that “that step” into immortality always brings about these ghostly apparitions.

It took the burning of the 3,000 bluestone paths dao, killing Fallen Divine Child and absorbing his initial stage immortal dao strand, and cultivating with the immortal bones absorbing their radiance for Shi Hao to fully develop his first strand of Immortal Energy.

Shi Hao is not the first to try and use the 10,000 dao to ignite the true self, as the long lived White Tortoise Carrying Immortal informed him, it was in fact the Little Immortal King.

Shi Hao has died several times, totaling up to 11 so far.

The author never mentions Shi Hao entering Divine Flame Realm Late-stage, and instead mentions Shi Hao being “at the peak of his cultivation realm” a couple of times, then directly advancing into True Deity Realm.

In his advancement to the True Deity realm, he went straight to the middle stages because he had saved up his energy which he could use to break through so he could cultivate Immortal strands.

Reincarnation Imprint: 10

In "Holy Ruins," it is mentioned that Shi Hao has two sons. The first son is attributed to Yun Xi, while the parentage of the second is not explicitly specified. However, considering the context in which Yun Xi and Yue Chan, the other two wives of Shi Hao, were sealed due to their limited cultivation, it is plausible that the second son was born to Huo Ling'er. This hypothesis is supported by the fact that when Huo Ling'er became aware of Shi Hao's paternity regarding Yun Xi, she was deeply disturbed because if she had not been kidnapped, she presumably would have been the one to give birth to his eldest child. Furthermore, it should be considered that due to Shi Hao's high level of cultivation, conceiving a child was extremely difficult; for example, the gestation period of Shi Fan lasted nine years, during which Shi Hao's cultivation level was significantly lower than when he conceived the second child. Given the limited cultivation of Yun Xi and Yue Chan, Huo Linger was the only plausible candidate to carry forward this pregnancy.

characters.introText: This was a child who was around three years old. He was standing close by, and turned towards them. Although he was young, he was already well-built. He had four pupils that flowed with divine light, holding a sort of imposing presence that completely did not match his age.
characters.appearance:
This was a child who was around three years old. He was standing close by, and turned towards them. Although he was young, he was already well-built. He had four pupils that flowed with divine light, holding a sort of imposing presence that completely did not match his age.

His current attire consist of red and white outfit with golden outline trim and gold belt, on his head since childhood has been wearing a crown diadem with a pearl place between his brows. This pearl is an attack weapon that shoot up a deadly beam.
characters.personality:
He was born with  Double Pupil which is a characteristic of the saints / deities of ancient times. By this characteristic he was the main candidate to replace the Emperor of Stone Country in the future.

When Shi Hao was born he was already 3 years old and gave no importance to him, using his time to cultivate and prepare for his destiny.

After Shi Hao's grandfather, Shi Zhongtian, disappeared after killing an archaic descendant of extremely pure blood and being pursued, his son and daughter-in-law, Shi Ziling and Qin Yining decided to leave to look for him, but before that they discovered that the little Shi Hao had a Supreme Being Bones Naturally Born which would make him a supreme expert in the future.

After informing an elder of the trusted clan about Shi Hao's Supreme Being Bones Naturally Born, Shi Ziling and his wife left. However Shi Yi eventually discovered about the Supreme Being Bones Naturally Born through their double pupils and informed his mother that for fear of Shi Hao taking the glory of his son devised a cruel plan to steal the Supreme Being Bones Naturally Born from Shi Hao.

After fooling the elder of the clan responsible for taking care of little Shi Hao she took him to a secret underground mansion and dug up the Supreme Being Bones Naturally Born from Shi Hao's small body and implanted it into the body of Shi Yi, in addition to she ordered all the blood of Shi Hao's essence to be withdrawn to nourish the Supreme Being Bones Naturally Born into Shi Yi's body leaving the little Shi Hao with a thin thread of life being saved from dying immediately by the elder who should be taking care of him .The old man wanted to kill Shi Yi's Mother because of his vile deed, but was prevented by Shi Yi who threatened to kill himself if he did something to his mother, leaving the elder with no choice.

When the father of little Shi Hao and his mother returned to the clan and saw his son the gates of death and discovered everything that happened, Shi Ziling felt guilty and decided to shoot down a path of blood in the clan branch of Shi Yi and his mother and promised to break more than a hundred bones of Shi Yi's body. After killing several elders of the clan branch of Shi Yi and fulfilling his promise to break a hundred of his bones, he fought with the ancestor elders of the clan and was exiled to the second ancestral land of the clan. Shi Yi went into the Heaven Mending Sect’s holy land for a few years, and only came out after the sect had been annihilated.

Shi Yi was revealed to be at the Engravement Realm when he exited the Ancient Sacred Courtyard accompanied by the Double Pupils Woman. Later, he would hear that Shi Hao had issued a challenge, he would first encountered Shi Hao at the Demonic spirit lake residence inside the Void God Realm  raising chaos, they would have their first preview battle by exchange blows before the void god realm overseer stop the match, only to officially set up a real match between the both of them within the void go arena a month later.

As time came closer to the month death battle Shi Hao spent time with his family in Stone Village and as for Shi Yi he continue to strengths this body with the rest of the Golden Liquid from the Heaven Mending Sect. A few days just before the match Emperor Shi Guo officially handed down a Decree Grand Title: The Peerless Lord or rather Marquis WuShuang meaning Unmatched/Unparalleled a title that is only given to those that have been definitely chosen as a candidate to become the next emperor. The front side had the title peerless lord, and there was another character on the back: human.

After accepting the decree he would use a magical artifact created from the primordial symbol bone of a void beast! to enter void god realm. Shi Yi  eyes lit up two halberds flew out from his pupils, and after making contact with each other, endless symbols erupted. They then merged together to form a magical artifact. All types of symbols appeared. Divine light flickered, and a sacred path was opened. This magical artifact was extremely mysterious; it could allow one to travel through the void. A moment later, he vanished from where he was standing into the void created by the magical artifact. It truly is shocking!.

After the battle was lost which he could've easily won but due to his recklessness and arrogance of a young man wanting to humiliate Shi Hao by killing him with his own Supreme Being Bones, a power that still needed time to assimilate within his body, had he used his ultimate eye technique the battle would've ended in victory in seconds. As shown in ancient era and future battles the Double Eye Pupil ultimate art is unstoppable and almost impossible to defend against. The Double Pupils Woman (who later retrieves Shi Yi’s body from the spider lake for unknown reasons, although she does have the same pupils as well. Shi Yi spirit is killed by Shi Hao in the Void God Realm in the Lower Realm during the stone brothers battle but revived later by the Dual Pupil Women and brought to the upper realm where he entered heaven fall sect.

At Heaven fall sect,  Shi Yi quickly rose up and became unrivaled in that sect and the entire province, their  powerful ancestor personally taught him everything he knew as explained.  Shi Yi was mention again by Li Yuncoung at fiend Island where he was praise as an unrivaled genius with a pair of unmatched dual pupil eyes. Shi Yi appeared at the immortal ancient battle in Chapter 817, the moment he entered many fighters jump in to action, as for Shi Yi  he didn’t take action at all, only using his eyes to kill all enemies.The creatures that surrounding him numbered over ten, among them including powerful experts from great provinces. They were recognized by others. “Golden Giant, Three-Headed Underworld Hound, Ifrit, Hidden Cloud Clan’s holy lady…”When these clans were named, everyone became shaken up. His Dual-pupils opened up heaven and earth. Those people all fell into the void, crushed to pieces. They were completely erased!

Shi Yi, Shi Hao and Qin Hao met while heading to find natural luck at the Fallen Immortal Ridge (Horn Ant Inheritance Cave) a member of the Archaic Vicious Ten . Shi Hao suspicion of Shi Yi still being alive was confirmed, Previously, he heard on Fiend Island that exceptional talent Li Yuncong was greatly defeated by a dual-pupil user, and back then, he already developed suspicions that it might be this person and at that moment everything was confirmed.

He looked at Shi Yi, discovering that his pupils were extremely deep he couldn’t see any dual-pupils they might be on the verge of merging! He had seen the gray clothed Double Pupils Woman in the lower realm’s ‘Medicine Capital’, and he had seen how her divine gaze was clear, her pupils returning to one. He could tell how she was different from normal people. That woman’s figure was unmatched, her might oppressing everything under heaven. She had said that when the dual-pupils reached their peak, they would return to being one, but could also produce the dual pupils again, it could be advanced to the limit  and now, Shi Yi had clearly stepped onto this unmatched path!  Shi Hao and Shi Yi both complemented each others for their surprisingly unmatched strength as hostility between both seems to have calm, Qin Hao spoke“ You are that dual-pupil Shi Yi?”  Shi  Yi reply You should call me older cousin.” Shi Yi had a warm smile on his face as he said that. Qin Hao’s eyebrows jumped and said, even someone who my older brother has cut down before is deserving of me calling an older cousin?” , Shi Yi reply again “Regardless of whether it was victory or defeat, whether we are hostile against each other or not, I am still your older brother. You should call me your older cousin regardless of feelings or reason.” Shi Yi’s face was calm, his eyes as deep as an ocean while his aura exudes dominance.

The Six Crown king (Ning Chuan’s) the unrivaled, was born after heaven and earth and gave a command of great fate, he was aloof and detached, and the moment he emerged from his mother’s womb he carried a heavenly diagram on his back, his forehead producing dragon patterns that is somewhat comparable to the supreme bone and dual pupil, that night, divine radiance illuminated the sky. He was a monster who swept away all  who oppose him during his six eras of dominance, arrived during the three stone brothers conversation as he was in pursue of the sinners blood descendant  Shi Hao but only to realize he was unlucky to meet three powerful sinners blood descendants but due to his confidence/arrogance decided to insult the brothers which cause Shi Yi and the other brothers to boil with rage, they allow Qin Hao to fight with Ning Chuans as they swat away everyone else, Shi Yi  being extremely intelligent and calculated since childhood said to Qin Hoa, little cousin you're still young and inexperience and proceed to belittle the six crown king by calling him the little six kid and wanting to not just simply defeat but carry out a great slaughter quickly to show their  Stone Brothers strength which shocked the millions that were watching.

After defeating Six Crown King Hundred of thousands of Geniuses that witness the fight ask if hey could follow their lead, they entered Fallen Immortal Ridge Horn ant inheritance cave by using the blood of Ning Chuan and then split up while Shi Yi took Entrance one, Shi Hao Entrance Two and Qin Hao entrance three. The inheritance was all a plot set by Exiled Immortal who decades ago took the inheritance but wanted to trap all the geniuses and used their blood as sacrifices to ignite and strengthen his foundation, out of the hundred of thousands of geniuses that entered only a hand full escape including the stone brothers, they were then relentlessly chase by Exiled immortal and barley escape with their lives which Shi Yi  Eyes played an quintessential role in their escape.

At the last battle for the final natural luck when all the major players such as, Shi Hao, Tian Zi ,Ning Chuan, Shenyan Samsara(Reincarnation disk holder) Zi Yanfei(The Great Heaven Burning Art holder) Exiled Immortal etc..They fought in an all out battle royal match, Shi Yi arrived late to the party with a powerful and tyrannical dominance and blast away Gu Jianyun with his eyes beam while stating how can a battle commence without the undefeated legend. Later the final natural Luck path was open and only the strongest could enter,  Shi Yi along with the others fought and obtained powerful script from multiple coffins, left behind by powerful True Immortal figures from ancient era, during this time immortal ancient were finally broken through by many of the outside clans Self-Release experts and then invaded by many Heavenly Deity powerhouses...they were chase by the deities with killing intent in order to steal their script and other treasures found in Immortal Ancient.

Shi Yi along with only  the most powerful young figures from the Three Thousand Provinces that rank in the top 50 or lower in Immortal ancient was recruited by the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths newly constructed Heavenly Deity Institution in order to train the best talents and create a dragon among cultivators in hopes of defeating the Foreign Realm invasion at the imperial pass desolate region. Shi Yi and Shi Hao during this time relationship became complicated but much better and he's frequently seen ready to defend Shi Hao in certain instances, also Shi Yi was seen a lot with exiled immortal and Tian Zi(Ten crown king) Which hinted they had a good Doa friendship. Shi Yi kept a very low profile while cultivating and getting stronger, he rarely fought, so many of his peers didn't know the full extent of his strength, it could be speculated that it was him being smart and cleaver, His chances of survival not having a strong background via Stone Clan in the Upper realm, not keeping a low profile was basically suicide so a low profile was the best decision. Shi Hao was repeatedly targeted over and over again, barely escaping death on many occasions, Luckily Hao had a  powerful backer and master aka the Heavenly Deity Institution number one head master Meng Tianzheng.

Shi Yi finally showed his cultivation progress again later when the  Foreign Domain king clan and Emperor clan young geniuses appeared looking for weaker opponent to slaughter, they mock Shi Yi as an unknown cultivator claiming only Huang was powerful which made Cao Yusheng angry and shouted that you all laughed and mock him, he is Huang older brother which made the other side all went quiet as bloodline in the Foreign realm was a huge matter, they then thought if Shi Hao was so powerful? how powerful was his older brother?.  Shi Yi  easily won his one vs one fight and then later easily win one vs seven against the king clan geniuses within minutes by using his sword decapitation eye ultimate technique, the settings then turn into an all out war where the other side Supreme Being elders all took note of the most dangerous opponent which  Shi Yi, Tian Zi, Exiled Immortal was among.

The years went by and Shi Yi had smaller and smaller roles focusing solely on cultivation, his fights became less and less until the final arc where Shi Yi attained immortal king realm level ahead of the others such as Yue Chan, the crown kings, Witch etc, with a fight prowess comparable to "GIANT and with intense life burning energy comparable to one foot inside Half-Immortal Emperor.  He was describe as one of immortal domain most powerful genius in the Immortal King Realm. While battling the dark army slaughtering many enemies both Fallen True Immortal and Fallen Immortal Kings carving out a name for himself they notice  Shi Hao blood essence was depleted who was still fighting the three half immortal emperors that lasted for 30,000 years without a break, Qin Hao and  Shi Fan was determine to blood sacrifice themselves for him to gain strength and defeat the three half immortal emperors, though willing they were constantly bombarded by Fallen Immortal King these fallen kings were too strong, they couldn’t stop them.

Right at this time, a man’s voice sounded... “All of you filth who live in darkness, get lost!”

A pair of dual pupil radiance tore apart the world, just too resplendent. With a peng sound, it even more so directly tore apart a fallen king. This was an outwardly extremely young man, but his body carried an aura of great changes. Moreover, his eyes were even more so terrifying beyond comparison, a pair of dual pupils that could forge heaven and earth, as well as destroy all things. He was Shi Yi!  He achieved Peak immortal king position slaughtering his way here. When he took action, the most powerful divine abilities were displayed, a single move deciding life and death, making a fallen king explode. The dual-pupiled Shi Yi roared out..."KILL"...His hair was disheveled, his entire body covered in blood. It was clear that he had experienced terrifying great battles. Right now, his pupils were so brilliant they couldn’t be stared straight at. Symbols covered those pupils densely, mysterious and unfathomable, possessing sky shocking divine might, slaughtering his way over until even immortal kings trembled. “All of you, get lost!” The  Double Pupil Shi Yi roared out. His body was contorting, because the price he paid was too great. Killing immortal kings like this, deciding life and death with a single move naturally exhausted too much. If this was a normal battle, how could one move kill a fallen immortal king?  Another fallen king was blasted apart by dual pupil radiance. The other darkness creatures weren’t on the same level as him. They were all smashed to pieces by a palm, buried in the void.

Qin Hao’s blood and soul still didn’t scatter. When he saw Shi Yi, he weakly cried out. “Also you, get lost as well!” The dual-pupiled Shi Yi said, not polite to Qin Hao in the slightest. His hand waved, seizing his blood and soul, merging it together, and then he threw him into the distance. “No, I still wish to offer myself as sacrifice!” Qin Hao roared out. “What is the use of that bit of blood? It isn’t Shi Hao’s life inheritance blood and you aren’t even an immortal king yourself. Just leave!” Shi Yi waved his hand coldly, sending him out.

Then, he began to offer himself up here!

When others saw this scene, they all couldn’t help but roar out. Shi Yi’s body broke apart, turning into a rain of light, wrapping it around a lump of true blood. Then, he fiercely rose into the sky, his dazzling brilliance illuminating the sky dome. With a hong sound, intense fluctuations shook this entire world, many people feeling dismal when they saw this scene. The dual-pupiled individual of a generation, someone with unmatched aptitude among immortal kings ended up splitting apart here.

Chapter 2002 Shi Yi’s final words To Shi Hao
characters.history:
In the ancient era, those people that had those Double Eye Pupil were known as saints or deities. Those people had world-shaking abilities and were unrivaled characters under the heavens.

As soon as Shi Yi was born, his double pupils were discovered. Naturally, the news riled up a huge shock within the tribe. Everyone had extremely high expectations of him, and in fact, he was indeed very extraordinary. He was a heavenly genius that studied everything so fast that he vastly exceeded a normal person.

characters.introText: Shi Yi's mother came from the Rain Clan, a powerful ancient tribe. She seemed gentle and dignified but never left her name. She was the favorite niece of King Yu.
characters.history:
Shi Yi's mother came from the Rain Clan, a powerful ancient tribe. She seemed gentle and dignified but never left her name. She was the favorite niece of King Yu.

She accidentally learned from her son that Shi Hao had the Supreme Being Bones in his body. As a paranoid mother, she always felt that all good things in the world should belong to her son. For this reason, she took advantage of Shi Hao's trust in her and deceived him into entering the basement. Together with the masters of the Rain Clan, they extracted the bone from Shi Hao's body and grafted it into the body of Shi Yi. Shi Hao, who had experienced the pain digging out all of his vitality, turned into an infant. A'man witnessed this incident and reported it to the elders at the Wu Palace. Fourth Elder was enraged and threatened to kill her. The aunt herself was then shot to death by Shi Hao's angry father Shi Ziling after returning from his search for Shi Zhongtian.

Since then, an irresolvable feud between the Rain Clan and Shi Hao's family had formed. On one hand, because Shi Yi's mother was killed by Shi Ziling, on the other hand, because the Rain Clan wanted Shi Hao dead to ensure that their grandson Shi Yi mantained absolute superior genius status. Shi Qingfeng took over Shi Hao's identity in the second ancestral land in order to protect the real Shi Hao. After Shi Hao returned at 7 years old, the Rain Clan kept tracking Shi Hao's whereabouts and hunted him again and again.

characters.history:
Grand Elder of Heaven Mending Pavilion and someone with a deep cultivation. Shi Yi  now a new member of Heaven Mending Sect recruited by Yue Chan was chosen to enter the heaven mending holy land to receive personal tutorship and the Golden Body  Elixir’s baptism precious liquid. The elder was shown to be a wise master with deep understanding of how to cultivate properly under the Venerable Realm.

With Shi Yi Double Eye Pupil and ability to learn knowledge quickly he was eager to learn the heaven mending (Mending the Sky technique) The elder told him it was too soon and rushing will only delay his cultivation progress but came to a compromise that Shi Yi can attack him wherever the opportunity present itself and if successful he was now ready to enter and learn the  secret technique. Shi Yi a very smart and calculative individual, held off from attacking after a  few unsuccessful attempts and waiting patiently.

During one of Shi Yi's  Supreme Being Bones pain episodes, the grand elder decided to help and ease his suffering by taking on the pain which significantly weakens the elder, at this moment Shi Yi took the opportunity to attacked, the elder already weaken and injured would die. He gave Shi Yi some final advice and stayed true to the bet made by opening up the temple for Shi Yi to study the technique.

characters.introText: A'man was a maid that worked for Shi Yi's family. She once worked at King Wu's palace of the Stone Country to take care of the eight month old Shi Hao.
characters.history:
A'man was a maid that worked for Shi Yi's family. She once worked at King Wu's palace of the Stone Country to take care of the eight month old Shi Hao.

Years later, A'man was seen at King Yu's Palace. She was favored by Shi Zhongtian, Master Fifteen of the Wu Palace. She asked him to take her to the Immortal Mountain to look for Shi Ziling and his wife.

Master Fifteen did not want Immortal Mountain to obtain the elixir, so he asked A'man to swallow the elixir. Later, they were forced into the Three Thousand Provinces of the Upper Realm. A'man was chased by some men of the Qin Clan in Wuxing State and escaped safely. After being quelled by Qin Changsheng, she and Master Fifteen attained enlightenment in the Immortal Tomb of Demon State and became the registered disciple of a giant in Jiehai. When the great liquidation came, she and Master Fifteen were taken into the fairyland.

In later events, after Shi Hao returned from the desolate border, Shi Zhongtian and A'man left for Fiend Island to find a Great Natural Luck. Both found it and became successors to a powerful Immortal King inheritance from the Immortal Domain. The only drawback was that they both would be in a state of seclusion lasting for ten thousand years. After the inheritance, both left for Realm Sea Dam to meet up with their mysterious master.

After Shi Hao was besieged, beaten to the brink of death by Aocheng Immortal King , TaiShi Immortal King,  YuanChu Immortal  king  and Golden-Hair Hou King. Shi Zhongtian and A'man awakened as True immortal, Heard the news that he was "Killled" during Breakthrough decided to seek Revenge and plotted assassination against the Ao Clan , TaiShi Clan and Yanchu Clan Geniuses and everyone associated with them.

500,000 years later after Shi Hao "death',  A young man approached and Rescued Shi Zhongtian and A'man who were on the run during an Ambushed from the three Prominent Kings Clans descendant True Immortals,  Shi Zhongtian was shocked and asked who was he, Then A'man with tears answered he was  Little Hao.

During the darkness of Calamity Era, she was sealed up by Shi Hao with the rest of the clan.
characters.trivia:
The pinyin is A'man, but Wuxiaworld for some reason spells it as Mang.

Ah Man (阿蛮) is also the name of a character in Nine Star Hegemon Body Art, and in The Legend of Sword and Fairy 1.

Historically, Man (蛮) is a pejorative ethnic slur in the Chinese language used to describe foreign tribes (non-Han ethnicities). The word means "barbarian."

characters.title: An Lan
characters.introText: An Lan often manifests as a terrifying, powerful entity. When he appears directly, his body radiates a blinding brilliance, making him impossible to gaze upon directly, akin to a golden sun. During his assaults, he frequently materializes a colossal hand, which, though capable of decaying to white bone, retains its destructive force. He is typically associated with a golden ancient spear and a sturdy shield, both symbols of his unmatched status. His primary mode of transit during large-scale invasions involves a grand, ancient war chariot, pulled by a golden-backed barbaric bull, capable of bringing forth primal chaos energy.

characters.personality:
An Lan's core personality is defined by an absolute and overwhelming arrogance, stemming from an unshakeable belief in his own invincibility and a profound disdain for all who stand before him. This boundless self-assurance is evident in his tranquil, almost indifferent demeanor, even when confronting multiple formidable adversaries or enduring severe injuries, as he calmly dismisses their efforts. He views himself as "unrivaled in this world," a conviction so deep that he boldly challenged his opponents upon his direct emergence from his war chariot, declaring:

Beyond this supreme confidence, An Lan possesses a ruthless and calculating nature, willing to employ extreme measures for his objectives, such as severing his own arm to escape karmic bonds, and his actions are often described as "ferocious," leaving behind "heaven shocking killing energy" in their wake. While capable of fleeting surprise when encountering truly unforeseen phenomena, such as Shi Hao's manifestation of multiple bodies, this pragmatic recognition of power is swiftly overshadowed by his inherent, imperishable sense of dominance and an imposing presence that instills dread in all who witness his might.
