Ancient Freaks
characters.introText:
Ancient freaks are exceptionally powerful prodigies, often referred to as "ancient kings", who once dominated one or multiple eras of cultivation. They possess strength far exceeding the norms of their realms, having evolved beyond conventional limits. Many demonstrate extraordinary innate talents or unique abilities, such as Heavenly Eyes or Mind Connection.Renowned for their overwhelming power and pride, ancient freaks typically act alone, believing themselves unmatched. However, they may form alliances when confronted by threats of the highest order. Many perished in their attempts to transcend even the ancients, leaving only the most terrifying and unparalleled survivors.

characters.introText: Aocheng Immortal King is one of the most ancient and powerful Immortal Kings in the Immortal Domain. He is a divine king-like figure, radiating otherworldly brilliance and commanding unmatched magical force. As the ruler of Aocheng King City, he holds immense influence and is regarded as one of the top Immortal Kings, standing on par with Pan King. Despite his strength, he was ultimately defeated and refined by Shi Hao after a prolonged and devastating conflict.
characters.appearance:
Aocheng Immortal King is one of the most ancient and powerful Immortal Kings in the Immortal Domain. He is a divine king-like figure, radiating otherworldly brilliance and commanding unmatched magical force. As the ruler of Aocheng King City, he holds immense influence and is regarded as one of the top Immortal Kings, standing on par with Pan King. Despite his strength, he was ultimately defeated and refined by Shi Hao after a prolonged and devastating conflict.

Aocheng has existed for countless eras, coexisting with the world since the earliest times of the Immortal Domain. He is the head of the Ao Family, a clan renowned for its strength and for producing true immortals. His scripture, the Aocheng Scripture, embodies the Radiant Dao, which dazzles mountains and rivers alike. Aocheng’s city, Aocheng King City, is a massive, prosperous metropolis rivaling even Pan King City and serves as the center of his clan's authority.
characters.personality:
Aocheng is cold, decisive, and nearly devoid of ordinary emotions. Like many ancient Immortal Kings, he has cultivated for countless eras until he has almost reached the emotionless state of the Great Dao, causing him to view nearly all living beings as insignificant.

Unlike Pan King, Aocheng does not believe potential dangers should be allowed to mature. Whenever he senses even the slightest possibility that someone may threaten him in the future, he prefers to eliminate them immediately, regardless of their current strength or status.

He places absolute trust in his own judgment and refuses to compromise once he has made a decision. Even after several Immortal Kings oppose him and warn him of the consequences, he repeatedly attempts to kill Shi Hao, declaring that he would rather kill an innocent than allow a possible future enemy to survive.

Despite his ruthless nature, Aocheng does not act out of personal anger or attachment toward his descendants. When Ao Gan is defeated by Shi Hao, he does not intervene because of family pride. Instead, he acts because he senses that Shi Hao's future cannot be perceived through heavenly calculations, making him a dangerous unknown variable.

His pride is equally overwhelming. Even after the Restricted Region Lord activates Realm Eradication, threatening the entire Immortal Domain with catastrophic karma, Aocheng initially refuses to retreat, insisting that an Immortal King cannot be coerced through threats.
characters.history:
During the Peaches of Immortality Distinguished Meeting held by Pan King, Aocheng observes Shi Hao’s astonishing victories over Ao Gan, Pan Yi, and Hun Tian. While others see only an extraordinary genius, Aocheng senses something he cannot fully comprehend.

After gathering with the other Immortal Kings, he openly declares his intention to kill Shi Hao. He explains that the heavenly mysteries surrounding Shi Hao are completely obscured and that he can vaguely sense a future unfavorable to himself. Rather than allowing such uncertainty to continue, he concludes that Shi Hao should be eliminated immediately.

Despite Pan King’s repeated objections, Aocheng refuses to reconsider. He states that he would rather kill Shi Hao wrongly than risk allowing him to become a future disaster.

When Shi Hao departs Pan King City, Aocheng immediately launches his attack. His enormous hand reaches across an entire star domain, effortlessly crushing countless stars into dust simply through its descent. Pan King intercepts the attack before Shi Hao is killed.

Afterward, Aocheng attacks again, this time through a strand of supreme Dao law intended specifically to erase Shi Hao. Even after multiple Immortal Kings interfere, the attack succeeds in shattering Shi Hao’s body and primordial spirit, forcing the Restricted Region Lord to expend one drop of Immortal King essence blood to substitute for Shi Hao’s death and restore him.

Aocheng remains unwilling to stop. He sends another killing strike in the form of his voice, using the simple utterance of Shi Hao’s name as an attack powerful enough to nearly destroy the Restricted Region Lord, the Crystal Skull, the Golden Arm Bone, and the Bleeding Eyeball while almost killing Shi Hao once again.

Only after the Restricted Region Lord activates Realm Eradication, threatening to guide the terrifying beings of the Realm Sea toward the Immortal Domain, do the other Immortal Kings unite to pressure Aocheng into abandoning his pursuit. Although forced to withdraw, Aocheng’s hostility toward Shi Hao remains unchanged.

characters.title: Aunt Blue-Scaled Eagle
characters.introText: While bringing prey back to the nest, the blue-scaled eagle saw the boys from the Stone Village steal her egg. She chased them all the way back to the village, but Shi Linhu and the surrounding mountains got in the way. Her egg suffered many injuries and died instantly after hatching. Fueled by anger and hatred, she unleashed her most powerful attack. Thankfully, Liu Shen resurrected the baby bird and allowed it to stay in the village to cultivate. Thus, her grudge with the Stone Village was resolved. Shi Hao named the baby bird Zi Yun.

Young Shi Hao had to fight off the Wolf Village on his own while waiting for backup.

She is later seen living at Stone Village's new location with her daughter.

characters.introText: The Blood Phoenix Lion is a formidable and rare Archaic vicious beast, renowned for its noble bloodline and exceptional power. It descends from a declined branch of the Blood Phoenix lineage and the ancient monk bloodline’s legendary “Fearless Lion,” a heritage that grants it unmatched strength and magical force. Towering at nearly a hundred zhang in height, the beast’s body is covered in scarlet red fur, while its blood-colored wings resemble those of a phoenix, lending it both majesty and terror. Its presence radiates a powerful life aura, and its icy, scarlet eyes shine like cold moons, striking fear into all who behold them.
characters.appearance:
The Blood Phoenix Lion is celebrated for its immense combat abilities, wielding unique divine techniques that showcase its destructive might. Among these is the fearsome Lion’s Roar, a technique that unleashes energy waves as vast as the sea, shaking heaven and earth and leaving devastation in its wake. Equally terrifying is the Blood Phoenix Cleave, an attack performed with its blood-colored phoenix wings, capable of cutting through everything in its path. This ability is a legacy of the Fallen Blood Phoenix a traitorous branch of the True Phoenix race and is feared for its ruthless capacity to hack down opponents without mercy.

Its bloodline grants it two types of unmatched precious blood, contributing to its strength and resilience. Even though it is a descendant of noble lineage, the Blood Phoenix Lion has been seriously injured and humiliated in battles, notably by a young Heavenly Horned Ant who went berserk and managed to suppress and seriously wound it. Despite its arrogance and power, it has been forced to flee on several occasions due to the ant's overwhelming strength

characters.introText: The Butcher (屠夫, Tú Fū) is one of the legendary figures associated with the Age of Emperor Collapse. He is remembered across later eras as a ruthless and extraordinarily powerful cultivator who killed all of his opponents and dominated the world.
characters.appearance:
The Butcher was originally a figure of the Age of Emperor Collapse, an ancient era whose history had become extremely remote and obscure.

The mysterious stone room in the Heaven Connecting Land is said to possess a connection to the past and present, with legends claiming that it may even allow one to witness or enter different segments of the river of time. The Restricted Region Lord and the other ancient beings had previously suspected that the place could potentially facilitate a form of living reincarnation or allow an individual to enter another period of history.

Shi Hao's arrival ultimately confirms that the stone room possesses an even more extraordinary function.

After the Embodiment Transformation Great Method is fully activated, Shi Hao disappears from the present era. His figure subsequently begins appearing on the ancient stone walls, where scenes from the Age of Emperor Collapse are gradually revealed.

This means that the appearance of Shi Hao and the Butcher together should not be interpreted as an ordinary event occurring within Shi Hao's original timeline. Rather, Shi Hao's Embodiment Transformation across the river of time causes his figure to appear within the historical scenes of that distant era.

Among the scenes revealed on the ancient stone walls is an encounter between young Huang (Shi Hao) and the young Butcher.

The two figures appear within the same great realm and briefly confront one another. However, they do not engage in a life-and-death battle. Instead, they merely cross paths before going their separate ways.

The Butcher subsequently leaves that great realm and disappears from the historical record of that world.

The Restricted Region Lord is particularly disappointed by the lack of a battle. Having heard of the Butcher's later reputation, he expresses a desire to know exactly how powerful the Butcher was during his youth and regrets that the two did not fight a bloody battle.

Because there was no decisive confrontation between them, the encounter provides no definitive comparison of the Butcher's strength with Shi Hao's strength at that point.
characters.history:
The stone-wall engravings initially appear vague and incomplete. As Shi Hao's transformation progresses, however, the ancient markings begin changing and revealing increasingly recognizable figures.

The Restricted Region Lord and the other ancient beings are shocked when they recognize Huang's figure among the scenes.

The discovery is extremely difficult for them to comprehend. Huang belongs to their present era, yet his figure is appearing within records associated with the Age of Emperor Collapse.

This phenomenon is ultimately connected to the nature of the Embodiment Transformation Great Method. Shi Hao is not simply observing the past from a distance; his existence is being projected into the historical stream, allowing him to embody and manifest across different ages.

The appearance of the Butcher alongside him therefore becomes one of the clearest indications that Shi Hao's path has become intertwined with the distant history preserved by the ancient stone walls.
characters.trivia:
The Butcher originated in the Age of Emperor Collapse.

His appearance in Chapter 1904 is revealed through the ancient stone-wall scenes activated by Shi Hao's Embodiment Transformation Great Method.

Shi Hao was transported or manifested into the distant era through the interaction between the Embodiment Transformation Great Method, the mysterious ancient blood, and the stone room's connection to the river of time.

The young Butcher and young Huang encountered one another but never engaged in a decisive battle.

characters.introText: The Protector of the Celestial Clan, a figure of great power within the clan, has reached the level of a Sect Master.
characters.history:
The Protector of the Celestial Clan, a figure of great power within the clan, has reached the level of a Sect Master.

He first appears when Kong Que (Peacock Divine Lord) attempts to free Shi Hao from the imprisonment of the celestials. Kong Que tries to persuade the protector, emphasizing the injustice in imprisoning someone who saved a genius of their clan from the War Clan. Additionally, he warns that releasing Shi Hao would be the best choice, considering that if Liu Shen were to return, the Celestial Clan would be erased from the Upper Realm.

Despite Kong Que's arguments, the Protector of the Celestial Clan dismisses them, confident that both are sect masters and one cannot truly evaluate the cultivation level of a sect master until witnessing them in action. The confrontation begins, but Kong Que's power proves significantly superior, leading to the loss of one of the protector's horns. The protector attempts to activate the formation of the Celestial City, but Kong Que's power remains overwhelming. Nevertheless, Kong Que fails to take Shi Hao away as representatives of the major powers of the higher realm appear at the gates of the Celestial City immediately after the clash. The protector of the Celestial Clan did not have the strength to defeat Kong Que, let alone another half a dozen individuals at the sect master level. Shi Hao will later be rescued with the assistance of Ye Qingxian.

During the battle between the successor of the Supreme Dojo and You Yu, the celestials learn that their strongest member among the six heroes of the Celestial Clan was fighting against Huang. They promptly inform the Heavenly Deity about Huang's location. After Yun Yu's defeat, the Protector of the Celestial Clan heads to the scene to take Shi Hao's life but is stopped by Qi Daolin. Before combat, the Celestial Clan's Protector absorbs some Immortal liquid to restore their vitality, thereby gaining a chance against Qi Daolin. However, they are easily defeated by Qi Daolin due to the 89 Heavens Technique.

When Qi Daolin decided to visit uninhabitated region (No Man's Land), he tried to divine Shi Hao location and injured himself. He said the same thing as what Yu Zimo (previous servant of the Rain Clan) said: "The divination will not appear... When I gazed into the future, there was an expanse of primal chaos. When he turns around, behind him is an expanse of nothingness. He... doesn't seem to belong in this set of history!"

Later he appeared again at the end of the Immortal Ancient battle, where all sect masters are trying to kill Shi Hao. However, he's so weak compared to the other sect masters. He can only run away when Qi Daolin and Undying Being fought crazily. The only good thing is that he's too slippery and have high level escape skills, Qi Daolin cannot catch up to him.

He appeared for the last time when Shi Hao was visiting Celestial Clan with Huo Ling'er, killing Mo Luo and Qi Tuo, two heavenly deities and plugging their city entrance to ruin their former Emperor Clan reputation. Since Shi Hao came prepared, together with Huo Ling'er, he just hacked the void using Everlasting Immortal Sword and ran away from the dao protector. Later on, Shi Hao came back and forth, basically provoking him five times to take action. After trying to chase Shi Hao for five times without any result, he tried to peer his location using the methods to find heavenly secrets.

If Shi Hao was far enough, the dao protector wouldn’t have tried to divinate his location, but with him almost in reach, he felt like he could easily succeed.

However, soon after, the dao protector coughed out blood, his face full of horror, injuring his great dao foundation.

“Why? He is just nearby, such a close distance shouldn’t cause me to suffer backlash! Is this the wrath of the heaven?!” The dao protector was shocked, muttering to himself.

However, he was unwilling to accept this result, carrying out another divination, wishing to do something before his death, suppress Shi Hao.

This time, it was even more severe. The dao protector sprayed out large amounts of blood, suffering serious injuries.

“How could it be like this?” He had also performed a divination before, knowing that Shi Hao was unordinary, not someone who could be peered at.

That time, it was because the distance was too great, the difficulty enormous.

Yet today, Shi Hao was just nearby, yet he still failed, impossible to deduce things, moreover worsening his injuries greatly.

“I want to capture him before my death!” Celestial Clan’s dao protector’s will was resolute.

He carried another divination, but in the end, the space between his brows split, his seven apertures releasing blood. He muttered, “How could it be like this, I saw a corner of the future, this person...”

Everyone in Celestial Clan saw the dao protector suddenly tremble slightly. He was shaken and horrified.

“Great one, what’s wrong?”

“Huang...” The dao protector only spat out this word. The space between his brows ruptured, and then he released a great roar. He fell on his back, entire body bloody, thus losing his life.

“Heavens! Dao protector great one has died!”

This cry of alarm shook up the entire City of Heaven.

“That brat harmed dao protector to death!” Someone cried out miserably, feeling incredibly mournful.

“We’re leaving!” Shi Hao said, bringing Huo Ling’er away.

We can infer from this passage that he possibly saw the future Huang as Heavenly Emperor and he paid too much price for his old body. He was immediately killed without even finishing his last sentence.

He's class as one of the Young generation Ancient Freaks along side Ning Chuan, Tian Zi, Divine Dark Child, Fallen Divine Child, Zi Yanfei Gu Jianyun and a few others that previously entered Immortal Ancient.
characters.history:
Chang Gongyan(Four Crown King) is a powerful first generation genius from the Upper realms closely acquainted to Tian Yao and her clan, Demon Pattern Clan. He's class as one of the Young generation Ancient Freaks along side Ning Chuan, Tian Zi, Divine Dark Child, Fallen Divine Child, Zi Yanfei Gu Jianyun and a few others that previously entered Immortal Ancient.

The title crown king were given for the number of times they entered Immortal Ancient and ranked first during that time. Like Ning Chuan and co, he could've entered the Heavenly Deity realm or higher easily but decided to break down his cultivation foundation back into the Venerable Realm in order to keep going back into Immortal Ancient which open every Three thousand years.

He first appeared in Sin Province at the Fire Nation capital Li Fire City to attend the gathering of geniuses and to commemorate the memory of his female friend or love interest an individual who was killed a few thousnad years ago and buried there, This woman had half Hellbrand Clan bloodline, as well as half sinner’s blood.

It was said that the reason why Chang Gongyan froze himself under the mountains, entering ‘Immortal Ancient’ for a second time was because he wanted to find the phoenix blood pond to revive that woman. It was clear to see that Chang Gongyan failed, unable to find it then. As a result, he went a third time, still unmatched this time, becoming number one under the heavens. However, he still wasn’t able to obain anything. However, in that era, what was most difficult for him to accept was that the woman’s corpse had been sealed for too long, no longer even having a chance to be revived. In the end, he could only carry that woman here to bury her where they first met. That was previously a night of full moon. He would fight with the Sword valley Golden Clad Male individual and later leave.

During Immortal Ancient and many battles later he became acquaintances with Shi hao , even helping him out with his legendary mysterious bow, he would also fight and acquire one of the natural luck coffins which held an immortal scripture.  After Immortal Ancient along with many of the Three thousand genius he was also recruited  by Heavenly Deity Institution, sadly due to the Three thousand province doa law being inferior to the 9heavns 10earth cultivators, they were naturally weaker. They would get bullied at times and shi hao would help out. He later joined Sacred academy as he wasn't able to get a perfect Immortal Seeds.

He went to desolate boarder and later became an Supreme Being  after entering Immortal Domain he became a True Immortal, he would become close old friends with shi hao and all the recruited genius that went with him from the 9heavens 10earth.   He would would later sealed up with Stone Village by Shi Hao after the era become too chaotic and a regular true immortal isn't powerful enough.

characters.introText: Chang Gongyan's lover was a woman born of mixed blood-half from the Hell-brand Clan, half from the lineage of sinners. She was not only his beloved but also his closest companion, bound to him by deep trust and shared history. Yet an unforeseen calamity tore them apart forever, leaving a wound that time could not heal.
characters.history: Little is known of her early life beyond her dual heritage, which marked her as an outsider in many realms. She formed an intimate connection with Chang Gongyan, meeting him for the first time on a night bathed in full moonlight a location that would later hold profound significance. An unexpected event led to her death and the permanent sealing of her corpse, rendering any form of revival impossible after prolonged containment.

characters.introText: Chen Dong, a renowned online writer and a Platinum author on Qidian. In the first "King of Online Literature" selection, he was ranked among the Five Supreme and Twelve Main Gods, earning the nickname "Pit God" from readers. His three works, "God's Tomb," "Cover the Sky," and "Perfect World," have all topped Baidu's Novel Popularity Rankings. Among them, "God's Tomb" and "Perfect World" have consistently held the first position for an extended period, making Chen Dong one of the most frequent chart-toppers on Baidu's Novel Popularity Rankings. His original novels have maintained the top spot on the Chinese literary website "Qidian Chinese" for several years. Furthermore, his works have been adapted into online games and mobile games, and physical copies of his books are widely loved and welcomed by readers on both sides of the Taiwan Strait.
characters.personality:
Chen Dong rose to fame with his work "God's Tomb," pioneering the ancient war and fantasy suspense genres and earning him the title of "Pit God." His extraordinary imagination, free-spirited writing style, and the ability to evoke a strong sense of identification and psychological desire in readers have contributed to his reputation. Chen Dong's writing is both bold and humorous, and his skillful use of language captures readers' attention and keeps them engaged.
In addition, Chen Dong's masterpiece, "God's Tomb," goes beyond the typical online literature by weaving struggles of human nature and the melancholy of worldly affairs into its exhilarating and blood-pumping narrative. Even in seemingly joyful conclusions, there are hidden concerns about society, elevating the work to a level beyond ordinary online literature and earning it the status of a premium creation in the field of online literature.

characters.introText: Chi Menghong appears as a young and heroic man with long, loosely scattered hair and striking scarlet eyes described as "red like gemstones, also like blood suns," giving him an imposing and intimidating presence. Even while seated and outwardly calm, he exudes an overwhelming pressure likened to a towering mountain.
characters.appearance:
Chi Menghong appears as a young and heroic man with long, loosely scattered hair and striking scarlet eyes described as "red like gemstones, also like blood suns," giving him an imposing and intimidating presence. Even while seated and outwardly calm, he exudes an overwhelming pressure likened to a towering mountain.

His primordial spirit reflects his true nature as a Time Beast, manifesting as a fist-sized, entirely scarlet beast with the head of a Flood Dragon and the body of a lion. Rather than skin, fur, or scales, its body is covered in sturdy scarlet bone spurs that possess an icy, metallic luster, making the small creature appear both fierce and unnatural.

Chi Menghong's original Time Beast body shares the same appearance as his primordial spirit, but at full physical scale. Measuring roughly one *zhang* in length, it possesses the head of a Flood Dragon, the body of a lion, and a scarlet body entirely covered in sharp bone spurs instead of fur or scales. These bony protrusions give the beast a cold, metallic sheen, revealing the true form hidden beneath his human appearance.
characters.personality: Chi Menghong is cold, arrogant, and openly, unrelentingly hostile toward Shi Hao from their very first encounter, driven by a personal grudge over the capture of his relative Chi Pu by Meng Tianzheng. He is supremely self-confident, choosing to remain seated even in direct confrontation with Shi Hao as a display of dominance, and shows little regard for his own family's honor he coldly dismisses the death of his own prospective brother-in-law as fitting punishment for weakness rather than an insult requiring vengeance. True to his Scarlet King bloodline's reputation, he is described as iron-blooded and merciless, carrying an innate killing intent. Once actually humiliated in combat  first kicked in the face, then straddled by Shi Hao's legs around his neck  his composure cracks into open rage; he cannot tolerate being made a spectacle of, escalating to increasingly desperate and forbidden ancestral techniques rather than accept defeat. Even at the brink of death, he refuses to yield, demanding a rematch "at your best" rather than retreat.
characters.history: Chi Menghong is the "heaven warping genius" heir of the Scarlet King bloodline, one of the Emperor Clans, known historically as the most vicious of the undying kings  a figure said to have slaughtered countless experts and refined an immortal king into a bloody paste, an act that fused the Scarlet King Furnace with his bloodline's secret method into a signature ancestral technique passed down through his descendants. Chi Menghong's own close relative, Chi Pu, was captured by Meng Tianzheng outside Imperial Pass, a humiliation that fuels his hatred of Shi Hao. His bloodline additionally carries the nature of a Time Beast, an ancient and supposedly undefeated species whose members possess innate mastery over time itself a power that must be personally comprehended and evolved rather than simply inherited, and one that few in history have found effective countermeasures against.
characters.trivia: He had the same fate like his Ancestor Scarlet King being eaten twice by Huang. Shi Hao saw them as food because of their Brutality toward the Nine Heavens and Tens Earths Humans, and Ancient Immortals.

characters.introText: The Chicken Farmer (养鸡的) was one of the most ancient and powerful giants of the Realm Sea, standing alongside the Butcher and Fake Medicine Seller as one of the supreme figures who had survived across countless eras. Despite her deliberately mundane title, she was an existence who had cultivated to the absolute limits of the Immortal King Realm and possessed extremely profound foundations.
characters.appearance:
The Chicken Farmer's true personality is largely obscured by the enormous amount of time that had passed since her era. Her title gives her an almost comical image, but her actual status was anything but ordinary. She was an ancient existence who had endured countless great eras and possessed the strength and experience of someone who had stood at the peak of the Immortal King path for an extremely long time.

Her habit of raising Phoenixes as chickens also reflects a remarkable degree of familiarity with creatures that ordinary cultivators would regard as divine or untouchable. To her, beings of extraordinary bloodlines could apparently be treated as little more than livestock.

characters.history:
The Chicken Farmer came from an ancient era so distant that much of her history had already disappeared beneath the passage of time. She eventually became one of the supreme giants of the Realm Sea, surviving through numerous great eras and witnessing the rise and fall of countless civilizations and cultivators.

At some point, she attempted to break through the Immortal King Realm and become an Immortal Emperor. Like the Butcher and Fake Medicine Seller, she failed to complete this transformation. Nevertheless, the attempt allowed her to accumulate an extraordinarily deep foundation, leaving her with faint traces of Quasi-Immortal Emperor radiance.

She later became one of the three ancient giants associated with the Butcher and Fake Medicine Seller. Together, they were among the few ancient beings powerful enough to directly oppose the forces of darkness emerging from the Guidance Ancient Palaces.

The Chicken Farmer, Butcher, and Fake Medicine Seller once fought against the Guidance Ancient Palaces in the Realm Sea. Their actions were instrumental in resisting the darkness army and preventing its forces from completely overwhelming Immortal Domain.

The three ancient giants managed to destroy two Guidance Ancient Palaces and seize a transport formation. Through this formation, some ancient Immortal Kings were able to return from the Realm Sea. Their actions demonstrated just how terrifying their combined strength was, even though none of them had successfully become an Immortal Emperor.
characters.trivia:
The Chicken Farmer was actually female, despite the masculine and somewhat rustic image commonly associated with her title.

Her nickname came from her habit of raising Phoenixes as though they were ordinary chickens.

She was one of the three ancient Realm Sea giants alongside the Butcher and Fake Medicine Seller.The three possessed faint Quasi-Immortal Emperor radiance, but none successfully completed the transformation into an Immortal Emperor.

Together with the Butcher and Fake Medicine Seller, she helped destroy two Guidance Ancient Palaces and seize a transport formation that allowed ancient Immortal Kings to return from the Realm Sea.

characters.appearance:
Chu Shanhe is an extraordinary and notable figure, known for his remarkable past and lasting influence despite his current weakened state. He is an elder of the Immortal Academy, distinguished by his waxy yellow complexion, grayish-white hair, and withered physique. Although he now appears ordinary and sickly, his reputation and past achievements reveal a far more formidable individual.

In the past, Chu Shanhe was renowned as part of a peerless duo alongside another Supreme Being, making him one of the most dazzling heroes of his era. His brilliance and dominance placed him among the highest echelon of cultivators five hundred thousand years ago. However, tragedy struck after a fateful expedition with seven other young supreme beings into a dangerous restricted area within the Nine Heavens. Their objective was to obtain a weapon left behind by an Immortal King and to investigate a mysterious legend. Only Chu Shanhe returned from this perilous mission; the other seven never reappeared and were presumed annihilated. This catastrophe dealt him a devastating mental and emotional blow, leaving him sickly and stripping him of his former domineering spirit, eventually causing him to withdraw from public life.

Despite his frail appearance, Chu Shanhe still possesses immense strength and formidable combat prowess. In a crucial battle, while seemingly restrained and coughing blood, he unexpectedly reversed the situation. Breaking free from a blood-colored divine ring that had trapped him, he decisively defeated a powerful opponent. This sudden turn of events stunned all who witnessed it and reaffirmed the terrifying depth of his remaining power.

characters.introText: Corpse Immortal Emperor or The True Fallen Immortal Emperor is a tower among cultivators within the Perfect world series, he was the first and only to reach the threshold and achieved the impossible of becoming a true Immortal Emperor, that is until Shi Hao came along endless years later. The Corpse Immortal Emperor holds the third and final piece of the True Primordial Record and is implied to have studied and were formally the owner or creator of the other two pieces thus led to his path of achieving the almost impossible true emperor realm.
characters.appearance:
After the ending of Perfect World, due to his inherent kindness, a portion of his true self was resurrected by the Desolate Emperor himself, who took control of him again. With a carefree and frivolous personality, he crossed the Boundary Sea to the mysterious source above the Heavens to seek revenge on the Immortal Emperors who had plotted against him. He ultimately slew a Immortal Emperor level being and returned from the mysterious source by stepping on the Emperor's bones. Having been isolated for countless years by his enemies in the Boundary Sea above the Heavens, he returned to the Boundary Sea via the Heavens. He is suspected of feuding with the masters of the three immortal artifacts in the mortal world. The remnant of his dark consciousness was resurrected alongside his true self, stripped of its Immortal Emperor power and sealed in a clay jar as a beacon to locate his true self.

When the Weird Clan attacked the heavens again, the dark remnant soul broke free from the seal and resurrected. Curious about the Earth where two Immortal Emperors had come out, he used the power of time to repeatedly replay and evolve the original history of the Earth , trying to evolve a third strongest person. He was the mastermind behind the entire small underworld. He once used a beast skin that was re-condensed from his past body to fight against Ye Fan 's projection. In the end, the beast skin was erased by Ye Fan's projection.

When the quasi-immortal emperor Gu Qing, Jiudao, Chu Feng, Heihuang , Duan De and others went to the small underworld to investigate, he attempted to take action, but his self-introduction before taking action aroused everyone's longing for their true self, and accidentally led to the return of the true self's will. Then the dark remnant soul was forcibly merged by the true self across countless dimensions, enhancing the strength to fight against the Immortal Emperor who was nicknamed "Tiger Level" by the true self.

During the grand sacrifice to the heavens Weird Clan , the Corpse Emperor attacked and defeated a strange Emperor, but to no avail. Faced with the Emperor who had been pursuing him, he was forced to leave again. When the strange ancestor found Huang and engaged in a decisive battle with Ye Fan and others, the Corpse Emperor reappeared and joined the three Emperors, the Ruthless Emperor , the Beginningless Emperor, and the Luo Emperor, to fight against the ten strange Emperors below the ancestor. Outnumbered, the Corpse Emperor sacrificed himself to completely annihilate a Dark Emperor who could infinitely resurrect. In the finale, Shi Hao, Ye Fan , and Chu Feng, who had broken through to the realm beyond the sacrificial Dao, resurrected him.

Multi Techniques

characters.history:
Within the perfect world, becoming an emperor is close to impossible and those who achieve the almost impossible since world’s creation, the age of emperor collapse, the immortal ancient era and the present era can be counted on each hands. It could be said that among the leading figures of the endless past, there were only a few individuals. Half-Immortal Emperor were the most powerful existences since the ancient times until now. Great eras passed one after the next, yet just how many of them were there until now? Even unmatched immortal kings didn’t have the qualifications to meet them.

The true full immortal emperor known as the Corpse Immortal Emperor were said to be the first and only cultivator  from the past to present who were able to achieved this feat, this accomplishment though short lived was still a monumental achievement that demanded respect and reverence. Comparably speaking a Half-Immortal Emperor  which was already an almost impossible mountain to climb compared to a true full Immortal Emperor is like comparing the earth to the heavens the gap is just too great.

It was explained in the other novel "The Holy Ruins" that the story of the corpse emperor was a tragic tale, as he was not an evil villain but someone who tried to protect all life through his actions after being plotted against. During his breakthrough the corpse emperor was plotted against by great figures from the realm beyond(FYI-This is the New realm Shi Hao discovered towards the ending of the  Perfect world Novel) More or less it was stated that the darkness which currently plague the entire Perfect World Realm came from this new world, the great figures uses this darkness dao law as a  catalyst to attacked the corpse emperor during his break through into the Immortal Emperor realm leaving him crippled and almost killed, to save his life he would split his primordial soul into two, half remain with his current body corroded by the darkness dao law and the other sealed in the Immortal Rotten Box, the box were sent away by the corpse emperor in order not to be corrupted by the darkness in hopes of one day reunited both half of his soul again. The box would  later discovered and studied through the ages by countless great immortal kings but with no success and then ended up in Shi Hao possession later.

The Corpse Immortal emperor is currently located within the depth of the land of darkness on a seated throne high as the mountains, body slash in half recovering using the spirit of the enslaves imprison within ancient guidance palaces. His goal is to recover by using the souls to heal his wounds, the strain of his severe wounds would push him into a deep comatose state for billions of years at a time, regaining consciousness only an monumental event occurs. Every million of years or so he would take a breathe which would leads to chaos throughout Realm sea, immortal kings would turn to dust and civilizations would cease to exist.

Realm would later become a legend, and rumors spread of it holding a path to becoming and emperor, Immortal King had hopes of taking that step, while Half immortal emperor held the same view, different cultivation levels different goals but their path all remain the same, realm sea holds all the answers. The Four Fallen Emperors was no different, having great ambitions, like many before, they slaughter their way into  realm sea to look for a path in order to take that step, the corpse emperor gave them and ultimatum of serving him and the path of a true emperor would be revealed to them, at first they rejected due to the darkness dao law but after countless years of not advancing not even an inch they made the choice to submit, hence using the darkness to advance their cultivation.

Countless years later Shi Hao would appear and enter the depth of the darkness land, The Immortal Rotten Box would finally took sentient and spoke to Shi Hao warning him to return and stay away from this place but Shi Hao soldiered on while being cautious. He would eventually come face to face with the corpse emperor, during their first interaction the emperor gave him the same ultimatum as those who came before, servitude and the path to emperor would be open to him or death, Luckily for Shi Hao the corpse emperor fell back into a deep sleep, during this time

Shi Hao went into seclusion after finding some writings, which turns out to be the Primordial record final piece, he decided not to cultivate but used it as reference because of the warning and would further his cultivation during his hundred thousands of years of seclusion next to the body of the corpse emperor. The corpse emperor would awaken once again and exchanges were made but shi hao was able to survive do to his advancement during those three hundred thousand years of seclusion.

The corpse emperor would again fell asleep and once he opened his again, he saw Huang who was still here about to reach Immortal Emperor. Then he told his other Half who were in the Wooden Chest why not merge together because we are the same source. In the end they merge together.

This time a battle took place , the corpse emperor would fully reunited both half of his primordial spirit and regain most of his emperor powers. Then  Great Luo Sword decided to betray Shi Hao and returned to the Corpse Emperor hand, Then he used  the Great Luo Sword Fetus  to hack Shi Hao into countless blood showers with a single stroke. While Shi Hao so closed to the  Immortal Emperor Realm scattering his through Embodiment Transformation Great Method across different point of times while his body remained in the depths of the Ancient Final Destination.

Corpse Emperor started to panicking and  sensed great danger to himself  because the aura of an Emperor that appeared on Huang's Body, He started deriving and became shocked even the past when Huang was incredibly weak could no longer be sensed.

“I’ve moved the great river of time. Even though I didn’t change history, I’ve already made contact with him. Perhaps some karma I am unaware of has happened.”

Huang had become an Unmatched Immortal Emperor and used the Embodiment technique.  3 more Huang Tian Di appeared, killed and all them together refined Corpse Immortal Emperor for thousands of years because of the Darkness matter on him was strongest and for leaving no mistake for the Future Generation.

characters.introText: The Chicken-Riding Immortal (Chinese: 骑鸡仙人; pinyin: Qíjī Xiānrén) is a powerful True Immortal and an envoy of the Life Restricted Region. Although his true name remains unknown, he is widely recognized by the phoenix-like immortal bird that serves as his mount, earning him the nickname "Chicken-Riding Immortal." As a representative of one of the ancient Forbidden Areas, he is entrusted with conveying its will and carrying out its commands. Possessing the cultivation of a veteran True Immortal, he stands far above all Human Dao cultivators, and his mere presence is enough to deter the strongest experts of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
characters.appearance:
The Crane‑Riding Immortal appears as an elderly, battle‑worn warrior whose age is etched deeply into his stern, somber features. His long white hair is tied into a messy topknot, matching the full, untamed white beard that frames his weathered face. He wears layered, asymmetrical garments: a dark under‑tunic beneath a heavy drape of textured gold‑brown fabric that falls over his left shoulder, secured at the waist by a thick leather belt studded with metal rivets and wrapped in patterned sashes. From this belt hang layered loincloths and protective metal plates that cover his dark trousers.

His right forearm is encased in a segmented golden gauntlet, and he leans heavily on a sturdy dark staff, using it to support his weight due to his missing leg. Despite his injuries and age, he stands tall, radiating the presence of a powerful yet weathered immortal whose long life has been shaped by hardship, discipline, and countless battles.

characters.introText: The Crimson-Haired Divine Monarch is a formidable figure whose story embodies both immense power and tragic fate. Hailing from a Long-Life family, he was once unmatched in strength and renowned for cultivating the Great Sky Burning Art, a technique capable of purging all evil and subduing many foreign cultivators during the Immortal Ancient era. Approximately two hundred thousand years ago, he was ranked among the top young kings of his generation, overwhelming his peers with unparalleled might. His cultivation had advanced to an extraordinary level, merging his flames with primal chaos—a step that could have granted him immortality and transcendence beyond the Long-Life domain.
characters.appearance:

His disciples and peers expressed profound grief and anger over his defeat, reflecting the devastating impact his loss had on their world.

The past Demonic Cattail King, this really was a fierce character, the faces of all cultivators in the Nine Heavens Ten Earths would change when talking about it. The amount of people this expert killed was so high, it could form mountains with their corpses, it was extremely cold-blooded. characters.history:

After his defeat back in ancient era some of his spirit was left alive wondering and later revived using a legendary pill from the Age of Emperor Collapse.

Shi Hao having being successful breaking trough but foundation highly unstable he was still powerful enough to defeat them all including a battle  that shows how viscous, arrogant and blood thirsty the Cattail demon king really was back in the past. This time his body and spirit completely destroyed.

Shi Hao and Huo Linger ,Shi Batian ran into a demon cattail tree in the shattered world in the lower realms seen in Episode 24 of the donghua, he attacked Shi Hao and used his dandelion seeds spurs to try and suck his power but in tern Shi Hao eat it and also tried to eat his tree vines which made the cattail tree shocked and angry as that has never happened before.

Years later after Shi Hao returned to the Lower realm with the descendants of the kings eight hundred children, he growing them up to be powerful beings to one day march in to all the realms and conquer, before then he decided to truly explore all corners of the Lower realms eight domains, he brought some of the now powerful kids, grown experts in their own rights to gain experience, also Hairy Ball, Big Red etc tagged along. They entered the shattered world and realize once lush and beautiful green small world now dark  and void off all life, up ahead they saw a middle age man in the Self-Release realm cultivating, its was the cattail tree in Humanoid form.. He was shocked to see the young boy that fought him now grown and powerful.

The Cattail tree using his innate ability the dandelion seeds that would flew about, took root in the flesh of enemies/living beings, it would definitely suck them dry, not even bone marrow remaining. He killed everyone including the heaven defying genius monkey king, all killed. Shi Hao  left the demon cattail tree to the three most promising leaders among the kids to fight, they were more than enough for the cattail tree, they suppress and killed it.

characters.introText: Di Chong (The Young Great One) Has the Nine-Headed Bird’s, Nine Lives undying body bloodline as well as another type of lineage. His relative Di Kun inside Immortal Ancient reveal to Shi Hao  that both of them were descendant that came from an extremely powerful humanoid creature’s bloodline of Immortal origins. Their ancestor the ruined True Immortal was said to come from an Immortal King Bloodline from Immortal Domain so it normal to guesstimate both have the same bloodline of kings.
characters.history:
Di Chong (The Young Great One) Has the Nine-Headed Bird’s, Nine Lives undying body bloodline as well as another type of lineage. His relative Di Kun inside Immortal Ancient reveal to Shi Hao  that both of them were descendant that came from an extremely powerful humanoid creature’s bloodline of Immortal origins. Their ancestor the ruined True Immortal was said to come from an Immortal King Bloodline from Immortal Domain so it normal to guesstimate both have the same bloodline of kings.

The nine headed Birds Innate bloodline supreme skills is said to be only second to the Archaic Vicious Ten great archaic bird ancient technique aka True Phoenix Treasure Technique. The Nine headed bloodline grants Nine Lives, once activated the user is very hard to kill as it allows the user to revived nine times in battle depending on his cultivation realm. Di Chong is the future inheritor of Immortal Palace, a true talented genius with the potential of becoming an immortal king in the future, he was talented enough  to  opened up a Martial Dao Heavenly Eye which along with Mind Connection are known as two of the most legendary Doa technique only the most gifted can accomplished, Even Sect Master found it extremely difficult to cultivate because this was something unrelated to cultivation realms, purely relying on talent.

Ancient talents such as six crown king, ten crown king etc in the Three Thousand Provinces who had decades of training under their belt but suppress their cultivation in the Venerable Realm through different methods, they were all ridiculously powerful than the average venerable realm cultivators and could easily defeat all at the same or a realm higher.  Di Chong was a bit like Shi Hao, Shi Yi who burst unto the scene without thousands of years of cultivation under their belt and could swept through or rather still be on par with those ancient freaks talented individuals.

Immortal Palace has a rich history since the Ancient Era and is known to never have more than five official members which includes their recovering ancestor the Ruined True Immortal. They have conquered many powerful clans over the years and instill many of them as loyal servants and with such dominant and servitude methods the majority of clans in the 3000 dao province feared them.

Immortal Palace were like a loose cannon and does as they like without restrain thus many clans were destroyed and their most powerful technique seized by Immortal palace, as explained in the novel by Qi Daolin Immortal Palace has a few matchless secret techniques, but they didn’t establish them, but obtained them from other inheritances. It could even be said that their hands are covered in blood. One of those technique was the  incomplete aka loose version of the Fetus Split Technique which allow him to split one body into two real body. (FYI: The true version is practice by the Undying Being Shi Hao and pagoda unchained during the immortal  mountain arc in the lower realm) Both bodies can cultivate and gain strength at the same time and once they merge, his fighting power will erupt like a volcano and have boundless power.

Di Chong second body while outside gaining experience were invited by the Heaven Mending Sect's elders and then they gain the loose split fetus technique which later given to Yue Chan. Its was implied that Di Chong and Yue Chan could one day become Doa Partners as stated by Huang Yu the immortal palace old servant.

The fetus split technique was said to be  extremely difficult to cultivate, as well as exceedingly dangerous. They originally thought that Immortal Palace was only testing this on Yue Chan, never expecting that their own inheritor also cultivated it. In this world, there were actually two who succeeded.

Di Chong wanted to get rid of Shi Hao after news travel to the upper realm that Yue Chan second body was captured by Shi Hao, this was a problem for the immortal palace young one  as there may be a possibility of the split technique secrets/weakness being leaked to outsiders so he sent Huaung Yu to slaughter him.

Di Chong tasted defeat for the first time from Shi Hao in the Upper Realm during the Yuan Tian Secret Realm Battle, he again fought Shi Hao at the Goddess Academy when he appeared alongside Yue Chan main body demanding the release of disguised Qing Yi to them, Shi Hao took action and this time a true battle erupted between them but in the end his second body again fell short, though his second body took a blow to his pride the main body did not care much because it was only his second body, his main body believed he could swept away all with is tyrannical archaic fighting style prowess, and had he merged he would've easily crush Shi Hao, after all, except for the hidden ancient freaks none could seriously in the younger genertion compare?.

During the Immortal Ancient Di Chong already merged bodies before entering became comparable and stronger than many of the crown king freaks a talented bunch of individuals. The moment he entered, the loose cultivator Shenyan Samsara spurred into action having a great battle with him and then the hothead and vicious individual Zi Yanfei (The Great Heaven Burning Art inheritor fought with Di Chong to a stand still but they decided to head into seclusion as it was a race for all the strongest to break into the Divine Flame Realm and create the most powerful foundation by igniting the first of their three Immortal Energy Strand.

Shi Hao, the first to cultivate a second Immortal Energy Strand and further strengthening it to an almost complete level went looking for Di Chong to settle the score, within a small world  Di Chong were spotted in seclusion using true immortal blood as his divine flame to lit his foundation and further stablizing his immortal energy strand, Shi Hao used a lion roar technique learn on the spot from Qing Yi  to disrupt a crucial and fragile moment during his cultivation, di chong became so scared and frantic that he ended up half crippled and half his body rotted from the immortal blood, he escape in a panic swearing he would return after recovering and slaughter Shi Hao .

Four hours later di chong came looking for Shi Hao demanding a face off to the death, a huge battle erupted but to di chong dismay he came to realize his opponent became much much more powerful, Shi Hao immortal strand was almost fully developed and strengthen to near completions, not to mention forming a second one, while di chong immortal strand still not fully formed due to the interruption from Shi Hao earlier, in the end di chong was no match for him and used his greatest innate ability of the Nine headed bird that allow nine lives but it did little, as he was cut down again and again by Shi Hao no matter how many times he revived.
characters.trivia:
In the novel, Di Chong's name wasn't introduced until Chapter 875.

Di Chong and Di Kun is a descendant of immortals, possible immortal king as the ruined immortal is from a immortal king family in immortal domain.

Di Chong has a relative name Di Kun inside immortal ancient who were the genius of his era who over look all in his generation.

The Donghua deviate from the novel a bit. Taking that step aka the Immortal Energy strand, during Shi Hao and Di chong final battle, Shi Hao had already fully formed one strand and was in the process of another, as for Di Chong when his training got interrupted his strand was 80-90% completed and was still able to be shrouded in immortal mist, therefore Di chong were fighting a losing battle from the start.

The Nine Headed legendary bird was not Di Chong original form as stated in the donghua- to be more precise he was half and half.

In the distant Future 500k Years after Shi Hao aka Huang became a powerful Immortal king, experiences countless great war via darkness era etc, he returned to a destroyed three thousand province and was overwhelmed with emotions, reflecting and  regretting his past young self eagerness to prove himself and slaughtering many young geniuses stating had he shown more restrain and not killed the likes of Di Chong and others perhaps the three thousand provinces wouldn't have been destroyed and survived.

Divine dark child former secret was widely known and was said to be a corpse from the Burial Domain a corpse that gain a new primordial spirit an Archaic Era ancient corpse, perhaps even originating from the previous great era.

His body sturdy and powerfully unique, his physical body is unmatched, it will never become exhausted. Dark Child had a world shocking flesh shell, some places even more terrifying than the Six Zhang Golden Body. Not only was it undecaying his flesh was incomparably strange, shining even when it had been chopped up, all types of symbols erupting and on each parts were engrave with symbols that automatically control each limb and a technique.

He's the owner of the Fist size mysterious ancient black cauldron, a powerful weapon made from Black Immortal Gold. Even if it was damaged right now, its material alone was enough to make the great sects of the higher realms’ three thousand provinces turn red with greed, willing to fight wars over it.

He would join an alliance with Jun Dao,  Heavenly kingdom Ancient King and Ancient Holy Child to defeat Shi Hao, they would lurk and ambush him on multiple occasions but in the end all four were defeat and killed miserably.
characters.trivia:
The name of this character is taken from the English translation of the novel, but it would actually be more accurate to call his Darkness God's Child (黑暗神子 - hēi àn shén zǐ).
"黑暗 " (hēi àn) means "darkness" or "dark."

"神 " (shén) means "god," "deity," or "divine."

"子 " (zǐ) means "child," "son,".

In Ep 163 of the donghua some translation had his name different from the novel which translate to Son of Darkness.

characters.introText: Double Pupils Women is a powerful cultivator from the ancient era, Shi Hao at age 15  said she Looks around  2-3 years older than him which is 17-18yrs old.
characters.appearance:
Double Pupils Women is a powerful cultivator from the ancient era, Shi Hao at age 15  said she Looks around  2-3 years older than him which is 17-18yrs old.

Her appearance was outstanding. There was a beautiful charm and otherworldly style to her. When her fine black hair scattered, an exceptional appearance was revealed. Her complexion was snow white like jade, extremely beautiful and almost dreamlike. Only fairy Yue Chan or the Witch would be able to compare to her beauty. Her pupils were extremely deep, and within them, there was surprisingly fatigue, as well as wisdom. It was as if those eyes witness the rise and fall of this world, giving  a rather strange feeling It was because she was extremely outstanding and beautiful, yet those eyes seemed to have experienced the endless visages of time. It was as if they could see through everything. When speaking a few words, her deep pupils shone with incomparable brilliance. At this moment, it was as if the entire universe had been recreated, and the great void was once again being remodeled.
characters.history:
Double Pupils Women or Grey clothed woman as referred to in the Novel, She became an guest elder of the Medicine capital which was established by the divine medicine gate.It can be said she is well verse in medicinal herbs and also hinted as a formation master as were shown in later chapter where she set up many Nine Tier powerful and complicated killing formation at Medicine capital Valley slaughtering many upper realm masters.

Shi Hao  wanted to see the master behind the Divine Medicine Sect. He climbed the stairs alone and came to the Palace of Double Pupils. The girl with heavy eyes just wanted to see Shi Hao, after all, he was able to defeat Shi Yi When she saw the remnant sword in Shi Hao's hand, she knew that it was the weapon of Ghost Grandpa. Unfortunately, after the baptism of the years, the remnant sword was already very dilapidated. The girl with heavy pupils revealed her own heavy pupils. Shi Hao could see at a glance that she also had heavy pupils.

Double Pupils Women comes from ancient Era, Time must have stopped for her when she was at her peak. She was someone who had never been defeated throughout the heaven and earth her dual pupil power earned an outstanding reputation! . This individual had lived from the ancient era until the present day. Even though the gray-clothed woman was weary, her body was still full of vitality. The endless passage of time could not affect her outstanding appearance. She was truly an extraordinary beauty.

The Grey clothed woman’s pupils could split and change into dual-pupils or merge and become no different from an ordinary person’s pupils and when needed, they could reappear. Those pupils were just too special. They could unexpectedly separate and bring about an image of heaven and earth splitting apart. Heavenly bodies fell one after another, and chaotic energy filled those eyes. How profound of a realm was this?  shi hao thought? The dual-pupils were merged, forming one pupil. Only when needed would they reappear to reveal their heaven defying might. Chaotic energy would filled those dual pupils as if the heaven and earth were splitting apart. Celestial bodies were falling within them. The dual-pupiled individual was unrivaled during the ancient era, whether it be in the heavens or underneath the earth. It has never been defeated. This legend has been in existence for far too long, one that had never been forgotten by the residents of this world as the most skillful being in the book, she fought directly from the beginning to the finale.

After the battle between the two stones, the girl with Double Eye Pupil  went to the Demon Lake to take away Shi Yi's physical body. Later, she appeared alongside the embodiment Imprint of Ruthless Empress , she seized the first spiritual root from the hands of many Upper realm leaders. The flower of the avenue, in all likelihood, was used to save Shi Yi, and then the girl with the double pupil simply disappeared, never appeared again until Shi Hao calmed down the dark chaos and rescued her from the Guidance ancient palace refined by the Four Fallen Half-Immortal Emperor Minions of the Corpse Immortal Emperor.

Like Countless others that went to Realm Sea in hopes of strength, it is stated that those of the Supreme Being and True Immortal realm has a death rate of 99.99%. None, if any ever survived, one example of which is the nine previous powerful True Immortal students of Shi Hao Master (Restricted Region Lord) all died, Fairy Qing yue the Green Moon Flame was the most notable of his previous students before shi hao. The restricted lord himself, then a powerful Peak True Immortal that could easily killed most in that realm also died shortly after barely escaping realm sea with life strengthening injuries. Unless they have a powerful Immortal King giant by their side it is suicide, even normal immortal king life isn't guaranteed and only can travel the outer areas of Realm Sea. when Huang entered Realm Sea outer regions its was describe that many Immortal king dead bodies float about, which is why many lower cultivation level individuals in the Supreme being and True immortal risk it all to enter, getting one of those Kings body or their cultivation script can help their cultivation skyrocket in to an true immortal or  immortal king realm faster.

During her conversation with Hao she quoted “It really is you, you quelled the chaos, cut through the prisons, eliminated the disaster on this end of Realm Sea.” She released a light sigh, endlessly moved". From a readers standpoint and knowledge of how Realm Sea Hierarchy is setup, the words have also shown that she went deep into Realm Sea before being defeated by the Fallen Immortals Kings and spirit captured. we can Guesstimate that she is at the realm of Peak Immortal King or first layer of Immortal King Giant, As we know from the novel only those of Peak immortal with higher battle prowess or Immortal king giants can enter the mids of realm sea, as for the final destination islands? only Ancient Immortal King giant or Emperor Light Immortal King can enter. The reasons why at the final destination many of the Powerful Giants like the Immortal Butcher, Chicken former etc were at the entrance of the main island for millions of years unable to enter just cultivating is because even Normal Half Immortal Emperors would find it difficult to enter the island and stay alive due to the Doa of law and the Four Fallen Half-Immortal Emperor.

During the Foreign Domain Arc,  when Shi Hao, Sanzang and Shenming leave Immortal Realm and entered the old imperial pass and learn of the stone clan "Sinners blood" past history, it was hinted that  the dual pupils woman bloodline was a descendant of one of the past three human king clan which two of them has been long eradicated leaving only the stone human clan which was bestowed the Human Kings Divine Inheritance (Extreme Arts) Double Eye Pupil and Supreme Being Bones bloodline imprint.

Her Legacy or greatest achievement known can be said to be the rescuing of  Shi Yi that can be regarded as indirectly saving Shi Hao. After all, Shi Yi sacrificed himself, and Shi Hao was able to defeat the three. As a Half-Immortal Emperor, the relationship between Shi Hao and her was also caused by cause and effect.
characters.trivia:
Ancient Era in general can be anywhere from 1500 years or more, in the Novel ancient era were referred to 10,000 years or more. Cultivators  that are 50,000+ years are still called younger generations.

The Double Pupil woman were described or referred to on more than one occasions to be of the younger generation via, Shi Hao ,Little Pagoda and Willow Deity

characters.history:
Dragon Girl is fame as one of the top beauties within the Three Thousand Provinces and also one of the most powerful among the younger generation. She is ranked within the top three when it comes to strength among the females that entered the Immortal Ancient.

Dragon Girl first met Shi Hao after the Three Stone Brothers (Shi Hao, Shi Yi, Qin Hao) fought against Ning Chuan at immortal fallen ridge within one of the Archaic Vicious Ten (Heavenly Horned Ant cave inheritance). Shi Hao and Shi Yi use the blood of Ning Chuan to break the cave seal, after a chaotic scramble to obtain treasures, Shi Hao accidentally smack Dragon Girl buttocks which lead to her embarrassment and exchange blows with Shi Hao regardless of his explanation.

With hundred of thousands of individuals inside they later realized it was all a trap, all set by a mysterious youth who slaughtered the hundred of thousands of genius that day using their blood as seed to lit and nourish his Divine Flame Realm and cultivate his second strand of Immortal Energy Strand.

characters.introText: Dugu Yun is a powerful Genius and of the most gifted during his time at the Heavenly Deity Institution. After the Foreign Land king clan temporarily broke through the realm wall  to the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths and decided to let the youngster fight to test out the current difference in strength they created a protective single domain using the two immoral treasure both sides owned, the  Heaven and Earth immortal Pouch artifact and Ten Realm Diagram, During the battle  Mo Dao lost and became Shi hao slave and the Void beast genius of a powerful clan on the other side killed by Shi Hao.
characters.appearance:
Dugu Yun is from an ancient clan bloodline called the protectors, their clan weren't many but a unique race with Golden Blood. When fighting their blood turn from normal to golden putting them in a berserk like state with unmatched power. There are divine consciousness fragments in the golden blood, imprints of their ancestors. the descendants could see the events that happened in the past! and also their clan inheritance, technique and skills pass down in their blood similarly to the Archaic Vicious Ten such as the Kun Peng Tribe, True Dragon Tribe etc.

Their clan in ancient times during the war were almost wipe out fighting a glorious battle sacrificing their lives and the others captured and brought to the foreign land, though In reality, in the bone books that were dug up, as well as some long life family’s jade books, there were vague recordings that spoke of how unfortunate the protectors’ bloodline was, dying tragically in battle all because a few people sold them out.

Dugu know some of the past from his golden blood has a burning hatred for  the nine heavens,  There are some of the traitors who aren’t dead, and they have descendants who are still are alive. The reason he  appeared is for vengeance!” Dugu Yun was extremely direct, stating this. He was very arrogant and and look down on those from the Nine heavens, after all they were inferior by far, only shi hao at that time were his opponent and if he had went all out shi hao may have lost. The elders wanted to protect him and have him fight for their side like in the future but Dugu Yun was straight forward and reject the idea because he told them that it was impossible to win, on the other side he was a normal genius but in the nine heavens only a handful was his opponent.

As time went on Dugu Yun was protected due to his clan background and the elders did everything to try and ease his hatred, having no way back to the other side Dugu became a resident in the nine heavens like his ancestors, after all he wanted to be there for the time been because he had access to this ancestors records, archaic sites that left traces of his clan etc... his true goal were to return to his clan and impossible place to find, later revealed to be Immortal Domain. Dugu Yun would gradually find out that his true bloodline was that of the darkness bloodline, his first hint came from the slave mine that shi hao were previously sold and worked in as a slave under the Wang Clan, there were unexplored regions inside that held secrets of Dugu Yun clan. Ning Chuan also confirmed in the final battle that the protectors lineage of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths were also darkness creatures. their blood sometimes became black, as if they were corroded. Meanwhile, Dugu Yun was the descendant of the protectors lineage.

As time went on he became more accustom to life there and eventually had praise for Shi Hao Talent realizing that there may be hope if he were given time to grow, after Desolate border war against the foreign land and the cultivation-less and darkness era arrived and clan scrambled to find away to enter Immortal Domain he was one of the genius chosen and he was able to return to his clan.

During the final battle a chaotic event which Immortal Domain was outnumbered ten to one while Shi Hao fought the Half-Immortal Emperor's and the Witch, Shi Yi , Qin Hao ,Exiled Immortal Yao Yue, Little Heavenly King and even the Golden Undead Knights such as Shen Ming and San Zang and their entire clan rejected their darkness bloodline and they all fought for Immortal Realm. Ning Chuan now a Peak True Immortal a bit off from breaking into the Immortal King Realm decided to fight with the enemy, they then made it their goal to slaughter him at any cost. Ning Chaun with a shocked to everyone revealed that he wasn't a traitor he simple went back to his true clan bloodline, revealing that he had the blood of the fallen one running true his veins he was their descendant. Dugu Yun story came to a closed in that battle after a bloody fight with Ning Chuan with both killing each other.

characters.introText: His true form: a huge red wolf head with thick crimson fur, adorned with a pair of giant black horns, and nine tails suddenly burst out from behind the wolf's body, each ending with a dragon head, actually nine true dragons, as black as ink, with fierce dragon heads, opening their huge mouths with sharp fangs, as if to tear apart the universe and the stars.
characters.appearance: His true form: a huge red wolf head with thick crimson fur, adorned with a pair of giant black horns, and nine tails suddenly burst out from behind the wolf's body, each ending with a dragon head, actually nine true dragons, as black as ink, with fierce dragon heads, opening their huge mouths with sharp fangs, as if to tear apart the universe and the stars.
characters.history:
The Elder of Apocalypse has already reached the realm where one foot steps into the realm of the Immortal Emperor. As the ancestral figure of the Jiuyou Tribe (he alone crushes all the past strongmen of the Archaic Vicious Ten; the True Dragon Tribe is like ants before him, and his appearance has made the Jiuyou Tribe the leader of the new Vicious Ten), he is a giant figure at the edge of the boundless sea, known as the "First Emperor of Heaven and Earth" by the Gray Emperor.

He once almost became an Immortal Emperor (which is why the likes of the Grand Emperor greatly fear and respect him), but in the end, he nearly perished and sealed himself after severe injuries. Drifting in the universe as an ancient corpse for countless epochs (much older than even the Three Fallen Emperors), he is the "guide" of the Three Fallen Emperors, and they resolutely contacted him to seek a breakthrough in their pursuit of the position of Immortal Emperor.

He was the first to come into contact with the remains of the Immortal Emperors; the Gray Emperor, Grand Emperor, and Feather Emperor are his juniors. Before being killed by Huang, he was the strongest Half-Immortal Emperor in all epochs.

He appeared during the battle between Shi Hao and the Three Dark Emperors, assisting the Three Dark Emperors in killing Shi Hao, but was beaten out of his original form by Shi Hao with a one-against-four confrontation.

It was then that it was revealed that he was the ancestor of the Jiuyou Tribe.

Extremely ferocious and terrifying, it opens its blood-filled mouth to devour Shi Hao. With a single bite, the sea of ​​bounds is annihilated, and the stars in the sky fall into its mouth, which is too terrifying. This power is countless times stronger than the Divine Ability of the Gluttonous, truly devouring the heavens and the earth, refining all things in the universe.

The huge divine wolf head, bloody mouth, in one bite, swallows everything nearby, emitting a dark light, refining all tangible matter. A pair of huge shining horns collided with the rules pool of Desolation, causing the space here to collapse, and the sea of bounds to dry up. Afterwards, the Dark Four Emperors were all suppressed into the rules pool by Shi Hao, and it took nearly ten thousand years for Shi Hao to completely kill the primordial spirits of the Dark Four Emperors.

characters.title: Elder Qing Mu
characters.introText: He is an elderly man with long, flowing white hair that is swept back in a refined style, giving him a distinguished and majestic appearance. His thick white eyebrows, full beard, and long mustache further emphasize his age and wisdom, while the wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes hint at a lifetime of experience.
characters.appearance:
He is an elderly man with long, flowing white hair that is swept back in a refined style, giving him a distinguished and majestic appearance. His thick white eyebrows, full beard, and long mustache further emphasize his age and wisdom, while the wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes hint at a lifetime of experience.

His most striking facial feature is his pair of light amber-gold eyes, which convey both authority and composure. He maintains a stern yet dignified expression, reflecting the bearing of a respected elder or powerful cultivator.

He wears an ornate golden hair ornament that arches gracefully over the top of his head, adding to his noble appearance. His attire consists of elegant traditional robes in shades of gray, accented with intricate golden trim and elaborate golden shoulder guards. The combination of muted fabrics and richly decorated armor-like embellishments gives him the appearance of a high-ranking elder or influential figure of great prestige.
characters.history:
One of supreme beings of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths

Elder Qing Mu was one of Imperial Pass' venerable supreme beings and the master of Qi Hong. He was the original owner of the Five Spirits War Chariot, a legendary artifact later inherited by Qi Hong. In his prime, Elder Qing Mu was a shocking figure who drove that war chariot into countless battles, feared and virtually unmatched among supreme beings of his generation.

By the time of the story's present, his blood energy had long since dried and withered with age, his hair scattered and meager  but he remained, in status and power, one of the unmatched pillars defending Imperial Pass. Like several of the city's other elder supreme beings, he had spent the greater half of his life standing guard against the other side's strongest existences.

When the undying king Anlan advanced toward Imperial Pass in an ancient war chariot pulled by a golden-backed barbaric bull using his own strength to physically prop up and drag the original Emperor City forward while crossing Heaven Abyss  the defenders of Imperial Pass found themselves powerless. Without true immortals of their own, no one on the wall could match an undying king directly, and the city fell into despair.

Recognizing that once Anlan finished crossing Heaven Abyss nothing could stop him, Elder Qing Mu made the decision to act preemptively, using the city's last trump card: the Immortal Subduing Monument, a forbidden relic left over from the Immortal Ancient era, rumored to be capable of killing true immortals and destroying undying beings  but only at the cost of exhausting the wielder's own magical force entirely in the process.

When Meng Tianzheng attempted to step forward, Qing Mu stopped him outright, insisting that Meng Tianzheng needed to remain behind to oversee the city, and that this task was his alone to carry out.

Elder Qing Mu walked out of Imperial Pass alone, the Immortal Subduing Monument manifesting behind him  initially only person-sized, but growing larger and more imposing with each step he took, until it towered "like a mountain" and seemingly threatened to crush him under its weight. Despite the visible strain, his back straightened as the monument fully separated from his body and became independent, and he turned to give Imperial Pass one final look before facing forward and advancing without looking back a clear signal to those watching, including a devastated Qi Hong, that he did not expect to return.

Charging toward Anlan's war chariot, Qing Mu activated the monument with a chanted incantation, his own body glowing with immortal dao symbols as the Immortal Subduing Monument shone with ancient natural-law power and descended toward the chariot.

However, the war chariot itself  scarred with the marks of endless historical battles (blade wounds, arrow holes) proved to carry its own undying radiance and defensive dao patterns. These activated on their own and struck back against the descending monument, shattering the Immortal Subduing Monument into pieces before it could reach Anlan.

In the same instant, Elder Qing Mu's body was hacked apart and exploded into a mist of blood, killing him instantly. Notably, his death did not trigger any of the dramatic natural phenomena that normally accompany the death of a supreme being the war chariot's own patterns actively suppressed and erased those reactions before they could manifest, denying his death even that final mark of significance.

The golden-backed barbaric bull pulling Anlan's chariot mocked his sacrifice afterward, calling him a "trifling ant" whose death "doesn't deserve pity"  a taunt that left the watching defenders of Imperial Pass furious but powerless to respond, having just witnessed their strongest trump card fail and one of their most venerable elders die for nothing tangible in return.
