Emperor Butterfly a race of mysterious and powerful clans that rarely seen since ancient times.

Shi Hao first learn of the Emperor butterfly while fighting the Supreme elder Lin Kun from the Divine Medicine Sect. While dealing for his life he offered some rare medicines but wasn't enough, so he then brought out half of the box and spilled its secrets. Its was said the sect founder (Medicine God) was looking for the Emperor Butterfly inside the Medicine capital valley but instead found the emperor cocoon in larva state and seal it within the  one half of the Treasure box while injured and later died by a powerful formation where the cocoon was located.

Before death he sealed it inside a Divine Ice Jar and then left it inside the small world of the World Treasure Box where it has been since. Lin Kun had the other half which he gave Shi Hao then went to the Medicine valley in search. After some Ups and down they were able to acquire the Complete World Treasure Box and the Emperor butterfly Cocoon,.

The Emperor Butterfly finally came out of seclusion and fully underwent rebirth by transforming into a powerful Self-Release Power house and help protect Hao while fighting Wang Clan elder, as they wanted to get rid for hao due to his talent and being enemies thus releasing a legendary insect the Lightning Spirit Bugs that attack ones Dao Fruit crippling that individual. The Emperor butterfly had a major battle with them protecting Shi Hao.

The emperor  made many appearances and had many battles and adventures alongside Shi Hao and friends during his younger days into the Darkness Calamity era before he was sealed up with the clans and everyone by Shi Hao.

characters.history:
Kong Qiuji, nicknamed Er Tuzi, comes from the Peacock clan. When he fell in love with Yun Menglan, he was regarded as a "scourge" by the gods. Due to the opposition of the clan members, Qiuji and Menglan failed.

Due to their love and arranged marriage, they ran away together. They headed for the upper realm but were hunted down. Qiuji was severely injured, with his cultivation abolished, vital status unknown to Menglan. He was then found by Shi Hao in the Hundred Shattered Mountains and nicknamed Er Tuzi.

It was not until the Lower Realm suddenly changed that he and Shi Hao traveled to the Celestial Clan, helped them repair the teleportation circle, and went to the Upper Realm with them. With Yun Menglan's connection, his relationship with the Celestial Clan was not too bad.

After going to the upper realm, Er Tuzi quickly found his own clan, the Peacock Clan, and due to Liu Shen's relationship, he followed him.

Next to the ancestor of the Peacock clan, this ancestor received a drop of divine liquid from Willow Deity when he was young, and regarded Willow Deity as his master. When Er Tuzi came to visit the Celestials, he happened to go to the prison and took a look. He found out that Shi Hao had caused trouble again and was imprisoned. He was immediately furious and started fighting with the Celestians.
His ancestor heard that Shi Hao was the master and disciple of Willow Deity. They were determined to protect Shi Hao, and there was a estrangement between them and the Celestials, and both sides took action.

Later, when Shi Hao escaped from the Celestial Clan, Er Tuzi even had a drink with him, and the brotherhood became very deep. The same goes for Lord Peacock. When Shi Hao came out of the Immortal Ancient Secret Realm, Lord Peacock was willing to have conflicts with several cult leaders for him. After Willow Deity appeared, he simply accepted the discipleship ceremony and asked Shi Hao to call him senior brother, which was regarded as Shi Hao. A force that we made friends with earlier in the upper realm.

During the Dharma End Age , He stayed in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths to train and fight together with his Martial Brother Shi Hao. Later to be sealed in the Three World Bronze Coffin with his wife because of the old Age and to avoid the Dark turmoil

characters.introText: The Fake Medicine Seller (卖假药的) is one of the most ancient and powerful giants of the Realm Sea, standing alongside the Butcher and Chicken Farmer as an existence who once dominated the depths of the sea. His true origins and full history remain largely unknown, but even ancient Immortal Kings regarded him as an extraordinarily dangerous existence.
characters.appearance:
The Fake Medicine Seller (卖假药的) is one of the most ancient and powerful giants of the Realm Sea, standing alongside the Butcher and Chicken Farmer as an existence who once dominated the depths of the sea. His true origins and full history remain largely unknown, but even ancient Immortal Kings regarded him as an extraordinarily dangerous existence.

His unusual title comes from his connection to an ancient Immortal Medicine. His body was divided into six parts, with each part sealed within one of six stalks of ancient immortal medicine. These six medicines were therefore not six separate beings, but fragments of the same existence. As long as one of the six parts remained intact, he could eventually reconstruct his true body.

The six-part division was not just a means of survival. The Fake Medicine Seller created this method with a greater ambition: to break through the limits of the Immortal King Realm and eventually become an a true Emperor. His method allowed his different incarnations to continue existing independently while accumulating experience and preparing for his eventual return.
characters.history:
The Fake Medicine Seller once attempted to break through the Imperial Path, but something went wrong. Rather than accepting failure, he developed a unique incarnation method and divided himself into six parts, sealing each fragment within an immortal medicine together known throughout Realm Sea and Burial Earth as the "six ancient medicines." According to the burial kings Huo Heng and Han Zhuo, this was no accident of desperation but a calculated strategy: by scattering himself in this dormant, disguised form, he could withdraw from the endless, mutually destructive struggle consuming other kings desperate to reach emperorhood, and instead wait potentially across great eras for the day he could safely reunite all six fragments into his true body at once. They believed that when that recombination finally came, it would demand tremendous resources and produce an "unimaginable great commotion," powerful enough to potentially threaten Burial Earth's very existence.

One of these six incarnations eventually surfaced in Burial Earth in the form of a mysterious spiritual root celebrated there as the "lower realm's number one spiritual root." Shi Hao had previously encountered this immortal medicine directly and found its behavior deeply strange for something supposedly just a plant: it was a small, foot-tall tree wrapped in hazy white immortal mist, its branches and leaves flickering with sparkling brilliance like stars caught in the haze, bearing three flowers that continuously changed form. One flower left the tree entirely, transforming mid-air into a tiny humanoid figure no larger than a fist, which then sat beneath the tree and began comprehending the dao like a cultivator in meditation. A second flower rang out with a bell-like sound and transformed into a weapon, cycling restlessly between the forms of a bell and a pagoda before settling as a halo of light floating above the small figure's head. A third flower flowed like liquid essence, landing on both the figure and the weapon and continuously refining them both.

This uncanny display a supposed "stalk of medicine" behaving as though fully alive, cultivating and refining itself with clear purpose unsettled even the burial kings who understood its nature. Rather than claim or study it, they deliberately tried and failed to send the stalk away, avoiding it entirely out of fear of the karma it might bring down on whoever grew too close. Only much later did Shi Hao learn the fuller truth behind what he had witnessed: that the small figure meditating beneath the tree was, in fact, one of the Fake Medicine Seller's six divided incarnations, quietly accumulating cultivation and awaiting eventual reunification with its five other counterparts.

Coin Uncle and Bird Grandpa suggested to Shi Hao if he ever encountered a part this individual to eat it because it too troublesome to deal with.

Divine Dark Child is a genius  He was a very prideful individual who rather death than summit to another, it was to the point that even as an enemy Shi Hao had great respect toward their battle and was even willing to let him survive, in tern allowing him to study the many Archaic Vicious Ten lost ancient technique he possess but he flat out rejected and choose death.  he held the loose True Phoenix’s divine ability which Shi Hao has always been interested in, Void return technique, refinement technique  and Fallen Divine Imprint just a few of the many ancient technique he used that were lost in the current era.

characters.trivia:
The name of this character is taken from the English translation of the novel, but it would actually be more accurate to call his Fallen God's Child (堕神子 - duò shén zǐ).
"堕 " (duò) means "fall," "fallen,".

"神 " (shén) means "god," "deity," or "divine."

"子 " (zǐ) means "child," "son,".

In Ep 163 of the donghua some translation had his name different from the novel which translate to Son of Duoshen (堕神子 - duò shén zǐ) with the pinyin.

characters.history:

It could be said that among the leading figures of the endless past, there were only a few individuals. Half immortal emperors were the most powerful existences since the ancient times until now. Great eras passed one after the next, yet just how many of them were there until now? Even unmatched immortal kings didn’t have the qualifications to meet them.

Feather emperor is from the age of emperor collapse and like his other three counterpart they came to the edge of realm sea in search of a path of becoming a true immortal emperor. They were like other cultivators with pride and ambitions when first slaughtered there way there, like Shi Hao when he first arrived the Corpse Immortal Emperor made them an offer to serve him, in return he will provide the cultivation path forward of taking that step of a true emperor, but they all refuse at first as the price was too great but after many eras of cultivating and not seeing a path forward they decided to become the corpse emperor minions. they would then create and refine the origin artifact which is responsible for creating the Burial realm and the Foreign land race.

For endless amount of time the four fallen half immortal emperor would used the entire "World Setting realms" as a medicine field similar to the lower realm calamity, they would wait for many great eras for them to populate with many creatures then release the darkness to seal primordial spirit and imprison them inside the ancient guidance palace, while origin artifact would create powerful soldiers. They claimed that newly half immortal emperors don’t understand the heaven’s mysteries, obstinately clinging onto their course/ideals. if anyone refuses to see their path as the correct choice death is their only choice as seen with the death ending  of the half immortal emperor who left the footprint behind the damn

There was an ancient war chariot that was extremely dazzling, releasing swirling brilliance, suppressing the world’s four extremes. The war chariot rumbled, surging behind the nine galloping ancient beasts who pulled it, quickly arriving.

Those nine ancient beasts all released endless power, every one of them sinister and terrifying, their scales indented. They were like True Dragons, but they weren’t either, all of them some unknown species. The nine ancient beasts moved along the great river of time, carrying that nine-colored immortal gold chariot as it slaughtered its way over.

After the appearance of Grand Emperor and Feather Emperor  Shi Hao ask what became of the primordial spirits trap inside the darkness, they open the void entrance  of the Guidance Ancient Palace and inside the darkness prison Huo Linger was loosing herself, mind wary forgetting much, Shi Hao would used his immortal emperor law to find and  protect her while attempt to also rescue her. During the process all hell broke loose as the three emperor notice Shi Hao feelings and decided to kill huo linger to rattle Shi Hao doa mind, he would next attempt and save Meng Tianzheng while fighting all three emperors. Feather emperor would then sound his dao will, saying charge to the other side of Realm Sea, bring back our people! If there are any that seem off, kill them all, endless  Fallen immortals would appear and head for Immortal Domain using the secrets passage by guidance palace, it would directly bring them there.

Close towards the climax of the battle, a defeated  Willow Deity and Little Pagoda both being nourish and protected by the defeated emperor from the age of emperor collapse, the Chaotic Flame fuse with willow deity, temporarily giving her the power of a Half Immortal Emperor power and the little pagoda fuse with his bones creating a tenth layer and become half emperor. The battle between huang and the three fallen emperor continued for many years. They fought from the primal chaos into the Land of Darkness, and then back into the ultimate ancient land. They went all out, fighting a decisive battle, In reality, the following battle toppled all of the records of the past great battles. They fought for thirty thousand years!. All of them were long skin wrapped around bones, their essence blood completely gone. If they continued like this, even half immortal emperors couldn’t continue. During the final Showdown, the river of time first produce three powerful half immortal emperors from the future who decided to give their life in order to change the past and kill Huang due to his influence on the future. They would join hand with the four fallen half emperors in order to eradicate him. characters.personality:
Feng Rui or the Golden tree woman is from the golden crow race and was speculated by her race to be a reincarnation of the Crow Emperor. Legends had it that their race originated from the Sun God Tree. One of their ancestors was produced from the tree. This ancestor broke out from a shell and ultimately became a Heavenly emperor.
That was precisely the first generation, the most powerful expert of a race. That existence had been produced by the world, and was an innate existence that was known to be unrivaled throughout the nine heavens and tenth earth. And now, this lady was also born from the Sun God Tree, blooming from a flower. Since the same things were happening, was another Crow Emperor going to be born?

When Shi Hao entered the ancestral land of the Golden Crow tribe[Lower Realm], he met a blonde woman. This woman was a descendant of one of the founders of the Immortal Domain Cultivation System, They were a group of powerful cultivators which initially name them self the imperial court but brought down the wrath of the fallen Half-Immortal Emperors on themselves who throughout history made it taboo to used that name, Only The Legendary Butcher of the group barely survived with his life.

Due the invasion of darkness, all the blond women's tribe perished, and only the blonde woman was sealed by her Grandfather inside of the world tree. She survived inside the golden sacred world tree.

When she was in the lower realm, she met Shi Hao. The two did not speak.

When they were in the upper realm, Shi Hao met the blonde woman again while entering Realm Tomb to look for a Perfect Immortal seed so to build a foundation breaking into the Void Dao, the blond woman also intended to take Shi Hao and others to find the way. The Heavenly Deity Academy geniuses follow behind the woman stopping at many locations finding many second grade seeds while the Half world tree and woman continue to cultivate the Dao, close to becoming a full world tree.

In later chapters 1932, the blonde girl completely transformed  told  Shi Hao some secrets about the Darkness calamity, Fallen immortal and also why he should be careful using the name Imperial Court. Shi Hao then learned the origin of the blonde girl. When Shi Hao was going through the Immortal King Tribulation, he was besieged by three immortal kings, Aocheng Immortal King, Taishi Immortal King and Yuanchu Immortal King outside the Immortal domain region, and the blonde girl also appeared. She wanted to save Shi Hao so she tried to block a powerful palm technique from AoCheng but she was no match for him, so she could only retreat with her heavy injuries.

Ao Cheng was said to be an Immortal King Giant  and unless you're an immortal king as well, going up against a normal immortal king giant would be suicide hence why her strength is guesstimated to be peak True Immortal with battle power an immortal king, or early stage initial Immortal King, the world tree has to be taken into consideration as it is shown to significantly boost one's power as it did for Tian Zi (Ten crown king) and he only has the world tree sapling, while she has a fully grown world tree.

The blonde girl didn't appear again until the finale.
characters.history:
The golden-haired woman's history stretches back an almost unfathomable length of time  so far that when Shi Hao asked which era she belonged to, she could only sigh and admit she had already forgotten how many great eras ago it was. She was born into the lineage of a being who helped draft the cultivation method behind Immortal Domain itself. Her grandfather was not its sole creator but one member of a larger group, all of them counted among the Prides of Heaven of their generation and among the most powerful individuals across many great eras. He personally came close enough to breaking through the Immortal King Realm that he was remembered as one who "almost" achieved it  an almost that, in the end, was the closest anyone in his circle would come.

That circle's shared ambition was to establish an Immortal Court and to be recognized as true emperors. None of them succeeded. Despite their strength, not one could actually cross into the Immortal King Realm, and one after another they collapsed, their clans nearly eradicated in the process. Her grandfather himself met his end after being seriously injured during an expedition into the Realm Sea; he ultimately died inside a Guidance Ancient Palace, the very type of structure that would come to define much of what she later understood about the mysteries of darkness. Of the entire group, only one other is known to have escaped total ruin  a "butcher" who fled to a different ancient realm, and who was rumored to have eventually made his own journey into the Realm Sea as well.

Before he died, her grandfather sealed her into the half World Tree, and it was here that she remained for the whole of the unmeasured time that followed, standing guard over the very Guidance Ancient Palace he had once slaughtered his way through the void to seize and suppress atop the tree. In her isolation there, cut off from her own generation, she came to understand secrets that almost no one else in her era possessed  knowledge she chose to lay out fully for Shi Hao once she realized his intentions toward Huo Ling'er.

She explained that this Guidance Ancient Palace was only one of many scattered throughout the void, all of them connected to one another and, crucially, to the Darkness Prison  the endless, boundless dark territory where primordial spirits are locked away, a place living creatures cannot normally set foot in. It was here, she revealed, that darkness matter itself originates. She described how the corrosion of darkness does not simply annihilate a creature: it strips away the primordial spirit while nurturing the abandoned flesh into producing an entirely new primordial spirit, one that genuinely belongs to the original body rather than being seized by some outside creature  though it comes without the original's memories, appearing to onlookers as someone changed. This was how she was able to reassure Shi Hao that Huo Ling'er's spirit still existed somewhere within that prison, even if the woman standing before him now was not, in memory, the one he had known. She further explained that the prison does not preserve everyone equally  only those who had achieved a form of immortality, becoming undying existences, had their primordial spirits kept intact at all, while ordinary bodies were simply erased by the darkness.

She went on to describe an entirely separate way into the Land of Darkness, one that did not require passing through a Guidance Ancient Palace at all: crossing the Realm Sea itself, which she called both an easier route and the path most commonly attempted by those seeking passage. She told him that travelers crossing the void could sometimes glimpse ascension light tearing open a crack into the Land of Darkness, but that no creature who had ever gone through such a crack had come back out alive. She added that those most driven to surpass the Immortal King Realm gravitated to this same route because of an old, unexplained clue: a pair of shallow footprints found at the edge of the Realm Sea, tracks that could not have been left by any Immortal King, and which had drawn seekers there for generations.

Finally, she turned to a rough bone record Shi Hao had once discovered within another Guidance Ancient Palace  a fragment describing a method so world-shocking that not even a heavenly emperor had ever obtained it. She identified this bone as something left behind by her grandfather's own generation, inscribed using great dao characters from different ages so that it might one day reach someone from a later era. By her own estimation, it represented the lower piece of the True Primordial Record, a text long rumored to exist in three parts  the upper piece Divine Guidance, the middle piece Transcendence, and a lower piece whose fate no one before her had ever confirmed.

Having shared everything, she left Shi Hao with a final warning to be careful, cautioning him with the fate of her grandfather's entire generation in mind  for even that group of world-shaking Prides of Heaven, aspiring to be emperors, had ultimately been unable to cross into true immortality, and had been all but erased for the attempt. With that, the World Tree turned into a streak of light and carried her away, leaving Shi Hao to absorb everything she had told him.

characters.history:
Feng Xingtian (风行天) emerged as a significant antagonist for Shi Hao, not from a personal slight, but from a deep-seated, historical feud between their respective clans. Feng Xingtian was the most outstanding genius of the Wind Clan (风族), an ancient and powerful family from the Nine Heavens. The Wind Clan held a long and bitter grudge against Shi Hao's lineage, viewing him as a threat to their standing and a target for elimination.

This animosity was not passive. Before Feng Xingtian’s direct involvement, the Wind Clan had already made overt moves to suppress Shi Hao, notably directing another cultivator, Yuan Qing, to act against him. This established a clear and hostile backdrop, making a direct confrontation between Shi Hao and the Wind Clan's top talent, Feng Xingtian, an inevitability.

The stage for their conflict was the Heavenly Deity Institution's ultimate trial: a venture into the Immortal Ancient Remains (仙古遗迹 - Xiān Gǔ Yíjì). This vast, ruined landscape, a remnant of a bygone glorious era, was the premier proving ground for the geniuses of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, filled with both profound opportunities and lethal dangers.

Within these ruins, Feng Xingtian’s reputation as an arrogant and ruthless individual was cemented. Drunk on his own power and the might of his clan's secret techniques, he acted with aggressive impunity. He targeted and attacked fellow prodigies, including the formidable Princess Yao Yue and Xuan Kun. His mastery of the Dark Heavenly Art was so overwhelming that these two powerful individuals, who were rivals themselves, were forced into a desperate retreat and an unlikely alliance with Shi Hao, who had been drawn to their conflict.

The chase led the trio deep into the perilous ruins, where the earth suddenly gave way, plunging them into a massive abyss. At the bottom, they discovered a hidden, dust-covered underground palace, an ancient and forgotten structure. This became the arena for their final battle.

Inside the palace, the alliance of Shi Hao, Yao Yue, and Xuan Kun confronted Feng Xingtian. Despite being outnumbered, Feng Xingtian was undaunted, his arrogance fueling a ferocious fighting spirit. He unleashed his clan's most powerful abilities, including the devastating Cross Divine Path and the Darkness Demonic Fist. However, he had underestimated his opponents, particularly Shi Hao. Shi Hao’s own profound heavenly arts, most notably the Six Dao Reincarnation Heavenly Art (六道轮回天功), proved superior. In a decisive clash, Shi Hao broke through Feng Xingtian's defenses and inflicted a grievous wound, leaving him on the verge of death.

As Shi Hao prepared to deliver the final, killing blow, the space in the palace warped, and a powerful figure intervened. This was Feng Xingtian's sixth uncle, the Wind Marquis (风侯 - Fēng Hóu), a terrifying expert at the Heavenly Deity Realm. Having disguised himself to illegally enter the trial grounds, his objective was twofold: save his promising nephew and capture Shi Hao, Yao Yue, and Xuan Kun.

His sinister plot went beyond mere capture. The Wind Marquis intended to use a forbidden clan art to refine their bodies and primordial spirits, either to create powerful, soulless servants or, more horrifyingly, to forcibly extract their talent and forge "fake" strands of Immortal Energy (仙气). This shocking revelation carried a dark implication: Feng Xingtian’s own acclaimed three strands of Immortal Energy were almost certainly not cultivated through his own effort but were products of this same unnatural and malevolent process.

The Wind Marquis's hubris led to his undoing. The immense energy unleashed during the battle, coupled with the Marquis's powerful aura, disturbed the palace's true master. The ancient structure was the resting place of a slumbering, half-rotten Supreme Being Imperial Butterfly (帝蝶) from a long-dead era.

Awakened from its eons-long slumber, the ancient creature was drawn to a familiar essence. It resonated with the Emperor Butterfly that Shi Hao carried, undergoing a sudden and spectacular rebirth. Reborn with immense power, its first act was to lash out at the intruder who had disturbed its rest. The newly reborn Imperial Butterfly annihilated the powerful Wind Marquis in a display of overwhelming force.

With his protector and uncle instantly slain, the severely wounded and terrified Feng Xingtian was left utterly defenseless before Shi Hao. Shi Hao, now unhindered, wasted no time. A single, powerful attack was all it took to end the life of the Wind Clan's top genius.

After the battle, Shi Hao confirmed his suspicions. He observed that the so-called Immortal Energy strands dissipating from Feng Xingtian's body were weak and unstable. He remarked that they were unquestionably "fake," as his true combat strength was far too low to be that of a genuine master who had cultivated three strands of Immortal Energy. Feng Xingtian's death was not just a personal victory for Shi Hao, but a devastating blow to the pride, prestige, and future of the deceitful Wind Clan.

characters.title: Feng Yingluo
characters.introText: Feng Yingluo (凤潆络; Fèng Yíngluò) is a major supporting antagonist in Perfect World. She is a core elder of the Wind Clan and the younger sister of the clan leader, Feng Zhao, as well as the aunt of Feng Xingtian. A powerful expert of the Nine Heavens, Feng Yingluo is renowned for her ruthless ambition, cunning schemes, and unwavering loyalty to the interests of the Wind Clan. Driven by her pursuit of greater power, she secretly cultivates the forbidden Dark Ancient Heavenly Art in an attempt to transcend mortality and attain the Immortal Dao.She has deep hostility towards Shi Hao and has long been secretly colluding with people from other realms.
characters.appearance:
Feng Yingluo possesses an elegant yet imposing imperial presence, her appearance defined by sharp contrasts of beauty, authority, and darkness. Her jet‑black hair is styled into an elaborate high bun, crowned with an ornate silver‑and‑gold headpiece whose wing‑shaped arcs rise like blades. Two rigid golden crescent ribbons curve dramatically above her shoulders, framing her silhouette like a luminous, weapon‑like halo. A stylized purple marking adorns her right cheekbone, accentuating her cold, calculating expression, while long, pointed gold earrings echo the sharp motifs of her crown.

She wears layered robes of silver, grey, and deep violet, with an asymmetrical bodice—one side embroidered in dark gold patterns, the other flowing with purple flame‑like motifs. Her shoulders are guarded by silver, wing‑shaped pauldrons that taper into metallic, ribbon‑like extensions along her arms. The overall effect is that of a regal, dangerous, and meticulously crafted figure whose beauty is inseparable from her authority and lethal grace
characters.history:
A prominent elder of the Wind Clan, Feng Yingluo rose to influence during an era when her clan had already spent generations navigating the shifting powers of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. Known for her sharp insight and formidable cultivation—standing at the peak of the Self-Severing she played a central role in the clan’s political strategies and long‑term survival efforts. The Wind Clan had maintained discreet ties with the Foreign Realm since the Immortal Ancient Era, a legacy of cautious opportunism that shaped their decisions as the great war of the Chaotic Ancient Era intensified.

When the conflict between the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths and the Foreign Realm escalated into full‑scale war and the Emperor Pass began to falter, the Wind Clan chose to abandon neutrality. As one of the clan’s most authoritative figures, Feng Yingluo became their representative in forging a formal alliance with the Foreign Realm. Her position granted her access to critical military intelligence, and her negotiations secured the clan short‑term protection, resources, and powerful techniques that elevated her status within the Foreign Realm’s ranks.

For a time, she commanded defectors and Foreign Realm troops on the battlefield, convinced that aligning with a rising power would safeguard her clan’s future. However, the rapid rise of Shi Hao overturned every calculation. His victories shattered the Foreign Realm’s younger generation, and his relentless counterattacks steadily eroded the forces under her command.

Her final attempt to strike down Shi Hao came when she joined a group of defectors and Foreign Realm cultivators in an ambush meant to eliminate him.Before she could retreat, a single blast of destructive energy pierced straight through her forehead, ending her life instantly.

characters.introText: The Five Crown King was a legendary figure whose talent shook both past and present. He was closely associated with the Void Sky Divine Vine, which once followed him. Seeking to become a deity through unconventional means, he attempted to use the source of the Five Elements as a baptism to transform himself. To achieve this, he traveled across the world gathering vast quantities of elemental treasures—chaotic earth, primordial water, and even origin matter from before the world was opened—piling them up like a mountain. His heaven‑defying method of merging the Five Elements’ source was described as shocking and unprecedented. However, during his experiments, a strange and ominous change occurred. When merging only two elements, something unexpected happened that left him visibly shaken. As he continued testing, his eyes gradually lost their brilliance, turning deathly gray, after which he quietly departed and disappeared. The Void Sky Divine Vine, having witnessed the event, was terrified and fled to safety.

characters.title: Ghost Immortal
characters.introText: Ghost Immortals (鬼仙) are an unusual form of immortal existence born from the corpses of powerful immortal beings. They are fundamentally different from conventional immortals because their immortality does not originate from personally cultivating an immortal dao fruit or successfully completing the ordinary path to True Immortality.
characters.appearance:
Ghost Immortals can possess extremely strange and frightening appearances because their bodies are often corpse-like remnants of their former existence. Some retain recognizable humanoid forms, while others display severe abnormalities resulting from the condition of their bodies after death.

One example is a Ghost Immortal whose original body had been skinned, leaving exposed, blood-covered flesh. Another appeared as a gray-haired humanoid, while another possessed the appearance of a pale woman.

Their grotesque appearances reflect the unusual nature of their existence: neither ordinary living beings nor ordinary corpses, but new consciousnesses born within immortal remains.
characters.personality:
The formation of a Ghost Immortal requires exceptionally unusual circumstances. The corpse must belong to an extraordinarily powerful immortal whose body retains sufficient vitality after death. Furthermore, the surrounding environment must possess special properties capable of preserving and nourishing the corpse.

Over an extremely long period, this preserved vitality can give rise to a new primordial spirit. Once consciousness develops, the corpse effectively becomes a new living entity.

The resulting Ghost Immortal is therefore not the resurrection of the original immortal. It is a new existence that possesses the original body's remaining physical foundation.

He had witnessed countless battles, upheavals, and farewells, surviving far beyond the lifespan normally available to a cultivator of his level. Unlike many of the cultivators around Shi Hao, however, the Golden Lion never reached the Supreme Being Realm. His lifespan had once been extended after he consumed a rare precious medicine obtained from the Other Side, allowing him to survive for thousands of years beyond his natural limit.

characters.introText: Grand Emperor’s might was unmatched, his figure carrying indescribable purple energy. His entire being ascended to the extreme peak of half immortal emperor level. On his head a purple-golden crown, his facial contour also a purple-golden color. His figure was tall and slender. This was a terrifying creature, the pressure he gave off made one feel like they were suffocating.In his surroundings, imprints of the heavens appeared, surrounding him.

characters.history:
Within the perfect world, becoming an emperor is close to impossible and those who achieve the almost impossible since world’s creation, the age of emperor collapse, the immortal ancient era and the present era can be counted on each hands. It could be said that among the leading figures of the endless past, there were only a few individuals. Half immortal emperors were the most powerful existences since the ancient times until now. Great eras passed one after the next, yet just how many of them were there until now? Even unmatched immortal kings didn’t have the qualifications to meet them.

The true full immortal emperor known as the Corpse Immortal Emperor were said to be the only known real true emperor from the past to present within this universe. The corpse immortal emperor were plotted against and corroded by the darkness at the moment of his emperor break through, to save his life he would split his primordial soul into two, half remain with his current body corroded by the darkness matter and the other sealed in the immortal rotten box, later discovered and studied through the ages by many great immortal kings but with no success and then ended up in Shi Hao possession later.

The true fallen immortal emperor is located within the depth of the land of darkness on a seated throne high as the mountains, body slash in half recovering using the spirit of the enslaves imprison within ancient guidance palaces. Grand emperor is from the age of emperor collapse and like his other three counterpart they came to the edge of realm sea in search of a path of becoming a true immortal emperor. They were like other cultivators with pride and ambitions when first slaughtered there way there, like Shi Hao when he first arrived the Corpse Immortal Emperor made them an offer to serve him, in return he will provide the cultivation path forward of taking that step of a true emperor, but they all refuse at first as the price was too great but after many eras of cultivating and not seeing a path forward they decided to become the corpse emperor minions. they would then create and refine the origin artifact which is responsible for creating the Burial realm and the Foreign land race.

For endless amount of time the four fallen half immortal emperor would used the entire "World Setting realms" as a medicine field similar to the lower realm calamity, they would wait for many great eras for them to populate with many creatures then release the darkness to seal primordial spirit and imprison them inside the ancient guidance palace, while origin artifact would create powerful soldiers. They claimed that newly half immortal emperors don’t understand the heaven’s mysteries, obstinately clinging onto their course/ideals. if anyone refuses to see their path as the correct choice death is their only choice as seen with the death ending  of the half immortal emperor who left the footprint behind the damn

Grand Emperor appeared after Shi Hao defeated Gray Emperor in their one vs one battle, Purple energy overflowed into the heavens from Grand Emperor’s body. He stood on a path made of great dao symbols, overlooking the heavens of endless ages. When his eyes swirled, the great river of time appeared. His aura was too great. When the aura between his mouth and nose naturally swirled, it was as if the starry seas collapsed. He didn’t seem to belong to this world. If he appeared in this world like this, everything would be destroyed.

After the appearance of Grand Emperor and Feather Emperor,  Shi Hao ask what became of the primordial spirits trap inside the darkness, they open the void entrance  of the Guidance Ancient Palace and inside the darkness prison Huo Linger was loosing herself, mind wary forgetting much, Shi Hao would used his immortal emperor law to find and  protect her while attempt to also rescue her. During the process all hell broke loose as the three emperor notice Shi Hao feelings and decided to kill huo linger to rattle Shi Hao doa mind, he would next attempt and save Meng Tianzheng while fighting all three emperors. Feather emperor would then sound his dao will, saying charge to the other side of Realm Sea, bring back our people! If there are any that seem off, kill them all, endless  Fallen immortals would appear and head for Immortal Domain using the secrets passage by guidance palace, it would directly bring them there.

Close towards the climax of the battle, a defeated  Willow Deity and Little Pagoda both being nourish and protected by the defeated emperor from the age of emperor collapse, the Chaotic Flame fuse with willow deity, temporarily giving her the power of a Half Immortal Emperor power and the little pagoda fuse with his bones creating a tenth layer and become half emperor. Feather emperor would fight them both while gray and grand emperor fought Shi Hao.

The battle between huang and the three fallen emperor continued for many years. They fought from the primal chaos into the Land of Darkness, and then back into the ultimate ancient land. They went all out, fighting a decisive battle, In reality, the following battle toppled all of the records of the past great battles. They fought for thirty thousand years!. All of them were long skin wrapped around bones, their essence blood completely gone. If they continued like this, even half immortal emperors couldn’t continue. Even half immortal emperors eventually ran out of energy. They fought continuously without resting for a moment, this was a tremendous type of exhaustion. Round two would continue again for hundred of years before it reaches the ultimate climax.

Shi Yi ,Qin Hao, Shi Fan Would sacrifice their blood essence in order to provide vitality for huang continued battle, he would go under a powerful transformation, undergoing a rebirth, producing an immortal core, or perhaps becoming a bit more complete, could be said to have taken a step, one foot into the true Immortal Emperor Realm thus all three other emperors no longer huang opponent, Feather emperor would has his wings torn of while  Grand Emperor and Gray Emperor’s situations were extremely bad. Their bodies had been blown apart by Shi Hao several times, cutting apart their souls from time to time as well, wishing to truly end them. World Eradication Emperor the fourth and most powerful of the four Half emperors would appear from his slumber.

During the final Showdown, the river of time first produce three powerful half immortal emperors from the future who decided to give their life in order to change the past and kill Huang due to his influence on the future. They would join hand with the four fallen half emperors in order to eradicate him. The Cauldron senior who gave Shi Hao his blood in Immortal Ancient and exchange blows with undying king anlan back in desolate border appeared alongside Without Beginning  and later the Ruthless Empress to help him fight. After a bloody battle Shi Hao would defeat the four emperors adding their primordial spirit inside his law pool, and took ten thousand year to fine their soul into nothingness.

characters.introText: Gu Clan's great ancestor is an elder of great, imposing height even while seated, with sharp eyebrows reaching into his temples and deep eyes "like the starry sky." His hair, once golden, has largely turned white, and his skin no longer carries its former sparkling vitality the visible toll of endless years spent crippled. Despite his diminished power, his bearing hints at a matchless heroic figure in his youth.
characters.appearance: Gu Clan's great ancestor is an elder of great, imposing height even while seated, with sharp eyebrows reaching into his temples and deep eyes "like the starry sky." His hair, once golden, has largely turned white, and his skin no longer carries its former sparkling vitality the visible toll of endless years spent crippled. Despite his diminished power, his bearing hints at a matchless heroic figure in his youth.
characters.personality: The great ancestor is profoundly calm and restrained, sitting for endless years without moving or speaking. When finally moved to emotion recognizing Shi Hao's Stone Clan bloodline imprint  his reaction is fleeting but so powerful it devastates the surrounding land, revealing enormous suppressed power and grief beneath his stillness. He is principled to an unusual degree for his world: despite Gu Yi's hope that he would seize Shi Hao's body-as-seed to restore his own ruined path, he refuses, stating that doing so would betray the very will and integrity that let him reach his level of power in the first place.
characters.history:
Once on the verge of becoming an immortal king, Gu Clan's great ancestor had his dao body and foundation shattered at the critical moment by an attack from Stone Clan's ancestor, ending his path forever. He was one of the original figures who conceived of the "body as a seed" cultivation theory during the Immortal Ancient era. Since then, he has resided in total seclusion in an underground chamber beneath Stone Valley  the same site where the Yin Yang Furnace, used to suppress and sustain what remains of his broken body, is kept.

Ancestor Gu was the progenitor of the Gu Clan and an Immortal King who lived during the era of the Immortal Ancient Era. Although history remembered him as one of the great traitors who defected to the Foreign Realm, the truth behind his betrayal was far more complicated. According to Ancestor Gu himself, his apparent defection had been a deliberate mission entrusted to him when the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths was on the verge of collapse.

As one of the leaders sent into the Foreign Realm, Ancestor Gu had to convince the enemy that his surrender was genuine. To accomplish this, he was forced to deceive not only the Foreign Realm, but even himself. He used a profound secret method to seal away his true memories, leaving behind only the belief that he had genuinely betrayed the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. In doing so, he ensured that neither his words nor his actions would reveal the truth, even under scrutiny by the powerful beings of the Foreign Realm.

Only after nearly half of a great era had passed did his original memories gradually return. By then, however, the Gu Clan had already borne the reputation of traitors for countless ages. During that time, Ancestor Gu himself had committed countless acts on behalf of the Foreign Realm, staining his own hands with blood in order to preserve the deception. He described the recovery of his memories as feeling like a knife twisting in his heart, forcing him to live with an infamy that history would likely never erase.

characters.introText: Gu Jianyun is described as possessing an impressive appearance. He carried a divine sword on his back.
characters.appearance: Gu Jianyun is described as possessing an impressive appearance. He carried a divine sword on his back.
characters.personality:
Gu Jianyun displayed a calculating and cautious demeanor, particularly concerning opponents who posed significant risk. During the arena battles in Immortal Ancient, he refused to fight the injured Huang (Shi Hao), dismissing him as a "dead person" suffering from injuries that harmed his great dao essence. This decision, while criticized by some rivals as cowardice, suggested a pragmatic approach to self-preservation, which was proven justified as he retreated to treat his wounds rather than engage in reckless battles.

He held a clear confidence in his own power, viewing himself as comparable to the highest-ranked geniuses. He also expressed admiration for other figures deemed exceptional, notably admiring Ning Chuan greatly.
characters.history:
Gu Jianyun is designated an Ancient Freak. He previously appeared in ancient times and once sealed himself after having only appeared once before. He garnered immense admiration, even from contemporaries like Ning Chuan.

Gu Jianyun achieved one of his most significant breakthroughs when he successfully challenged the Heavenly Tribulation. His success in guiding and passing this tribulation established an era of great glory, positioning him as a leading Heaven Warping Genius who advanced to the True Deity domain. This accomplishment was celebrated throughout the three thousand provinces.

Following his success, Gu Jianyun entered the Immortal Ancient Remains. Due to the historical opposition between his sect (Sword Valley) and the Sinner's Bloodline, he naturally stood against Huang (Shi Hao). He showed disdain for Huang, calling him a "dead person" and refusing to fight him in the arena, believing his great dao was damaged and predicting he would not surpass eight hundred battle rounds.

Gu Jianyun fought intensely against another Ancient Freak, a cultivator of the Endless Blood Scripture, whom he had previously defeated by a fluke. During this conflict, despite being injured, he managed to cut down his rival again.

In later conflicts, he was severely tested. During one encounter, he was struck by Huang, making him stagger backward with blood flowing from his lips and his divine sword growing dim. He was later hit by a surprise arrow, forcing him to leap off the arena to avoid further injury. He was noted to have allied with an Ancient Freak from the Fire Cloud Cavern during this period.

characters.introText: Gu Yi is an elder with a short, stooped, shriveled figure  easy to underestimate at a glance. His hair was originally golden but has turned snow-white with age, though it still faintly flickers with golden color. His eyes are his most striking feature: bright and piercing "like golden lamps," carrying an aura of great and intimidating age despite his diminutive frame.
characters.appearance: Gu Yi is an elder with a short, stooped, shriveled figure  easy to underestimate at a glance. His hair was originally golden but has turned snow-white with age, though it still faintly flickers with golden color. His eyes are his most striking feature: bright and piercing "like golden lamps," carrying an aura of great and intimidating age despite his diminutive frame.
characters.personality: Gu Yi is calm, calculating, and difficult to read, capable of smiling warmly one moment and radiating cold menace the next. He is deeply devoted to Gu Clan's restoration and the memory of its "great ancestor," to the point of manipulating events (including Shi Hao's near-fatal refinement and subsequent rescue) for his clan's benefit while denying doing so intentionally. He speaks with an air of foreboding about a coming, world-ending war, and treats Emperor Clans as equals or near-equals despite their greater renown, never showing them deference. Beneath his outward geniality lies genuine ruthlessness  he crippled Shi Hao without hesitation to extract secrets from his mind— but he is also capable of extending real assistance when it serves his clan's long game.
characters.history: Gu Yi is a supreme being of Gu Clan, an ancient and powerful lineage  as rare and formidable as the Emperor Clans, wielding twin mastery over space and time  that, like Shi Hao's own people, originated in the Nine Heavens before defecting to the foreign side after a shattering defeat. Gu Clan harbors a generations-old grudge against Stone Clan, whose ancestor is said to have attacked and crippled Gu Clan's own great ancestor at the cusp of his ascension to immortal king.

characters.title: Han Ming
characters.introText: Hanming (寒溟) is an antagonist introduced in the Perfect World (完美世界). His name roughly translates to “Frozen Abyss” or “Dark Ice,” reflecting his extreme cold-based combat style. Like Liuli, Yigu, and Ziting, he is a Supreme being-level cultivator from the Foreign Realm, holding the title “Foreign Realm Supreme” (异域至尊). He serves as a frontline commander in the large-scale invasion of the Desolate Border, where the Foreign Realm launches repeated assaults against the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
characters.appearance:
Hanming has a cold, sharp, and elegant appearance strongly themed around glacial and crystalline imagery. He has a youthful but expressionless face, paired with long silver-white hair styled beneath a crystalline crown-like headpiece.

He wears layered robes in icy blue and translucent white tones, decorated with snowflake patterns and frost-like motifs. His forearms are protected by sharp, crystalline gauntlets resembling condensed ice structures.

His primary weapon is a crimson spear with a jagged edge, creating a strong visual contrast against his cold aesthetic. Behind him float six large glacial shards arranged like frozen wings, along with smaller ice daggers forming a halo-like formation above his head, emphasizing his control over condensed ice energy.

characters.introText: He Wushuang is described as having an exquisitely handsome appearance, possessing a face so flawless that he even overshadowed many women. He is typically seen with long golden hair that scatters down to his waist, accompanied by deep eyes and a complexion likened to jade. When he reached the rank of Immortal King, his physique remained that of a youth, and he was observed with a pair of golden wings, exuding an aloof and transcendent temperament. During a major confrontation, he was seen generating golden radiance around his body, as if he were bathed in the splendor of the sunrise.

He is typically seen with long golden hair that scatters down to his waist, accompanied by deep eyes and a complexion likened to jade. When he reached the rank of Immortal King, his physique remained that of a youth, and he was observed with a pair of golden wings, exuding an aloof and transcendent temperament. During a major confrontation, he was seen generating golden radiance around his body, as if he were bathed in the splendor of the sunrise.
characters.personality: He Wushuang possessed overwhelming confidence and arrogance, viewing the cultivators of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths with disdain. He held himself above the common populace, exhibiting a style that was often tyrannical and haughty. His historical actions reveal a cruel and ruthless nature (Psycopath); during the Immortal Ancient Great Era, he was a vicious being who murdered the kin of the Heavenly Horned Ant and fed them to his mount. Even when challenged by opponents who utilize powerful Heavenly Arts, he remained dismissive and convinced of his own invincible power.
characters.history:
He Wushuang established himself as an unrivaled existence among the younger generation of the foreign realm during the latter phase of the Immortal Ancient Great Era. He was known for his ruthless dedication to eliminating the proud youths of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, using his power to crush young kings. He personally killed the older brothers and sisters of the Heavenly Horned Ant, showing exceptional cruelty by subsequently feeding them to his mount. His power enabled him to dominate the world, intimidating all opponents during his time. He eventually defeated Emperor Clans during the later stages of his life, bolstering the prospects of the He Family becoming a new Emperor Clan.

He Wushuang was involved in a vicious contest against the rising star Huang (Shi Hao) over the acquisition of the Imperishable Scripture. This conflict, perceived by Huang as occurring within a miraculous place or dream-like state, was incredibly real and served as a test for the scripture. He Wushuang fiercely declared ownership of the text, stating:

The battle was so intense that it ended in mutual destruction, resulting in a draw between the two supreme talents. Following this acquisition, He Wushuang left and cultivated in the foreign realm, refining his true self under its complete dao laws.

Over the passage of endless years, He Wushuang continued to cultivate, reaching the level of an Undying existence or Immortal King. He emerged from seclusion to provide guidance to his descendant, He Ziming, ensuring the He Family lineage maintained its terrifying power. He Wushuang was implicated in the operations involving the Immortal Smelting Pot, a supreme artifact used to seize the essence blood of powerful experts for the benefit of the foreign realm. He Ziming, his descendant, rose to become the recognized number one among the foreign realm’s ten great young kings.

He Wushuang's end came in the depths of Realm Sea, where he had spent hundreds of thousands of years alone, grinding away at his cultivation and consolidating his dao skills after first obtaining the Imperishable Scripture. During that time he had grown considerably stronger, confident enough in his own power to attack the moment he recognized his old rival. He was, by this point, an undying king a rank he considered even more sacred than that of an ordinary immortal king and he fought with everything he had: hundreds of thousands of streaks of sword energy, fists radiant as forged gold, and the full weight of his king inheritance's activated imperishable body.

It wasn't enough. Shi Hao had, by then, become a giant even among immortal kings, having completed the Imperishable Scripture in full and reforged himself under the foreign realm's complete laws advantages He Wushuang, who had only ever cultivated a partial and deficient version of the same method, could not match. Shi Hao battered him without real resistance, striking him until he coughed up mouthfuls of blood and his arm nearly exploded, inflicting the worst injuries He Wushuang had suffered since first achieving his dao. When He Wushuang tried to flee, Shi Hao seized him in a single closing hand.

Shi Hao felt no pity for him. He Wushuang's cruelty toward the Heavenly Horned Ant's family the killing of the Ant's older brothers and sisters, later fed to He Wushuang's own mount, and the cold, almost boastful way He Wushuang had once recounted it had left a wound in the Ant that Shi Hao knew would never fully heal. With that in mind, when his closing fist crushed He Wushuang's flesh into a burst of bloody mist, Shi Hao felt no reluctance at all.

He Wushuang's primordial spirit surged up from the wreckage of his own bones and attempted to recombine, and in that moment he still believed himself untouchable declaring himself undying, certain that no one, not even Huang, could destroy an undying king's spirit so easily. Shi Hao's response was blunt: he told He Wushuang he wasn't yet in a position to speak of being undying in front of him, then closed his hand around the reforming spirit a second time, tearing it apart and beginning to refine it across his six great secret realms. He Wushuang's undying radiance thinned rapidly under this treatment, and he came close to true death his spirit shaved down and weakening by the moment.

Shi Hao stopped short of finishing him. He thought of the Heavenly Horned Ant, and of the debt that could never be paid unless the Ant delivered the final blow himself. Rather than destroy He Wushuang's primordial spirit outright, Shi Hao sealed it away in the same law pool already holding the captured spirits of Scarlet King, Aocheng, and other fallen kings, intending to carry it back for the Ant's sake.

Years later, once Shi Hao emerged from seclusion recovering from his battle with Kun Di, he brought the Heavenly Horned Ant into a secret chamber and revealed He Wushuang's sealed spirit to him. The Ant's reaction was immediate and shattering his eyes turned red, blood tears spilling from them as the old grief for his lost siblings surfaced all at once. He demanded to kill He Wushuang with his own hands, his human form giving way to his true original shape as rage overtook him.

In the aftermath, the Heavenly Horned Ant vanished from public view. Only those close to Shi Hao understood what had happened: rather than have Shi Hao simply finish He Wushuang off for him, the Ant had entered a state of near-crazed cultivation and retreated into the Heavenly Horned Ant Clan's ancestral land a sunken, killing-intent-soaked region where his clan had once been wiped out. At the time he was still only a true immortal, a powerful member of the Vicious Ten but not yet of king rank, while He Wushuang remained sealed as a full Immortal King-level undying king. The Ant asked Shi Hao to keep He Wushuang's spirit sealed and safe rather than release or destroy it, so that he could settle the matter personally once he was strong enough to do so. Shi Hao agreed, privately hoping the weight of that unfinished vengeance might be exactly what pushed the Ant to finally break through to king level himself.

characters.title: He Ziming
characters.introText: He Ziming is the most outstanding young supreme of the He Clan (Crane Clan) from the Foreign Realm (Exotic Realm) during the chaotic Era of Emperor Fall. He is the direct descendant of the legendary He Wushuang (Crane Wushuang), a figure who once possessed an unparalleled reputation as "Unrivaled Under Heaven." He Ziming is recognized as the "Number One Expert" among the Royal Clans (Wang Zu) of the Foreign Realm. His strength is so profound that he is considered comparable to the direct descendants of the Immortal Kings (Emperor Clans), possessing the potential to lead the He Clan into becoming a new Emperor Clan. He served as one of the primary rivals to Huang (Shi Hao) during the border wars between the Foreign Realm and the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
characters.appearance:
He Ziming possesses an appearance that transcends the mundane, often described as having the temperament of a banished immortal or a young war god. He appears as a young man in his twenties with a physique that is slender yet sturdy, carved like jade. His skin is as white as sheep-fat jade, and his facial features are chiseled and distinct, described as exceptionally handsome and heroic.

His most striking features are his hair and eyes. He possesses thick, brilliant golden hair that is incredibly long, draping down his back and reaching as far as the bend of his knees, flowing like a golden galaxy. His eyes are golden pupils that contain a terrifying, mystic phenomenon: within the depths of his pupils, there are cross-shaped golden rifts (Dao markings) that sometimes manifest as crossed golden lightning, a trait inherited from his ancestor He Wushuang. When he walks, he is often surrounded by a divine golden halo or stepping on a golden path, exuding an aura of holiness and supremacy.
characters.personality:
He Ziming is defined by an intense pride in his lineage and an unshakable confidence in his own invincibility. Unlike many other Foreign Realm creatures who are outwardly savage, He Ziming often presents a calm, collected, and even polite demeanor, masking a cold and ruthless interior. He views the creatures of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths as "cattle" or inferior beings, heirs to a failed civilization.

He is extremely protective of his ancestor's honor. Any perceived slight against He Wushuang provokes a murderous rage in him. Despite his arrogance, he is not reckless; he is calculating and prudent. For example, he did not rashly break the rules of the Immortal Tortoise Shell divination battle at the Great Scarlet Sky border, choosing to wait for a legitimate turn that never came. He possesses a strong dao heart, aspiring to reach the pinnacle of cultivation and elevate his clan to the status of an Emperor Clan.
characters.history:
He Ziming emerged during the turbulent period when the Foreign Realm began probing the defenses of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths at the Great Scarlet Sky Border. He arrived late to the famous "Ten Battles of the Border," appearing as a finale figure and a leader for the younger generation of the Foreign Realm. His arrival was treated with immense reverence by his peers, who bowed to him as if welcoming a king. Upon his arrival, he did not immediately engage in combat because the divination of the Immortal Tortoise Shell had not selected him. Instead, he observed Huang (Shi Hao) defeating multiple foreign kings. To suppress Huang without breaking the rules, He Ziming bestowed a drop of his ancestor He Wushuang's "Ancient Ancestor True Blood" upon a female cultivator named Yin Ling. He used a special brush to write a "Kill" character with the blood on her palm, granting her terrifying power. However, Huang successfully defeated Yin Ling and captured the blood, threatening to feed it to pigs, which infuriated He Ziming and nearly caused him to attack prematurely.

Before He Ziming could personally duel Huang at the border, the situation escalated. He Ziming revealed the true purpose of his presence: he was not there merely to fight, but to deliver the news that the Foreign Realm's main army had successfully breached the Diguan (Imperial Pass) via a different route. With the Great Scarlet Sky border compromised and the Immortal Kings' decrees active, the duel was interrupted, and He Ziming retreated with the Foreign Realm armies, vowing to kill Huang on the true battlefield in the future.

Later, during the chaotic exploration of the Divine Medicine Mountain and the Heaven Beast Forest, He Ziming pursued Huang alongside other Emperor Clan descendants like Wu Kun and Yu Yu. They sought to hunt down Huang, who was trapped in these dangerous zones. During this period, He Ziming displayed his mastery of the Indestructible Scripture, engaging in brief but intense clashes with Huang. He utilized his clan's supreme physical arts, proving that his reputation as a near-Emperor Clan talent was well-deserved.

When Huang was captured and brought to the Foreign Realm, He Ziming appeared at the Gu Clan's ancient land. The Gu Clan prepared the Yin Yang Furnace to refine Huang and extract the seeds within him. He Ziming was present but was notably excluded from entering the furnace to share in the "fortune" of the refinement. This opportunity was reserved for the "Six Small Emperors" (direct descendants of Immortal Kings like Anlan and Yu Tuo). This event highlighted the slight gap in status between the He Clan (a Royal Clan) and the true Emperor Clans, a fact that He Ziming deeply regretted, as he wished to use the furnace to further temper his own body.

Throughout the war, He Ziming remained a persistent threat and a symbol of the Foreign Realm's elite power. He constantly sought to validate his clan's supremacy and wash away the "shame" of the Foreign Realm's younger generation suffering defeats at the hands of Huang.
characters.trivia:
The surname He (鹤) translates to "Crane," signifying his origin from the He Clan (Crane Clan) of the Foreign Realm. The given name Ziming (子铭) can be interpreted as follows: Zi (子) is often used for a son or a term of respect for a man; Ming (铭) means "inscription" or "to engrave/remember." His name may symbolize his role as the "Inscription of the Crane," carrying the weight of engraving his ancestor's glory into the current era.

His golden hair is described as being exceptionally long, reaching the bend of his knees. This physical trait is a marker of his pure bloodline within the Golden Crane family, distinguishing him from mixed-blood or lesser descendants.

characters.title: Heaven and Earth Immortal Core Woman
characters.introText: She was describe as  a woman whose long hair scattered over her shoulders, perfect and flawless, beautiful like something out of a dream.
characters.appearance:
She was describe as  a woman whose long hair scattered over her shoulders, perfect and flawless, beautiful like something out of a dream.

This woman was different from all of the women Shi Hao had met in his life, not carrying a type of otherworldly, fairy-like aura. Her beautiful eyes were extremely large, moreover incredibly sharp. Even though they were extremely pretty, they weren’t gentle, the two eyes like immortal pools that contained sword radiance!

This type of deep divine light would make even the giants of an area lower their heads, not willing to face it head-on. Under its radiance, one would feel like they were far too inferior.Meanwhile, her brows were extremely beautiful, slender and long, but they were about to reach her temples, giving off a rather unique feeling.

This was an extremely beautiful woman who was full of essence energy and imposing might. Her forehead was wide, snow-white like jade, her beautiful eyes releasing essence energy, fine nose straight and tall. She truly had cherry lips that were moist and bright, her teeth like jade. Even though she was sitting, her body was definitely tall and slender, her curves astonishing. If she stood up, she would be half a head taller than ordinary men.

At this moment, she had already gotten up, standing in the void, surrounded by chaotic energy, using it like clothes, white mists blocking a few of her crucial areas. However, this type of hazy beauty only made her appear even more astonishing, full of irresistible temptation. It had to be said that this woman was different from everyone else. If one only looked at her exterior appearance, she really was too outstanding.

She had a head of purple hair that scattered down to her waist, some in front of her chest, blocking her tall chest. Her waist was small, a pair of slender beautiful legs pure white like jade, astonishingly long. Even Shi Hao who had seen many astonishing beauties couldn’t help but reveal a shocked appearance now. This woman was beautiful to the point of being a bit unreal, could be considered perfect, moreover carrying a unique style.

During the body as a seed path which a seed was needed to breakthrough to the Void Dao Realm as a powerful foundational source the Immortal Golden shell was used as the final step to nurtured Shi Hao body which could only be done by physically entering the shell core.

After entering the shell, Shi Hao was shocked to see that inside the Golden shell was a living being a creature, to be precise, a beautiful woman, one who's beauty was above all beauty Shi Hao came across up to then, she was describe to have purple hair a trait of the Celestial Clan, gorgeous face that could toppled nations with a godly figure, she was also powerful and hinted as being at the Peak Supreme Being or True Immortal Realm base on  contexts.  Its was explained that since ancient time there were individuals who uses this cultivation method to gain immortality with 100% success rate the only draw back was the process time frame which is very slow and could take one or multiply era aka millions of years for completion but once fully nurtured by the heaven and earth essence and exited the creature/being would immediately become an immortal. It was explained that her process seemed to already be completed and once exited would become an Immortal.

The beautiful woman at first erupt with killing intent and wanted to punish  Shi Hao for interrupting her cultivation because once the Immortal golden shell was damage or open whether the individual cultivation was incomplete or completed the process would end but after exchanging a brief dialog with Shi Hao she calm down  and mention that is was a faith meeting, she also was able to see a corner of the future due to being bless by heaven and earth essence and being able to touch up on the outside world after the golden shell core was open. The Purple hair beauty told Shi Hao that the world will be chaotic and if she came out in this era she would surely die as being an immortal wasn't enough to survive the calamity that's coming, she told Shi Hao in exchange for cultivating in the shell core he would need to take her place to fight in the coming final war and if he survive they would meet in the next era.

The purple hair woman ask Huang how was he able to resealed the golden immortal shell, he reply by saying a wondrous medicine comparable to long life medicine provided to Meng Tianzheng by Heaven Mending Dao Sect she ask if more is available and told him to resealed once return and then hid the Immortal Golden shell, Shi Hao agreed and proceed to cultivate the body as a seed.

The Heaven and Earth Core Woman having many traits of the Celestial Clan such as their main bloodline Purple hair it 's  rumored that she's and ancient figure from their clan with similar situation to Three Stone Monarch.

The heaven and earth core nurturing is another form of cultivation which always lead to 100% perfection in terms of the cultivator becoming an immortal. the only drawback  it could take up to million of years depending, each cultivator has different time frame such as shorter or longer.

characters.introText: Heavenly Deity Tree in the  novel is an extremely rare divine medicine found in the Immortal Ancient period, primarily known for bearing Heavenly Deity Fruit  that can instantly elevate an ordinary person to the Heavenly Deity Realm. The tree only produce Heavenly deity fruit because its current  power is only such. Later after it recombined  with all his four bodies, instantly returned to its original self of a True immortal tree, the premise remain the same which eating a fruit will instantly turn the fruit eater into a True Immortal.
characters.history:
Heavenly Deity Tree in the  novel is an extremely rare divine medicine found in the Immortal Ancient period, primarily known for bearing Heavenly Deity Fruit  that can instantly elevate an ordinary person to the Heavenly Deity Realm. The tree only produce Heavenly deity fruit because its current  power is only such. Later after it recombined  with all his four bodies, instantly returned to its original self of a True immortal tree, the premise remain the same which eating a fruit will instantly turn the fruit eater into a True Immortal.

The heavenly Deity tree is only 1 of 3, trees  mention with such power within the series with exact fruit ability but the cause and effect varies depending on the environmental changes via Dao Law's of where the tree is located, after all, beings that cultivate in the lower realm will be significantly weaker than those in the upper realms unless there's some prior unique conditions.

The two others are:

1] Heavenly Deity Poison Tree:

This tree is also found inside Immortal Ancient within a small world where Di Chong was cultivating Episode 172 of the Donghua, the tree has the same effect but comes with a poisonous downside. The tree was a holy tree worship by all the poison insect and animals that would gather around it to worship. As Qing Yi stated, eating a fruit would instantly make you a Heavenly Deity if you can survive its incredibly deadly effect, there was one mention who survived and he gain an incredible deadly and powerful poison power that would leave a wave of poisonous destruction in its path wherever he would roam.

2] True Immortal Peach Medicine Tree:

This tree was found within the Immortal Domain within Immortal King Pan (also known as King Pan) Peach Garden. The fruit will make the user an instant True Immortal but different from others it has contained unmatched great Dao fragments, the value unimaginable!. During the great competition among young genius where Shi Hao dominated the realm younger generations and declared the now recombined  Qing Yi/Yue Chan is his woman, won the fruit and gave it to her.

Origin: The Heavenly Deity Tree was a rare divine medicine discovered in the secret realm of the Immortal Ancient. Its fruits contained immense divine power and were highly coveted by cultivators. In Ancient times the Heavenly Deity Tree was originally one but were split into four by a Powerful cultivator known as the Fake Medicine Dealer a powerful Peak Immortal King Giant one step away from becoming an Half-Immortal Emperor. His main goal was/is to split himself into three, one of which is a Medicine and live three lives and by using this method with the hope of some day finally breaking into the Emperor Realm.

Discovery by Shi Hao:  Shi Hao, first found the fruits during his venture into the Immortal Ancient land. He personally chose not to consume a Heavenly Deity Fruit because he preferred to temper himself through tribulations and cultivation rather than relying on an external boost , he would later find the three other split Heavenly Deity tree and recombine them all. The locations of the other three is as followed, Two are located inside Immortal Ancient , one at the desolate border[No man's Land] per donghua translation and the other??

Distribution of Fruits: After leaving the Immortal Ancient, Shi Hao distributed the fruits to his loved ones. His wife, Huo Linger, consumed one, which rapidly advanced her cultivation to the Heavenly Deity realm and awakened her Vermilion Bird bloodline, granting her significant self-protection abilities. Others such has Shi Zhongtian and many from the Stone Village etc.

Other Uses: The tree provided a significant power boost and a means of protection for those who consumed its fruits, making it a valuable asset for Shi Hao's allies. The tree itself, or its sapling, may have also been linked to other characters, such as the Ten Crown King Tian Zi, who was shown to be significantly boosted by a World Tree sapling. We know while shi Hao was training the Bone Tempering Method in preparations for the Becoming the Seed one of the ingredients were the Heavenly Deity Leaf.  The ultimate fate of the primary tree itself is tied to the overall narrative as one of many rare treasures Shi Hao acquired. == References ==

Heavenly Kingdom/Country Ancient King is a Genius from the upper realm Three Thousand Provinces and the Heavenly Country/Kingdom first King, he's basically the first ranked Genius of the entire Heavenly Country within the younger generation. His younger brother  Xue Ji is rank Second.

He's someone who is proficient in assassination techniques and like to ambush and attack his enemies. After Shi Hao killed his younger brother in the Burial Realm, he ambush Shi Hao and his friends in Burial City using his unique Blood Drop Sword made from the bones of a Heavenly God.

He would continue to lurk and attack Shi Hao on several occasions before finally  join an alliance with Jun Dao, Ancient Holy Child and Divine Dark Child to defeat Shi Hao, they would lurk and ambush him on multiple occasions but in the end all four were defeat and killed miserably.

characters.title: Heroic Spirits
characters.introText: Heroic Spirits (英灵) are remnants of powerful cultivators who died in battle but whose will, soul fragments, and lingering obsession with the battlefield remained after death. They are not ordinary ghosts or resurrected beings. Instead, they are manifestations of the deceased's residual spiritual essence, created because their final will was too strong to completely dissipate.
characters.personality: Heroic Spirits and Ghost Immortals are both unusual forms of post-death existence, but their origins are fundamentally different.
