characters.introText: Red Phoenix, the noble daughter of the Red Phoenix Palace in the Upper Realm, possesses the Red Phoenix magic, is dressed in red, can control fire, is beautiful and passionate, and has a crush on Shi Hao
characters.appearance: According to the original work, there were four beauties from the upper world, and the other two were Shuiyue and Yingying. However, due to financial issues, the official Donghua deleted these two beauties and only retained Lan Yu and Hong.
characters.history:
Hong Huang and Lan Yu  are both distinguished guests of Burao Mountain. In order to entertain these two beauties, Burao Mountain even gave up the VIP cabin. Shi Hao wanted to go to Burao Mountain to find his parents, so he took this boat. This is how I met these two beauties.
Because these two beauties had just experienced the Lower Realm, they didn't know how much trouble Shi Hao had done recently. They just felt that he was valuable in making friends and training, so they both wanted to draw Shi Hao into their influence. And in order to win over Shi Hao, the beautiful Red Phoenix also told a secret, that is, the world in the lower world is lacking, and the laws are incomplete.

It is difficult to have a future if you practice in the lower world. If things go on like this, it will be extremely harmful to the cultivators. In the end, no matter how talented you are, you will never be able to succeed. will be buried.
She has a way to let Shi Hao go to the upper realm, that is, let Shi Hao join her force first, and then she asks for a place for Shi Hao, so that him can ascend the Heaven Gate and enter the heaven.

However, Shi Hao was very moved, but with good intentions, he would not join any upper realm force. At the same time, he still had many things to do, including protecting Stone Country, retrieving his parents, taking care of Shi Hao, etc. In the end, Blue Rain Beauty and Red Phoenix Beauty couldn't move Shi Hao, so they stopped trying to win over Shi Hao. Not long after, they parted ways.

With the opening of the Ancient Treasure Realm, the opportunities hidden in it also attracted countless cultivators. Naturally, Hong Huang and other upper realm geniuses could not lag behind others. In order to seize the creation on the Sun God Tree, Hong Huang and others did not hesitate to risk entering. The land of the Golden Crow Tribe, but facing the large number of Golden Crow Tribe people, Hong Huang and other superior geniuses seemed a little powerless. When they saw that Red Phoenix was about to be in trouble, the geniuses present were helpless and could only watch her from the sidelines. Fortunately, they were all along the way. Shi Hao, who was following Red Phoenix, arrived in time and saved her from the Golden Crow people.

However, Shi Hao never expected that his heroic act of saving the beauty would arouse the dissatisfaction of several male geniuses. After entering the Sun God Tree, they attacked Shi Hao sneakily and pushed him into the magma filled with earthly fire liquid. However, Shi Hao saved the day. Not only did he improve his cultivation, but he also obtained his second Supreme Treasure. With the power of the Supreme Treasure, Shi Hao suppressed all the people who came to hunt for treasures on the Sun God Tree. Those who have made it possible for Hong Huang and other upper realm female geniuses to leave the ancient treasure world safely. If Shi Hao had not taken action to suppress those venerables, not only would Red Phoenix and other upper realm geniuses not be able to get the treasures, but they would also lose their own. Life will also be on the line.

After Hong Huang and Shi Hao experienced the incident in the Ancient Treasure Realm together, their relationship became even better, and in the subsequent period of getting along, Hong Huang also got to know the person of the Demon Emperor more clearly, and also Because of this, the two became even better friends. Unfortunately, when the Seven Gods descended to the lower realm, the Seven Gods tried their best to kill Shi Hao, and Shi Hao also tried his best to survive from the Seven Gods. After trying everything, Shi Hao finally killed the seven gods, but he was also cursed by the green patina of the Immortal Palace. Under the torture of the green patina curse, Shi Hao's vitality became weaker and weaker. None can save it.

Just when Shi Hao's life was about to come to an end, Peng Jiu suggested that Shi Hao use the Veermilion Nirvana Technique, the Five Elements Nirvana Technique, and other Nirvana Techniques related to the True Phoenix as a last-ditch effort, and Red Phoenix happened to have it in his hands. There is a nirvana method related to the true phoenix, but this method is a secret technique that is not passed down in the Hong Huang family. However, she couldn't bear to see her old friend become like this now, so Honghuang This method was given to Shi Hao. In order to thank Hong Huang for his generous teaching, Shi Hao also gave the Five Elements Nirvana method he had obtained from the Everlasting Mountain to Hong Huang as a token of his gratitude.

After the last method proposed by Peng Jiu failed, Shi Hao also completely lost hope of living. Although Hong Huang was very sad, the laws of the lower world gradually became complete, and she had to return to the upper world.

Hong Huang successfully penetrated the Immortal Ancient. During her exploration, she discovered a rare sacred medicine stalk, but her find attracted the attention of the members of the Nether Clan, who relentlessly pursued her. While fleeing, she encountered Shi Hao. His appearance filled her with terror, fearing that the Nether Clan had turned her old friend into a specter.

However, Shi Hao, seizing her arm, assured her warmly with his body that he was still alive. The joy of seeing him alive was overwhelming. But the moment of happiness was short-lived, as they were soon surrounded by members of the Nether Clan. Without lifting a finger, Shi Hao unleashed lightning from every pore of his body, scattering most of the enemies. His only craving at that moment was to eat a ghost for the first time.

Seeing the power and the relentless desire to eat their enemies, Hong Huang understood that he was truly her old friend. The situation further complicated with the arrival of a prominent figure of the Nether Clan, Qi Bing, accompanied by a Three-Headed Hound. Sensing Shi Hao of Qi Bing's role as a subordinate of the Divine Dark Child, logically Shi Hao had no faintest idea who he was, and asked if he was stronger than Underworld Child he had previously killed. At those words, Hong Huang understood that Shi Hao was the notorious Huang, and explained to him that that person was decidedly much stronger than Underworld Child.

Shi Hao indifferently said that he would kill him like all the others. The massacre of the members of the Nether Clan continued without respite, until Qi Bing pleaded for mercy and attempted to flee with a scroll. However, thanks to the intervention of the Void Halberd, Shi Hao caught up with him and eliminated him. Before breathing his last, Qi Bing used the bone mirror to inform the Dark Divine Child of the existence and power of Shi Hao.

She was never mentioned again for the rest of the story, after parting ways with Shi Hao in Immortal Ancient.
characters.trivia: According to the original work, there were four beauties from the upper world, and the other two were Shuiyue and Yingying. However, due to financial issues, the official Donghua deleted these two beauties and only retained Lan Yu and Hong.

characters.title: Hu Sun
characters.introText: King of the Monkey clan (Hu Sun) is a talented creature from inside the small world Hundred Shattered Mountains. He is describe as golden monkey with good aptitude who loves to fight.
characters.history:
King of the Monkey clan (Hu Sun) is a talented creature from inside the small world Hundred Shattered Mountains. He is describe as golden monkey with good aptitude who loves to fight.

His tribe ruled over the Hundred Shattered mountain with an iron fist, with few inside his opponent Lao Jiao an old Flood dragon tried to take him down for hundred of years but couldn't, he went as far as to recruit outsider to aid him with the lure of the Holy medicine the Immortal Peach Tree Fruit. Young Shi Yi, Young Yun Xi were among those agreed.

He was able to easily hold his own against the best and brightest young geniuses alone, showing how talented the monkey king was. He later exchange blows against the Fire Emperor , though defeated he vowed to suppress the emperor once he leave the small world in the future.

Later when Shi Hao came back to the lower realm, now a powerful Supreme Being he wanted to fully explore every corners of the Eight Regions, his first stop were the Hundred Shattered Mountain, he also brought many of the talented students from the Stone Village, the Seven kings old imperial past descendants to gain experience inside and others, Hairy Ball had heard about the Monkey king talent and were waiting for the next opening as he wanted to fight with him.

When Shi Hao entered the mountain everyone and everything was dead, a past lively mountain now became a void and desolate place, lifeless, they came upon a cave and saw a staff, the monkey king fighting staff halberd he used back then and beside it a skull and bones, the monkey king killed. Demonic Cattail Tree  killed every living creatures inside.

Huang Yu of the Immortal Palace came to the lower realm as one of the Seven Gods.

Immortal Palace is known to have no more than five official members of their sect since Ancient Era but known to have many servants and Haung Yu is such.

Huang Yu is describe as a Loyal long-standing servant member of the immortal palace, having live to such a old age being someone who was a warrior servant, has to be said were impressive. Immortal Palace were known to be arrogant and had many enemies and conflict fights , their servants were numerous, chess piece use as cannon fodders, as Qi Daolin said, their hands were covered in blood due to destroying whomever messed with their bottom line.

Haung Yu, was said to be of the Golden crane bird bloodline a meticulous individual as seen in the lower realm where  he watch all of Shi Hao fights with the Divine Flame Realm masters he came with, and did a thorough research on his power, treasures, and battle capabilities.  He was also vicious and cruel to living beings whether human or others, as long as his or the immortal palace bottom line gets done he would do whatever.

He appeared in the lower realm under the orders of  immortal palace young great one Di Chong to get rid of Shi Hao  and also for his own ambition to unify the 8 regions and gain the greatest natural luck that it  had to offer. His battle against Shi Hao was a hard fought and desperate one that lasted a while but in the end he were defeated with an attack from the Supreme Being Bones innate ability the Reincarnation Heaven calamity light attack.

Though defeated he was able to last moment send the immortal palace bronze poison cube into Shi Hao body that corroded his soul and in the end Shi Hao died as awell.

characters.appearance:
Scarlet multicolored light flashed, and the curtain made out of pearls and jades was pushed to the side. A young lady walked out from within, and her age was roughly fifteen to sixteen. Her forehead was a sparkling white, and she had an oval face. Her black eyebrows were curved, and large eyes were brilliant like crystals. She had a radiance of spirituality around her.

Her skin was snow white, and although she was still a minor, her figure was excellent. It was not worse than those of eighteen or nineteen year old girls. She was taller than her peers by a head, and as she leisurely walked, her soft small waist swayed back and forth. It was as if she was a snake, and her curves were extremely elegant.

Her figure was extremely great. Her two legs were slender and straight, and as she walked over in this way, her curves were moving up and down. It was graceful and touching, making even eighteen and nineteen year old girls feel inferior.
characters.history: Huo Ling'er was the Fire Emperor’s daughter. She was known to be an absolute genius. She was reputed to be a heaven warping divine talent, extremely powerful.
characters.trivia:
In "Holy Ruins," it is mentioned that Shi Hao has two sons. The first son is attributed to Yun Xi, while the parentage of the second is not explicitly specified. However, considering the context in which Yun Xi and Yue Chan, the other two wives of Shi Hao, were sealed due to their limited cultivation, it is plausible that the second son was born to Huo Ling'er. This hypothesis is supported by the fact that when Huo Ling'er became aware of Shi Hao's paternity regarding Yun Xi, she was deeply disturbed because if she had not been kidnapped, she presumably would have been the one to give birth to his eldest child. Furthermore, it should be considered that due to Shi Hao's high level of cultivation, conceiving a child was extremely difficult; for example, the gestation period of Shi Fan lasted nine years, during which Shi Hao's cultivation level was significantly lower than when he conceived the second child. Given the limited cultivation of Yun Xi and Yue Chan, Huo Linger was the only plausible candidate to carry forward this pregnancy.

On the way to the Divine Cave Shi Hao constantly provoked her by saying that she should exercise more and lose weight, because her ass was very large and round, hearing that made her very embarrassed and irritated.

After getting an egg from a descendant of God with great difficulty in the Divine Cave, he was taken by Shi Hao who wanted to eat it, but after trying to cook it he ended up hatching a wolf cub who stayed with her for the food but only heard the orders of Shi Hao making her very irritated.

She met Shi Hao again.

Shi Hao proclaims her has his wife.<ref>

characters.introText: Phoenix Girl was a young supreme being from the Immortal Ancient Great Era and the last surviving descendant of the Ten Fierce Phoenix Clan. As the bearer of the clan’s supreme bloodline, "Phoenix True Blood," she possessed extraordinary innate talent and inherited the clan’s secret arts, including the "Heavenly Phoenix Precious Technique" and the power of the "Five-Colored Divine Light". She also wielded the legendary Immortal King weapon, the Nine Phoenix Furnace, which could be activated through her bloodline resonance and produced nine divine phoenix particle rings in combat. Her appearance as a young lady combined elegance and power, often described as wearing a blue-yellow gradient long dress with flowing hair, and in battle, she donned five-colored battle garments.
characters.appearance:
Phoenix Girl was a young supreme being from the Immortal Ancient Great Era and the last surviving descendant of the Ten Fierce Phoenix Clan. As the bearer of the clan’s supreme bloodline, "Phoenix True Blood," she possessed extraordinary innate talent and inherited the clan’s secret arts, including the "Heavenly Phoenix Precious Technique" and the power of the "Five-Colored Divine Light". She also wielded the legendary Immortal King weapon, the Nine Phoenix Furnace, which could be activated through her bloodline resonance and produced nine divine phoenix particle rings in combat. Her appearance as a young lady combined elegance and power, often described as wearing a blue-yellow gradient long dress with flowing hair, and in battle, she donned five-colored battle garments.

During her cultivation, Phoenix Girl achieved an extraordinarily rare feat by mastering three strands of immortal energy, a level of accomplishment few could reach. She refined a fragment of the nascent cosmos into her own body as an immortal seed, strengthening her essence and enabling her to perform feats such as phoenix rebirth and destructive combat techniques. Her cultivation allowed her to manipulate space and time through her innate domain power, "Five-Colored Divine Light," and control the Nine Phoenix Furnace to unleash forbidden killing arrays, making her a formidable presence on the battlefield.

Phoenix Girl’s story is closely tied to Shi Hao, whom she encountered during a mental journey into the past(Dream of the immortal Ancient). They exchanged insights on the cultivation of three strands of immortal energy, and she helped him understand that he was witnessing a reflection of the Immortal Ancient Era, constructed by powerful figures who pierced through the endless flow of time. Her interactions with Shi Hao highlighted her wisdom, strategic mind, and compassionate nature despite the chaos around her.

In the final battles of the Immortal Ancient Great Era, Phoenix Girl with the surviving members of her clan and everyone in Nine Heavens and Ten Earths against invading enemies. She fought fiercely to protect the Nine Heavens and her people, using her bloodline, immortal energy, and the Nine Phoenix Furnace. Ultimately, she fell in battle, collapsing into a pool of blood along with her companions. Her attempt at phoenix rebirth failed, and her soul dissipated, leaving only her divine substance. Later, Shi Hao discovered a brilliant, five-colored phoenix egg that seemed to contain traces of her essence, though it lacked any soul imprints, indicating that her true rebirth had not occurred.

characters.introText: The Without End Immortal King was one of the most powerful Immortal King giants of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths during the Immortal Ancient Era. As a supreme expert who cultivated the Dao of Time, he possessed unparalleled mastery over temporal laws and wielded the legendary Without End Bell, whose power could freeze space-time, shake the souls of countless enemies, and dominate large-scale battlefields. During the Immortal Antiquity War, he personally slew the Foreign Realm giant Pu Demon King, one of the enemy's most formidable Immortal Kings.
characters.appearance:
Without End Immortal King' and Six Paths of Reincarnation Immortal King were already regarded as peerless geniuses whose talents and strength surpassed their generation. They were considered unmatched among their peers, earning reputations as existences with no equal under the heavens. As they matured into Immortal King giants, the two became the leading figures of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, carrying the hopes of their world and standing at the forefront of resistance against the Foreign Realm. Before the destruction of the Immortal Ancient Era, they were regarded as the greatest protectors and leaders of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.

His final act, where he "exploded, turned into a rain of light" and his "immortal king essence blood completely burned up," is speculated to be a successful, albeit long-term, method of returning or reincarnation, requiring "endless ages, millions and millions of years" to verify

The restricted region lord, however, speculated that Without End Immortal King might have succeeded in some form of reincarnation, potentially reappearing in a future great era, though this would take endless ages to verify.

It is a popular belief that the Without End Immortal King (无终仙王) maybe have reincarnated as Great Emperor Wushi (无始大帝) from Shrouding the Heavens. The connection between the two is supported by a powerful combination of similarities: their philosophically linked titles, their nearly identical supreme weapons the Without End Bell and the Beginningless Bell their shared bond with a loyal black dog companion, and their similar roles as peerless figures who stood at the pinnacle of their respective eras. Within the novel's lore, they are suggested to be two manifestations of the same flower blooming in different eras a continuation of the same profound existence across different ages. While their direct reincarnation is never explicitly confirmed in the novels, the overwhelming parallels have led many readers to regard Without End Immortal King and Great Emperor Wushi as one of the strongest implied reincarnation connections in the series.
characters.history:
Without End Immortal King was one of the foremost Immortal King giants of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths during the Immortal Ancient Era and one of its greatest defenders against the Foreign Realm. Having cultivated the Dao of Time to an extraordinary level, he was renowned throughout both the Nine Heavens and Immortal Domain for his overwhelming strength. He was among the few Immortal Kings capable of invading the Foreign Realm and returning safely, and his mastery of temporal laws made him one of the most influential figures of the Immortal Ancient War. His mastery over time allowed him to traverse the River of Time, while his divine weapon, the Without End Bell, possessed terrifying power capable of freezing space-time, shaking the souls of enemies, and suppressing vast battlefields.

Throughout the war, Without End Immortal King frequently fought alongside Six Paths of Reincarnation Immortal King, serving as one of the twin pillars of the Nine Heavens' resistance. During the conflict, Without End Immortal King also engaged the Foreign Realm giant Pu Demon King in a bloody battle, ultimately killing him with the power of the Without End Bell, whose divine might could freeze space-time and shake the souls of countless opponents.

As the Immortal Ancient War reached its climax, Without End Immortal King and Six Paths of Reincarnation Immortal King made their final stand against more than ten Foreign Realm Immortal Kings, including supremes of the Foreign Realm such as Anlan and Shutuo. Vastly outnumbered and without sufficient reinforcements, they fought until all of their strength was exhausted before ultimately falling in battle. Their deaths marked the collapse of the Nine Heavens' final line of defense and the end of the Immortal Ancient Era.

Following his death, the spirit of the Without End Bell departed, leaving behind only the empty bell, later known as the Bell Corpse, which eventually came to rest within a Life Restricted Zone.

Without End Immortal King kept a True Immortal-level little black dog as a close follower, a being who was revered even within the Immortal Domain and had once accepted numerous "human pets." The dog was nailed to death during the great war but later revived in the subsequent era with only a fraction of its former cultivation remaining.

His True Immortal-level black dog follower preserved the remaining fragments of the bell and a final drop of his Immortal King essence blood in hopes of reviving him. Although these attempts ultimately failed and the remnants were exhausted, witnesses recalled that in his final moments Without End Immortal King smiled before dissolving into a rain of light. This unusual end led the Lord of the Restricted Zone to speculate that he may not have truly perished, but instead achieved a form of rebirth, leaving open the possibility that he would reappear in a future great era.

In his final moments, Without End Immortal King and Six Paths of Reincarnation Immortal King acted from the upper reaches of the River of Time, using their supreme temporal abilities to send  Shi Hao back to the final years of the Immortal Ancient Era. Through this intervention, they allowed Shi Hao to witness the final battle and the tragic downfall of the era they fought to protect acting as a warning of what is to come and which enemies they will face in the future.

characters.title: Immortal Qin
characters.introText: Immortal Qin is the Grand Ancestor of the entire Qin Clan both Upper and Lower Realm. He is rank in the top ten most powerful figures in the Three Thousand Provinces(Upper Realm). He is at the Peak of Self-Release realm.
characters.history:
This world’s mysteries are endless, strange things numerous. There are many things even we cannot understand, Immortal Qin said while spoking to Shi Hao. In the archaic times, Immortal Qin was extremely heroic, ambitions lofty, indeed a genius, slaughtering out his way to fame. He entered the uninhabited region, actually losing his way, but in the end miraculously made it out alive. He discovered that he was close to Imperial Pass, arriving at Desolate Border. It was precisely at that time that his fate underwent a shift! He still remembered stumbling into an ancient region. That place was hazy with immortal energy, incredibly pure and holy. However, there was blood covering the ground as far as the eyes could see, blood-soaked mud everywhere, the scene horrifying. There was a small marsh that was entirely dark red colored, a pool within that was bubbling about. However, what came out was all terrifying liquid that was bright red like blood. When Immortal Qin entered, he immediately passed out. When he woke up, he already mysteriously left the uninhabited region, his body returning to the Three Thousand Provinces. However, ever since that time, he discovered that he became different. After closely examining himself, he found that there was an extra bone in his body.

He originally didn’t have this name, but ever since he experienced that strange experience, he felt like he obtained the care of the heavens, and only then did he obtain such natural luck. During that period, there was always something in his mind telling him that changing his name was changing his fate, that he had to change his name to Immortal Qin. The bone had a name, which was "long life", and through this influenced the present world Qin Clan’s powerful individual into changing his name. Then, he found an ancient cave, cultivating inside. He wanted to get to the bottom of this bone’s mysteries, but before he knew it, he sunk into a deeper state of dao comprehension.  A single instance of dao comprehension and a hundred thousand years passed. When he emerged again, the world had already completely changed.

After a hundred thousand years passed, many people and things would change. However, Immortal Qin discovered that he was still young and full of vitality. In addition, his cultivation increased greatly, immediately becoming one of the Three Thousand Provinces few powerful individuals. However, when he returned home, he found that those he knew pretty much all died. Apart from a few Heaven’s Prides from the same generation who became powerful figures of their respective clans, everything else had already changed.

His female fiance of his waited many years for him, but in the end, she was forced to marry another by her clan. After a hundred thousand years had passed, not even her grave could be found. He could only quietly stop in that area and became sentimental. it affected him greatly. Immortal Qin then revealed Qin Yining Shi Hao mother’s bloodline’s blood inheritance. Immortal Qin did not have any descendants. After searching around, he found a bloodline of his former fiance, taking in him as an adopted son.

Immortal Qin cultivation skyrocketed, even without cultivating, just by having that bone, later on, there was someone who found him, someone named immortal Mu. At that time, he was already at the Supreme Being Realm!  He told Immortal Qin that in the past, he had also visited that bloody swamp, moreover even saw Immortal Qin unconscious. Moreover, that person himself also went unconscious. When he woke up, he saw a snow-white infant. There were three of them there at that time in total. That infant was snow-white and sparkling, but beside him was cutin skin, as well as pitch-black fingernails, extremely terrifying, Soon afterwards, that infant ran, directly disappearing. Later on, Immortal Mu also left that region. There was no extra bone in Immortal Mu, but there was some type of true blood that didn’t belong to him. In the end, his strength erupted, becoming a supreme being. During that process, he changed his name to Immortal Mu, his name was not originally this. Immortal Mu told Immortal Qin that the infant is the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths is Immortal Wang. After hearing everything from Immortal Mu he got sacred and got rid of the Immortal Bone before entering the Supreme Being realm but did many testing with servants by placing it inside of them, the servants power became greater as well. That bone was later given to Qin Hao

characters.introText: Jin Jiaoxi was a renowned young expert of the Jin Family, often described as a heaven warping genius. His story begins when he confronts Shi Hao, attempting to stop him from keeping a mysterious stone box. Jin Jiaoxi argued that the item was ownerless and should be discussed collectively, but his intentions quickly turned confrontational. With golden light surging from his eyes and skin, he released an overwhelming aura as his upper body transformed into the form of a divine rhinoceros, preparing to seize the stone box by force.
characters.appearance:
Jin Jiaoxi was a renowned young expert of the Jin Family, often described as a heaven warping genius. His story begins when he confronts Shi Hao, attempting to stop him from keeping a mysterious stone box. Jin Jiaoxi argued that the item was ownerless and should be discussed collectively, but his intentions quickly turned confrontational. With golden light surging from his eyes and skin, he released an overwhelming aura as his upper body transformed into the form of a divine rhinoceros, preparing to seize the stone box by force.

However, Shi Hao acted with astonishing speed. In a single, lightning fast move, he broke through Jin Jiaoxi’s sect master level defenses and cut off his most powerful golden horn,the very source of his dao. The blow left Jin Jiaoxi in disbelief and agony, his once proud composure shattered. Observers noted that Shi Hao had struck precisely at Jin Jiaoxi’s weakest point, even using the latter’s own power against him, leaving the divine rhinoceros in such humiliation and despair that he nearly contemplated ending his own life.

When Shi Hao mockingly asked whether he still wanted the stone box, Jin Jiaoxi—now terrified—attempted to retreat. Shi Hao stopped him, casually remarking that “divine rhinoceros meat isn’t bad,” and told him to stay. Overcome with fear, Jin Jiaoxi reverted to his original golden rhinoceros form, towering like a small mountain, and cried out for help.

His cries were answered when Zi Tong, the attendant of the Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch, intervened and ordered Jin Jiaoxi to stand beside him, assuring that no one would dare harm him. Soon after, the Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch himself descended, acknowledging Shi Hao’s presence and instructing Zi Tong to step back.

In the aftermath, Jin Jiaoxi’s arrogance was completely replaced by terror. He trembled uncontrollably and begged Shi Hao for forgiveness, regretting his earlier defiance. The once fearsome divine rhinoceros imagined himself roasted over an open flame, helpless and humiliated. Even as the Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch attempted to mediate, Shi Hao calmly replied that he was “quite benevolent” and did not wish to kill only to “taste a bit of rhinoceros meat.” The remark left Jin Jiaoxi speechless and horrified, realizing that, in Shi Hao’s eyes, he was nothing more than a moving piece of meat.

characters.title: Jin Zhan

infobox.Title: Jin Zhan
infobox.realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText: Jin Zhan possessed a majestic and intimidating presence, often appearing as though he were a supreme deity descending to the mortal realm. He was typically shrouded in thick chaos mist, which obscured his figure and gave him a mysterious, hazy silhouette, or surrounded by a broad divine ring that radiated awe-inspiring power,. His most striking features were his eyes, which were described as being as brilliant as two heavenly suns; when they opened and closed, beams of divine light would split the sky, revealing his terrifying prowess. During moments of extreme exertion in battle, his appearance would transform to reveal his non-human lineage: mysterious patterns would manifest on his forehead, and a crystalline horn would grow from his head, capable of slicing through the order and laws of the universe. He was also known to travel in the Five Spirits War Chariot, a vehicle of immense prestige that further amplified his regal image.
characters.appearance: Jin Zhan possessed a majestic and intimidating presence, often appearing as though he were a supreme deity descending to the mortal realm. He was typically shrouded in thick chaos mist, which obscured his figure and gave him a mysterious, hazy silhouette, or surrounded by a broad divine ring that radiated awe-inspiring power,. He was also known to travel in the Five Spirits War Chariot, a vehicle of immense prestige that further amplified his regal image.
characters.personality: Defined by supreme arrogance and an unshakeable belief in his own invincibility, Jin Zhan viewed himself as the pinnacle of the younger generation. He was deeply status-conscious and demanded absolute respect, flying into a rage if he felt slighted or if his elders were disrespected. He possessed a strong sense of entitlement, believing that only the strongest opponents were worthy of him; he felt insulted when the foreign realm sent a "side branch" descendant to fight him, viewing it as a humiliation despite the opponent's strength,. However, his confidence was brittle; after suffering crushing defeats, particularly being stepped on by the foreign expert and suppressed by Huang, his pride turned into deep-seated resentment and frustration,. He was also vindictive, harboring grudges for years, as seen when he roared in anger upon regaining his ability to speak after being suppressed by Shi Hao decades later.
characters.history:
Jin Zhan was the most valued descendant of Jin Taijun. He entered the Saint Academy, a place reserved for the most elite geniuses, where he broke numerous ancient records. He was hailed as a legend who pushed the limits of the Present World Law, aiming to surpass all predecessors. It was rumored that he had once attempted to break two extreme realms within half a year, nearly dying in the process, which only added to his mystique as a "living legend".

Jin Zhan's path crossed with Huang's at the Deity Academy. The conflict began over a cultivation mountain containing ancestral dragon veins. Jin Zhan attempted to seize the mountain occupied by Huang to give it to his fiancée, Wang Xi. Although the physical confrontation was initially halted by elders, the animosity took root.

Later, during a gathering, Jin Zhan challenged Huang. However, Huang, viewing Jin Zhan as unworthy of a direct challenge, sent his mount, the Golden Lion (a formidable descendant of the Fearless Lion), to fight in his stead. Jin Zhan fought a fierce, evenly matched battle with the lion, which was a source of great humiliation for him, as he could not even quickly suppress his rival's mount.

During the border wars against the Foreign Realm (Exotic Realm), Jin Zhan sought to prove himself. He challenged a silver-robed young expert from the opposing side. Despite unleashing his full power—manifesting his forehead horn and a domain of laws—he was decisively defeated. The foreign expert shattered Jin Zhan’s techniques and stepped on him, publicly humiliating him and the Jin Family. Jin Zhan only survived because he possessed a life-saving treasure from his family that whisked him away.

Thirty years after the events that supposedly left Huang crippled by the Remnant Immortal, Jin Zhan re-emerged from seclusion, his cultivation having advanced significantly. At a gathering at the Sumeru Broken Mountain, he openly mocked the "deceased" or "crippled" Huang, claiming that Huang was destined to be dust while he would rise to supremacy.

However, Huang appeared at the gathering, fully recovered and now a Supreme Being (Zhizun). Jin Zhan, recognizing his nemesis, was shocked and enraged. He attempted to speak but was suppressed by Huang's pressure. In the ensuing confrontation, Huang did not give Jin Zhan a chance to showcase his skills. With a single stroke of sword energy, Huang beheaded Jin Zhan, ending the life of the Jin Family's greatest hope. His soul was subsequently suppressed and destroyed.

characters.title: Jin Zhu
characters.introText: Golden Spider is the Great Master of the Demon Spirit Lake, and the master of Shi Ziteng. He is a powerful cultivator in the Stone Country of the Lower Realm.
characters.history:
He is a powerful and prideful creature whose descendants are from the true spider bloodline. He has an arrogance about him when speaking about his clan's former glories in ancient era, as seen during his defeat and death.

Golden Spider was invited by his disciple Shi Ziteng to fight Master Fifteenth, Shi Zhongtian. He faced off against Shi Zhongtian with only his spirit body. Though defeated, it also showed the strength of him as one of the most powerful in the Venerable Realm, as a spirit body typically has only 60-80% of the of the original body's power.

After Shi Ziteng was defeated by Shi Hao, Golden Spider arrived to save his disciple and punish Shi Hao. However, the Stone Emperor showed up to stop him from causing a blood calamity, and broke off the fight. Shi Hao captured and later killed his grandson, the Demon Spirit Lake's young prince, after encountering him during the pre-gathering at a market place before the Stone Emperor's birthday party celebration.

During the Emperor's birthday party, Shi Ziteng mentioned the Stone Country's state law, which allowed a life and death duel in the military arena to settle disputes. A battle between Golden Spider, Qing Tian, and Shi Hao began. In the end, he was killed by Little Pagoda's blood sacrifice. He died cursing his bad luck and arrogantly recalling his clan's dominance over humans.

characters.introText: King Yu is the current leader of the Rain Clan and is said to be one of the most powerful in the lower realms.
characters.history:
When the Rain Clan ancestor (Rain Deity) went missing after leaving in ancient times for the secret realm, and was said to be dead, they needed someone to fill the gap quickly. They needed someone of high talent, a young genius who could lead the clan to future glory. They chose him to be the King.

The Rain Clan and King Yu had a connection with Stone Clan, as his favorite clan junior was married to Shi Ziteng. When Shi Ziling killed Shi Yi's mother for stealing the Supreme Being Bones, King Yu vowed to help eradicate Shi Zhongtian's side of the family. He ordered a man hunt for Shi Ziling, Qin Yining, and baby Shi Hao, which lasted for years.

When the infamous Master Fifteen Shi Zhongtian returned a decade later and demanded justice for his grandson, Shi Ziteng invites King Yu over to help quell the havoc. Bringing an outsider into clan affairs upset a lot of the elders. King Yu calculated wrongly, not realizing that Master Fifteen's cultivation during his time away had soared. After the arrow blew off everything below his waist, he frantically retreated back to the Rain Palace. But Master Fifteen followed closely, destroyed many courtyards and temples, and finally stopped after killing a few clan members. The Rain Clan that day took a huge loss.

Later, King Yu appeared at the Stone Clan treasury and fought a great battle with Shi Hao. After his defeat, he again retreated back to his clan. Shi Hao followed him, and this time, the clan was totally destroyed, leaving only the women and children.

characters.title: Kong Tuo
characters.introText: Kongtuo (孔拓) is a minor antagonist introduced in the Perfect World (完美世界). Unlike the elemental-focused Supremes peers, of the Foreign Realm, his combat style is centered around serpentine constructs and curse-based ink arts. He is an elite cultivator from the Foreign Realm (异域), holding the title Foreign Realm Supreme (异域至尊). He participates in large-scale invasions aimed at breaking the defensive lines of the Desolate Border, where the Foreign Realm wages war against the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
characters.appearance:
Kongtuo has a sinister, dark, and malevolent appearance strongly associated with serpent imagery and forbidden techniques. He has a pale complexion, sharp facial features, and short, slightly disheveled silver-white hair, accented by streaks of red framing his face.

He wears an open-chested black and crimson robe, revealing glowing red and pink curse-like markings across his chest. The lower part of his attire is formed of long, trailing black ink-like sashes, decorated with metallic chains and silver accents.

Instead of a traditional halo, Kongtuo is surrounded by massive serpentine entities formed from black ink and crimson energy. These writhing constructs coil around his body and extend outward like a living cloak, reinforcing his oppressive and sinister aura.

characters.title: Kun Di
characters.introText: Kun Di is an immensely powerful existence from the Foreign Realm, holding the status of an Undying King. He is recognized as one of the most formidable experts in the Foreign Realm, generally considered the number one figure, excluding those transcendent creatures dwelling in the Realm Sa. His name is intentionally audacious, reflecting his power and ambition. He served as the master of the highly talented disciple He Wushuang.
characters.appearance:
Kun Di possesses a thin and withered physical form, not physically imposing or bulky in the way many other undying kings and immortal kings are his power is not written into an obviously massive or muscular frame, which makes his true strength easy to underestimate at a glance. He has long silver hair, every strand described as brilliant, scattering loosely down and around him rather than kept bound or restrained.

His most distinctive feature is his eyes: his pupils are unusual, taking the shape of silver crosses rather than ordinary irises. In stillness, this simply lends him a strange, otherworldly quality, but the crosses are not merely cosmetic when Kun Di engages in serious combat, his silver pupils visibly shift and intensify, and the cross shape itself becomes the source of his signature attack, releasing cross-shaped slashes of energy powerful enough to tear apart the void and threaten to cleave open Realm Sea itself. His name is itself a reflection of his character and ambitions while the "Di" he uses formally reads as "truth" or "examine" rather than "emperor," the two characters are close enough in sound and form that the name projects the same boldness and ambition of someone reaching for the emperor's throne.
characters.personality: Kun Di exhibits an extremely dominant and cold disposition, maintaining a terrifying presence characteristic of the Foreign Realm's hierarchy. Despite being an ancient figure, he possesses a temper often described as fiery, even more vigorous than a youngster. He holds the highest authority, with other Undying Kings deferring to him and referring to him as "senior". He is known as a great slaughterer in the Foreign Realm. His arrogance led him to believe that no matter Shi Hao’s talent, he could be suppressed and killed if he did not reach Kun Di's level of power. Driven by vengeance after the fall of his last disciple, He Wushuang, Kun Di acted decisively to ensure Huang’s demise.
characters.history:
Kun Di is an ancient figure, having existed for countless years, rooted deeply in the history of the foreign land.

Kun Di was roused from his slumber when his most favored disciple, He Wushuang, fell. This event triggered Kun Di’s overwhelming wrath and focused his efforts entirely on eliminating Shi Hao (Huang).

Kun Di was actively involved in coordinating efforts to prevent Shi Hao from breaking through the IHalf-Immortal Emperor realm. He gathered powerful allies, including the Demonic Cattail Tree and Wu Shang, and contacted giants from the Realm Sea, convinced that Huang would fail and that Immortal Domain was trying to bait them. Kun Di personally descended to attack Shi Hao during his breakthrough attempt, viewing it as an overestimation of abilities, believing Huang would inevitably fail and be destroyed.

Kun Di confronted Shi Hao at the edge of Realm Sea shortly after Shi Hao had killed He Wushuang, Kun Di's favored disciple, in single combat and sealed his primordial spirit rather than destroying it. Kun Di, alerted by his disciple's fall, arrived guarding the border of Realm Sea and demanded Shi Hao release He Wushuang's soul. When Shi Hao refused, a world-shocking battle erupted, one intense enough that the clash echoed through Realm Sea's border and drew the attention of powerful creatures ascending from the sea. The two fought from sea to shore and then all the way to Lightning Abyss, over a thousand exchanges, cracking heaven and earth and seemingly reversing the flow of the river of time.

During this fight, Kun Di wielded the Immortal Smelting Pot personally, and its power in his hands proved far greater than when it had been used by lesser wielders a single strike from it staggered Shi Hao badly enough that, had he been any ordinary immortal king rather than a cultivator of the Imperishable Scripture, half his body would have been destroyed outright. The pot also displayed the strange ability to break through time-space, striking Shi Hao before he could react. In turn, Kun Di suffered severe injuries of his own: one of his arms was snapped by a fist imprint, his shoulder caved in with the bones inside shattered, and later his chest was blasted open by another strike, exposing a silver-red heart. When Kun Di taunted the Everlasting Sword Core as being made of mere "scraps," Shi Hao pressed him for its origin Kun Di revealed it had been forged from a coffin (though he denied it was the Three World Bronze Coffin), and warned that every past owner of the sword core had died a miserable death since the Age of Emperor Collapse, a curse Shi Hao dismissed.

Ultimately Kun Di chose to disengage rather than continue the fight to the death, retreating toward the foreign realm; Shi Hao gave chase, slaughtering his way through the gates of a foreign realm city and cutting down all who tried to stop him along the way.

Shi Hao chased Kun Di deep into foreign realm territory, the battle continuing to shatter stars and destroy entire star domains as it went. An undying king who ruled the region they crashed into rushed to Kun Di's aid, addressing him as "senior" a sign of just how elevated Kun Di's status was among the foreign realm's kings but was cut down by a single strike from Shi Hao's sword. Kun Di, attacked again by the enlarged, mountain-sized Immortal Smelting Pot, briefly pinned Shi Hao under its crushing weight before Shi Hao broke free using a secret technique combining Kun Peng wings and True Phoenix rebirth flames, then blasted the pot out of the star system entirely. Kun Di nearly lost his head to a strike from the Everlasting Sword Core, forcing him to retreat further, this time deliberately luring Shi Hao toward a specific, ancient golden temple floating in the depths of foreign realm space ground he had chosen deliberately, expecting reinforcements.

By this point nine undying kings, including Anlan and Shutuo, had converged on the location, surrounding Shi Hao. Despite being encircled, Kun Di ordered the others to hold back and not close in together, apparently wary of Shi Hao's strength even in a group setting.

Rather than fight directly, Kun Di withdrew to the temple's side and began chanting an ancient incantation, summoning a massive black shadow from within the temple a shadow Shi Hao recognized, having previously seen an identical figure once summoned by Scarlet King to fight off a white-clothed woman during an earlier confrontation. This first shadow fought Shi Hao directly, and though it was still only Immortal King-level in power, it proved formidable. Kun Di continued the incantation, summoning a second shadow that did not fight but instead merged with the first; in total, eight shadows were summoned and merged together, with a ninth attempted but scattering back into the temple before it could take form. Rather than making the combined shadow's power simply additive, the merging instead made its magical body more solid and "real" striking it felt like striking an actual flesh body rather than a construct.

Even at full merged strength, Shi Hao found the creature though a serious threat, not unbeatable until he discovered its true nature: it could not be permanently destroyed. He and the little figure atop his Everlasting Sword Core beheaded it twice using techniques that broke through the limits of time-space, methods that visibly unnerved the watching kings, yet the shadow simply reformed each time, regenerating endlessly like an undying king given form.

Eventually Kun Di called for a full withdrawal, having the other kings retreat to a safe distance and begin chanting incantations of their own to lend magical force from afar. The black shadow shrank and returned into the temple and when it reemerged, it was no longer a formless giant but a normal-sized figure, this time carrying an object so blindingly radiant it was unbearable to look at directly: the foreign realm's own Origin Ancient Artifact, comparable to the one Shi Hao had previously encountered in Burial Earth. Shi Hao realized then that the black shadow was not a true creature of the world at all, but something born from the artifact itself likely a construct of natural law rather than flesh, a discovery that revealed just how far Kun Di and the foreign realm's researchers had progressed in unlocking the artifact's secrets.

Because Shi Hao had once been exposed to Burial Earth's Origin Ancient Artifact and survived, he found himself with a strange degree of immunity its radiance, lethal to nearly anyone else, including most undying kings, could not harm him. Confident, he turned to leave rather than touch it directly, but the foreign realm's kings refused to let him go, again activating the shadow and driving it at him with the Origin Ancient Artifact in hand. Cornered, Shi Hao killed a nearby undying king and threw the corpse's head directly at the artifact to test it, then seized the primordial spirit back into his own collection for later study, further shocking the watching kings, who couldn't understand why he wasn't being destroyed by the artifact's radiance.

Forced into direct contact with the chest while fending off the shadow, Shi Hao discovered something the foreign realm apparently didn't know: the chest was developing cracks, as if it were on the verge of being opened by his touch alone despite the foreign realm's endless searching for a "seed" or key to do exactly that. He had no idea what about him could be causing this, only that once the cracks appeared, the light pouring from the chest intensified many times over, and rather than being purely divine and auspicious as before, it began manifesting as thick, corrosive darkness matter stronger than any darkness matter he had previously encountered, threatening to overwhelm and corrupt him. Recognizing the danger of losing himself to it, Shi Hao broke off and began slaughtering his way back out of the foreign realm rather than risk further contact.

As Shi Hao withdrew, badly wounded from the crack's escalating radiance enough to cough up immortal king essence blood Kun Di and the other undying kings deliberately vanished from the battlefield rather than press the advantage directly, gambling that the corrosive darkness matter would finish him off on its own. Unaware that his injury stemmed from the chest cracking rather than a losing battle, they went into hiding, intending to exhaust him. Shi Hao fought off the corrosion, forced open a sealed passage by hurling the freed primordial spirit of a captured undying king into a blockading city gate, shattering it, and slaughtered his way out of the foreign realm entirely, with the shadow still carrying the Origin Ancient Artifact and the pursuing kings chasing him all the way to the edge of Realm Sea.

Upon nearing Immortal Domain, Shi Hao found the city gates sealed against him by order of an unnamed elder, on the standing command of an "old senior" recently returned to Immortal Domain a delay that nearly cost him his life given the pursuing undying kings closing in with the Origin Ancient Artifact in tow. Only Immortal Domain's own protective natural laws held back the artifact's radiance long enough for reinforcement kings, led by Pan King and Hunyuan Immortal King, to arrive and escort him back across the border, at which point the foreign realm's kings, warned off by mention of a prepared World Eradication Great Formation, withdrew.

Once safely back, Shi Hao purged the corrosive darkness matter from his body using his six great secret realms, privately shaken by how close the "sacred darkness matter" had come to overwhelming his will recognizing it as a substance that had destroyed countless experts throughout history and was nearly impossible to expel once it took hold.

During Shi Hao’s ascension, Kun Di desperately supported the Origin Ancient Artifact, willing to sacrifice the rest of his existence to stop Huang. However, his efforts were abruptly nullified when Ancestor Gu (Old Gu), a powerful defector from the foreign side, intervened. Ancestor Gu used time and space dao laws to shatter the ritual, sending Kun Di flying and seizing the Origin Ancient Artifact. Furious and defeated, Kun Di's primordial spirit was left exposed and vulnerable. Shi Hao then delivered the decisive blow, crushing Kun Di's body and obliterating his primordial spirit, ending his life.

characters.title: Kun Peng King
characters.introText: The Kun Peng King is an ancient and supremely powerful entity originating from two great eras ago, noted in records as an existence even more formidable than the Kun Peng of the Vicious Ten. This being currently manifests as a shriveled golden figure, possessing only a fragment of its former strength as a remnant will. His immense status is such that the Immortal King Aocheng, upon realizing his background, expressed profound shock.
characters.appearance: During his brief appearance in the current era, the Kun Peng King was physically perceived as a shriveled golden figure. Though human-form, his body was long broken apart and merely forcefully pieced together. He possessed a massive stature and was accompanied by golden wings. His overall appearance suggests immense power despite the visible signs of decay and damage accumulated over endless time.
characters.personality: The Kun Peng King displayed immense courage and an unwavering presence, even when facing an aggressive rival Immortal King, Aocheng, while in a ruined state. He demonstrated defiance, confronting Aocheng and commanding him to cease actions that "crossed the line". His actions showed a protective instinct towards the successors of his realm, intervening in a fatal attack despite the risks to his already frail existence.
characters.history:
The Kun Peng King belonged to a time two great eras ago, placing his origins well before the Immortal Ancient period. He was an unmatched giant whose might was universally known. At some unknown point in history, he suffered a tremendous disaster, leading to his presumed demise. As a result, his physical form was ruined, leaving him as only a remnant will dwelling within a shriveled body. This ancestor is confirmed to be even more powerful than the renowned Vicious Ten's Kun Peng, who was female.

The Kun Peng King's remnants were found within a certain ancient cave, having been dug out from a pile of bones, indicating he did not originally belong to the era when Shi Hao discovered him. He was still tenuously alive, having forcefully pieced his fractured body back together.

The Kun Peng King reappeared during a critical moment when Aocheng Immortal King, attempting to cross the immortal gate, launched an attack intended to kill Shi Hao. The appearance of the golden, winged figure was sudden, creating an unforeseen change in the deadly confrontation. Aocheng Immortal King immediately recognized the figure, identifying him as the Kun Peng King from two great eras ago, but sneeringly referred to him as a "dead person". The Kun Peng King confronted Aocheng, stating the Immortal King had "crossed the line". Despite Aocheng’s immediate and domineering response, Kun Peng King held his ground, clarifying that he was merely a remnant will with wounds. Aocheng proceeded with his attack, asserting that no one could stop him, and the powerful strike shattered Kun Peng King’s physical form, confirming that his body was unable to withstand further damage due to his past injuries.

characters.title: Lan Yichen

infobox.Title: Lan Yichen
infobox.CauseOfDeath: Probably died during Dharma end Age.
infobox.realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText: Lan Yichen was the most renowned youth of the clan, a true phenomenon who had dominated his region, unrivaled in defeating all experts who dared to challenge him. When he reached the pinnacle of his power, he was recognized as the strongest in an entire province.
characters.history:
Lan Yichen was the most renowned youth of the clan, a true phenomenon who had dominated his region, unrivaled in defeating all experts who dared to challenge him. When he reached the pinnacle of his power, he was recognized as the strongest in an entire province.

Lan Yichen and Luo Dao decided to attempt to steal the Void Sky Divine Vine from Shi Hao after he destroyed the formations protecting the divine medicine. When Hong Huang recounted the story of these two geniuses to Shi Hao, the latter, in a provocative tone, commented that he was facing individuals who must be among the top ten thousand experts of the Immortal Ancient. This assertion was bold, considering that Luo Dao and Lan Yichen were the greatest talents in their region, and it was expected that Shi Hao would consider them among the top three thousand experts of the Immortal Ancient.

Luo Dao proposed to Shi Hao and Hong Huang to kneel and serve them to spare their lives, but Lan Yichen disagreed with this proposal, reluctant to carry burdens. Their confidence was fueled by their assurance in their own strength, which made them behave arrogantly as they tried to steal others' opportunities. Their confidence was not unfounded, as they truly had the power to justify it.

Shi Hao looked at them with a calm expression, neither despising them nor showing fear, simply treating them with a normal expression. He advanced step by step to face his enemy head-on! He had already become a deity and, as such, had the confidence needed to defeat all enemies. Luo Dao noticed that Shi Hao's transition to the divine flame was not yet complete, and they believed he was a formation master, so if he wanted to activate one, they wouldn't give him the time. But after just one strike from Shi Hao, they realized that they were actually facing an exceptional talent who was no weaker than them. They had made a judgment error.

Shi Hao did not use the Magic Power Immunity ability. Now he could control it even better, choosing whether to activate it or not. He wanted to confront his enemies head-on to defeat them.

Luo Dao's eyes were deep, producing two streaks of light as they stared at Shi Hao. He knew that this time things would be extremely problematic. He had not encountered just anyone, but an exceptional talent. Lan Yichen joined the fray, but it was all in vain; the strength of the young man they had challenged was overwhelming.

Luo Dao decided to employ his closely guarded secret skill, leading others to believe his innate ability was the sparrow bone sword. However, this was deliberately orchestrated to conceal the true source of his power; his genuine innate ability resided in his hair. These hair strands could transform into weapons, wrapping around Shi Hao's arm until they pierced his flesh, draining his divine strength. However, Shi Hao countered by using  the power of reincarnation to accelerate Luo Dao's aging and weaken his hair. Ultimately, Luo Dao fell to the ground as his hair separated from Shi Hao's arm.

At that moment, Shi Hao presented Luo Dao and Lan Yichen with a dramatic choice: accept to become his servants or face death. The two warriors were torn, aware that refusing would mean the end of their lives, but accepting would compromise the honor of their respective sects. While Luo Dao desperately attempted to flee, achieving little success, Lan Yichen prepared to face the attack with dignity, activating his precious technique. With determination, Lan Yichen unleashed a series of divine blades, unleashing a blue-golden light that struck Shi Hao violently. These blades, formed from the essence of gold, emitted a metallic homicidal aura and could transform into various weapons. However, surprise and desperation struck Lan Yichen when the powerful divine blades were all destroyed by Shi Hao's simple touch. Retreating in the face of this overwhelming superiority, Lan Yichen roared, and suddenly, a molten metallic liquid began to flow from his mouth. With a gesture, he summoned metal from the mountains and rivers, causing it to emerge from the earth beneath their feet. The blood-red magma transformed into an infinity of weapons of all kinds, covering the sky and the earth, creating a scene akin to a sea of weapons, a sky brimming with scorching metal.

The metallic element of the world seemed to bend to his command, incessantly creating bone blades that transformed into weapons to annihilate the enemy. It seemed that there was no end to his supply. The world itself transformed into his army of swords, with endless metal flowing everywhere, generating a lethal energy that filled the skies. Shi Hao watched in awe, recognizing the power of these techniques.

Nevertheless, he did not succumb to fear. Every time he grasped such an element, the liquid metal sprayed in all directions, but it failed to harm his body. He appeared as an indomitable hero, an immortal warrior descended into this world. Meanwhile, Lan Yichen merged with the molten metal, camouflaging himself and moving in the shadows. Although he was outmatched, he still hoped to escape. Shi Hao countered by using the lightning technique against the molten liquid, and the metallic clang echoed in the air, shattering stones and putting everyone to the test.

As the two battled in the sky, ripples formed and spread, reaching the distant peaks of the mountains and causing them to explode. Lan Yichen was struck by an intense flash, crashing to the ground near Luo Dao.

Shi Hao asked once again to choose between being killed or becoming his servants. Lan Yichen asked who the person who had just crushed them really was, and upon hearing the answer, they agreed to be subdued.

“Huang, sinner’s blood descendent, Shi Hao.”

Shi Hao spoke out the three identities at the same time.
Lan Yichen’s body was immediately shaken, looking at him with complete shock. He muttered,

“I knew it… ended up kicking a metal plate.”

Without saying anything else, just the Huang identity was enough to make him sigh. When the Lightning Emperor precious technique was displayed, it would completely suppress him.

Shi Hao used the Seed Formation Technique to subdue them and make them his slave.

Shi Hao sent Lan Yichen ahead to retrieve the Void Sky Divine Vine, but he was cut in half. Fortunately, having a metal body, he survived, albeit consuming a great deal of divine energy.

Meanwhile, Luo Dao and Lan Yichen were sent on a medicinal herb hunt while Shi Hao was in isolation to advance in the divine flame. They managed to obtain Octadic Treasure Qilin but were pursued by major forces of the Immortal Ancient, who attempted to steal their treasure.

Immortal Emperor Shi Hao went to the past and paid him and Luo Dao  a last Visit from Afar at the End of Novel. He had kept memories and mentioned them several times

characters.title: Lan Yu
characters.introText: Hong Huang and Lan Yu are both distinguished guests of Burao Mountain. In order to entertain these two beauties, Burao Mountain even gave up the VIP cabin. Shi Hao wanted to go to Burao Mountain to find his parents, so he took this boat. This is how I met these two beauties.
characters.history:
Hong Huang and Lan Yu are both distinguished guests of Burao Mountain. In order to entertain these two beauties, Burao Mountain even gave up the VIP cabin. Shi Hao wanted to go to Burao Mountain to find his parents, so he took this boat. This is how I met these two beauties.

Because these two beauties had just experienced the lower world, they didn't know how much trouble Shi Hao had done recently. They just felt that he was valuable in making friends and training, so they both wanted to draw Shi Hao into their influence. And in order to win over Shi Hao, the beautiful Red Phoenix also told a secret, that is, the world in the lower world is lacking, and the laws are incomplete.

It is difficult to have a future if you practice in the lower world. If things go on like this, it will be extremely harmful to the cultivators. In the end, no matter how talented you are, you will never be able to succeed. will be buried.
Hong Huang has a way to let Shi Hao go to the upper realm, that is, let Shi Hao join her force first, and then she asks for a place for Shi Hao, so that him can ascend the Heaven Gate and enter the heaven.

However, Shi Hao was very moved, but with good intentions, he would not join any upper realm force. At the same time, he still had many things to do, including protecting Shi Country, retrieving his parents, taking care of Shi Cun, etc. In the end, Blue Rain Beauty and Red Phoenix Beauty couldn't move Shi Hao, so they stopped trying to win over Shi Hao. Not long after, they parted ways.

With the opening of the Ancient Treasure Realm, the opportunities hidden in it also attracted countless cultivators. Naturally, Lan Yu and other upper realm geniuses could not lag behind others. In order to seize the creation on the Sun God Tree, Lan Yu and others did not hesitate to risk entering. The land of the Golden Crow Tribe, but facing the large number of Golden Crow Tribe people, Lan Yu and other superior geniuses seemed a little powerless. When they saw that Red Phoenix and Lan Yu was about to be in trouble, the geniuses present were helpless and could only watch her from the sidelines. Fortunately, they were all along the way. Shi Hao, who was following Red Phoenix, arrived in time and saved her from the Golden Crow people.

However, Shi Hao never expected that his heroic act of saving the beauty would arouse the dissatisfaction of several male geniuses. After entering the Sun God Tree, they attacked Shi Hao sneakily and pushed him into the magma filled with earthly fire liquid. However, Shi Hao saved the day. Not only did he improve his cultivation, but he also obtained his second Supreme Treasure. With the power of the Supreme Treasure, Shi Hao suppressed all the people who came to hunt for treasures on the Sun God Tree. Those who have made it possible for Lan Yu and other upper realm female geniuses to leave the ancient treasure world safely. If Shi Hao had not taken action to suppress those venerables, not only would Red Phoenix and other upper realm geniuses not be able to get the treasures, but they would also lose their own. Life will also be on the line.
characters.trivia: According to the original work, there were four beauties from the upper world, and the other two were Shuiyue and Yingying. However, due to financial issues, the official Donghua deleted these two beauties and only retained Lan Yu and Hong Huang.

characters.title: Li Yuncong
characters.introText: Li Yuncong, he is the first generation of Tianyun Province, he is very young, but very powerful and a handsome guy. Unlike other geniuses, he is not so cold or arrogant. He is polite and does not easily make enemies with others.
characters.history:
Initially without any defeats, he only realized the existence of someone stronger when he faced a Double Eye Pupil expert. This defeat left Li Yuncong with a lingering illness, hindering his further progress. However, Li Yuncong possesses the thunder and lightning treasure technique, which happens to be what Shi Hao needs.

Coincidentally, Shi Hao also came to the Tianhe, hoping to get some treasures in the Tianhe, so Shi Hao and Li Yuncong met. When Li Yuncong saw Shi Hao, he bowed first and then started talking to Shi Hao. During the conversation, Shi Hao saw that he was very strong, so he wanted to spar with him. Li Yuncong didn't refuse, so they started sparring with him in the Tianhe River.

After the discussion, Shi Hao had an idea, so he hoped that Li Yuncong could exchange treasure techniques with him, and said that his treasure technique was the Suanni treasure technique, and he would guarantee that you would not suffer any loss. Li Yuncong was moved, so he gave Shi Hao his precious skill, the Thunder Sky Bird Skill, and both parties were happy as they each got what they needed.

This time when he met Li Yuncong in the Tianhe River, Shi Hao also learned a big secret. The big secret was that his old rival Shi Yi did not die but came to the upper world. Shi Hao knew this big secret from Li Yuncong. Li Yuncong had already regarded Shi Hao as a friend, so he talked about everything. During this period, Li Yuncong mentioned a person who had double pupils. Although he was very young, his strength was higher than his own, and he was defeated because of this.

Shi Hao was immediately moved when he heard this. After all, double pupils are rare, only one in a million. In addition, Shi Yi happened to have double pupils, so Shi Hao reasonably suspected that Shi Yi was not dead. After asking Li Yuncong again what he looked like with double pupils, he confirmed that Shi Yi was not dead. Since Shi Yi is not dead and has come to the upper world, he will encounter him sooner or later, so Shi Hao is on guard.

characters.introText: He is the only surviving one among the many children of the old Heavenly Hornet Ant, and he is also the most doted one. During the Immortal Ancient War, he was protected by his father and became one of the few survivors. characters.history:
He is the only surviving one among the many children of the old Heavenly Hornet Ant, and he is also the most doted one. During the Immortal Ancient War, he was protected by his father and became one of the few survivors. All Heavenly Horned Ant are born with deficiencies that were harmed before they were born, but luckily they make up for it later in life with Huang's help. After sleeping for an era, he was reborn.

At the end of the Ancient Era, he woke up and became brothers with Shi Hao and others. Ever since he met He Wushuang when he captured the Immortal Sutra at the True Immortal Peak and learned that he was a great enemy, he has been obsessed with He Wushuang all his life.

Five hundred thousand years later, because He Wushuang became the Immortal King, ordinary True Immortals could not kill He Wushuang at all, which greatly stimulated him and inspired his infinite fighting spirit. He did not hesitate to risk his own life and entered the land of the Great Evil Ancestor to hone himself.

He asked Shi Hao to suppress He Wushuang's spirit, and he would end it himself in the future. Therefore, he went to the ancestral land to practice for 800,000 years, and successfully advanced to the level of the Archaic Vicious Ten (because he was a member of the Heavenly Horned Ant Tribe and practiced the Immortal Sutra, so he was physically invincible), reaching the strength of his father back then, and finally killed He Wushuang to avenge his relatives.

Heavenly Horned Ant never actually became a full Immortal King he rose to the level of the Vicious Ten, which is described as comparable to but still short of a true immortal king. Here's how and why that happened:

The Heavenly Horned Ant's drive to grow stronger was rooted entirely in grief and rage toward He Wushuang, the undying king who had killed his older brothers and sisters and fed them to his own mount. When Shi Hao eventually defeated He Wushuang in Realm Sea, he deliberately chose not to destroy He Wushuang's primordial spirit outright instead sealing it away specifically so the Heavenly Horned Ant could have the chance to deliver the final blow himself.

When Shi Hao revealed He Wushuang's sealed spirit to the Ant, the emotional impact was immediate and overwhelming his eyes turned red, blood tears fell, and he demanded to kill his enemy personally. Rather than accept an easy resolution, the Ant entered a state of near-crazed cultivation and vanished from public life, retreating into the Heavenly Horned Ant Clan's ancestral land a sunken, killing-intent-soaked region where his own clan had once been wiped out, entering it "without any regard for the dangers" to sharpen himself there. At the time, he was still only a true immortal, not yet strong enough to face He Wushuang, who remained sealed at full Immortal King-level power.

Shi Hao privately hoped this exact motivation the unbearable weight of an unresolved debt was what would finally push the Ant across the threshold into Vicious Ten-level strength.

That hope paid off. After a long period of bitter, secluded cultivation, "there was a violent upheaval from the Heavenly Horned Ant's ancestral land" a massive golden ant, its single horn erupting with endless radiance, rose from the ancestral land, its power shocking all of Immortal Domain. The Heavenly Horned Ant had succeeded in rising to the level of the Vicious Ten: his flesh became unmatched, and his primordial spirit strength trailed only slightly behind that of a true immortal king. His signature trait, a berserk transformation triggered by rage, meant that once angered, his strength and primordial spirit force would surge even further beyond that baseline.

This was enough, at last, for him to face He Wushuang directly. Shi Hao released the sealed spirit and sent the Darkness Willow Deity along to guard against anything unexpected, letting the Ant finally settle the score himself the actual outcome of that final confrontation isn't detailed in the chapters given, but by that point the Ant, now at the height of his power, stood a real chance against an enemy that had once been far beyond him.

When the Three Dark Emperors came with their army, he had completely surpassed his father and was promoted to True Immortal King, and his combat power at this time was able to defeat the giant Immortal King. (They have the same fighting power as Shi Yi and the Ten-Crown King who are both in the Immortal King Realm).

characters.title: Little Heavenly King
characters.introText: Little Sky King or Little Heavenly King is a first generation genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths that is describe as the number one genius of the  Immortal Academy. Though short in stature hence the title little but his power and talent swept away all in the same realm at the academy, never lost a battle why the Sky or heavenly king came about. He was from  a True Immortal or Rather Long life family.
characters.history:
Little Sky King or Little Heavenly King is a first generation genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths that is describe as the number one genius of the  Immortal Academy. Though short in stature hence the title little but his power and talent swept away all in the same realm at the academy, never lost a battle why the Sky or heavenly king came about. He was from  a True Immortal or Rather Long life family.

He was first mention by one of his followers inside Realm Tomb. Shi Hao and his fellow mates entered realm tomb to look for Immortal Seeds in order to breakthrough into the Void Dao Realm. Shi Hao was attacked out of nowhere by someone from Immortal Academy wearing the Immortal Azure Armor dub little sky armor, after Shi Hao defeated him and took the armor as spoils of war, he was threaten to return the armor or else, taking something that belong to little sky is courting death.

After the crew return from realm tomb Little Sky King appeared, respected for his stregth from all the student from his academy and even some of the Elders, he had a few back and forth words with Shi Hao which eventually became a challenge. He had recently broken through to the Void Dao realm and his foundation with the Prefect Immortal Seed did not yet stabilize, though Shi Hao  was one realm below him, still in the Heavenly Deity realm he wanted to still fight and suggest the god arena which suppress all who entered cultivation equally. Little Sky King refuse saying Shi Hao is still not his opponent and called Yu Wudi, someone who had the same potential and wasn't weaker than he was at the Heavenly deity level.

During the Desolate boarder war, he was only shown fighting once and that was the all out battle against the king clans from the Foreign Land of which he had little choice. It was implied that he wasn't confident  enough, as he never once took the initiative when a challenge is given,  as the so called strongest he seems  very scared or timid. To be fair he just wanted to live as every one vs one battle, their side got slaughtered, always on the loosing end.  As time goes on  Shi Hao slaughtered out a reputation and became famous a pride of the Nine heavens Ten Earth, they all slowly became friends and after Shi Hao decided to head back down to the lower realms he gave back the Armor to the Little Sky King but he reject and gave it to him as a going away present.

During the final battle versus the fallen immortal, now being a powerful True Immortal he fought with pride but was killed like the others.

characters.title: Little Pagoda
characters.introText: When he met Shi Hao in the Eight Regions (Lower Realm), only the 4-story tower was left, which became Shi Hao's big killer weapon. He used Shi Hao to transfer the cause and effect to obtain heavenly materials and earthly treasures to repair himself.
characters.history:
When he met Shi Hao in the Eight Regions (Lower Realm), only the 4-story tower was left, which became Shi Hao's big killer weapon. He used Shi Hao to transfer the cause and effect to obtain heavenly materials and earthly treasures to repair himself.

Later, he and Liu Shen fought against the leader of the upper realm in the lower realm. Successfully recaptured the 2-story tower and turned it into a 6-story tower.

Later, he and Liu Shen entered the primitive gate and reached the dark place deep in the boundary sea. They were defeated by the Dark Half-Immortal Emperor. The nameless Half-Immortal Emperor died in the Emperor's Fall Era. Under the protection of fire, he persisted until Shi Hao became the Half-immortal Emperor and came to the depths of the boundary sea. With the help of Shi Hao's power, he restored the nine-story tower and integrated it with the bones of the nameless Half-immortal emperor.

The tower became 10-story and its strength reached the Half-immortal level. In the realm of the Immortal Emperor, he and Liu Shen made sacrifices to help Shi Hao, the Emperor of Desolate Heaven.

In the Holy Ruins, he was resurrected. In the final battle, he became a bone tower that was infinitely close to the Immortal Emperor-level weapon. He transformed into a man holding a bone tower and participated in the battle. However, the two generations of Heaven were defeated and eventually died in the battle.
characters.trivia: In the Holy Ruins extra chapter, he was resurrected.
