characters.introText: The Little Puppy, who proudly calls himself Great Virtue (大德, Dà Dé), is an ancient degenerated True Immortal from the Immortal Ancient Era. Although he appears to be nothing more than a palm-sized dog with dark red fur, he is in fact an extraordinarily powerful being with a mysterious past closely connected to the Immortal Domain and the legendary Immortal Kings. After suffering a catastrophic decline that left him in a ruined immortal state, he lost the majority of his cultivation and primordial spirit, yet retained an exceptionally powerful physical body capable of resisting attacks that would annihilate ordinary immortals.
characters.appearance:
The Little Puppy is a palm-sized dog with dense dark red fur, though his coat is occasionally described as blackish-red and, in certain circumstances, appears to have faded to an ashen white hue due to the passage of countless years. Despite his diminutive stature, he possesses an extraordinary presence that far exceeds his appearance, radiating the aura of an ancient and powerful immortal.

His large, expressive eyes are filled with vitality and intelligence, occasionally glowing with a piercing blue light when enraged. He has a pair of sharp, snow-white fangs that become particularly prominent whenever he bares his teeth, giving him a fierce and intimidating expression despite his otherwise adorable appearance. His fur is thick and lustrous, sometimes shimmering with a dark, mysterious radiance that hints at the immense power concealed within his small body.

Although he appears to be nothing more than an ordinary puppy, the Little Puppy possesses astonishing speed and agility, capable of moving faster than most cultivators can perceive. His physical body is exceptionally powerful, allowing him to withstand devastating attacks that would destroy ordinary immortals. This stark contrast between his harmless appearance and overwhelming strength often causes others to underestimate him, only to discover that he is an ancient True Immortal with an illustrious past and a cultivation foundation far beyond what his size would suggest.

characters.title: Little White
characters.introText: Little White was a scaled horse densely covered in silver scales. There were still some silver white hair on the back of his neck. He was a mutant with a horn on his head, thus also known as a unicorn.
characters.appearance: Little White was a scaled horse densely covered in silver scales. There were still some silver white hair on the back of his neck. He was a mutant with a horn on his head, thus also known as a unicorn.
characters.history:
The unicorns and the scaled horses were both descendants of the Archaic Heaven Horse, and were considered the posterity of a mythological beast. Although their blood were extremely diluted, they could still show some power.

Little White accompanied Shi Hao during his cultivation in Stone Village, and they traveled together to Stone Clan's second ancestral land to look for his parents.

Shi Hao and Huo Linger's fight in the forest attracted an Earth Dragon and caused everyone to run. Later, Little White and the others were chased by an Ancient Divine Bird, and he almost died from jumping into a river of freezing water. He was saved by Shi Hao, where he consumed a little bit of the egg that Hairy Ball stole.

characters.title: Little Wolf God
characters.introText:
Huo Ling'er's Friend, Pet and Mount. 

History[]
Little Wolf God was discovered within an Golden egg inside an ice wolf cave by Huo Ling'er and Shi Hao during their time in the shattered Mountain.
characters.history:
Little Wolf God was discovered within an Golden egg inside an ice wolf cave by Huo Ling'er and Shi Hao during their time in the shattered Mountain.

Shi Hao stole the egg from Huo Ling'er while she were asleep and tried to cook and eat the egg but it hatch instead. The little wolf god took a liking to Shi Hao and always marked his scent.

In the upper real 3000 province after Shi Hao left for immortal Ancient he made a stop by the Fire clan in Li-Fire City (Fire Country) to look for Huo Ling'er, after some ups and down he was finally able to find her whereabouts after as she were keeping a low profile from a few enemies, little wolf now older and talking was shock and excited after picking up Shi Hao scent, he ran over to Shi hao with joy, they had a grave for Shi hao as they thought he died in the lower realm.

Later during the darkness calamity, cultivation-less age and the constant invasion of the Foreign Domain, during the great battle at desolate border the Undying king Shotou broke the realm wall using a palms technique adjacent to Hand of God technique and carve out the entire 3000 province bringing it over to their side. Little wolf and Huo Ling'er became powerful darkness creatures.

They later met Shi Hao again ten thousand years later after a portal open and little wolf walk out with Huo Ling'er , both now powerful in cultivation, neither of them recognized Shi Hao as their primordial spirit was a new.

After Shi Hao became a powerful True Immortal he broke into the foreign domain and capture both little wolf and Huo Ling'er, though both had different spirits they somewhat believe Shi Hao that he knew them and they never left imperial court. After many battles Shi Hao headed to eradicate the darkness, he save their true souls returning them to their true self.

characters.title: Liu Li
characters.introText: Liuli (琉璃) is a minor antagonist in the Perfect World. She originates from Foreign Realm (异域) faction and holds the prestigious title of “Foreign Realm Supreme” (异域至尊). She participates in large-scale invasions and world-shattering conflicts at the Desolate Border.  where the Foreign Realm forces clash with the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
characters.appearance:
Liuli has a cold, regal, and otherworldly appearance typical of high-tier immortal cultivators. She possesses long, flowing silver-white hair, often styled with delicate crystal-like hair ornaments. Her expression is calm and detached, reinforcing her aloof and superior demeanor.
She wears a layered, traditional silk gown with a high-slit design, transitioning in color from frosty white to deep sapphire blue.

The outfit is decorated with intricate silver embroidery along the sleeves, complemented by metallic leg armor beneath the flowing robes. When entering combat, a luminous astral halo appears behind her head, formed from rotating spectral blue flames and shifting ice constructs, symbolizing her overwhelming cultivation pressure and elemental mastery.

characters.introText: Liu Shen or Willow Deity is a Immortal King Supreme Giant from the Age of Emperor Collapse and later became an Half-Immortal Emperor, she's also the Protector of the Ancient Stone Village. The Willow Deity had descended into Stone Village while being struck by tens of thousands of streaks of lightning, and kicked the old guardian spirit out. Its entire body was scorched black, and it seemed like it was on the verge of death. Only after more than ten years did a single branch grow again.
characters.appearance:
In the novel Willow deity is cast as a man who was in disguise, she only revealed her female form in later chapters.

Willow Deity is proficient in all of Immortal Ancient’s methods, able to display them all at will. She used the Six Dao Reincarnation method against Feather Emperor

Shi Hao got revenge for her by slaughtering Aocheng Immortal King, Taishi Immortal King and Yuanchu Immortal King after he himself became an Immortal King.

Shi Hao and Liu Shen never had a physical or emotional type of relationship that would lead to any form of intimate relations, their interactions had always been disciple and master relationship. Please keep in mind not even Shi Hao knew she was female in the novel.

She hasn't truly stepped into Half-Immortal Emperor realm during the fight against those three darkness half-immortal emperors. It was that chaotic-like flame (previously the flame of a fallen Half-Immortal Emperor from the Age of Emperor Collapse, also the only person before Shi Hao who left his footprints on the dam realm) that merged with her and the small pagoda, giving her the strength to fight Feather Emperor together with the pagoda. Finally, she was able to heavily injure the enemy with her sacrifice, allowing Shi Hao to deal more permanent damage towards Feather Emperor.

In Sacred Ruins Ch. 1658, she was initially nurtured in Huang's Lightning Pool so that she can obtain a new life and surpass her previous peak strength. But the battle was too tragic, so she had to come and separate herself from the pool. Afterwards, she took initiative to transform herself into dao, killing an immortal emperor from strange plateau/vile earth! In addition, Ye Qingxian who were nurtured in Ye Fan's Myriad Qi Cauldron also died in a similar way.
characters.history:
It was hinted that she might have been at the Heavenly Deity realm at the beginning then breaks through to Void Dao. She became like a teacher at first to Shi Hao guiding his cultivation and directing him in the art of the primordial record technique,  later on in the upper realm she officially proclaimed Shi Hao her disciple. Willow deity being from ancient times  knows a lot! also speaks of divine beings like Tao-wu, Vermilion Bird, and Taotie without reverence like its normal.

An altar had been built in the middle of Stone Village. It swirled with golden luster. It was clearly made out of jade, yet it looked like it was made of metal. This was created by the Willow Deity, with the greatest quality materials. It also had carved engravings on it, so one could vaguely sense chaotic energy seeping out from it. When this altar emerged, this entire world seemed to be a bit different.

The altar was a formation that could not only protect Stone Village, but also serve as a giant transport formation. As long as one knew the coordinates, it could send one far from the village.

This was another layer of strengthening on top of the divine formation that was laid before!

Time moves forward and willow deity cultivation returning slowly she was hinted now to be around the Void Dao realm but still in her original tree form. Shi Hao now the emperor of the Stone Clan had his responsibility of protecting the clan, the upper realm masters came down to look for the Supreme Hall inheritance  and a battle took place, Willow Deity sensing the chaos decided to transform into her human form  revealing that appearance for the first time.

She would help calm the chaos at the Divine Medicine Sect Capital, medicine valley where the First Spirit Root were been fought over by a few masters from the Three Thousand Provinces and the Double Pupils Woman who was accompanied by the Paper boat mask lady aka the Ruthless Empress embodiment Imprint from shrouding the heavens. She then help push back embodiment projections at the Immortal Mountain where a few big names appeared such as Immortal Qin, Condensation Sect elders etc, after the Undying Being under the Five Phase Mountain were release by Shi Hao and Little Pagoda.

She would later enter a secret realm with Pagoda and the undying being to search for opportunities after the gold crow clan small world had opened. Shi Hao would returned to the stone village after she returned an during their conversion of the upper realm, some of her past were revealed, it were stated that she shad spent time at three thousand worlds and they all worshiped her as a god, she also stated in ancient times she entered the primordial gate through life and death back then. she would end the conversation by letting Shi Hao knows she would be leaving for the upper realm soon but she would first help protect the lower realm from the incoming final treasure hunt wave  before she leaves.

During the Lower realm final battle it was hinted that she were now in the Self-Severing or Self-Release possible at the peak due to her dominance while fighting against the Ying Yang master, immortal Qin, and the owners of the Immortal king without end damage bell and Immortal King reincarnation damage single disk.

Willow deity been around for a very long time since the Age of Emperor Collapse so she has left a lot of legendary feat behind in many worlds one of which includes  Immortal Ancient, she were worshiped by the natives as the guardian spirit as their protectors, her old imprint before rebirth were still present at their clans altar. After immortal ancient forcefully ended, Shi Hao were surrounded by many clan elders in the Self-Severing, Self-Release and one of  Immortal Palace Supreme Being old monster, Her imprint from immortal ancient natives reappears to protect Shi Hao, along side Qi Daolin, Undying Being, Peacock clan, etc, she would let it be known that should anyone bully her disciple she would annihilate them in the future.  She would use the last of her power to activate a powerful technique before her imprint dissipate allowing Shi Hao to see a corner of his future.

Another imprint of hers were again later found on the path leading to the dam in the mysterious desert region where all the tribulation lighting were now gathered and the footprints of the Half-Immortal Emperor from the age of emperor collapse could be found. Her imprint would protect Shi Hao,Shen Ming, San Zang on their path back from Immortal Domain.

Shi Hao breaking the record of becoming a Supreme Being under five hundred years would be permitted to enter Immortal domain  by invitation signed  by Pan King and AoCheng king to take part in the gathering of the immortal peach battle within in one thousand year. Shi Hao would learn the truth of williow deity downfall back then,  it was Aocheng Immortal King, Taishi Immortal King and Yuanchu Immortal King who were involved in the lightning  strike that struck down willow deity having her undergoing rebirth and eventually ended up in the lower realms stone village.

During the last battle with the masters of the upper realm, Willow Deity would Leave the lower realms and stone village through the primordial gate and enter Realm Sea  a path that  leads into the land of darkness, a fools errand countless immortal flocks towards in search of the almost impossible feat of breaking into the emperor realm. she was never heard from again and almost one million year went by with Shi Hao always wondering if they would meet again someday, it was not until Shi Hao became a powerful Immortal King giant and enter Realm sea when he randomly came across her body in tree form on an island, pitch black and corroded by the darkness, her original primordial spirit was gone. Dark Willow Deity attacked Shi Hao while asking for his identify, Shi Hao reply by saying her student and family member.

When Willow deity decided to abandon her body and slaughter her way into the darkness final destination with her primordial spirit using the guidance ancient palace as it would've taken millions of years to reach that location traveling at immortal king current pace. Being that she's the one who decided her own path she made preparation for her abandon body, she left an memory imprint for her new darkness primordial spirit, (FYI: Once a body is corroded by darkness their original spirit would be taken prisoner into guidance palace and their empty body shell nourished by the darkness and form a new spirit exactly like the previous excluding any memories of the previous self. With the memory imprint she would remembers Shi Hao and returned with him to imperial court in immortal domain. When they returned many of the immortal kings were skeptical after seeing the darkness Willow deity, all doubt were dropped after her battle a few days later against the fallen immortals.

The Dark willow  Deity would stay by Shi Hao side for many hundred of thousand of years fighting with him and the imperial court throughout the chaotic time, she even follow him into the depth of immortal domain unmanned region to save Qin Hao and fight the nine headed monster who was the source of  the long life calamity with Immortal Qin, Immortal Mu and Immortal Wang.

When Shi Hao was fighting Grand Emperor, Gray Emperor, and Feather Emperor in Land of Darkness, the  dormant Chaotic Flame inside his body was used to revive Willow Deity (That flame originally belonged to the Half-Immortal Emperor from the age of emperor collapse who left the footprint inside the sand leading towards the dam in realm sea, he were killed by the three half immortal emperor mention. She sacrificed her original primordial spirit and body during her fight with the darkness feather emperor to critically injure him, Shi Hao teleports her dead charred stump, Huo Ling'er, and Great Elder to a new world temporarily. Later during the final war of the fallen immortal against the non fallen  at Realm Sea, Darkness Willow Deity, and her new Primordial Spirit were surrounded and killed by many fallen immortal Kings.

Shi Hao Kept the dead charred stump in hopes of reviving her. Shi Hao cultivated further and entered a dark hole realm that leads to a new higher realm and after coming back he revived many of his dead friends. Willow Deity's charred stump produced bits of greenery, which shows her revival was positive. She would follow Shi Hao and Huo Ling'er into the new higher realm.

characters.introText: Long Que, a first generation genius of the Vermilion Dragon Clan. Her clan has a mixture of a dragon and Vermilion blood in their veins whether its a True Vermilion and dragon is unknown.
characters.history:
Long Que, a first generation genius of the Vermilion Dragon Clan. Her clan has a mixture of a dragon and Vermilion blood in their veins whether its a True Vermilion and dragon is unknown.

Like many of the Immortal Palace servants she was loyal and proud of being associated with the sect knowing that they have powerful Supreme Being experts and a backing of the Immortal palace ancestor the Ruined True Immortal. Not many were their opponent in the 3000 provinces and seen throughout the series clans were happy to become loyal servant if their masters were powerful.

characters.introText: Princess Lu Hong is a first generation genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths that is describe as one the the top beauties. She has an unmatched ancient seed within her, known as the Life Seed. She's from the Lu Clan Family a True Immortal or rather Long life family. They weren’t a human clan, speculated to be some sort of plants clan but had humanoid forms, no one knowing exactly what their original forms were, just that they possessed overflowing magical force, their divine might able to oppress the world!.
characters.history:
Princess Lu Hong is a first generation genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths that is describe as one the the top beauties. She has an unmatched ancient seed within her, known as the Life Seed. She's from the Lu Clan Family a True Immortal or rather Long life family. They weren’t a human clan, speculated to be some sort of plants clan but had humanoid forms, no one knowing exactly what their original forms were, just that they possessed overflowing magical force, their divine might able to oppress the world!.

An elder from Immortal Academy personally stated that in the era of divine dao, she could perhaps claim the title of being Lord of Life, imperishable through endless generations. She was destine to become an True Immortal even if it was the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths incomplete Dao law, with her abundant of life force from her immortal life seed she could be the first to break through under such condition in the future.

She was describe as extremely beautiful. She had a head of green hair, her skin snow-white, her eyes extremely large, full of spirituality. Her pupils were deep green, as if she was a spirit that emerged from the most primitive mountain forest depths. Her dress extremely long, dragging on the ground, her figure swaying about, She was astonishingly beautiful, and also full of spirituality, even more so having a type of unimaginably rich life force, as if a boundless source of life accompanied her.

Lu Hong made her first appearance at the Heavenly horn ant cave after her seclusion and took part in the test for lifting the horn ant  cauldron, she failed to lift it but were praise for her beauty and life seed.

During the battle at Great Scarlet Sky the younger generation from the Foreign Land and Nine Heavens and Ten Earths decided to clash and like in ancient times they used a supreme physic turtle shell previously own by Cao Yusheng master but now own by the enemy, it would randomly select opponents to fight one versus one battle, she was chosen as the first which made her family and the teachers nervous because she was suited as a supportive cultivator and  not a battle individual, she would've become instrumental in the future. Sadly her opponent was a powerful  humanoid bird clan from the other-side a clan that previously deem so terrifying that in Ancient times Immortal King Wuzhong personally slaughter his way into the other side so that he could destroy the clan, he almost completely wipe them out. Lu Hong was killed horrible and her immortal seed taken.

characters.title: Lu Tuo
characters.introText: Lu Tuo is described as having striking green hair that scatters down his shoulders. He possesses an extremely handsome appearance, with a refined figure. He is typically depicted as being surrounded by primal chaos, often seated motionless in cultivation on a dao platform that floats in the air, giving him an extraordinary and holy aura.
characters.appearance: Lu Tuo is described as having striking green hair that scatters down his shoulders. He possesses an extremely handsome appearance, with a refined figure. He is typically depicted as being surrounded by primal chaos, often seated motionless in cultivation on a dao platform that floats in the air, giving him an extraordinary and holy aura.
characters.personality:
Lu Tuo embodies an arrogant and dismissive demeanor, particularly towards those he perceives as weaker, such as Shi Hao (Huang) before his significant breakthroughs. He is supremely confident in his own abilities, with many believing him to be "impossible to defeat". In battles, he is portrayed as valiant and decisive. His mere presence is imposing; a "cold snort" from him is capable of silencing a noisy crowd, affecting their minds like thunder and causing physical pain and staggering. He displays a clear sense of superiority stemming from his ancient origins and formidable cultivation.

He is exceptionally proud and can be dismissive of those he deems lesser. His authoritative and arrogant nature is established early on through the words of his peers, with one cultivator quoting his judgment on the protagonist, Huang:
characters.history: Lu Tuo holds a highly respected position as a core disciple within the Heavenly Deity Institution. This status allows him to select followers, a process that draws large crowds of cultivators eager to learn from such a powerful being. During one such selection, he successfully acquires an imperial lady from a well-known ancient country as a follower. His authority is clearly demonstrated when he silences the commotion of the crowd with a mere "cold snort" after someone questions if his follower is to become a concubine.

infobox.Title: Lu Yi
infobox.realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText: Lu Yi is a cultivator from the Three Thousand Provinces and a merchant residence in Radiant City. Most cultivators that enters Immortal Ancient are strong enough to fight, risking their lives for natural luck but there are those like Lu Yi who understand their strengths and weaknesses and took caution by strictly entering and becoming a merchant, this way they have similar opportunity to gain natural luck by buying, selling and exchanging treasures and medicine via barter system mostly. This path give the weaker cultivator hope to keep their lives while gaining and taking less risk... after all Radiant city has a policy against violence and it rarely take place. This rule were set by the natives, though Shi Hao was brave enough to break those rules.

Most cultivators that enters Immortal Ancient are strong enough to fight, risking their lives for natural luck but there are those like Lu Yi who understand their strengths and weaknesses and took caution by strictly entering and becoming a merchant, this way they have similar opportunity to gain natural luck by buying, selling and exchanging treasures and medicine via barter system mostly. Lu Yi along with Luo Dao and Lan Yichen will accompany Shi Hao for a while mainly for protection, in return they provide knowledge etc. During their travels they had many up and downs including an island with many divine medicines where they were almost killed by Exiled Immortal Black Divine Bugs and Divine demons beast, they also watch the fight between the Three Stone Brothers and Ning Chuan etc.

After Immortal Ancient and hundred of thousand of years later while Shi Hao returned to a ruined Three Thousand Provinces, while thinking back to some of the past cultivators he met, he had wonder what had happen to Lan Yichen, Luo Dao and Lu Yi as he never had the chance to run into them again. Were they among some of the lucky few who fled to a star system during the calamity or perish.

characters.title: Luo Dao

infobox.Title: Luo Dao
infobox.CauseOfDeath: Problably die of Old Age During Dharma End Age.
infobox.realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText: His body was swirling with holy radiance, sharp eyebrows and bright eyes resting on his face. He possessed extraordinary divine heroicness, his stature wasn’t all that tall, but he had a heroic air around him. His expression was calm, not showing any fear. He didn’t seem to attach much importance to the opponent in front of him.
characters.appearance: His body was swirling with holy radiance, sharp eyebrows and bright eyes resting on his face. He possessed extraordinary divine heroicness, his stature wasn’t all that tall, but he had a heroic air around him. His expression was calm, not showing any fear. He didn’t seem to attach much importance to the opponent in front of him.
characters.history:
Luo Dao, hailing from the Scarlet Province, wields the Sparrow Bone Sword, whose glow is said to reflect his extraordinary talent. When the blade gleams, nothing can withstand its power. He has even slain a True God in the Venerable Realm.

An exceptional talent, with significant battlefield successes, who has dominated various provinces to the point of becoming a deity. Undoubtedly, one of the most dangerous beings in the current landscape of Immortal Ancient.

Luo Dao and Lan Yichen decided to attempt to steal the Void Sky Divine Vine from Shi Hao after he destroyed the formations protecting the divine medicine. When Hong Huang recounted the story of these two geniuses to Shi Hao, the latter, in a provocative tone, commented that he was facing individuals who must be among the top ten thousand experts of the Immortal Ancient. This assertion was bold, considering that Luo Dao and Lan Yichen were the greatest talents in their region, and it was expected that Shi Hao would consider them among the top three thousand experts of the Immortal Ancient.

Luo Dao proposed to Shi Hao and Hong Huang to kneel and serve them to spare their lives, but Lan Yichen disagreed with this proposal, reluctant to carry burdens. Their confidence was fueled by their assurance in their own strength, which made them behave arrogantly as they tried to steal others' opportunities. Their confidence was not unfounded, as they truly had the power to justify it.

Shi Hao looked at them with a calm expression, neither despising them nor showing fear, simply treating them with a normal expression. He advanced step by step to face his enemy head-on! He had already become a deity and, as such, had the confidence needed to defeat all enemies. Luo Dao noticed that Shi Hao's transition to the divine flame was not yet complete, and they believed he was a formation master, so if he wanted to activate one, they wouldn't give him the time. But after just one strike from Shi Hao, they realized that they were actually facing an exceptional talent who was no weaker than them. They had made a judgment error.

Shi Hao did not use the Magic Power Immunity ability. Now he could control it even better, choosing whether to activate it or not. He wanted to confront his enemies head-on to defeat them.

Luo Dao's eyes were deep, producing two streaks of light as they stared at Shi Hao. He knew that this time things would be extremely problematic. He had not encountered just anyone, but an exceptional talent. Lan Yichen joined the fray, but it was all in vain; the strength of the young man they had challenged was overwhelming.

Luo Dao decided to employ his closely guarded secret skill, leading others to believe his innate ability was the sparrow bone sword. However, this was deliberately orchestrated to conceal the true source of his power; his genuine innate ability resided in his hair. These hair strands could transform into weapons, wrapping around Shi Hao's arm until they pierced his flesh, draining his divine strength. However, Shi Hao countered by using  the power of reincarnation to accelerate Luo Dao's aging and weaken his hair. Ultimately, Luo Dao fell to the ground as his hair separated from Shi Hao's arm.

At that moment, Shi Hao presented Luo Dao and Lan Yichen with a dramatic choice: accept to become his servants or face death. The two warriors were torn, aware that refusing would mean the end of their lives, but accepting would compromise the honor of their respective sects. While Luo Dao desperately attempted to flee, achieving little success, Lan Yichen prepared to face the attack with dignity, activating his precious technique. With determination, Lan Yichen unleashed a series of divine blades, unleashing a blue-golden light that struck Shi Hao violently. These blades, formed from the essence of gold, emitted a metallic homicidal aura and could transform into various weapons. However, surprise and desperation struck Lan Yichen when the powerful divine blades were all destroyed by Shi Hao's simple touch. Retreating in the face of this overwhelming superiority, Lan Yichen roared, and suddenly, a molten metallic liquid began to flow from his mouth. With a gesture, he summoned metal from the mountains and rivers, causing it to emerge from the earth beneath their feet. The blood-red magma transformed into an infinity of weapons of all kinds, covering the sky and the earth, creating a scene akin to a sea of weapons, a sky brimming with scorching metal.

The metallic element of the world seemed to bend to his command, incessantly creating bone blades that transformed into weapons to annihilate the enemy. It seemed that there was no end to his supply. The world itself transformed into his army of swords, with endless metal flowing everywhere, generating a lethal energy that filled the skies. Shi Hao watched in awe, recognizing the power of these techniques.

Nevertheless, he did not succumb to fear. Every time he grasped such an element, the liquid metal sprayed in all directions, but it failed to harm his body. He appeared as an indomitable hero, an immortal warrior descended into this world. Meanwhile, Lan Yichen merged with the molten metal, camouflaging himself and moving in the shadows. Although he was outmatched, he still hoped to escape. Shi Hao countered by using the lightning technique against the molten liquid, and the metallic clang echoed in the air, shattering stones and putting everyone to the test.

As the two battled in the sky, ripples formed and spread, reaching the distant peaks of the mountains and causing them to explode. Lan Yichen was struck by an intense flash, crashing to the ground near Luo Dao.

Shi Hao asked once again to choose between being killed or becoming his servants. Lan Yichen asked who the person who had just crushed them really was, and upon hearing the answer, they agreed to be subdued.

“Huang, sinner’s blood descendent, Shi Hao.”

Shi Hao spoke out the three identities at the same time.
Lan Yichen’s body was immediately shaken, looking at him with complete shock. He muttered,

“I knew it… ended up kicking a metal plate.”

Without saying anything else, just the Huang identity was enough to make him sigh. When the Lightning Emperor precious technique was displayed, it would completely suppress him.

Shi Hao used the Seed Formation Technique to subdue them and make them his slave.

Shi Hao sent Lan Yichen ahead to retrieve the Void Sky Divine Vine, but he was cut in half. Fortunately, having a metal body, he survived, albeit consuming a great deal of divine energy.

Meanwhile, Luo Dao and Lan Yichen were sent on a medicinal herb hunt while Shi Hao was in isolation to advance in the divine flame. They managed to obtain Octadic Treasure Qilin but were pursued by major forces of the Immortal Ancient, who attempted to steal their treasure.

Immortal Emperor Shi Hao went to the past and paid him and Lan Yichen a last  Visit from  Afar at the End of Novel. He had kept memories and mentioned them several times

characters.title: Luo Mo
characters.introText: Known as the Unmatched ancient ancestor Luo Mo Great One!  was a powerful Undying Being from the Foreign Realm during the Immortal Ancient Era that had a colossal battle with Immortal Female Ghost and others but died during that battle leaving only a remnant soul within a seal small world at the entrance of the Great Scarlet Heaven. This was an unmatched ancient ancestor, one who wouldn’t be weaker than the An Lanor Shutuo!
characters.history:
Known as the Unmatched ancient ancestor Luo Mo Great One!  was a powerful Undying Being from the Foreign Realm during the Immortal Ancient Era that had a colossal battle with Immortal Female Ghost and others but died during that battle leaving only a remnant soul within a seal small world at the entrance of the Great Scarlet Heaven. This was an unmatched ancient ancestor, one who wouldn’t be weaker than the An Lanor Shutuo!

The foreign Realm individuals would gather at the abyss entrance of the Great scarlet Heaven and while using the Immortal Smelting Pot  and a altar as a medium to  gather weaker heroic spirit in order summon a more powerful Remnant Heroic Spirit

[FYI]- Heroic Spirits there were some creatures that were just too powerful. Even though they were killed, they could still leave behind some imprints. They were nurtured by yin energy from the battlefield, difficult for them to be directly wiped out, with that being said even if everything was gathered, they would still scatter, to the extent where they would be directly erased, no way they could still revive Once one died, they would forever be dead.

During the Summoning Meng Tianzheng notice that this particular Heroic spirit was different, this heroic spirit was actually sacred, its soul flame pure. Meng Tianzheng even question whether it could be revived?. One had to understand that normal heroic spirits were covered in yin energy. This heroic spirit not only had yang power, it was too sacred, something that had never been seen before!.

On the altar, a damaged eyeball had unknowingly when appeared. It had long dried up, lacking life force, in complete tatters  However, at this moment, following the sacred soul flame’s return, that withered and damaged eyeball actually moved, and then it produced radiance , moreover enlarging, floating above the black abyss. it actually reached several thousand zhang tall, grand like a great peak. This was previously an unmatched existence, yet now, only a ruined eyeball and some soul fragments remained. It lacked fighting strength, only possessing the aura of the past. Despite this being the case, that aura was still astonishing, as if an unmatched ancient ancestor was reborn!.

The Foreign Realm Elders would as him about the past secrets that needed to be known before they invade the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, he replied There is no way to explain it clearly. I believe Anlan and Shutuo have already deduced that there is a sealed ancient realm here, an unstable node that could perhaps be opened up today. You all should just enter and search for everything from the past yourselves. The fact that I am awakened signifies that true disappearance is near.” Luo Mo said.

Before using his last strength to open the  sealed small world he asked, Are my descendants well?” an Elder reply, they are all doing well, still one of the most powerful clans of the world, never declining, always protected and assisted by Ancestor Shutuo. His descendants being protected and assisted, could also be understood as being looked down on and intimidated or suppressed. After using its last strength to show the path the eyeball crack apart for ever disappearing such was the ending of a fomer giant from the Foreign Realm.

characters.title: Manzhu Shahua

infobox.Realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText: The Celestial Clan, in order to bring Shi Hao to their side, decides to offer him in marriage to one of Manzhu Shahua and Fu Qu, on the condition that he manages to lift the Flying Immortal Stone. Shi Hao, however, discerns the clan's intentions and decides to defy them, issuing a challenge: he claims that if he succeeds in the task, he wishes to marry both women. Despite their complaints, the women agree, aware of the difficulty of the task, but warn him that failure would mean his immediate departure from the Celestial Clan. In reality, Shi Hao has no intention of marrying both women and plans to feign failure in the task as an excuse to leave the Celestial Clan.

characters.title: Mao Qiu
characters.introText: Shi Hao had always carried Mao Qiu with him since he was seven years old, and the two of them would grab bird eggs and steal the ancestor's elixir together. Although Mao Qiu didn't want to recall these past events after regaining his memory, he still regarded Shi Hao as a good brother. Not only did he pass on the precious skills of Zhuyan's lineage to Shi Hao, but he also later became the patron saint of Stone Village.
characters.appearance:
The Zhuyan was one of the four beasts that fought for the Mountain Treasure. He was heavily injured from the battle. Shi Hao found him trapped in a lake that had dried up. He seemed to be starving. When Shi Hao gave him some dried meat, he devoured voraciously. Shi Hao named him Mao Qiu (hair ball) due to his furry appearance.

After Shi Hao used a technique that used the Bone Text to investigate the status of his opponent, he discovered that Mao Qiu had suffered a serious injury. The symbols inside Mao Qiu were destroyed, and his prints were destroyed too.

After Mao Qiu turned into his current appearance, Shi Hao fed him some more. Confirming that he was not dangerous, Shi Hao took him back home to the Stone Village. Arriving in the village, village chief Shi Yunfeng observed him for a while stated that Mao Qiu was not an ordinary monkey.

The village chief said that an ancient legend spoke of a cruel and unequaled beast called Zhuyan. It had the shape of a monkey with scarlet feet and white head. His appearance predicted which place would end in chaos.

But after seeing that he seemed harmless and had suffered a serious injury, Shi Yunfeng allowed Mao Qiu to settle down in the village with Shi Hao. They fed him and he eventually became accepted by all of the villagers as one of them.

Shi Hao and Mao Qiu's journey started from the Hundred Shattered Mountains, to where he later became the Emperor of the Stone Country. The most important thing around him was natural materials and treasures. As a foodie, Mao Qiu naturally gained a lot of glory by following Shi Hao. Because of this, its injuries have gradually improved over the years, and the runes that were obliterated back then slowly emerged. In the end, Liu Shen personally healed it, and Mao Qiu completely recovered to its peak state, with a little bit of divine fire even lingering around his body. Not long after that, Mao Qiu successfully ignited the divine fire, and his combat power was even better than before.

As one of the Ten Evil Treasures, the Kunpeng Technique contains supreme secrets and is not weaker than the Immortal King-level treasures. Shi Hao once passed the Kunpeng Technique to Liu Shen. After Liu Shen thought about it, he couldn't help but admire it again and again. Later, Shi Hao wanted to obtain the seventy-two transformations and the three heads and six arms of the Zhu Yan clan. This was the core method of the Zhu Yan clan. In order to prevent Mao Qiu from feeling disadvantaged, Shi Hao exchanged part of the Kunpeng method with Mao Qiu.
The Kunpeng Technique emphasizes the interplay of yin and yang. Mao Qiu followed the path of being tough and courageous, and finally got the masculine part of the Kunpeng Technique from Shi Hao.

After returning to the lower realm, Shi Hao obtained the Eighty-nine Heavenly Skills from the Lord of the Forbidden Zone, which is a peerless skill of the lineage of the Hunshi Demon Ape. In fact, strictly speaking, the Eight-Nine Heavenly Skills were created by the ancestors of the lineage of the Hunshi Demon Ape, and Zhu Yan shared the same ancestor with the Hunshi Demon Ape, so the one most suitable for the Eighty-nine Heavenly Skills was Mao Qiu. At this time, Mao Qiu almost scratched his head trying to learn the Six Paths of Reincarnation, but he still couldn't comprehend it. As a result, after Shi Hao passed on the Eighty-nine Heavenly Skills to it, this technique was simply prepared for it. Not long after, a golden violent ape stood tall in the wilderness, and Mao Qiuu took this technique to a higher level.

In the cruel Age of Dharma Ending, not to mention the harsh environment of monasticism, ordinary monks only have a few thousand years to live. It is extremely difficult to become a supreme being in such a short period of time, let alone become an immortal.Mao Qiuu struggled to survive in such an environment. During this period, he relied on Shi Hao's blood to renew his life, but in the end he failed to become the Supreme. When the Mao Qiu was about to die of old age, Shi Hao used the divine source liquid to seal its vitality.
Until he later became the Immortal Emperor, Shi Hao used the essence of the Immortal Emperor's blood to extend the lives of everyone in Stone Village, including Mao Qiu. The fruit produced by King Pan could already make people become immortals instantly, and Mao Qiu was baptized by the Immortal Emperor's blood. , longevity is naturally a no-brainer.

He stole an egg from a descendant of an Ancient Divine Bird and he, Little White and Shi Hao were pursued by the huge bird and almost dying after jumping into a river with freezing waters.

characters.introText: Master Gui was a ghost that had tormented Shi Hao for a long time.
characters.history:
Master Gui's original name was Wu Tianchong, He was the founder of the Heaven Mending Pavilion in the Eight Regions(Lower Realm). He was not a person from the lower realm, but a disciple of the Heaven Mending Sect in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths(Upper Realm). With the emergence of numerous talents in the golden age of the world, he could also be regarded as a supreme genius.

He was originally extremely prosperous, but because he fell in love with the goddess of heaven, he became an abandoned disciple of the sect. In order to make up for the mistakes in his heart, Master Gui came to the lower world.

Afterwards, Heaven Mending Pavilion was founded. Master Gui never imagined that he would be betrayed by the Goddess Tian Yi, who would join forces with an assassin to kill him in the lower realm.

characters.introText: Jin Taijun (金太君) was one of the most powerful Supreme Realm experts of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths  and the ancient ancestor of the Long Life Jin Family of Yu Yu Heaven. Having lived through multiple epochs, she stood among the oldest and most influential figures of her generation, possessing immense prestige and serving as one of the pillars of the Long Life Families. She cultivated the Vajra Immortal Heavenly Art, inherited the Jin Family's ancient longevity techniques, and was instrumental in maintaining her clan's status as one of the foremost aristocratic families in the Nine Heavens.
characters.appearance: Jin Taijun was an elderly woman with silver-white hair, reflecting the immense age she had accumulated over several epochs. Despite her advanced years, she carried herself with the dignity and imposing aura befitting the ancient ancestor of a Long Life Family. Her gaze was cold and authoritative, while her presence alone was enough to pressure ordinary cultivators and even many experts. She typically wore luxurious golden robes that symbolized the Jin Family's wealth, prestige, and ancient heritage, giving her the appearance of a noble matriarch whose authority had remained unquestioned for countless year
characters.personality:
Jin Taijun was calculating, pragmatic, and fiercely protective of her family's interests. Having survived for multiple epochs, she viewed the rise and fall of factions with detached realism, believing that preserving the Jin Family was more important than defending abstract ideals or sacrificing for the greater good. This conviction caused her to place political expediency above morality, often justifying controversial decisions as necessary for her clan's continued survival.

She possessed the pride and arrogance common among the ancient ancestors of the Long Life Families, regarding herself as one of the rulers of the Nine Heavens. Accustomed to commanding respect, she rarely tolerated opposition and frequently attempted to influence major decisions through her prestige and authority. Even when confronted by s Meng Tianzheng, she remained unwilling to admit fault or abandon her own interests.

As the war with the Foreign Realm worsened, Jin Taijun's pragmatism gradually descended into opportunism. Rather than placing her faith in the younger generation or the future of the Nine Heavens, she sought compromise and self-preservation, believing that sacrificing individuals such Shi Hao was an acceptable price to secure temporary peace and preserve her clan's legacy. Her willingness to cooperate with the Darkness Creatures and betray her own world ultimately revealed the extent to which her fear of the Jin Family's destruction had eclipsed her responsibilities as one of the Nine Heavens' foremost guardians.
characters.history:
Jin Taijun (金太君) was the ancient ancestor and supreme leader of the Long Life Jin Family, one of the most prestigious immortal lineages of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. The Jin Family traced its origins back to the Immortal Domain, inheriting ancient longevity techniques, vast wealth, divine treasures, and countless generations of accumulated heritage. Having attained the Supreme Realm long before the Archaic Era, Jin Taijun survived through multiple epochs and became one of the oldest and most powerful cultivators in existence. During her prime, her might illuminated an entire era, and she was regarded as one of the pillars responsible for safeguarding the Nine Heavens.

Throughout her long life, Jin Taijun devoted herself to preserving the prosperity and influence of the Jin Family. Under her leadership, the family remained one of the foremost Long Life Families, possessing immense political influence and maintaining close ties with other ancient clans, most notably the Wang Family through marriage alliances. Among the younger generation, she placed great hopes on her descendant Jin Zhan, believing he would carry the Jin Family to even greater heights.

As war with the Foreign Realm intensified, however, Jin Taijun increasingly placed the interests of her own family above those of the Nine Heavens. When the Five Dragons of the Wang Family committed serious offenses by disrupting the war effort and humiliating veterans of the Immortal Ancient Era, she personally intervened to protect them, fearing that punishment would weaken both the Wang and Jin Families. Her willingness to place family alliances above military discipline revealed the extent to which political self-interest had come to dominate her decisions.

Following the rise of Shi Hao, Jin Taijun viewed him less as the greatest hope of the Nine Heavens than as a political liability and threat. When the Foreign Realm demanded Shi Hao's surrender in exchange for temporary peace, she became one of the principal advocates for sacrificing him, believing that surrendering a single individual was a reasonable price to preserve the Jin Family and delay the destruction of the Nine Heavens. Exploiting Shi Hao's sense of responsibility, she supported a plan to send him into the Foreign Realm under the pretense of pursuing a diplomatic solution, despite knowing the mission was almost certainly fatal.

Her actions provoked the fury of Meng Tianzheng, who regarded the decision as a betrayal of the Nine Heavens and one of its greatest heroes. Upon learning the truth after emerging from seclusion, Meng Tianzheng publicly humiliated and injured Jin Taijun, exposing her selfish motives before the assembled cultivators. Rather than reflecting on her mistakes, Jin Taijun became increasingly resentful and entrenched in her belief that preserving her clan justified any sacrifice.

As the situation of the Nine Heavens deteriorated, Jin Taijun's pragmatism evolved into outright opportunism. While publicly seeking refuge through the Immortal Domain, she secretly established ties with the Darkness Creatures, providing intelligence and assistance in hopes of ensuring the Jin Family's survival regardless of which side ultimately prevailed. In doing so, she abandoned the responsibilities expected of one of the Nine Heavens' foremost guardians and became one of the most infamous collaborators of her era.

After Shi Hao returned from the Eight Region , he uncovered and publicly exposed the Jin Family's collusion with the Darkness Creatures. The revelation shook the Nine Heavens and permanently tarnished the Jin Family's reputation. As punishment, the Immortal Domain stripped the Jin Family of its qualification to enter the Immortal Domain. Desperate to salvage what remained of her clan's standing, Jin Taijun was forced to conduct a ruthless internal purge, personally executing numerous descendants implicated in the conspiracy, including members of her direct bloodline. Despite these sacrifices, the Jin Family's prestige never recovered.

The conflict soon escalated into open warfare. Shi Hao launched an assault on the Jin Family, breaking through its ancient formations and heavily wounding Jin Taijun despite the clan's vast accumulation of defensive treasures and inheritances. During the battle, she was driven back into her ancestral grounds, covered in blood and unable to halt Shi Hao's advance, while the Jin Family itself descended into chaos.

Refusing to accept defeat, Jin Taijun later allied herself with several other Supremes, including the Feng clan Ancestor, in a final attempt to eliminate Shi Hao before he could grow even stronger. By this point, however, Shi Hao had already surpassed ordinary Supreme Realm experts. Their combined assault failed, and Jin Taijun was ultimately killed by Shi Hao, who shattered both her physical body and primordial spirit.

characters.introText: Meng Tianzheng was Shi Hao's third mentor, one of the people who planned to establish Heavenly Deity Institution, the Great Elder of Tianshen Academy, the most selfless and brave person in the Nine Heavens Tenth Earths Continent.
characters.appearance:
In the chaos of the battle, countless cultivators are fighting against the “strange race army” of eerie beings. Chu Feng himself is bloodied, fighting desperately, while figures like Li Ran and Yao Yao are also locked in combat. The battlefield is filled with corpses, blood, and despair. Even though supreme powers like Ye Tiandi and the Female Emperor intervene, their methods are limited, and the enemy’s foundation seems inexhaustible.

Amid this hopelessness, Ancestor Meng is described as covered in blood, standing among bones and ruin, his strength still astonishing but his heart filled with sorrow. He laments: “They invade our homeland, kill our disciples, stir up blood and fire and chaos. Even though we are still alive, in this lifetime we still have not solved the great calamity.” This is the voice of an elder who has fought across epochs, yet sees the same endless cycle of destruction repeating.
Meng Tianzheng writes scriptures in his own blood, burns them in the void, and cries out:

His cry is both a prayer and a desperate summons. For the first time in ages, someone dares to invoke the name of Desolate Emperor. The entire battlefield falls silent at this invocation.

Nine Dao One(Jiu Dao Yi) also shouts: “Desolate Emperor is back!” Meng Tianzheng repeats his call, his voice low and filled with grief:

And then, astonishingly, a voice answers: “I am here. I have always been here.” Though quiet, this response is heard across all heavens and worlds. Even the weird race is shocked — the one they thought gone has been present all along.

The scene then reveals Huang himself: bloodied, gravely wounded, yet still standing tall, facing three unimaginable beings — the Three Ancestors of the weird race. These beings distort time and space, backed by the phantom of three coffins that endlessly supply them power. Huang admits he has killed some of them before, but they revive through their ancestral lands. His presence confirms that he has been fighting in silence, bearing the impossible burden alone.

During his reappearance, Strange Clan Ancestors reveal Huang’s greatest act, revealed during Ancestor Meng’s desperate call, was that he once reflected the Heavens themselves. In an ancient age, both the Heavens and the Upper Realm collapsed together, and even the combined might of the supreme beings of the Upper Realm could not prevent their destruction. Yet Huang alone, through his own body and will, mirrored that era and forced reality to replay, pulling the Heavens back into existence. By imprinting the lost world onto himself, he re‑created what had been annihilated, ensuring that the cosmos continued when it should have perished. Consequently were that the strain of reflecting the Heavens drained his vitality, leaving him gravely weakened in subsequent ages and limiting his ability to intervene directly in later conflicts.He immediately retreated to the absolute darkest region beyond all worlds and has remained there ever since, fighting an unending solitary war against the Strange Progenitors to prevent them from destroying the living mirror he has become.That's why later generation couldn't finds his traces in future when they searched for him.

In the finale of the Holy Ruins, Meng Tianzheng was reflected and resurrected, and later lived in the fairyland created by Shi Hao outside the world. In the extra plot, he watched Shi Hao and Liu Shen play a chess game without saying a word, and he cultivated to the Immortal Emperor realm or higher.
characters.history:
In the battle of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths at the Imperial Pass, the Supreme Being was besieged, and a veteran immortal was forcibly sent from a Foreign Land. He could only choose to fuse the immature demon body and divine fetus to become the first person in the ancient era to achieve the status of a True Immortal; and finally succeeded in killing the veteran immortals in the foreign land, avoiding the entire Nine Heavens and Ten Lands from being enslaved and killed, and finally left the border wilderness with an ominous appearance.

When the Age of Ending Dharma came, a body that was occupied by darkness but still retained part of its soul appeared in the Nine Heavens and rescued Shi Hao from the hands of the True Immortal. Later, Yuan Shen was finally rescued by his apprentice Shi Hao in the Ultimate Ancient Land. During the battle, Shi Hao found an opportunity to exile his mentor and Huo Ling'er respectively , tearing apart the chaotic void and allowing the two to seek refuge in an unknown place.

Shi Hao became the Immortal Emperor. Then bring him back. They appear as clay bodies in the holy ruins to guard reincarnation. In the struggle for the throne of the Heavenly Emperor in the Holy Ruins, he went head-to-head with the forces of Heaven and easily defeated the Heavenly Dao Ancestor. He appeared in the two strange wars between the heavens. He was invincible in the realm of the Half-Immortal Emperor, but he was defeated by the dark forces who had the advantage of numbers and the weapons of the Immortal Emperor, and finally died in the battle.

Back then, he almost died miserably because of his failure as a human being. In the end, his body was cut off, and part of his true spirit was buried in his sidearm, the Iron-Blooded Longbow, sealed and nurtured. Inside the bow, there is flesh, blood, and even bones . If the divine fetus in the bow is born naturally, it is expected to ascend to the throne of immortality. Later, the Supreme Beings were besieged at the Imperial Pass, resulting in heavy casualties. Meng Tianzheng fused with the Divine Embryo in advance in exchange for combat power, but because of this, he was deprived of the cause and effect of becoming an immortal. After the fusion, the enemy said that he had stepped into the Immortal Realm with one foot, killing a group of enemies (slaying countless foreign Supreme Beings), and frightening the foreign powers.

Because a veteran immortal was forcibly sent to him from a foreign land, he could only choose to fuse the devil body and divine fetus to achieve the True Immortal fruit for the last battle in his life. He successfully killed the veteran immortal from the foreign land and avoided the entire nine heavens and ten places from being enslaved and killed. In the end, he carried Ominously leaving the wilderness, life and death are unknown.

When the Age of Ending Dharma came, he once appeared in the Nine Heavens and rescued Shi Hao from the hands of the True Immortal (the True Immortal was killed by him and his body was dragged away by him), but he became a dark creature and did not recognize Shi Hao. After Shi Hao established a human heaven, he detected ancient artifacts from the Burial Domain and Foreign Lands. The ancient artifacts were sacred artifacts from the Dark Land. The two ancient artifacts came to the light world of the sea of ​​​​world to create dark creatures. Some of them would be sent back to the dark world along the ancient palace of Jie Yin. Shi Hao thought that his mentor was the chosen one . Because there are no living beings in the dark land, they need to be nurtured and nurtured by the light world. Therefore, the true spirit of the mentor went to the dark place.

After Shi Hao entered the Ultimate Ancient Land and fought against Gray Emperor, he finally found the true soul of his mentor. Hong Di and the other two wanted to attack Shi Hao by killing the souls of the Great Elder and Huo Ling'er. Shi Hao was beaten with injuries all over his body for protecting the two souls.

Then, Emperor Yu was about to send out his minions to a dark legion with a large number of Immortal Kings. However, Shi Hao discovered in the legion that the Dark Elder had been promoted to a fallen Immortal King. At this time, a dramatic scene occurred where the Dark Elder rebelled against Yu Emperor and killed the same Immortal. The king's king is immortal (this is why, because the great elder's body has some soul and memory left in his body, the dark elder helped Shi Hao to kill this enemy).

Shi Hao found an opportunity to exile his mentor and Huo Ling'er respectively, tearing apart the chaotic void and allowing the two to seek refuge in an unknown place. At this time, Meng Tianzheng's true soul merged with the body of the dark creature, and his Immortal King-level power surged.

Shi Hao was the great elder's most admired disciple, and was closer than his son. In order for Shi Hao to have no worries, he could only escape far away. Shi Hao's two balls of light wrapped around the two people, penetrated all obstacles, and traveled across the eternal sky. This is Shi Hao's power. Shi Hao was worried that the two of them would be injured or in danger, so there was a fairy elixir of immortality left in the light. Shi Hao had the soul marks of the two on his body, which was the key to finding the two in the future.

Shi Hao swept away the boundary sea, quelled the great chaos of darkness, and solved the great trouble. After breaking the prison, he was taken back by him to destroy the void.

During the period between the Holy Ruins and the Perfect World, all heavens and heavens were destroyed by strange forces. Meng Tianzheng and others also died, but they were resurrected by Emperor Huangtian in ancient times.

During the Holy Ruins period, he became a guard on the road to reincarnation. He was an obsessive Taoist at the peak of his cultivation and could easily resist God's decrees. He once fought with the Immortal Emperor in Mucheng in the chaotic universe for the letter Shi Hao left for future Immortal Emperors.

He can gain the upper hand in a duel with the Taoist Patriarch of Heaven. He is obsessed with the peak of the Half-Immortal Emperor. When all realms are in ruins, he revives to participate in the battle to destroy the world, and successfully calls back the Emperor of Desolate Heaven who confronts the three strange ancestors.

After the final battle in the underworld, the true spirit was led back to the main body by Emperor Huang Tian, but the world where the main body was located was also noticed by the strange ancestor. Subsequently, a bloody battle broke out between Meng Tianzheng and other powerful Taoist ancestors of the heavens and the strange Taoist ancestors. Although Meng Tianzheng was invincible among the Taoist ancestors of the same level, he was still killed by a large number of enemies with imperial troops.

characters.title: Mo Dao
characters.introText: Mo Dao is a prominent young supreme being originating from the world beyond the Desolate Border, a realm parallel to the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. He is recognized for his exceptional talent and formidable cultivation, holding a reputation as one of the most powerful individuals of his generation within his home region.
characters.appearance: Mo Dao is characterized by his handsome and delicate appearance, often depicted in white robes, which he himself jokingly refers to as a "pretty playboy" style. His demeanor is typically arrogant and proud, fitting his status as a renowned genius.
characters.personality:
Mo Dao hails from the Mo Family, a clan of significant influence in his world, with connections even to the ancient realm linked to Undying Mountain. His prodigious talent allowed him to cultivate three strands of immortal energy at a young age, a feat that firmly established his reputation as unrivaled in his domain and a "hero of a generation". He possesses an older sister, Mo Xian, who is also an exceptional talent, equally stunning, and held in high regard by Emperor Clans and even undying beings.

Mo Dao's path directly intersected with Shi Hao's in the Immortal Ancient Battlefield, where he arrived with an air of immense confidence, looking down upon the cultivators of the Three Thousand Dao Provinces. He challenged Shi Hao, initially opting to use only two of his three strands of immortal energy, believing it would be sufficient to suppress the "body cultivator" Huang. During their confrontation, Shi Hao subjected him to ridicule, calling him "little white" and a "little boy servant," which greatly angered Mo Dao. Despite his powerful techniques, including the use of Li Flames and a "small world" cage, Mo Dao found himself disadvantaged by Shi Hao's close-range combat and a peculiar "magical immunity" ability that seemed to weaken his precious techniques. Mo Dao quickly adapted, employing damaged magical imprints to counter this immunity, but ultimately, he was injured and captured by Shi Hao.

Following his defeat, Mo Dao, bound by his word, admitted his loss, a decision that shocked his peers who adored him. As a symbolic act of subjugation, he handed over his Soul Storing Pagoda, which contained a portion of his primordial spirit imprint, effectively binding him to Shi Hao. Shi Hao then began to treat Mo Dao as a personal "hired thug" and "servant," ordering him to perform tasks such as "interacting" (robbing) other cultivators for their gains, a role Mo Dao found initially uneasy but eventually carried out. He also stood guard for Shi Hao, notably sealing Wang Xi's cave and confronting disgruntled members of the Wang Family, displaying disdain for their "impure" immortal energy. Mo Dao's presence by Shi Hao's side, especially his three strands of immortal energy, served to intimidate opponents and paved the way for Shi Hao in various conflicts, such as during the pill furnace expedition. He continued to fight on Shi Hao's behalf, including against powerful figures like Lu Tuo, where he finally unleashed his full three immortal energies. His white robes were even stained with the blood of the Three-Headed King after Shi Hao killed it, leading many to mistakenly attribute the victory to Mo Dao, a narrative Shi Hao subtly encouraged.

Mo Dao's time in the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, particularly his journey through the Origin Ancient Mine, exposed him to "truth" through engraved diagrams of ancient battles. These experiences led him to question the history he had been taught in his own realm, specifically the belief that his people were solely victims of invasion. He struggled with this internal conflict, finding it difficult to reconcile the one-sided stories from his ancestors with the broader, more complex reality presented by these ancient imprints. This period deepened his understanding of the larger conflict between the two worlds.

Eventually, Mo Dao regained his freedom, coinciding with Immortal Wang's decision to pass on the Chaos Calming Art to Shi Hao. This suggests that his period of direct service to Shi Hao, while significant, was not permanent. Despite being freed, Mo Dao continued to maintain a connection with Shi Hao, sharing information and remaining a powerful presence. His primordial spirit, however, bore an imprint from an undying being, which nearly caused a disaster when Heavenly Deity Institution attempted to forcefully search his memories. Later, Mo Dao continued his cultivation, and was eventually reunited with his sister, Mo Xian. He is seen as a key figure whose experiences and potential influence could "topple" established beliefs in his home world.

characters.introText: Mo Shang was a lower realms Ocean Clan heaven warping genius, someone who fought a great battle against Shi Hao in the Kun Peng nest, competing over natural luck. He ultimately entered the higher realms.
characters.history:
Mo Shang was a lower realms Ocean Clan heaven warping genius, someone who fought a great battle against Shi Hao in the Kun Peng nest, competing over natural luck. He ultimately entered the higher realms.

When Kun Peng's Nest was about to arrive, Shi Hao encountered so many dangers. However, it went smoothly, Shi Hao saw a stronger power, and even if he sailed alone, he still had a chance to reach the Kun Peng Nest. Before reaching the Kun Peng Nest, Shi Hao found another ghost ship, but it was now a black paper ship.

Just because Shi Hao took the ghost ship, it became the target of the attack again. Mo Shang, the descendant of the Seagod, appeared on the stage. His weapon seemed to be the Poseidon Halberd, or a person who transformed the spirit realm into the extreme realm. In terms of realm, it was stronger than Shi Hao. Could this ghost ship have special abilities that would make Mo Shang go into war.

The battle was inevitable, and Shi Hao had to fight again. I don't know if Shi Hao is recovering now, and whether he can win Mo Shang. There are crises everywhere in Kunpeng's nest, but there must be great opportunities waiting for Shi Hao's arrival.

Mo Shang  rivals were Mermaid Princess of the Mermaid Clan, and Han Tian of the Flaming Fish Clan

Mo Shang went to the Three Thousand Provinces (Upper Realm) and wasn't heard from again until later when Shi Hao went to the Land of Darkness.  Shi Hao walked through the land of darkness, he discovered an extremely strong creature. He wanted to kill it, but in the end, he was shocked. When they met again, it was actually this scene. That person didn’t recognize him at all, because he fell into darkness.

After all these years, he didn’t see him again. Shi Hao never expected him to have turned into a darkness creature. Shi Hao didn’t deal the killing blow. Even though they stood against each other, they were still old acquaintances. He personally went out of his way, handing it to Mu Qing and the others.

“After two hundred years passed, I cannot turn around. Many things from the past will not return.” Shi Hao said quietly. Then, he continued on his path.

characters.title: Mo Xian
characters.introText: Mo Xian is a formidable human cultivator originating from the world beyond the Desolate Border. She is the elder sister of Mo Dao, a prominent young expert from the foreign realm who cultivated three strands of immortal energy. Mo Xian's talents are deemed exceptional, noted to far surpass those of her brother. Her extraordinary qualifications led to her early selection and fostering by an ancient Emperor Clan, granting her a status equivalent to their direct line of descent and placing her at a terrifyingly high standing within the foreign realm hierarchy. She is a well-known and respected figure even among the proud Emperor Clan members who actively sought to integrate her into their lineage. Possessing a perceptive nature, she understands that many perceived truths are merely superficial, with deeper realities often concealed.
characters.appearance: Mo Xian generally maintains an outwardly aloof and calm demeanor, speaking with a measured and thoughtful tone. Her interactions frequently reveal a perceptive understanding of situations and underlying truths, suggesting a shrewd and intelligent mind that can discern realities beyond common perception. Despite her elevated status within the foreign realm, she exhibits a notable degree of empathy and compassion, particularly towards her younger brother, Mo Dao, and the human children Shi Hao rescues from the foreign lands. Her willingness to assist Shi Hao by undertaking the responsibility for these children underscores a soft spot and a capacity for trust, especially when appealed to on the basis of shared humanity. She expresses genuine worry regarding the chaotic future and its potential impact on her loved ones.
characters.personality: Mo Xian generally maintains an outwardly aloof and calm demeanor, speaking with a measured and thoughtful tone. Her interactions frequently reveal a perceptive understanding of situations and underlying truths, suggesting a shrewd and intelligent mind that can discern realities beyond common perception. Despite her elevated status within the foreign realm, she exhibits a notable degree of empathy and compassion, particularly towards her younger brother, Mo Dao, and the human children Shi Hao rescues from the foreign lands. Her willingness to assist Shi Hao by undertaking the responsibility for these children underscores a soft spot and a capacity for trust, especially when appealed to on the basis of shared humanity. She expresses genuine worry regarding the chaotic future and its potential impact on her loved ones.
characters.history:
Due to her unparalleled talent, Mo Xian was identified and chosen by an ancient Emperor Clan from beyond the Desolate Border during her youth. This unprecedented selection allowed her to cultivate within their ancient lands, positioning her on par with the Emperor Clan's direct descendants and dramatically elevating her status within the foreign realm. This integration, remarkable for a human, solidified her foundation and set her apart as a figure of immense potential.

Mo Xian is observed present in the Medicine Refinement Hall, a relatively peaceful and less frequented location. Here, she notes the presence of powerful figures, including supreme beings and Gu Clan's formidable grandson, Gu Hong. Her presence in such a setting, combined with her observations, suggests a period of contemplative cultivation, where she perhaps focused on understanding deeper dao principles or refining her own path without engaging in overt conflicts.

A pivotal moment occurs when Mo Xian encounters Shi Hao near Dao Comprehension Mountain. Shi Hao, appealing to their shared human heritage and the compassionate nature he observed in her brother, Mo Dao, entrusts Mo Xian with human children he rescued from the foreign realm. Despite her position and the ongoing conflict, Mo Xian agrees to take the children, showcasing a profound sense of compassion and establishing a unique trust with Shi Hao. Furthermore, she provides Shi Hao with critical information about Ocean Fall, a dangerous yet potentially invaluable cultivation spot, warning him of its inherent perils.

After a significant span of time, Mo Xian is reunited with Shi Hao. She expresses profound disbelief and shock at his continued existence, as widespread rumors in the foreign realm had asserted his death at the hands of immortal kings. Despite the problems Shi Hao had caused her realm, she acknowledges his extraordinary power and influence, noting that he had broken "dust covered glorious record" by achieving dao before 500 years. She expresses a quiet belief in his eventual return, indicative of her deep understanding of his unique capabilities and resilience.

characters.introText: Mu Qing was one of the many children Shi Hao brought back from the True Emperor City and Heaven Abyss. He also witnessed the destruction of the pass during the Final Imperial War.
characters.appearance:
Mu Qing was one of the many children Shi Hao brought back from the True Emperor City and Heaven Abyss. He also witnessed the destruction of the pass during the Final Imperial War.

Mu Qing's greatest distinction was not an extraordinarily rapid cultivation speed, but his steadfast Dao heart and perseverance. His rise from the brutal environment of the Primordial Imperial City to the Supreme Realm was the result of prolonged cultivation, repeated battles, and an unwillingness to surrender before seemingly insurmountable obstacles.
characters.history:
Mu Qing was a direct descendant of the Seven Kings, yet from a young age he was confined within the isolated Primordial Imperial City. Ravaged by endless war, the ancient city had become a graveyard, its streets littered with corpses. The surviving descendants of the Seven kings Bloodline lived at the very bottom of the world, struggling to survive by devouring the remains of the strong.

Mu Qing's childhood was therefore one of unrelenting bloodshed. There was no warmth, no peaceful cultivation, and no ordinary childhood—only death and the constant struggle to survive.

Everything changed when Shi Hao came into the Primordial Imperial City. Seeing the children of the  Seven kings Bloodline, whose blood was branded as sinful and whose lives had been treated as worthless yet Still protecting Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, Shi Hao agreed with the Shi Elder  to take them. He brought Mu Qing, Zhu Lin, Shi Zhong  and a group of other youths out of the isolated city and returned with them to Stone Village in the lower realm.

Mu Qing consequently became one of the earliest core members of the Eight Hundred Disciples. Among his many talents, Mu Qing possessed an extraordinary affinity for the Dao of Thunder. Recognizing his potential, Shi Hao did not hold back. He personally imparted to Mu Qing the complete , one of the supreme inheritances of the Ten Fiends .,

Mu Qing possessed an exceptional innate affinity for the Dao of Thunder. Recognizing his potential, Shi Hao personally imparted to him the complete Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique  one of the supreme inheritances of the Ten Fiends and also sought out countless divine medicines and immortal treasures to help him refine his Seven King Bloodline, laying a solid foundation for him.

Although Mu Qing's cultivation speed could not compare with Shi Hao's extraordinary progress, his Dao heart was exceptionally firm. He devoted himself to cultivation and accompanied Shi Hao through numerous trials and battles.

During these experiences, Mu Qing fought powerful opponents in the Void God Realm and the Western Spirit Realm. Among cultivators of his generation, he rarely encountered opponents capable of matching him.

Mu Qing eventually reached the Self Releasel Realm in his forties. While this achievement was considerably less astonishing than Shi Hao's own cultivation speed, Mu Qing's strength continued to grow through years of accumulated experience and combat.

Seeking to help his disciples overcome the limitations of their cultivation, Shi Hao repeatedly led Mu Qing and other disciples near to the Realm Sea Dam for training. This region was extraordinarily dangerous, but its harsh environment also contained opportunities for cultivators seeking to break through their existing realms.

Mu Qing spent a hundred years cultivating within the Lightning Abyss near the  Dam. Through prolonged cultivation and relentless effort, he eventually reached the peak of the Self Realease Realm.

His advancement nevertheless encountered a formidable obstacle.

The restrictions of the Dharma-ending Age placed severe limitations upon cultivation. The five-hundred-year cultivation threshold became a seemingly insurmountable barrier for Mu Qing, preventing him from opening the path to the Supreme Realm despite his accumulated foundation.

Mu Qing learned Modern Cultivation but later became stuck at the Self Release Realm during the Dharma Ending Age.In his pursuit to become a young Supreme Being like Shi Hao, he switched to the Immortal Ancient Cultivation.

Recognizing the difficulty of Mu Qing's situation, Shi Hao provided him with a fragment of the Heavenly Core Imprint for study. This opportunity became decisive for Mu Qing's cultivation. By studying the fragment and comprehending the mysteries contained within it, he gradually found a way to overcome the shackles that had confined him

After more than 5,000 years of accumulation and comprehension, with the guidance of the War Spirit Immortal and Ghost Immortals who had joined to protect the Imperial Court and the Nine Heavens defense. Mu Qing finally broke through his bottleneck and successfully entered the Supreme Realm.

He was a very loyal and important member of the Imperial Court, becoming one of its foundational pillars in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. Even after the fall of the Imperial Court, he stayed behind with the others while Shi Hao slumbered for 500 000 years.
