characters.introText: The nameless half immortal emperor from the Age of Emperor Collapse was a powerful yet tragic figure. Having reached the half immortal emperor realm a level of unmatched strength and status he stood above immortal kings and undying beings. Despite his immense power, he met a pitiful end, dying before he could fulfill his purpose of quelling the great darkness chaos and restoring peace to the far shore of the Realm Sea. His ruined body, still burning with the dao flames of a half immortal emperor, was found under the protection of the Willow Deity, but he was ultimately overwhelmed by three other half immortal emperors: the Feather Emperor, the Grand Emperor, and the Gray Emperor. Together, they defeated him in battle.
characters.appearance: The nameless half immortal emperor from the Age of Emperor Collapse was a powerful yet tragic figure. Having reached the half immortal emperor realm a level of unmatched strength and status he stood above immortal kings and undying beings. His ruined body, still burning with the dao flames of a half immortal emperor, was found under the protection of the Willow Deity, but he was ultimately overwhelmed by three other half immortal emperors: the Feather Emperor, the Grand Emperor, and the Gray Emperor. Together, they defeated him in battle.
characters.history:
The Nameless Half-Immortal Emperor was a survivor of the Age of Emperor Collapse and one of the vanishingly small number of beings across all of recorded history to have broken through the Immortal King Realm into half-immortal emperor status — a level of power so far beyond ordinary immortal kings and undying beings that creatures of those ranks lacked even the qualification to stand before him. He belonged to that rare handful of leading figures who, across the endless span of great eras, actually managed to reach this level, placing him among the true apex of the setting's power hierarchy.

Despite that unmatched strength, his story is defined by failure and tragedy rather than triumph. At some point after the Age of Emperor Collapse, he made the choice to cross Realm Sea alone, driven by the singular goal of quelling the great darkness chaos at its source and restoring peace to the sea's far shore a mission he undertook fully aware of its danger, and one that ultimately cost him everything. He never completed it. Upon reaching the limits of Realm Sea, he was confronted by three dark half-immortal emperors Grand Emperor, Gray Emperor, and Feather Emperor who moved against him together rather than risk facing him individually. Outnumbered three-to-one even at his own rarefied level of power, he was overwhelmed and killed, his blood taken as a trophy on Feather Emperor's spear.

His ruined body was discovered still burning with the lingering dao flame of a half-immortal emperor long after his passing a flame powerful enough on its own to ward off external interference sheltering within it a small, foot-tall willow tree: the corrupted, darkness-fallen remnant of Willow Deity. Rather than let it be destroyed or claimed by his killers, he spent what remained of his strength shielding it, a final gesture that preserved Willow Deity's remnant until Shi Hao himself arrived generations later to find them both.

Before his fate was known, the only sign he had ever existed was an unrepeatable trail of footprints left in the sand at the edge of Dam World ground that, for endless generations afterward, no other being could leave a mark on, restricted-region lords and immortal kings included. Those footprints alone drove wave after wave of ancient kings into Realm Sea, chasing the mystery of who had walked there and where he had been going. When his fate was finally uncovered a being who had reached the very summit of cultivation, dying before completing a mission to save a world not even his own it left everyone who learned of it with the same grim question: if even he could fall, was there truly any hope for whoever tried next.

characters.introText: Ning Chuan (The Six Crown King) is one of the major antagonists in Perfect World. A powerful first generation freak from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm) (Three Thousand Provinces). The title 'Six Crown King' was given to him for the number of times he entered Immortal Ancient and ranked first during that time. He was described as a genius from birth, talented in all areas and as such he was very arrogant. He's class as one of the Young generation Ancient Freaks along side, Tian Zi, Gu Jianyun, Divine Dark Child, Fallen Divine Child, Zi Yanfei and a few others that previously entered Immortal Ancient.
characters.appearance:
His clothing appearance was white as snow down to his socks and shoes pure white, untainted by a speck of dust. His silver hair scattered about, shining brilliantly. His face was beautiful to an almost unrealistic level, being prettier than many girls.

He was different from everyone else since birth, carrying a heavenly diagram on his back, his forehead bore intricate dragon motifs, later revealed to symbolize the True Qilin Tribe , one of the Archaic Vicious Ten. contrary to popular belief. He strategically allowed others to mistake it for a dragon, preserving its true significance as a trump card.
characters.history:
To understand Ning Chuan (The Six Crown King) role we need to touch on the basics or rather the surface level regarding the Sinners Blood History. To quickly sum up, Since ancient times a total of Thirty Clans were group as primary and secondary sinners, whereas Stone Clan, Fire Nation etc was designated in the primary group. The Sinner Clans were said to have been traitors during the ancient wars and darkness calamity, they supposedly committed crimes that weren't forgivable, but in reality the clans and especially the Stone Clan were plotted against by those having contact with the Fallen Ones, and the accusers were from the Wind Clan, Sword Valley etc. The Stone Clan could've been exonerated of their false crimes had the Immortal Palace leader the Ruined True Immortal and others had come forward to testify but they instead stood with the others plot.

Some of the 'sinners' were wipe out and others were inevitably grouped together in one province that came to be known as Sin Province. Later on, a group of clans and sects more than ten were put in place to  suppress and oversee them. Those clans were Demon Dragon Sect, Fire Cloud Cavern, Luofu True Valley, Sword Valley and others. The reasons why they weren't entirely exterminated was because the overseers  weren't sure if the The Seven Kings from the Old Imperial pass from desolate border were still alive and afraid one day they would return and if such was the case and they went too far they would all be annihilated.

Ning Chuan's Birth.

Ning Chuan (The Six Crown King) was born after heaven and earth and gave a command of great fate, he was aloof and detached, he was extraordinary. That night, when he emerged from his mother’s womb, divine light shone resplendently, heaven and earth as bright as day. Some even said that he might be the reincarnation of an unmatched forbidden individual. There were others that claimed that he was related to immortals, inheriting the foundation of the Immortal Dao, that there were unmatched imprints that merged with him while he was still within his mother’s body, creating an incomparable great path for him.

The clan Ning Chuan resided in was the extremely rich and powerful Qilin Ridge Clan located in the Upper Realms. On the night of his birth, irregular scenes shocked the heavens, shaking up many ancient sects. He had a heaven diagram on his back, dragon pattern on his head. But now, it seemed eerily similar to a Qilin Pattern. That night, divine light illuminated the heavens, making it as bright as daytime! Many great provinces saw what happened that day, causing countless people to become shocked.

This was also precisely the reason why Ning Chuan was treated with importance by many ancient sects, placing their great hopes and expectations on him a long time ago. Later on, Demon Dragon Sect, Fire Cloud Cavern, Luofu True Valley, and other great sects came one after another, wishing to take him as a disciple. This was the reason why Ning Chuan was proficient in so many extreme arts!

Being wanted by many top sects naturally Six Crown King had some relationship with the Sinners Suppressor Sects, and others. That's why he was viewed as an unmatched hero who possessed the great dao.  He was seen as the future face of those Sinners Suppressor Sects. He appeared in the world six times, each time rising to the top in Immortal Ancient, his divine bravery unmatched, forging an undefeated legend. He was one of the most powerful individuals of the current cultivation realm from past to present!

Ning Chuan's origins were barely laid out in the Novel version, hence Ning Chuan's backstory was extensively shown in the Donghua.

Shocked Ning Chuan after learning his "past".

Despite his prestigious upbringing, Ning Chuan harbored a deep and dark secret that was hidden even from himself for a long time: the Darkness One Bloodline from the Foreign Realm ran through his veins. His mother, instrumental in shaping his fate, had lied to him about his origins. She had claimed to him she had fallen in love with a cultivator from the Lower Realms with the Sinners Bloodline. However, in reality, she had collaborated with a certain individual from the Foreign Realm, allowing him to manipulate her unborn child. Unable to face the full truth of her betrayal in front of her son, she ended her life, concealing the darker aspects of his heritage. After this, Ning Chuan struggled with feelings of self-loathing, believing himself vile and repulsive to the laws of heaven due to his supposed inheritance with the Sinners Blood. Despite his external confidence, this internal conflict led to a sense of moral delusion, where he convinced himself that purging the Sinners Bloodline was a righteous duty.

Having been indoctrinated by sects and prestigious clans of the Upper Realms, such as the Demon Dragon Sect and Fire Cloud Cavern, Ning Chuan saw the Sinners Bloodline as traitors. His actions, including massacres in the Lower Realms, were driven by this twisted sense of justice. He hunted down those from the Sin Province and anyone connected to the Sinners Bloodline, oblivious to the fact that many of the Sinners were falsely accused by corrupt clans who had actually maintained contact with the Fallen Ones in the past.

characters.introText: The Heavenly Horned Ant Great One, known as the father of the Little Heavenly Hornet Ant, was a legendary figure from the archaic era one of the Vicious Ten and a peerless existence even among them. He was regarded as the number one in courage and strength under the heavens, known for his unrivaled divine might. His power was said to surpass even that of a True Dragon.
characters.appearance: In his human form, he appeared tall and heroic, with golden hair and an aura that could “devour mountains and rivers.” He stood as the sole sovereign between the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, with eyes that could pierce through endless time and movements powerful enough to destroy stars and suns. His fighting strength was extraordinary nearly on par with that of an Immortal King, even though he had not achieved that specific Dao Fruit.
characters.history:
The Great One’s life was filled with immense battles and deep tragedy. His family suffered greatly: his wife, the mother of the Little Golden Ant, was killed in battle, and his other children the Little Ant’s elder siblings were also slain, some even devoured by the Blood Phoenix Lion.His final battle was legendary. He fought alone against countless enemies, holding up the heavens with his own strength. Despite his unmatched might, he was ambushed by several terrifying opponents one wielding a green sword that pierced his brow, another a giant shadowy figure, and finally Anlan, who struck him with a golden spear. Even so, he slaughtered many foreign top-level figures before his injuries became fatal.

As he neared death, the Great One made a final, selfless act. Dragging his shattered body through endless time, he used the last of his foundational essence to defy the heavens and ensure the survival of his son. In the end, his body turned into blood and ashes, never having the chance to meet his child. His death was mournful a hero’s end that burned away in the light of sacrifice.He left behind his shed skin and remnants in his ancient cave, which continued to emanate terrifying pressure even after countless years. The Imperishable Scripture was also linked to him, though he never directly passed it on. Shi Hao later speculated that the Great One deliberately withheld it, believing it to be incomplete, and wished future generations to perfect it to create an “imperishable divine legend.”

Shi Hao first encountered the remnant will of the Heavenly Horned Ant Great One within the ancient palace of the Heavenly Deity Institution. There, a middle-aged man the Great One’s human form manifested before him. The remnant will communicated with Shi Hao, showing him visions of past battles, including the ambush by the green sword wielder and the giant shadow, warning him to beware such enemies. The Great One also expressed approval of Shi Hao’s pursuit of the Extreme Dao.

Shi Hao held deep admiration for the Great One’s strength and sacrifice, respectfully addressing him as “Senior.” The Great One, in turn, showed the tenderness of a father toward his own son, stating that he would rather not meet him in person wishing instead for his child to “stand alone beneath the heavens, able to support the dome of the world with his own strength.”Shi Hao later understood that the Great One had secretly guided his son’s path, arranging for him to inherit the Imperishable Scripture and avenge their family’s destruction. His actions reflected a profound, silent love fatherly affection as deep as a mountain.

The Old Heavenly Horned Ant's connection with Shi Hao is closely tied to the mysteries of the long river of time. During their initial indirect encounter, the Old Heavenly Horned Ant told Shi Hao that he had “met” him millions and millions of years earlier. Shi Hao initially found this impossible, as they had never encountered one another directly in his own era. He eventually realized that the Old Heavenly Horned Ant possessed the ability to perceive the river of time and had likely glimpsed his future existence while looking across different eras.

When Shi Hao asked whether the Old Heavenly Horned Ant had seen him while gazing into the future, he confirmed Shi Hao's deduction. The Old Heavenly Horned Ant explained that, while searching for and observing his own child, he had also seen Shi Hao because his child would eventually be together with Shi Hao, fighting through bloody wars while the flames of war engulfed the Nine Heavens. Thus, his statement that he had met Shi Hao millions of years earlier referred to an encounter made possible through the river of time rather than a conventional meeting.

The connection became even more significant during Shi Hao's eighth life in the Age of Emperor Collapse. After successively living through eight lives and accumulating approximately 490,000 years, Shi Hao's divine awareness became extraordinarily powerful. He was able to perceive the river of time on multiple occasions and observe powerful beings looking across its currents, either tracing the past or overlooking distant eras.

During this period, Shi Hao once again encountered the Old Heavenly Horned Ant across the river of time. He saw the ancient Vicious Ten drenched in blood, standing within the endless river of time, and their gazes met across the separation of different eras. Shi Hao immediately recognized him as the father of the Little Heavenly Horned Ant and remembered the Old Heavenly Horned Ant's earlier statement that he had seemingly seen Shi Hao countless years in the past.

At this moment, Shi Hao finally understood the meaning behind that earlier encounter. The Old Heavenly Horned Ant had indeed perceived Shi Hao across the river of time.

characters.introText: Pan King (盘王) is one of the oldest and most powerful Immortal Kings of the Immortal Domain, standing among the realm's supreme rulers. Having survived from the Immortal Ancient Era, he has existed through countless great ages, witnessing the rise and destruction of innumerable civilizations. His exact origins and age are unknown, but he is recognized by both allies and enemies as one of the Immortal Domain's ancient giants.
characters.appearance:
Pan King (盘王) is one of the oldest and most powerful Immortal Kings of the Immortal Domain, standing among the realm's supreme rulers. Having survived from the Immortal Ancient Era, he has existed through countless great ages, witnessing the rise and destruction of innumerable civilizations. His exact origins and age are unknown, but he is recognized by both allies and enemies as one of the Immortal Domain's ancient giants.

He is the founder and ruler of the Pan King Clan, as well as the lord of Pan King City, one of the largest, oldest, and most prosperous Immortal King cities in the Immortal Domain. His territory encompasses an enormous cosmic region formed from merged ancient worlds, serving as both a political center and one of the Immortal Domain's foremost gathering places for immortal clans.

Although Pan King possesses authority rivaling the greatest experts in existence, he is known for his calm temperament and measured judgment. Unlike several other Immortal Kings who act solely according to calculations of fate and future karma, Pan King still values personal promises and ancient friendships. This trait places him at odds with other Immortal Domain giants during Shi Hao's arrival.
characters.personality:
Pan King is calm, composed, and exceptionally rational. After living for countless eras, he has approached the emotionless state sought by supreme cultivators, rarely displaying obvious emotional fluctuations. Most of the time he remains silent for tens of thousands of years while comprehending the Great Dao.

Despite this detached nature, Pan King has not completely abandoned personal principles. He values promises and loyalty, honoring commitments even when they place him in conflict with fellow Immortal Kings. Because of a promise made to the Restricted Region Lord, he repeatedly risks offending Aocheng Immortal King and Taishi Immortal King in order to protect Shi Hao.

Unlike Aocheng, who is willing to eliminate any potential threat before it matures, Pan King refuses to execute members of the younger generation based solely on uncertain future possibilities. He repeatedly argues that Shi Hao should not be killed merely because his future cannot be seen clearly.

His governing philosophy is equally strict. Within Pan King City, no individual is exempt from the law. Whether mortal cultivators or True Immortals, anyone who violates the city's regulations receives the same punishment. His impartial enforcement of justice has made Pan King City one of the safest and most orderly cities in the Immortal Domain.
characters.history:
Pan King is one of the surviving Immortal Kings from the Immortal Ancient Era, having personally experienced the conflicts that devastated that age. During that era, he became acquainted with the Restricted Region Lord and the mysterious Ancestral Guardian Spirit, establishing relationships that would continue into later ages.

As one of the Immortal Domain's founding giants, Pan King established the Pan King Clan, whose descendants would inherit his bloodline across countless generations. His clan eventually became one of the Immortal Domain's most influential immortal families, with descendants such as Pan Yi representing its younger generation.

Over the endless passage of time, Pan King built Pan King City, transforming it into one of the Immortal Domain's greatest centers of commerce, cultivation, and political authority. Countless immortal clans settled within his territory under his protection, while his long-distance transportation formations connected his domain to other Immortal King territories throughout the Immortal Domain.
characters.trivia:
Pan King is one of the few Immortal Kings who actively protects Shi Hao despite knowing it could place him in conflict with other Immortal Domain giants.

He willingly gave the Restricted Region Lord three drops of his Immortal King essence blood, an almost priceless treasure even among Immortal Kings.

His life-oriented Great Dao allows him not only to block destructive attacks but also to restore celestial bodies that have already been destroyed.

Pan King City is governed under absolute law, with even True Immortals having been executed by Pan King for violating its rules.

Despite being described as comparable in strength to Aocheng Immortal King, the two have never fought a decisive battle, leaving their exact relative strength unknown.

Shi Hao was the only Immortal King that Pan King met with his True Body after he returned to Immortal Domain

In its previous existence, it was described as an "exceptional beauty". This is not her true body; she traversed the world's barrier by attaching herself to the remains of an ancient ancestor of the Xu family (Princess Yao Yue's ancestor) who perished in the foreign realm during the ancient immortal era. characters.history:
The Snow-White Skeleton appeared from the foreign realm, descending into the three thousand provinces. She served as a representative for the foreign realm's younger generation, proposing a competition against the Heavenly Deity Institution's disciples. This challenge, ostensibly an exchange of pointers, was in reality a secret mission to allow the foreign realm's prodigies to adapt to ultimate war, thereby preparing them for future decisive battles. The competition was set within a specific black peak, which the Snow-White Skeleton indicated was resistant to the Heaven and Earth Pouch's influence.

During the competition, the Snow-White Skeleton expressed concern regarding the outcome of the competition when its participants, including the Three-Headed King and Void Beast, were killed or defected. She believed that an easy defeat would not only demoralize her young prodigies but also render the cross-realm exchange meaningless. Possessing a strong sense of pride and dignity as a powerful being, the Snow-White Skeleton initially intended to lead the foreign realm's talents to showcase their formidable strength and establish their renown. However, suffering defeat and conceding to Shi Hao was a profound humiliation she found difficult to accept. Despite realizing she was not Shi Hao's match, she harbored a sliver of hope, believing that prolonged resistance might create an opportunity for other foreign realm talents to gain an advantage. She also showed strong disapproval when Mo Dao, one of their prominent young talents, defected.

characters.title: Primordial Fish Fry
characters.introText: The Primordial Fish Fry were born deep within the Foreign Realm  sea waterfall connecting the Boundary Seas. Belonging to an extremely ancient and primordial species, records indicate they might only appear once or twice per era, a sight most cultivators never witness in their lifetime. Its appearance was peculiar, possessing the head of a tyrant's dragon, with a pair of massive black horns atop its head. Its body resembles a giant carp, covered in thick, dark gold scales. Newborn fry can reach lengths of tens of thousands of feet, and the truly mature Primordial Fish are unimaginably large. This race has no clear ancestral origins, having lurked within the sea waterfall since the beginning of the Boundary Seas Creations, nourished by the unique spatial and temporal essence of the waterfalls.

characters.introText: Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch was a renowned individual and an exceptional heavenly talent, hailing from Purple Manor, one of the richest and most powerful ancient lands within the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. He is a young supreme being of Immortal Academy and is considered one of the four individuals whose formidable reputation dominates the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, representing the academy's greatest fighting strength. He is often referred to as a supreme being among men.
characters.appearance:
The Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch possesses a deeply arrogant and self-confident demeanor, stemming from his exceptional talent and the inherent power of his Dao Seed. He firmly believed that those who did not obtain a perfect Dao Seed were fundamentally flawed, asserting that the distance between himself and such individuals (like Huang) would only grow greater, rendering them unworthy opponents in the Sect Master realm.

He is highly decisive, but his immense pride makes him extremely sensitive to humiliation and defeat, struggling greatly to accept being bested, particularly in front of peers. Following his defeat by Huang, he endured his rage and coldly retreated to avoid compounding the shame of appearing as a "sore loser" in front of Lan Xian and Qi Gu.

characters.history:
Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch was born into the Purple Mansion (Purple House), one of the most formidable ancient families in the Nine Heavens. His birth was accompanied by heaven-shaking phenomena; divine birds cried out, and a massive purple sun descended from the sky, shrinking to fall into his delivery room. Many believed him to be the reincarnation of an Immortal Dao figure.

He was sent to the Immortal Academy at a young age, where he was instructed by old monsters and bathed in divine medicines to forge an indestructible foundation. During an excavation of an underground immortal cave by the academy's elders, the Grand Mist Purple Qi Seed (Hongmeng Purple Qi Seed)—a legendary "Invincible Seed" lost since the Immortal Ancient era—flew out and voluntarily merged with him. Upon exiting seclusion, purple qi surged for 30,000 li, shocking the world. He solidified his status by inscribing his name on the "Martial Dao Transcendent Peak" at the North Sea Stone Forest, a feat reserved for the most powerful martial artists. He also fought Blue Immortal (Lan Xian) to a draw, cementing his place as a top Young Supreme.

After Shi Hao (Huang) returned from three years of silence, Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch’s follower (a book boy) and his mount (a Golden Horned Rhinoceros) provoked Shi Hao at the Heavenly Deity Institution. Purple Sun appeared, initially intending to suppress Huang to avenge his friend, Nine Nether. Upon learning that Shi Hao had not merged with a Perfect Seed, Purple Sun lost interest, declaring Shi Hao unworthy. However, he agreed to suppress his cultivation to the Heavenly Deity Realm to fight Shi Hao, intending to crush him completely.

The battle was cataclysmic. Purple Sun utilized his full arsenal, including the Purple Sky Palm, True Phoenix Art, and Qilin Art. Despite his overwhelming power and the manifestation of the Hongmeng Seed as a weapon (a purple halberd), he was physically overpowered by Shi Hao. Shi Hao shattered the purple sun phenomenon and broke the manifested weapon of the Hongmeng Seed. Unable to accept defeat, Purple Sun attempted to unseal his full cultivation and summon the complete Hongmeng Seed to kill Shi Hao. However, even with the interference of Great Xumi and Blue Immortal, Purple Sun was grievously wounded and nearly killed by Shi Hao, saved only by the intervention of an Immortal Academy elder. This defeat shattered his "Invincible Dao Heart."

Later, in an underground cave, the Young Supremes attempted to lift the Heavenly Horned Ant's weapon, a heavy cauldron. Desperate to prove himself after his loss to Huang, Purple Sun attempted to lift it using the power of the Hongmeng Seed. He failed and suffered a backlash, coughing blood, while the Heavenly Horned Ant (in its small form) mocked him.

During the Great War at the Desolate Border, the geniuses of the Nine Heavens were pit against the Kings of the Foreign Realm in a series of duels decided by the Immortal Turtle Shell. Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch was selected to fight against a member of the Mantis-Centipede (Tang Wu) clan, a cold-blooded Royal Clan of the Foreign Realm. Desperate to regain his dignity and prove his worth, Purple Sun fought madly, burning his blood and soul to activate the Hongmeng Seed's ultimate power. However, the Mantis-Centipede was too strong and physically nearly indestructible. In a tragic end, the Mantis-Centipede sliced through the Hongmeng Seed's projection and cut Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch in two. He died on the battlefield, but his corpse, along with Lu Hong and Xuan Kun was later recovered by Shi Hao and repaired their bodies to their former state, with his body later stitched together and eventually returned to his clansmen amidst great mourning.

characters.introText: This underworld individual wore blood-colored armor and carried deathly energy. His pupils were silvery white.
characters.appearance: In Donghua, this character is never shown; their role is replaced by their Three-Headed Hound.
characters.history:
Shi Hao encountered this cultivator in the Immortal Ancient, accompanied by a Three-Headed Hound. He was surprised that his lackeys hadn't yet eliminated Hong Huang, but was told she was protected by an extremely powerful individual.

Qi Bing took initiative and sent his mastiff against Shi Hao, but the latter brought it down with a single blow, despite being in the Divine Flame Realm. When Hong Huang revealed to Shi Hao that Qi Bing was a subordinate of the Divine Dark Child, Shi Hao was perplexed, as he didn't know anyone by that name. He asked if the Divine Dark Child was stronger than the Underworld Child he had previously defeated. This exchange stunned everyone, making it clear that their enemy was Huang, the killer of one of their allies in the Yuan Tian Secret Realm. Qi Bing stiffened, and when Shi Hao declared he would eliminate the Divine Dark Child as he had done with the Underworld Child, Qi Bing grew furious, calling him too arrogant and threatening that the Divine Dark Child would crush him mercilessly as soon as he found him.

As he prepared to flee using a scroll, Shi Hao pursued him with the Void Halberd and killed him, emphasizing that he couldn't escape once he had decided to kill him. 
However, just before dying, Qi Bing used a bone mirror to reveal to the Divine Dark Child the appearance of the one who had killed him.
characters.trivia: In Donghua, this character is never shown; their role is replaced by their Three-Headed Hound.

He says that there could be Immortal Gold or Supreme Treasure inside that egg being nurtured and Shi Hao could use it's connection with the Dao to consolidate his own Dao.

After Shi Hao helps Qing Yi in capturing Green Moon Flame he is dejected that Shi Hao gave up a good opportunity and decides to help him acquire a flame to step into Divine Flame Realm. Shi Hao refuses saying that he wouldn't use a flame to step into deity realm and instead use his own body as Shi Hao feels that this is the right way. Qi Daolin refuses Shi Hao as that is a broken path and that Qi Daolin himself used when he was young but failed. Qi Daolin then gives him many books in which there are records of young supreme beings that followed this path but ended up withering into Dao.

Qi Daolin stops Celestial clan when they come to come with True Deities to kill him. He says that he wont stop any cultivator in Venerable Realm and Divine Flame Realm from fighting with Shi Hao, they could even kill him if they have the power, as students of Supreme Being Dao rite need to stand above the world but if anyone in True God Realm  or higher wants to even harm Shi Hao he would kill their clan's and sect's entire younger generation.

Shi Hao hesitatingly tells him that he has found the Three World Bronze Coffin that Qi Daolin's master was researching, fearing that Qi Daolin would go to Three World Bronze Coffin to investigate and die inevitably. When Shi Hao and Qi Daolin reach that site of Three World Bronze Coffin they encounter the Nine Dragons' skeletons guarding the coffin and a Mysterious Flame inside the coffin, which ends up taking place inside Shi Hao. After some Unforeseen event with Three World Bronze Coffin Qi Daolin leaves for Uninhabited Region to investigate and find clues for the lost Supreme Palace.

Qi Daolin together with Undying Being, Peng Master and Willow Deities Imprint later rescues Shi Hao from the barricade of Sect Masters who want to kill him in revenge of their students who died at Shi Hao's hands in Ancient Immortal.

Many hundreds, if not thousands of years later during the Cultivation-less Age  after Shi Hao establish Imperial Court he had the members constantly look for his teacher and the Supreme Being Dao Rite inheritance a top of the  Giant Turtle. After many years of searching Shi Hao finally got some news so he immediately set out and capture the inheritance, within the inheritance was a simple message from his old teacher stating that after finding the  inheritance he also found a passage way aka Primordial Gate which led into the Uninhabited Region (No Man's Land/Desolate Border)  he dived right in and was never herd from again. Qi Doalin Soul lamp  also was out which means body and soul was killed. Shi Hao was truly sadden.

He was later revived millions of years later at the end of Secret Ruins Novel.

characters.introText: Qin Hao, the younger brother of Shi Hao, was born in Bulao Mountain. He was originally conceived to help his brother recover from the injuries he suffered when his Supreme Being Bones was removed.
characters.history:
Qin Hao, the younger brother of Shi Hao, was born in Bulao Mountain. He was originally conceived to help his brother recover from the injuries he suffered when his Supreme Being Bones was removed.

Qin Hao was shown to be an ambitious individual with goals of surpassing his elder brother and becoming the best in the world, he was fearless and eager to fight which at times seems naive. As a child he experience many discrimination and were teased frequently by the other sect members for being  less talented than his brother due to being born a replacement holder for  Shi Hao recovery in the future, regardless he still showed perseverance and held high standard for himself that one day he will defeat his brother and become the best. He finally met his elder brother  and were fired up to prove himself but easily beaten by Shi Hao, after his master Qin Zhan appeared having ulterior motives and purposely sewing discord among brothers Qin Hao remembered his trauma and murderously rush at his elder brother with killing intent but were again defeated by Shi Hao. After many events they later put aside their differences after meeting up with their parents.

Majority of their time in the lower realm Qin Hao were spurred on by his ambition and some times it turned into brotherly jealousy, sometimes appreciation for his brother strength and glory which kept getting further and further away from him but even with all that they still understood each other and became closer. Qin Hao decided to go ahead with the Qin Clan Supreme immortal plan which in-tails the fusion of the immortal bone into his body, once held by ancestor Immortal Qin, in reality, it was reveal that the main reason they force Qin Yining and Shi Ziling to conceive another child was because of this plan after learning about Shi Hao bone and the Stone Clan special bloodline. Shi Hao and his parents at first tried to dissuade him from that path but later agreed that all cultivator has their own path to take while reluctantly agreeing with Qin Hao.

During  Shi Hao battle with the seven gods from the upper realm and was severely injured by Huang Yu, before his death Shi Hao gave his Reincarnation Supreme Being Bone that grew back to Qin Hao.

Qin Hao became the number one genius in the upper realm Qin Clan ranked among  some of the best such as Zhan Tiange, Zhen Lun, etc. he was known as Qin Clan genius with two bones, one the Immortal Bone and the other the Reincarnation Supreme Being Bone, Qin Hao became undefeated in his province and later host the qin clan Yuan tian secret realm inheritance battle, as it was located in qin clan territory.

Qin Hao later enter immortal ancient where he met up  with Shi Hao again and met Shi Yi  for the first time, all three Stone Brothers had an amazing battle against the Six Crown King (Ning Chuan) Refer to Shi Yi .

Qin Hao after the immortal ancient events later entered the Nine Heavens Tenth Earths, heavenly deity academy with Shi Hao and other genius of the Three Thousand Provinces to train, after many events he enter Imperial Pass(Desolate Border)to fight against the geniuses of the foreign realm, in one instance when Cao Yusheng master's turtle physic shell now held by the foreign realm since ancient era randomly select opponent to fight to the death, after the Nine Heavens Tenth Earths side had all loses and no wins Qin Hao was select as the next opponent to fight against one of the king clan genius but Shi Hao step in and somehow rigs the selection process using their supreme bone, as he knew qin hoa would've died. Qin Hao and other younger genius were sent away from the desolate region war back to the academy in fear of loosing all their future prospects.

After the desolate border war when Shi Hao went back to the Three Thousand Provinces and head to the lower realms, during the darkness calamity Ao Cheng grandson goons/servants sent from immortal domain to find secrets techniques in the void realm later swept through all the so called strong cultivator in the self serving realm and target Qin Hao due to him being Shi Hao brother and beat him to inches of his life that took months to recover from.

As time went on and the darkness calamity got worse, immortal domain decided to take in genius and their clans and Qin Hao was also select by a mysterious clan in the Unmanned region of immortal domain where even immortal kings were afraid to dare set foot. it was later revealed that is was due to the 3 immortal bones from a former immortal king, which Qin Hao held  in his body. Later for hundreds of Thousand of years he was never heard from again until Shi Hao became Immortal King Giant and went to rescue him with Darkness Williow deity, Immortal king Coin Uncle, Immortal King Bird Grandpa and others from the Imperial court

Left without the immortal bone and now only the supreme being bone Qin Hao cultivation became slower, though in reality is wasn't that much slower than the others like Witch, Yue Chan, Tian Zi, Exile immortal etc, he became less relevant but still  became a powerful True Immortal at the end of the series, when Shi Hao was fighting three Half-Immortal Emperors in Realm Sea, and was close to being defeated,Qin Hao, Shi Yi, and New Little Stone sacrificed themselves so that Shi Hao could use the essence blood of blood relatives to strengthen himself.

characters.introText: Qin Yining is the mother of Shi Hao and Qin Hao. She was the former Saint of Immortal Mountain in the Three Thousand Provinces of the Upper Realms.
characters.history:
Qin Yining is part of the Qin Clan and originally the Saint of the Immortal Mountain. She was gravely injured by an enemy ambush during her wilderness training. She was then rescued by Shi Ziling and subsequently became his wife, giving birth to Shi Hao. She decided to leave with him in search of her father-in-law, as he has a technique that combines their attacks to reach a higher level.

As soon as she returned to the Wu Palace and saw the state of her son, who reverted back to an infant, she went into despair and followed her husband in search of revenge. The couple was no match against the supreme elders of the Stone Clan and were exiled in the end. But since Shi Hao was still very weak, the couple decided to seek the true ancestral land of his clan so that Shi Hao could recover there. After they arrived there, they were disappointed and moved Shi Hao to Stone Village, while they went in search of a divine remedy that could save him.

During their journey, they decide to have another child, Qin Hao, who serves to help his brother Shi Hao recover from the injuries he suffered. Later, they head to Immortal Mountain, where her original clan lives. Seeing potential in Qin Hao, the clan imprisons both Qin Yining and Shi Ziling so that Qin Hao can't leave the clan.

Shi Hao learns about the location of his parents from Qin Fa, who reveals this information to save his own life. Shortly after, the Qin clan sends the Decree of the Ancestor of the Gods to the emperor's palace, granting them the opportunity to enter into the Immortal Mountain. Here, Shi Hao encounters his brother and confronts Qin Wu, who desperately wants Shi Hao to stay with the Qin Clan. With the help of Little Pagoda, Qin Wu is eliminated, and Shi Hao frees his parents.

Upon returning to Stone Village, the couple express gratitude to Shi Yunfeng for raising Shi Hao.

After Shi Hao is nearly killed by Huang Yu, they are told that the only way to save their son is to find another supreme bone. The only supreme bone they know is that of Qin Hao. The couple is indecisive about what to do, but Shi Hao refuses to let his brother go through what he experienced as a child.

Shortly after Shi Hao's death, they decided to ascend to the upper realm.
characters.trivia: He Wenxiao (贺文潇) is also the voice actor for Shi Qingfeng in the Donghua

He started to train the clans secret body art the Immortal magical body method since he was ten years old, it allows his body to be unbreakable even if he dies his flesh would remain the same. when he appeared he decided to taunt Shi Hao making comments about how Shi Zhongtian were killed making Shi Hao angry and wanting to take revenge, this was a ploy set by Qin Zhan as he needed a powerful foe to temper his body with force hence complete nirvana and during the process steal and engrave Shi Hao abilities in him. Qing Tian is the elder and leader of the Blue Sky Phoenix Clan in the lower realm, a clan with a rich history in the lower realm since ancient times. His clan seemed to have a friendly relation with the Ancient Sacred Mountain and Yun Xi's grandfather Yun Canghai.

He would first exchange blows with Golden Spider in order to decide who will be the one who can slaughter Shi Hao. However, Shi Ziteng decided that both elders should take their personal matters to the military arena instead, in a life and death match against Shi Hao.

He was killed by Shi Hao and Little Pagoda during the match.

characters.title: Qing Xian
characters.introText: Qinq Xian is from the Lotus Race Clan a powerful clan in the upper realm with a long history.  Her clan ancestor is from the Immortal Realm a powerful Immortal King named (Eternal Clear Sky Lotus) in ancient Era during the Foreign Land invasion he disappeared and thought to had been dead, however Shi Hao discovered a hidden small world around the desolate regions with rich immortal energy, in that world were the ancestor and Qing Xian both undergoing rebirth.
characters.history:
Qinq Xian is from the Lotus Race Clan a powerful clan in the upper realm with a long history.  Her clan ancestor is from the Immortal Realm a powerful Immortal King named (Eternal Clear Sky Lotus) in ancient Era during the Foreign Land invasion he disappeared and thought to had been dead, however Shi Hao discovered a hidden small world around the desolate regions with rich immortal energy, in that world were the ancestor and Qing Xian both undergoing rebirth.

During the establishment of the Heavenly Deity Institution from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths and the recruitment test of crossing the deadly desolate region, as the elders stated that there was a 70% chance of death and only those were fated could safely passed the trial, in the end Qing Xian were one of those that fell.

She wore green clothes, her figure elegant and refined, like a divine lotus that was swaying about, releasing its brilliance. That was Qing Xian, someone who could be called a formidable young expert from the Three Thousand Provinces. Back then, when Shi Hao ascended the Void God Realm, ascending the Copper Sparrow Altar to enter the Three Thousand Provinces’ Spirit Realm, he had met her brother and even fought against him.

Qing Xian, an exceptional talent of the Lotus Race, reputation great, even more powerful than Child of Lightning and Underworld Child. She was a well-known female exceptional talent, ranked close to the front. However now, her body couldn’t move, blood flowing out from the space between her brows, her expression full of sadness, the light in her eyes dimming.

Shi Hao wanted to offer a helping hand, but it was already too late.

Qing Xian saw him, her eyes flourishing with radiance, but she still fell in the end. “Truly is cruel.” Shi Hao’s face was expressionless. A well known person from the Three Thousand Provinces died here. However, this path must be treaded on. He walked forward, activating all types of precious techniques to defend himself.

Blood appeared in the space between his brows, because the most crucial intersection had been reached. That formless sword energy crushed down, attacking his soul viciously. He chanted the True Primordial Record from his mouth and activated all types of precious techniques, doing everything he could to resist. His mind sustained some damage to his soul, but he still made it through in the end.

In the sky, a blue-colored great star exploded. That formless sword energy became weaker, no longer being as powerful. At the same time, Qing Xian collapsed onto the ground, quickly shrinking, unexpectedly turning into a seed. “Rebirth?” Shi Hao was shocked. This woman was unordinary as expected, actually not completely destroyed, transforming into a dark green jade stone like seed.

“Please bury me nearby.” A weak voice sounded.

“Bringing you out isn’t necessarily better.” Shi Hao said.

“No, this is my great calamity, and also my opportunity. I can sense the Chaotic Green Lotus’ aura, true traces left behind by him. Please help me.” Qing Xian transmitted sound. When Shi Hao heard this, he raised his head to look towards the great stars in the sky. They were tightly packed, numbering in the tens of thousands, refined by a matchless expert.

“Chaotic Green Lotus?” Shi Hao didn’t understand.

“He doesn’t belong to this great era, but had previously reached the peak of glory, known as an Eternal Clear Sky Lotus. Please help me, there will be reciprocation in the future.” Qing Xian said. “Fine!” Shi Hao said, no longer hesitating. This didn’t take much effort at all, planting this sparkling green seed deep into the not too distant soil.

Then, he continued on his way.

Shi Hao discovered a hidden small world around the desolate regions with rich immortal energy, in that world were the ancestor and Qing Xian both undergoing rebirth. she didn't recognized Shi Hao as she underwent rebirth and lost all her memories. He help both of them and went on his way.

characters.title: Qing Yue
characters.introText: During her lifetime, Qing Yue studied the method of immortality intensively. With her cultivation at the peak of the True Immortal level, she sat down with the two immortal king giants, the Immortal King of the Endless Immortal and the Immortal King of the Six Paths of Reincarnation, to discuss the Tao and practice the method of reincarnation together.
characters.appearance:
That woman was of extraordinary beauty. There was a green moon behind her head, reflecting the heaven and earth. She was like a god from the beginning of the world, overlooking the world. Every frown and every smile is beautiful.

Fairy Qing Yue was very peaceful, holy and flawless. This should be her demeanor and temperament when she was alive. She was very calm even when facing the Lord of the Forbidden Zone.
characters.history:
Qing Yue's talent not only astounded the heroes of the Ancient Era, but also the heroes of the Ancient Era. She was filled with so many mysteries. She had achieved reincarnation and was reborn. This act of defiance was unprecedented and unparalleled. 
It moved the Immortal Taoist Order and amazed the Immortal King.
If this method is successful, the era will collapse, the world will overturn, and she will temporarily dissipate. Sooner or later, she will come back and appear in the world alive.

Not only did Qing Yue successfully return at the end of the Ancient Era, but all her memories and cultivation abilities returned with her. In the world view of Chen Dong's trilogy, no one has ever mastered the method of reincarnation. However, Qing Yue's talent is astonishing, and she mastered the method of reincarnation with the cultivation of a true immortal. It only took an era for her to be reborn and return, with her memory and cultivation still intact.
Qing Yue fell in the last years of the Immortal Ancient.

When she died, her cultivation reached the peak of the True Immortal. She left behind the True Immortal fire in the Huozhou Plain. Later generations called the fire left behind Qing Yue .

characters.history:
Qing Yun is a talented youngster from the Blue Sky Phoenix Clan in the lower realm, and was regarded as a genius. His clan seemed to be closely acquainted with Yun Xi and her grandfather Yun Canghai as shown throughout their interactions.

Yun Xi and her grandfather recruited young Shi Hao due to his ten Heavenly Passage Realm which would activate the opening of the Kun Peng Nest. With Qing Yun having a bird clan bloodline, it made sense to fight for the kun peng inheritance.

Qing Yun became very hostile to Shi Hao from the moment they met. He continued to agonize and plot against him the entire time during their journey to the kun peng nest. Qing Yun ordered everyone to leave Shi Hao for dead on the ghost ship, and even stopped Yun Xi from helping him.

Later, after Shi Hao came out of his seclusion from the Fire and Ice Cave, a cultivation cave, they would met again. Qing Yun continued his hostility, but was killed, and then eaten by the Witch and Shi Batian.

His grandfather Qing Tian would later arrive to take revenge during the Stone Emperor's birthday party at the capital.

characters.title: Rain Clan Ancestor

infobox.Title: Rain Deity
infobox.realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText: Rain Deity is the ancestor of the Rain Clan from ancient times, he was known to be a true genius who's talent rival the best of an era in the Lower Realm regions, unbeatable. The clan in current times was led to believe that he was long dead due to his disappearance back in ancient times.
characters.history:
Rain Deity is the ancestor of the Rain Clan from ancient times, he was known to be a true genius who's talent rival the best of an era in the Lower Realm regions, unbeatable. The clan in current times was led to believe that he was long dead due to his disappearance back in ancient times.

During Shi Hao assault on the Rain Clan manor after entering the Stone Clan capital, the elders being out match decided to use the clans most powerful formation technique known as the Rain Dao’s Nine Heavens, Simply put this formation holds eight powerful technique and the ninth is the projection of their clan ancestor Rain Deity. This formation takes several elders to control, the Sect leader or the strongest elder is the only known individuals to use this technique solo because the consumption is immense, the stronger the individuals the more powerful the formation.

For many years the ninth technique which is the Rain Deity Imprint Projection never appeared because when using this formation it could only produce the projection if the Rain Deity send his projection, with no projection for many years they were led to believe he was long dead so the joy when his projection appeared during the battle with Shi Hao, though very weak it still appeared.

During the cultivation-less era while Shi Hao return back to the lower realms, now a Self-Release expert one day out of the blue heavy wind, lightning, storm swept the Stone Country slaughtering many common people, inside was a projection, precisely the Rain Deity projection return for revenge, this time he was much stronger than before. Shi Hao would face it and easily defeat the projection which left the Rain Deity shocked and decided to retreat, Shi Hao would follow suit entering that hidden realm where the Rain Clan ancestors reside.

In ancient times the Rain Clan ancestors along with some of his clan members and other clans who became deities head out in search for a higher realm, a small portion of them went to the Three Thousand Provinces, but most of them vanished.

After arriving, though the rain god cultivation was deep due to cultivating from ancient times he was still easily suppress. This realm Shi Hao sensed a sea of heaven and earth essence energy, too rich, even richer than the three thousand provinces. This was definitely not a normal place! It was a realm tomb, These hidden realms were in the Three Thousand Provinces, Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, and other places left as a gate entrance to Immortal Domain by powerful Immortal King to used in the future during another darkness calamity. In the end, Shi Hao received confirmation that this was an extraordinary secret land, There was a path here that needed to be protected. When he looked into the distance, there was an expanse of silence, an abandoned star system, a withered heaven and earth. However, the spiritual essence here was extremely rich.

Upon closer inspection, Shi Hao understood that this place was already in ruins, star remains in the distance. This was an ancient place, an abandoned ruined world. Rain Deity, as well as the other creatures from the ancient times had previously arrived here, becoming soldiers to protect this place together. Comparatively speaking, even though Rain Deity was powerful, he could only serve as a soldier here, not standing out at all. However, Rain Clan’s origins weren’t small, this clan still not considered weak. However, in this ruined ancient world, Rain Clan declined, not really any exceptional experts to be seen. Shi Hao would further learn from a powerful figure imprint who appeared from immortal domain that the clans residing here numbered one million and If not for Immortal Domain opening again, about to reappear, this place would have become a land of death.

Only when Desolate Border’s great battle ended that Immortal Domain sensed something, receiving news about it, did the immortal gates finally open, making contact with some ancient lands, for example this place, thus allowing them to be saved. Immortal Domain then took action, continuing to seal the passage! The entire ruined realm’s prosperity and decline was because of a single passage.

After inquiring about a few other things from the mysterious imprint individual Shi Hao ask  if he was allowed to kill the rein deity, the individual replied the Rain Deity went against the rules, casting his projection without permission, killing him  can also be considered a type of predetermined fate. Shi Hao was too decisive. The Everlasting Sword Core swept out. Under Rain Deity’s shocked gaze, a sword stabbed into the space between his brows, killing his primordial spirit, blood splashing all over.

characters.introText: The Ruthless Empress is a legendary figure from Chen Dong's classic xianxia novel, Shrouding the Heavens, and its related works, also appearing in Perfect World and Sacred Ruins. A mystical treasure vase hovers above her, nullifying all laws and bending reality to her will.
characters.appearance: The White-Clothed Empress aka Ruthless Empress, though born in the future, left clear traces across ancient eras. She crossed the long river of time and intervened even in ages far older than her own. She appeared in the Immortal Ancient Great Era as a unique, unmatched woman involved in major events, and in the Age of Emperor Collapse.Traces of her can be find off in Immortal Ancient great era and even before that.
characters.history:
The White-Clothed Empressor Ruthless Empress is she is known is a powerful and exceptional woman whose presence spans multiple eras in the narrative. She is renowned for her magnificent style, otherworldly and aloof immortal aura, and unmatched beauty, which often evokes awe and confusion even among the most powerful experts. Her reputation stretches across time, and her actions have left indelible marks on the course of events.

She first gained attention when she saved Shi Hao on the Immortal Battlefield. Three years before a specific event, she intervened to protect him from a terrifying giant originating from the upper reaches of the great river of time. Her intervention was forceful and decisive, driving back the creature and preventing disaster.

Shi Hao and his companion, the little ant, later encountered her in a time passage within the Realm Grave. She was described as an "empress," whose name was vaguely chanted by all life, even across endless time, signaling her immense achievements in saving the creatures of an entire heaven and earth. In this encounter, she once again protected Shi Hao by pointing her finger and radiating Ascension-level immortal light, locking down the passage. This act came at a cost: her bronze mask cracked, fell, and a drop of her blood trickled down, indicating the heavy price of her interference in time.

Her identity and motives were further pondered during the Imperial Court investigation. Cao Yusheng and Shi Hao noted her repeated appearances in both ancient times and the present, raising questions about whether she had been buried or had concealed herself to appear in this era.

In the Realm Sea, she demonstrated her formidable combat prowess in a major battle against a golden-clothed woman. Her presence was described as stunning and unrivaled, overwhelming her opponent and forcing her to continuously cough up blood, displaying superior combat sense and raw power. In the same battle, she also defeated a silver-haired man, a half-immortal emperor, with a single powerful palm strike. She scattered his primordial spirit light and ultimately forced him into a cauldron to be refined, confirming her status as a peerless immortal.

He has brilliant golden hair that shines like the morning sun and falls over his shoulders, while his pure white, jade-like skin is flawless. His features are so refined that even beautiful women would feel inferior standing beside him. He carries a gentle, warm smile and an aura of serenity that makes others instinctively feel at ease, resembling a sacred deity rather than an undead knight. Despite his kind and elegant demeanor, there is an underlying sense of mystery and danger about him, hinting at the extraordinary power and secrets hidden beneath his flawless appearance

characters.introText: The Scarlet King, also known as the Red King, was an undying king of the foreign realm and a descendant of an Emperor Clan, known for his unparalleled ferocity, mastery of time, and terrifying strength. He was regarded as one of the great giants of the foreign realm, an existence whose might could shake the heavens. His vicious nature, coupled with his insatiable ambition, made him a name feared across both realms. Even among the undying kings, he stood as an unrivaled expert, one who could look down upon entire domains and extinguish countless beings in the Nine Heavens Ten Earths.
characters.appearance: The Scarlet King, also known as the Red King, was an undying king of the foreign realm and a descendant of an Emperor Clan, known for his unparalleled ferocity, mastery of time, and terrifying strength. He was regarded as one of the great giants of the foreign realm, an existence whose might could shake the heavens. His vicious nature, coupled with his insatiable ambition, made him a name feared across both realms. Even among the undying kings, he stood as an unrivaled expert, one who could look down upon entire domains and extinguish countless beings in the Nine Heavens Ten Earths.
characters.history:
The Scarlet King’s power was symbolized by his legendary weapon, the Scarlet King Furnace (also called the Scarlet King Cauldron). This furnace became entirely crimson after being infused with the blood of countless fallen immortal kings during the final years of the Immortal Ancient Era. It was said that he once refined an Immortal King alive, sealing the victim within the furnace until their blood and bones were melted into a bloody paste. This horrifying act earned him everlasting infamy. The furnace itself was tied to a secret bloodline technique, passed down to his descendants, that allowed them to condense a scarlet great furnace directly from their blood energy. The Scarlet King’s clan regarded this as their ancestral method, a sign of their lineage’s savage heritage. In addition to this weapon, he wielded a small bell, an equally fearsome undying king weapon capable of distorting space-time and unleashing chaotic energy.

As a being of immense ambition, the Scarlet King sought to surpass the limits of the Immortal King Realm and step onto the emperor path. To achieve this, he entered a perilous transformation, entering a “half-living, half-dying” state while awaiting a chance at rebirth. During this era of seclusion, he used the dao fruit of an immortal king he had refined to nurture his transformation. He hoped to devour its essence and elevate his dao to an unprecedented level. For countless years, he remained dormant, nursing injuries and waiting for the right moment to revive.

One of Scarlet King’s most formidable powers was his mastery over the domain of time. He was considered one of the greatest temporal cultivators in existence, able to manipulate the great river of time itself. Alongside other undying kings ( they were An Lan and Shu Tuo), he once looked into the future and saw a “bad outcome” for the foreign realm, a future intertwined with Shi Hao (Huang). Determined to prevent this destiny, he stood at the upper reaches of time and attempted to assassinate Shi Hao during his Immortal Ancient Battlefield trial. However, his strike was stopped by a mysterious white-clad woman,Ruthless Emperor from the future, who countered his attack from the lower reaches of time. This defiance of temporal law brought immense backlash—Scarlet King’s body nearly disintegrated, forcing him into dormancy and delaying his long-awaited rebirth. He then used the refined immortal king’s body as sustenance for his eventual return.

When Scarlet King finally began his rebirth, seeking to rise anew and reclaim his strength, fate once again turned against him.Shi Hao invaded his ancestral land during this process and attacked his newly reborn body, slicing off half of it. This devastating blow crippled Scarlet King’s dao foundation and destroyed his hope of ever reaching the emperor realm. He was forced to fuse his divine core back with his decayed old body, sealing his fate as an undying king forever. The assault enraged his bloodline, who threatened war upon all other clans. Even the mighty An Lan and Shu tuo descended to investigate the event, only to learn from Scarlet King himself that Huang was the one who had injured him.

Half a million years later, Scarlet King fully recovered to his peak. Though his dream of ascension was forever lost, his hatred for Huang burned stronger than ever. When they finally met again, he immediately recognized Shi Hao as the “variable” he had seen in the river of time. Their final battle was a monumental clash between fate and defiance, shaking both realms. Scarlet King unleashed his full might, his Scarlet King Furnace, his time techniques, and his dreadful small bell. The bell emitted waves of chaotic light and time ripples, tearing apart reality, while the furnace tried to devour Shi Hao whole. Despite enduring the erosion of time force and severe injuries, Shi Hao shattered the furnace, broke through the king’s defenses, and tore off the Scarlet King’s head. Shi Hao broke through the Scarlet King Furnace and forced his opponent into his original form. In his original form, the Scarlet King appeared as a monstrous creature with the head of a flood dragon, the body of a lion, and blood-red scales that radiated murderous aura.

The end came when Shi Hao shattered Scarlet King’s primordial spirit.Even as his body and spirit were collapsing, Scarlet King warned Anlan and Shutuo that Shi Hao was “that person” the same unpredictable variable they had once tried to erase from the timeline. Shi Hao later detonated the broken Scarlet King Furnace, along with the remains of two other immortal kings, to escape pursuit. When he returned to the Immortal Domain, he carried with him the head of the Scarlet King, shocking both realms. The fall of such a powerful giant caused strange phenomena and panic throughout the foreign realm, as his death marked the end of one of their greatest pillars and Shi Hao forever solidified his reputation as a taboo, unmatched existence

Scarlet King’s bloodline was as cruel and ambitious as their ancestor. Among his descendants were members of the Time Beast Clan, and the Emperor Clan figure Chi Menghong, who directly inherited the Scarlet King’s techniques. Chi Menghong practiced the terrifying Flesh Into Furnace method, a condensed form of the Scarlet King Furnace, but was once defeated and humiliated by Shi Hao, who cut off and roasted his leg in battle. This humiliation echoed the downfall of his ancestor and symbolized the karmic cycle that haunted their bloodline.

characters.introText: Shan Dianzi  is a powerful First-Generation Genius of Three Thousand Provinces in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm), known as The Child of Lightning due to his extraordinary inheritance that was given to him by the heavens at birth.
characters.history:
Shan Dianzi  is a powerful First-Generation Genius of Three Thousand Provinces in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm), known as The Child of Lightning due to his extraordinary inheritance that was given to him by the heavens at birth.

Blessed by the heavens, his story at birth is similar to Ning Chuan when the heaven causes some disturbance, in his case the Child of Lightning was born on the night of a thunderstorm. Back then, a streak of supreme lightning struck down, landing on his head. Not only was he not hacked to death, it refined his body, forming a forbidden symbol on the crown of his head.  This was why he was called the Child of Lightning!

In terms of lightning symbols, none of the secret techniques everyone else grasped could compare. The Child of Lightning had an innate secret method bestowed by the heavens, the Innate Dao Fruit thunder ability.  Such like Shi Hao and others who practice lightning ability and had to get external source (Lightning Fruit) etc to comprehend the law of thunder, since birth law of thunder was innately instill within Shan Dianzi.

Such like Teng Yi and others whose clan declined over time due to the lack of genius successors until they were born, Shan can be place in that group.

He made many appearances during the Yuan Tian Secret Realm arc and became of one of the main rivals that fought with Shi Hao over the Lightning Inheritance. They were fighting over the second golden sheet and the jade book. He was killed by Shi Hao, but he managed to escape by the protection of his lightning pagoda.

Later, he met Shi Hao again in Immortal Ancient's Immortal Dao arena, as a selection to enter Golden Dao Palace (the place containing a lot of immortal ancient inheritance and scriptures). In the last battle, he threw around several dozens of treasures and explode them in attempt to kill Huang, but it was ineffective. Then, he was immediately killed without any suspense by Huang using Willow Deity Precious Technique.

characters.title: Shen Ming

infobox.Title: Shen Ming
infobox.realm: Burial Domain

characters.introText: Shenming is one of the two mysterious Golden Undead Knights from the Burial Earth and a close companion of Sanzang. Although she often presents herself as playful, flirtatious, and seductive, she is highly intelligent, perceptive, and possesses immense strength. She is walking the Path of the Burial Kings, a dangerous cultivation path that has fundamentally changed her while leaving her true self intact. Beneath her charming personality lies a deep awareness of the world's coming catastrophe, making her actions and words far more profound than they initially appear. She develops a friendly relationship with Shi Hao, frequently teasing him while also treating him as someone who may one day stand alongside them.
characters.appearance: Shenming is an extraordinarily beautiful young woman with a flawless and alluring appearance. She has snow-white, jade-like skin that glows with a soft radiance, large, vivid eyes that are both lively and captivating, long eyelashes, a tall, elegant nose, and bright red lips that enhance her seductive charm. Her fiery red hair is smooth and lustrous, flowing over her shoulders and down her back. She possesses a tall, graceful figure with long, slender legs and a swan-like neck, embodying both elegance and sensuality. When she is still, she appears holy and immortal-like, radiating a pure divine aura. However, when she smiles or moves, her beauty becomes irresistibly enchanting, capable of captivating anyone who looks upon her
characters.personality: Shenming is confident, charismatic, and playful, often expressing herself through teasing remarks and open flirtation. She enjoys provoking reactions from others, particularly Shi Hao, but beneath her seductive exterior lies a calm, perceptive, and intelligent individual. She is capable of becoming completely serious when discussing important matters, revealing a thoughtful and melancholic side shaped by her experiences on the Path of the Burial Kings. Despite her mysterious nature, she values those she acknowledges and treats trusted companions with sincerity.

characters.introText: Shenyan Samsara describe as the Reincarnation disk Holder. The Man in the Divine Flame
characters.history:
Shenyan Samsara describe as the Reincarnation disk Holder. The Man in the Divine Flame

The reincarnation disk truly belongs to the "Six Paths Reincarnation Immortal King" from the previous era. This is one of the three giants in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths in the Immortal Ancient Era. He specializes in the Great Way of Reincarnation. Whether this Shenyan Samsara is the reincarnation or descendant of the Reincarnation Immortal King has not been introduced in the novel but, he has an incomplete reincarnation disk, one of the six disk, after all, he has a certain relationship with the reincarnation Immortal King.

Samsara is a unique cultivator which hates to be tied down by sects so he's a lone cultivator in the upper realms doing as he pleases accomplishing his goals, he has three:

1st. Gather all the beautiful women cultivator as his lovers;

2nd. Gather all the powerful and rare techniques;

3rd. Gather a following of powerful cultivators under his command.

Shenyan Samsara appeared in the Void God Realm for two purposes. The first was for Fairy Yue Chan, and the second was to capture the creation of the Void God Realm.
The purpose of Samsara and  Yue Chan's fight was only to test the bottom line of the Void God Realm, and finally after the test, Samsara began to make a move to the Void God Realm.

Generally speaking, the Void God Realm Envoy is an invincible existence in the Void God Realm. Even those who break the extreme realm cannot defeat the Void God Realm Envoy. However, there is a treasure in Samsara, and this treasure is the reincarnation disk. As the weapon of the Six Paths Reincarnation Immortal King, although the reincarnation is only a corner, it is enough to defeat the Void God Realm Envoy In the end, under the attack of Samsara, the Void God Realm Envoy was defeated by Samsara, and Samsara also seized the divine creation in the Void God Realm. Shi Hao, the witch and others also gained some benefits. However, after that, the Void God Realm Lord shot down the divine punishment, and Samsara and others were also driven out of the Void God Realm, and Samsara was forbidden to enter the Void God Realm.

However, for Samsara, the impact of not being able to enter the Void God Realm is not very big, because the Void God Realm is only the entrance to the lower realm, and there is an entrance to the upper realm, and the name of this entrance is called the spiritual realm. Samsara itself is a person from the upper realm like  Yue Chan, so the Void God Realm that cannot enter the lower realm is irrelevant to him at all.

This Divine Flame Man was quite strong at the beginning, Yue Chan could not take him down for a long time, but he took advantage of him a lot, and Shi Hao even used the small tower to deal with him, and finally reluctantly retreated under the persuasion of the small tower. But after that, the Divine Flame Man couldn't do it, and when the Immortal Ancient Ruins of the Upper Realm were fighting for supremacy, he suddenly jumped out and wanted to compete with Shi Hao and other geniuses, he was full of confidence, but he was groundless and self-contained as soon as he struck, and he didn't need Shi Hao to shoot, and the Heavenly Horned Ant clan descendant suppressed him as soon as he moved, and as a result, in the end, the Divine Flame Man couldn't even enter the top ten of the rankings, and after that, the Divine Flame Man didn't have any drama.

The Divine Flame Man is quite strong at first? but stacked up against the real ancient geniuses of the upper realm he falters, and it could be these reasons for his lack of growth, One is to form a cause and effect with the Six Reincarnation Immortal Kings. When he first appeared, Xiao Ta had told Shi Hao that this Divine Flame Man was related to the Six Reincarnation Immortal King, so he could use the reincarnation disk of the Six Reincarnation Immortal King. However, although the effect of using this reincarnation disk is very good, in the future, it will have to pay something back to the Immortal King. But what was the Immortal King's eye on him? That was only his luck and future, and in the end, the Divine Flame Man became very mediocre in the later stages, and he did not even have the qualifications to compete with Shi Hao and others.

Samsara seems to relied on the reincarnation disk a lot, which also limited his growth but had he been aware of, and been able to acquire the other disk from the shattered mountain before his showdown with Shi Hao or entered Immortal Ancient he would've been at the top of the genius list. Only three of the disk location where revealed in the Novel. The six path reincarnation king, friend, "without end" damage bell was also acquire by a cultivator in a cave and elevated him to sect master realm, also, later on the 'without end' bell spirit was taken from Ye Qingxian in later chapters by the restriction lord the Golden Fur Hou who later became Shi Hao mount. If all Six Reincarnation disk were found, though damage, Samsara jn the future would've been able to possible step into the True Immortal Realm realm as shown throughout the series that external power from immortal kings elevated one cultivation level.

characters.history:
The Divine Striking Stone beside Shi Hao (it has been with Shi Hao from before the establishment of Heaven to the ending). He was born in the Divine Garden of the Lower Realm, and his gender is male.

It is a psychic stone that Shi Hao encountered in the Baicao Garden. It was later used by Shi Hao as a weapon to hit it accurately. It can absorb different divine ores or sands to grow, and it is proficient in formations.

After that, he followed Shi Hao into the upper realm, where he swallowed the golden stones, the Destiny Stone, and the Hunyuan Stone. Later, Shi Hao named him: Shi Batian.
Shi Hao never left until he established the Heavenly Court. After sleeping for half a million years, Shi Hao woke up again and was very happy to see the God-killing Stone again in Panwang City. His talent was not as good as that of Red Dragon and Little Ant, but about the same as that of Little Qilin.
Shi Hao personally cultivated him with the fire of the Half-Immortal Emperor and resurrected him to reappear in the world.
But it will take time to recover.

In the end, Shi Hao went to the heaven to explore for 80,000 years and brought back some things. Shi Hao used the treasure brought back by the heaven to resurrect a total of six people (Mu Qing, Taiyin Jade Rabbit, Witch, Emperor Die, Shi Batian, Willow God), and thus entered the realm of the Immortal King.
Since then, he has been staying in Heaven to protect and protect Heaven.

characters.title: Shi Chong
characters.introText: Shi Chong is the 19th prince of the Stone Country and son of the former Stone Emperor.
characters.history:
Shi Chong is the 19th prince of the Stone Country and son of the former Stone Emperor.

During the Lower Realm calamity after his father was captured, the Immortal Mountain clan, Condensation Sect, and Heaven Mending Sect appeared. They were looking to bring the Stone Country under their command and put Shi Chong on the throne as a puppet. He asked Shi Hao for help to drive away their enemies. However, he became upset and enraged after learning that his father chose Shi Hao, an outsider, to be the new emperor. He supported his subordinates' actions to capture "traitor" Shi Hao, despite opposition from his older sister.
