characters.title: Shi Fan
characters.introText: His appearance is very similar to Shi Hao, and he was even mistaken for Emperor Huang Tian.
characters.appearance: His appearance is very similar to Shi Hao, and he was even mistaken for Emperor Huang Tian.
characters.history:
Shi Hao's son was born nine years after Yun Xi became pregnant, an unusually long gestation that greatly exceeded the expectations of everyone around them. His birth took place after Shi Hao had already experienced the extraordinary events surrounding his eight lives and returned to the present era. By this point, Shi Hao had accumulated hundreds of thousands of years of personal experience through his successive lives, although only a fraction of that time had passed in the present world.

His birth immediately attracted widespread attention. The moment he entered the world, divine multicolored light surged through the heavens, the essence of heaven and earth gathered, and countless great dao laws interwove around him. The phenomenon was so extraordinary that even the people of Imperial Court were shocked.

The child was a boy whose physical constitution was extraordinary from birth. His body naturally radiated precious light, his skin possessed remarkable toughness, and he innately contained a tremendous amount of magical force. Even his cry was extraordinary, loud and clear like a golden bell, displaying vigorous vitality far beyond that of an ordinary newborn.

The Little Puppy was particularly astonished by his innate potential and immediately proposed taking him as a disciple, claiming that he could make him the second Without End Immortal King. Even the Restricted Region Lord, an existence accustomed to witnessing extraordinary geniuses, took a serious interest in the child and carefully examined him.

The child's birth was accompanied by a natural phenomenon resembling a heavenly baptism. The great dao descended around him, with countless laws and strands of divine light attempting to envelop his body. However, Shi Hao personally intervened and dispersed these manifestations.

Shi Hao's reasoning was closely connected to his own cultivation path. He followed the principle of “body as the seed”, believing that relying excessively upon the blessings and recognition of heaven and earth was not necessarily beneficial. He was also acutely aware that the current world was approaching an unprecedented catastrophe and that the existing heavenly order might eventually be destroyed.

Consequently, Shi Hao did not allow the world's natural laws to freely baptize his son.This decision demonstrated an important difference between Shi Hao and many conventional cultivators. Rather than allowing his son to rely upon the world's recognition from birth, Shi Hao wanted him to develop his own foundation and path.

Soon after the child's birth, the Five-Colored Sparrow unexpectedly arrived from the Lower Realm. It carried a tiny white cauldron in its beak—the ancient white bone cauldron that had previously been concealed within Stone Village's black-gold cauldron.

The Five-Colored Sparrow explained that the cauldron was an ancient medicinal cauldron once used by an immortal family. It possessed extraordinary medicinal properties and could be used to refine the body, remove impurities, and eliminate certain disasters.

More importantly, the cauldron possessed the ability to preserve a living being for an extremely long period of time. A person sealed within it could enter a dormant state in which the passage of time would no longer normally erode their body and vitality.

The Five-Colored Sparrow therefore suggested that Shi Hao and Yun Xi seal their newborn son inside the cauldron and allow him to emerge in a future era when the world had become more peaceful.

The proposal was made because the current great era was becoming increasingly dangerous. The approaching great showdown threatened to engulf the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, and even Shi Hao could not guarantee his son's safety.

Yun Xi was deeply attached to her newborn son and was unwilling to completely seal him away for an unknown number of years. When the possibility was raised, she became tearful and even expressed her willingness to be sealed alongside him.

Shi Hao ultimately compromised. Rather than completely sealing the child away, he decided that the child would sleep inside the white cauldron and be awakened periodically. Only if an unavoidable catastrophe approached would Shi Hao completely seal the cauldron and have the child preserved for the distant future.

Yun Xi subsequently remained beside the sleeping child, speaking to him every day. From time to time, the child would be awakened, opening his large, bright eyes and looking toward his mother. Yun Xi treasured these moments and remained unwilling to be separated from him.

characters.introText: Shi Li is an elder of the Wu Palace in the Stone Country that was biased toward Shi Yuan's lineage.
characters.history:
Within the lineage elders (宗老), Shi Li was ranked ninth of his generation, along with Second Elder, Fourth Elder, and Fifth Elder Shi Yuan. He respected the old ancestors of the Wu Palace a lot.

After the extraction of the Supreme Being Bone brought Shi Hao to the brink of death, his parents Shi Ziling and Qin Yining returned to the clan two months later to take revenge. Countless servants, geniuses, elders, and old ancestors came out to stop them from destroying the palace and killing more people. Seeing that even an old ancestor generations above was no match for the young Shi Ziling, Shi Yi asked Shi Li to carry him on his back so that he can enter the battlefield. Shi Yi offered to provide aid using the power of his Double Eye Pupil and newly fused Supreme Being Bones, but in the end they were still defeated.

The infamous Master Fifteen Shi Zhongtian returns thirteen years. Shi Li lies about Shi Ziling's whereabouts, angering Shi Zhongtian to seek the truth from the imprisoned relatives and fight his uncles. Among them, Shi Li was deliberately spared but left completely crippled, his cultivation destroyed and his face a bloody ruin. Yet he didn't survive King Wu and Shi Zhongtian's godlike clash, being accidentally killed when he was caught in its aftermath.

After eating the precious corpse of Suanni, and that of an extraordinary Guardian Spirit, his many years of cultivation and accumulated experience gradually erupted. Him, Shi Feijiao, and Shi Shoushan entered the realm of Blood Transformation.

characters.introText: Shi Qingfeng was the child who stood in the place of Shi Hao in exile in the second ancestral land, while the real Shi Hao left with his parents to search for a cure. He and his grandpa were bullied and tortured for years by evil servants bribed by the Rain Clan.
characters.history:
Shi Qingfeng was the child who stood in the place of Shi Hao in exile in the second ancestral land, while the real Shi Hao left with his parents to search for a cure. He and his grandpa were bullied and tortured for years by evil servants bribed by the Rain Clan.

After meeting the real Shi Hao, he decided to change his name to Shi Qingfeng, as he wished he could be as free as the wind in the future and be released from this prison.

Once saved, he decided to follow Shi Hao to the Stone Village. He was not only welcomed as a guest, but also treated with affection and respect, as if he was truly a family member. Their connection strengthened further shortly after, when he accompanied Shi Hao to the Heaven Mending Pavilion. Shi Hao gifted Shi Qingfeng his Talisman, which would allow him to become part of the Heaven Mending Pavilion without the need to pass any tests.

The climax of their extraordinary partnership occurred during the confrontation with Shi Heng. Shi Hao, an attentive spectator, was impressed not only by Shi Qingfeng's skills in decision making, but also his profound intelligence and kindness towards the Stone people. Thus, Shi Hao decided to appoint him as his successor to the throne of the Stone Country.

characters.title: Shi Yuan
characters.introText: His whole body emitted red clouds, like an old fire phoenix. Although he was old, he was still in good spirits and his eyes were like golden lamps.
characters.appearance: His whole body emitted red clouds, like an old fire phoenix. Although he was old, he was still in good spirits and his eyes were like golden lamps.
characters.history:
Shi Yuan is a generation older than Shi Zhongtian. Within the lineage elders (宗老), he was ranked fifth of his generation. He is one of the two elders in charge of the clan, with a very high seniority and a powerful and unfathomably deep cultivation. He rarely shows up in public. He had been cultivating alone and comprehending the profound principles in the ancient caves.

When Shi Yi's Mother brought Shi Hao to the brink of death by transferring his Supreme Being Bones to Shi Yi's body, he desperately defended his great-grandson and asked the elders to spare his life. The people of his lineage were terrified that Shi Ziling would come back to settle the score with them.

Shi Ziling was furious with how the dozen of elders of Wu Palace dealt with his son's case and drew his sword to get justice. Shi Yuan fought Shi Ziling with all his might. He was helped by Shi Yi, who had double pupils and was able to see the origin of many things, pointing to Shi Ziling's weaknesses. In the end, he was defeated and ended up half crippled.

Master Fifteen Shi Zhongtian returns thirteen years later and demands justice for his family. Shi Yuan tries to stop his killing spree but was no match, having his cultivation destroyed in the end.

characters.title: Shi Yunfeng
characters.introText: The old patriarch of Stone Clan once walked out of the wilderness and brought back some bone inscriptions. Living in Stone Village, Shi Yunfeng has studied the power of bone inscriptions for more than ten years.
characters.history:
The old patriarch of Stone Clan once walked out of the wilderness and brought back some bone inscriptions. Living in Stone Village, Shi Yunfeng has studied the power of bone inscriptions for more than ten years.

When Shi Yi's Mother brought Shi Hao to the brink of death to extract the Supreme Bone from the child. Poor little Shi Hao was severely injured and on the verge of death. When his parents returned, they sent him to the ancestral land of the Stone Nation, precisely to the Stone Village, where he was saved by the godly figure Liu Shen. Under the care of Chief Shi Yunfeng, Shi Hao gradually grew up. Shi Hao regarded Shi Yunfeng as his own grandfather and would often search for fierce beast milk for him, making Shi Hao's physique stronger than that of ordinary people from a young age. When Shi Hao grew up and started practicing cultivation techniques and ancient arts, it was Shi Yunfeng who taught him. Therefore, in Shi Hao's childhood, Shi Yunfeng was his guide and the person closest to his heart.

Unfortunately, with the arrival of the Dharma-ending era, the lifespan of everyone was drastically reduced. Even though Shi Hao tried his best to extend Shi Yunfeng's life, he couldn't ultimately allow him to live a second lifetime. In desperation, Shi Hao had to sever the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, transforming into a divine source, sealing Shi Yunfeng within it. He planned to release him when, in the future, Shi Hao ascended above the heavens and shared the ages with him.

Regrettably, all of this was disrupted by the chaos of the Dark Era. In the midst of the great upheaval, both Stone village and Shi Yunfeng were reduced to ashes.

It wasn't until Shi Hao reached the Sacrifice to the Dao Realm that he was able to restore Stone Village and Shi Yunfeng. Since then, Shi Yunfeng, just like how Shi Hao was nurtured initially, cultivated batches of children in the Stone village of the Desolate Emperor's Dao field.

characters.history:
Shi Zhong was one of the many children Shi Hao brought back from the True Emperor City and Heaven Abyss. He also witnessed the destruction of the pass during the Final Imperial War.

Shi Zhong's foundation was indeed exceptionally gifted. As a descendant of the Seven King bloodline , his  physique was already far superior to that of ordinary cultivators. After returning to Stone Village with Shi Hao, he received the Kunpeng Treasure Technique personally taught by Shi Hao. The Kunpeng is one of the Ten Fiends, capable of traversing star seas with a single flap of its wings, its speed unmatched throughout the heavens, possessing both offensive and defensive capabilities, and terrifying destructive power. In the early wars of the Upper Realm, Shi Zhong relied on the Kunpeng Treasure Technique to dominate the battlefield, repeatedly slaying the prodigies of the Longevity Clan, and was a sharp spearhead of the eight hundred disciples.

He was a very loyal and important member of the Imperial Court, becoming one of its foundational pillars in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.

The overwhelming power of the world in the Dharma-ending Age is like a mountain pressing down on the heads of all cultivators in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. In this era, the Great Dao is incomplete, and heaven and earth reject beings from achieving immortality. Even with divine elixirs to prolong life, it's incredibly difficult for cultivators to advance further after breaking through to the Supreme level. Shi Zhong learned Modern Cultivation but later became stuck at the Self Release Realm during the Dharma Ending Age. In the race to become a young Supreme Being like Shi Hao, he switched to the Immortal Ancient Cultivation. Only after more than 5,000 years, with the guidance of the War Spirit Immortal and Ghost Immortals who had joined to protect the Imperial Court and the Nine Heavens,  he finally succeed in becoming a Supreme Being  achieving it together with two other members.

Breakthrough To Supreme being in the 5000years still made Shi Zhong and the rest Young Geniuses advancing Faster  and Stronger than Supremes in the Foreign Realm and Immortal Domain.

Shi Zhong , The Heavenly Hornet Ant  and the Three Thunder Spirits tried refining and fusing with the Nine Heaven's Core Imprint But the Core Imprint was too powerful He died together with two other Thunder Spirits and absorbed by the  Dao.

characters.introText: Shi Zhongtian, known as the Great Demonic God for his infamous unparalled combat prowess, is a powerful elder of the Wu Palace and Stone Country. He is the father of Shi Ziling and a very caring grandfather towards Shi Hao.
characters.history:
Shi Zhongtian embarks on a journey in search of Pixiu blood to aid his grandson in cultivation, but after acquiring the Pixiu pup blood, he was attacked and chased by the parent. He was gravely injured, losing one arm during the struggle, and disappeared for many years.

Thirteen years later, Zhongtian escapes out of the Deep Black Forest, kidnaps a Dragon Scaled Sparrow, and rides it home. Upon returning to the Wu Palace, he is angered by Uncle Shi Yuan and Uncle Shi Li's constant lies. He makes the shocking discovery that his brothers and cousins are imprisoned, his grandson had been terribly wounded by his own blood relatives, and his son disappeared too. Filled with disappointment and rage, he erupts with killing intent. Zhongtian fought his uncles and great-uncles, leaving Shi Li crippled and a few senior elders dead. The clan's strongest fighter, King Wu, tries to subdue Zhongtian, but was beaten half to death, leaving everyone shocked and terrified.

Shi Ziteng then brought over King Yu of the Rain Clan. This deeply upset the elders, because bringing in an outsider to meddle in clan affairs is prohibited. After a fierce battle, King Yu had half his body blown off and tried to retreat back to the Rain King Palace, but he was chased and his clan suffered huge destruction. Jin Zhu was also invited over by Ziteng, unleashing his golden spider spirit body. After defeating his all opponents, Zhongtian decided to head over to the Immortal Mountain to look for his son, and was accompanied by maid A'man.

Zhongtian was yet again met with intent at Immortal Mountain and had to fight his way out. He was then secretly led to the teleportation by Qin Hao, and left for the Upper Realm with A'man.

During his time at the Three Thousand Provinces with the Qin Clan, he fell out with the clan yet again, and was sent to the prison mine on Fiend Island. Meanwhile, A'man was held back due to her amazing aptitude for cultivation, and recognize as a genius. While being suppress as a work slave, Zhongtian found a Great Natural Luck, left by the blood of the demonic emperor Tian. The power resonated and instantly gave him a boost in his cultivation, where he was able to slaughter a few clan members and escape the mine.

Shi Zhongtian went under disguise and later reunited with Shi Hao during the Emperor Tian Yuan's inheritance secret realm battle. After finally leaving Shi Hao to stabilize his cultivation at the Demon Province, his features begun to change drastically. His hand grew back, his hair became black, and his facial features became younger, like a man in his early to mid 30s, full of vitality.

In later events, after Shi Hao returned from the desolate border, Shi Zhongtian and A'man left for Fiend Island to find a Great Natural Luck. Both found it and became successors to a powerful Immortal King inheritance from the Immortal Domain. The only drawback was that they both would be in a state of seclusion lasting for ten thousand years. After the inheritance, both left for Realm Sea Dam to meet up with their mysterious master.

After Shi Hao was besieged, beaten to the brink of death by Aocheng Immortal King , TaiShi Immortal King,  YuanChu Immortal  king  and Golden-Hair Hou King. Shi Zhongtian and A'man awakened as True immortal, Heard the news that he was "Killled" during Breakthrough decided to seek Revenge and plotted assassination against the Ao Clan , TaiShi Clan and Yanchu Clan Geniuses and everyone associated with them.

500,000 years later after Shi Hao "death',  A young man approached and Rescued Shi Zhongtian and A'man who were on the run during an Ambushed from the three Prominent Kings Clans descendant True Immortals,  Shi Zhongtian was shocked and asked who was he, Then A'man with tears answered he was  Little Hao.

During the darkness of Calamity Era, he was sealed up by Shi Hao with the rest of the clan. He was only released again after Shi Hao returned from the New Realm at the end of the series.

characters.introText: Before setting off to find his missing father, Shi Ziling put his son Shi Hao under the care of Shi Ziteng and his wife. He later returned to the Wu Palace and discovered what happened to his Shi Hao. Enraged, he drew his sword and cleared a path filled with blood on Shi Yi's lineage. After defeating the fifth elder Shi Yuan in battle, he approached Shi Yi and broke more than a hundred of his bones instantly, to make up for the pain that little Shi Hao suffered from having his Supreme Being Bones removed from his body. Ziling then threw his golden spear, stabbing Shi Yi's mother to death.
characters.history:
Before setting off to find his missing father, Shi Ziling put his son Shi Hao under the care of Shi Ziteng and his wife. He later returned to the Wu Palace and discovered what happened to his Shi Hao. Enraged, he drew his sword and cleared a path filled with blood on Shi Yi's lineage. After defeating the fifth elder Shi Yuan in battle, he approached Shi Yi and broke more than a hundred of his bones instantly, to make up for the pain that little Shi Hao suffered from having his Supreme Being Bones removed from his body. Ziling then threw his golden spear, stabbing Shi Yi's mother to death.

After this, he fought against several elders and the four supreme elders of the Stone Clan, with his wife Qin Yining. In the end, they were exiled to the desolate lands. He had established an agreement with the supreme elders that if Shi Hao could regain his exuberant life force, they would immediately return his Supreme Being Bones naturally born. But since Shi Hao was still very weak, the couple decided to seek the true ancestral land of his clan so that Shi Hao could recover there. After they arrived there, they were disappointed and moved Shi Hao to Stone Village, while they went in search of a divine remedy that could save him.

During their journey, they decide to have another child, Qin Hao, who serves to help his brother Shi Hao recover from the injuries he suffered. Later, they head to Immortal Mountain, where the clan of Qin Yining resides. Seeing potential in Qin Hao, the clan imprisons both Qin Yining and Shi Ziling so that Qin Hao can't leave the clan.

Shi Hao learns about the location of his parents from Qin Fa, who reveals this information to save his own life. Shortly after, the Qin clan sends the Decree of the Ancestor of the Gods to the emperor's palace, granting them the opportunity to enter into the Immortal Mountain. Here, Shi Hao encounters his brother and confronts Qin Wu, who desperately wants Shi Hao to stay with the Qin Clan. With the help of Little Pagoda, Qin Wu is eliminated, and Shi Hao frees his parents.

Upon returning to Stone Village, the couple express gratitude to Shi Yunfeng for raising Shi Hao.

After Shi Hao is nearly killed by Huang Yu, they are told that the only way to save their son is to find another supreme bone. The only supreme bone they know is that of Qin Hao. The couple is indecisive about what to do, but Shi Hao refuses to let his brother go through what he experienced as a child.

Shortly after Shi Hao's death, the couple decided to ascend to the upper realm.

characters.introText: She was extremely beautiful, her hair shiny and glossy, falling like a waterfall. Her pupils were silver-colored as well, possessing a special type of temperament, as if a beautiful fairy landed in the mortal world.
characters.appearance:
She was extremely beautiful, her hair shiny and glossy, falling like a waterfall. Her pupils were silver-colored as well, possessing a special type of temperament, as if a beautiful fairy landed in the mortal world.

Among the creatures of the other side, she was definitely an exceptional beauty, none of the others could compare to her. In reality, even in the foreign side, she was an extremely well-known young lady, her beauty ranked within the top ten.

“One of the ten great beauties!” Those on the other side said quietly, eyes revealing brilliance.

Beauty, regardless of where it was, would always draw eyes, difficult for them to not be the focal point of attention even if they didn’t want to be, let alone that this was someone ranked the tenth beauty in a generation.
characters.history:
Yin Ling, came from the Grand Ancient Mountain’s Silver King Clan in the Foreign Realm a great beauty and rank as one of the top Genius of the King Clans. she  previously came out, killing a young genius from Sacred Academy. she was ruthlessly killing the Sacred Academy’s disciple. Blood splashed out, yet she was smiling, extremely bewitching and ruthless, moreover even giving out her name, stating that she came from Grand Ancient Mountains’ Silver King Clan, that they could feel free to seek her out for revenge. At that time, just how arrogant was this woman, even more so how cold?. At Great Scarlet Heaven skirmish among the young genius battle from both worlds, after Shi Hao killed the 9th king Clan genius she was again Chosen by the  Immortal Tortoise Shell Fragment. However, at this moment, there was no one now who could replace her. She had to enter the battlefield.

It was because the Immortal Tortoise Shell Fragment was extremely strange, able to affect the fate of a clan. If she went against it right now, or if she withdrew in the middle, it might produce significant changes.One had to understand that in the great gambling battle of the Immortal Ancient Great Era, it was carried out precisely in this type of manner. The effects were too great, many secrets circling about! Normal people all felt great restraining fear towards these Immortal Tortoise Shell Fragments!

After He Ziming appeared the silver-haired woman spoke out again and again, asking He Ziming to enter the battlefield, her words even more so carrying contempt, saying that when He Ziming took action, he could easily kill that servant. The one she was humiliating was naturally Huang.

Shi Hao[Haung] would taunt them about finalizing his 10th victory such He Zimming became some what displease call over Yin Ling stating he had a gift for her, with a serious expression He Ziming produce a Jar container with drop of his ancestral He Wushuang True Essence battle blood.

She would fight a great battle Heaven and earth became silvery-white, dazzling to the extreme, silver liquid flowing about. The great earth melted, void also collapsing. This was Silver Clan’s ability, able to turn everything into silver and use it for themselves. They could use this to trap and kill opponents, wipe out all enemies but in the end lost her life and became the 10th ingredient in Shi Hao soup pot.

characters.title: Stone Emperor
characters.introText: Stone Emperor is a powerful cultivator and leader of the Stone Clan in the Lower Realm (Eight Regions)'s Desolate Region. Like most emperors, he has many wives and nineteen children. The most notable are the 16th Princess and the 19th Prince Shi Chong.
characters.history:
Stone Emperor is a powerful cultivator and leader of the Stone Clan in the Lower Realm (Eight Regions)'s Desolate Region. Like most emperors, he has many wives and nineteen children. The most notable are the 16th Princess and the 19th Prince Shi Chong.

Stone Emperor is said to be a capable leader and respect power overall. He stood up for Shi Hao on multiple occasions, when he was being bullied by Golden Spider, who was much more powerful than Shi Hao. Stone Emperor always welcomed powerful cultivators as guests, to the point where there are arenas for life and death fights to settle disputes around the military fields at the palace. As shown at his birthday party, he followed the Stone Country's state law and allowed Shi Hao, Master Golden Spider, and Master Qing Tian to settle their dispute at the arena without objection.

After the duel and crowning of Shi Hao as Marquis Huangtian (Heavenly Wasteland Lord), per Shi Hao request, he allowed the battle for Shi Yi and Shi Hao to take place.

During the Lower Realm calamity, Stone Emperor was captured by the medicine field theory and taken to the Upper Realm (3000 Province), to Sin Province. It is unknown whether he was in the Sin Province when Shoutou, the undying king from the foreign domain, carved out Sin Province during the war at the desolate border and brought it over to their side to turn the entire population into creatures of darkness.

The Beast was injured and thus became a sought after prize by countless beast in the great wilderness, the lion was hunted down relentlessly by his two main enemies Lihuo Bull Demon and Gorilla Wing Demon. During it pursuit the Lion pretended to be on its last leg but it was a trap set to go out in a blaze of glory, it set a powerful formation to killed his two powerful enemies along with himself.

The Body was taken by Shi Hao and used as a foundation for his Blood Transformation Realm medicinal bath.

characters.title: Suo Gu
characters.introText: Suo Gu was a descendant of the undying king Shutuo and a member of the so-called Six Small Emperors — a group of six young Emperor Clan geniuses who had once been refined together with Shi Hao in the same Gu Clan Yin Yang Furnace, making them old, bitter enemies from that shared history. Their feud predated the battle at Imperial Pass: the two had previously fought over a rotten wooden chest at the borders of Burial Earth near the Divine Medicine Mountain Range, with Suo Gu and other foreign cultivators later chasing Shi Hao into the Heavenly Beast Forest in an attempt to kill him.
characters.history:
Suo Gu was a descendant of the undying king Shutuo and a member of the so-called Six Small Emperors — a group of six young Emperor Clan geniuses who had once been refined together with Shi Hao in the same Gu Clan Yin Yang Furnace, making them old, bitter enemies from that shared history. Their feud predated the battle at Imperial Pass: the two had previously fought over a rotten wooden chest at the borders of Burial Earth near the Divine Medicine Mountain Range, with Suo Gu and other foreign cultivators later chasing Shi Hao into the Heavenly Beast Forest in an attempt to kill him.

At Imperial Pass, Suo Gu joined Wu Kun, Yu Yu, and Qing Kun in surrounding and attacking Shi Hao together after he killed Chi Menghong, refusing to let Shi Hao claim the Time Beast's corpse unchallenged. During the four-on-one battle, Suo Gu unleashed a domineering fist strike infused with golden five-colored brilliance, described as containing full ancestral divine might, striking at Shi Hao's back while he was occupied facing Yu Yu head-on.Shi Hao met the blow without turning around, countering with his elbow using the Lightning Emperor Precious Technique, resulting in a devastating exchange of fist and lightning.

Later in the engagement, Shi Hao deliberately allowed Suo Gu's fist to strike his back, using the impact to bind Suo Gu in place with the Willow Deity Technique — a golden willow tree manifesting from his back to entangle him and prevent his withdrawal.Declaring that it was time to settle their old grievance over the wooden chest, Shi Hao tore Suo Gu's body in half with his bare hands.

Though his physical body was destroyed, Suo Gu's true spirit escaped into his ancient pagoda an extraordinary magical artifact carrying near-supreme-being level aura, which then attempted to crush Shi Hao from above. Shi Hao met the pagoda with the Everlasting Sword Core, sending it flying, and declared that Suo Gu's "last hope of survival has been squandered."The remaining three Emperor Clan experts (Wu Kun, Yu Yu, Qing Kun) rushed to protect the pagoda, recognizing that if Suo Gu's true spirit remained intact within it, Emperor Clan revival methods might still restore him.

They arrived too late. Shi Hao unleashed his lightning divine ability to its limit, and the Everlasting Sword Core forcibly expelled Suo Gu's remnant spirit described as only a lone, incomplete will rather than a full primordial spirit — from the pagoda. In beast form (his true, original appearance), Suo Gu's spirit was instantly devoured and burned to ashes by the golden lightning-flame, ending him permanently.

characters.title: The Five Elements Mountain
characters.introText: Five Elements Mountain possessed five enormous peaks, with each peak embodying one aspect of the Five Elements. The mountain was immense and majestic, with Chaos Qi continuously descending from its body like waterfalls. Its existence was closely connected to the fundamental laws of the Five Elements.
characters.appearance:
Five Elements Mountain possessed five enormous peaks, with each peak embodying one aspect of the Five Elements. The mountain was immense and majestic, with Chaos Qi continuously descending from its body like waterfalls. Its existence was closely connected to the fundamental laws of the Five Elements.

The mountain was not merely a geographical formation. It possessed spiritual intelligence and could communicate with other powerful beings. At an earlier stage, its consciousness was relatively immature, resembling an artifact spirit. However, after countless years of development, its true spirit eventually manifested, becoming vastly more powerful and mature.

Five Elements Mountain was born within primordial Chaos during the Age of Creations. Its body naturally contains traces of the innate Great Dao.

Throughout the unimaginably Unlike an ordinary mountain or a weapon forged by a cultivator, its existence is inherently connected to the primordial laws of the world. Its body contains profound Five Elements Dao principles, and throughout its immeasurably long existence, it even gave birth to numerous innate divine beings.  This was one of the reasons its origins are considered extraordinary even among ancient immortal treasures. At certain moments, visions of countless primordial gods and demons could appear around it, while their remains are buried within or carried by the mountain. Because of its primordial origin, the Five Elements Mountain is fundamentally different from weapons forged by cultivators.
characters.personality:
Five Elements Mountain's relationship with Shi Hao eventually changed because after He found out that he has a maternal connection with Qin Clan, Also as an act of forgiveness for attacking him and little Pagoda in the lower realm letting the Kun Peng Zi escaped.

Before  Shi Hao returned to Eight Regions, A Ruined True Immortal from Immortal Palace  came to cripple to  him thus The Five Elements Mountain decided to protect Shi Hao form the attack. This severed the old and created a new good karmic connection between the two.

Many years later, after Five Elements Mountain had suffered catastrophic damage, Shi Hao encountered it again.

The mountain had been reduced to a severely damaged state and was buried deep beneath the earth, sleeping and isolated from the outside world. He was Shocked and recognized Shi Hao, the youngster that once he tried protect all his against the Immortal Breaking Curse but still could not do much, yet he had become an Immortal King.

Shi Hao remembered the protection it had once provided him and repaid this old favor. Using his powerful cultivation and Immortal King-level flames, Shi Hao personally helped repair Five Elements Mountain's shattered body. He refined its broken remains and supplemented them with rare heavenly materials.

Afterward, Five Elements Mountain was restored. The mountain explained that it had been severely injured during a battle involving powerful beings from the Sea Realms, including an existence at the level of a Immortal King giant

After its restoration, Five Elements Mountain considered remaining hidden from the conflicts of the world.

However, it ultimately chose to accompany Shi Hao.

Rather than hide, why not  I go with you to the Immortal Domain?”

Thus, Five Elements Mountain became associated with Shi Hao's Heavenly Court

characters.title: Three Stone Monarch
characters.introText: To understand the three stone Heavenly monarch first we need to take a closer look at the Heavenly Fate Stone. Three Stone Heavenly Monarch is the number one genius and the future of the celestial clan rest on his shoulders. It was said he was from ancient era and after fusing with the three heaven mandate stone, went into seclusion or rather deep sleep for a long time and woke up in current era not aging, his mental also didn't evolve, he was still the same young man, age same as the current generation's You Yu, Yun Xi etc. His unique case could be describe as somewhat similar to Immortal Qin.
characters.appearance: He is the same age as You Yu
characters.history:
To understand the three stone Heavenly monarch first we need to take a closer look at the Heavenly Fate Stone. Three Stone Heavenly Monarch is the number one genius and the future of the celestial clan rest on his shoulders. It was said he was from ancient era and after fusing with the three heaven mandate stone, went into seclusion or rather deep sleep for a long time and woke up in current era not aging, his mental also didn't evolve, he was still the same young man, age same as the current generation's You Yu, Yun Xi etc. His unique case could be describe as somewhat similar to Immortal Qin.

He was first mention by Qi Daolin explaining to Shi Hao that the Celestial Clan wasn't simple and had a history. Qi Qdaolin went on to explained that previously in history, there was a youngster who merged with three Heaven’s Mandate Stones, known as Three Stone Heavenly Monarch. There were six great celestials in the archaic era, but that was still only six single Heaven’s Mandate Stones. The fact There was someone who unexpectedly merged with three pieces of Heaven’s Mandate Stone alone was heavenly. His aptitude was only normal though, not an exceptional talent. Before he merged with them, he was obscure and unknown, However, after undergoing three perfect transformations, no matter how lacking his aptitude was, he still became unimaginably powerful. Rumor has it that his whereabouts were lost after he explored some Immortal Ancient ruins, hence why he wasn't around when Shi Hao got captured.

The Three stone heavenly Monarch never had any major roles in the novel or rather one vs one confrontation with Shi Hao though he was always mentioned and stayed unanimous most of the times. He also entered Immortal Ancient to fight for natural luck and were mention again where he and Yun Xi spoke about Shi Hao. In another area of historical remains, a purple-clothed girl sighed softly. She also heard the rumors outside, learning of Huang’s rise, how he hunted down heavenly deities. Moreover, it was still continuing right now. That person was unstoppable, killing who knew how many heavenly deities, to the extent where there were even those from her clan!. Yun Xi looked at these remains, saying with a sigh, “I knew you would rush into the skies one day, but I never expected you to be this domineering, directly entering the nine heavens. I believe those great ones in the clan are probably feeling regret now... Only, your situation is also becoming more and more dangerous. She looked distracted, emotions complex. Immediately afterwards, she became lost in her thoughts.

This person is indeed extremely formidable, even more powerful than those I saw in the ancient times!” There was a youth in the remains. He sat on a large purple-colored stone, staring at the red clouds in the horizon. Three Stone Senior, even with your terrifying strength, could it be that you are going to challenge him?” Yun Xi was shocked, asking in this way. I don’t wish to anymore.” This youth shook his head, and then said, “I slept for an extremely long amount of time, my mental age not that much greater than you all, so there is no need to call me senior. If there were others here, they would definitely feel incomparable shock. This person was the Three Stone Heavenly Monarch that had disappeared in the endless river of time!. In the archaic era, the Celestial Race rose up because of their six great matchless celestials, and that was why they were known as an Emperor Race. Those six individuals had previously accepted Heaven’s Mandate Stones. In later generations, the clan had a disciple who obtained three pieces of the Heaven’s Mandate Stone alone, shaking past and present, titled Three Stone Heavenly Monarch! This person was extremely strong, deep and immeasurable, praised as the Celestial Clan’s Lord of Restoration. However, later on, he disappeared mysteriously, never appearing again.

During the Final Natural Luck Showdown when the few top genius such as Shi Hao, Shi Yi, Tian Zi, Ning Chuan, etc etc fought in an all out battle royal the three stone heavenly monarch was also among them. Over time Shi Hao became a torn in Celestial Clan side, slaughtering and pillaging whenever he was given the chance  to where the clan was in fear of annihilation. The three stone heavenly monarch made many more low profile appearances in the series. Shi Hao became powerful and decided to visit their clan once again, the clan was like a lamb, quiet and domicile willing to adhere to his every demand in fear or total eradication, they look to Three stone monarch and You Yu but his response was Hao was now to powerful and he is no longer his opponent only death await if he acted.
characters.trivia: He is the same age as You Yu

characters.history:
In the Novel Shi Hao encountered this beast in the Immortal Ancient, accompanied by his master Qi Bing.

Qi Bing took initiative and sent his Three-Headed Hound against Shi Hao, but the latter brought it down with a single blow, despite being in the Divine Flame Realm.

When Hong Huang revealed to Shi Hao that Qi Bing was a subordinate of the Divine Dark Child, Shi Hao was perplexed, as he didn't know anyone by that name. He asked if the Divine Dark Child was stronger than the Underworld Child he had previously defeated. This exchange stunned everyone, making it clear that their enemy was Huang, the killer of one of their allies in the Yuan Tian Secret Realm. Qi Bing stiffened, and when Shi Hao declared he would eliminate the Divine Dark Child as he had done with the Underworld Child, Qi Bing grew furious, calling him too arrogant and threatening that the Divine Dark Child would crush him mercilessly as soon as he found him.

As he prepared to flee using a scroll, Shi Hao pursued him with the Void Halberd and killed him, emphasizing that he couldn't escape once he had decided to kill him. 
However, just before dying, Qi Bing used a bone mirror to reveal to the Divine Dark Child the appearance of the one who had killed him.
characters.trivia: In the donghua, this character takes on the role of Qi Bing, causing Qi Bing to not appear in the donghua.

characters.title: Three-Headed King
characters.introText: The Three-Headed King is a powerful and terrifying creature, few in number but exceptionally strong. It is known as a nightmare-level existence, tyrannical and cruel, with an unmatched reputation. This creature is described as a massive spider, several dozen zhang(Meters) in length, with a mottled body of mysterious and bright five-colored patterns. It possesses three heads a golden spider head in the middle, a black lion head on the left, and a normal human head on the right. Each head is associated with a great dao flower, symbolizing its ability to cultivate three strands of immortal energy, an extraordinary feat that makes it stand above countless others of its generation.
characters.appearance: The Three-Headed King’s appearance is both majestic and horrifying. Its massive body is covered in ancient patterns that shimmer with an ominous glow, and its eight legs are sharp and flexible, allowing it to move with terrifying speed. The fine spider hairs covering its legs can become rigid like steel needles during battle, sharper than heavenly deity weapons and capable of piercing through almost anything. In addition to this, it possesses an exceptional regenerative ability, able to regrow missing limbs without suffering a loss in vitality. Its body is unlike that of ordinary creatures composed of unique materials that blur the line between flesh and divine metal.

characters.introText: The Lightning Emperor was a legendary figure known for his mastery over lightning and was considered one of the later experts who rose with tremendous potential, earning a place among the Vicious Ten. He was rumored to be immortal and originated from a vast, boundless uninhabited region, separate from the higher realms' three thousand provinces. His origins were so taboo that ancient records about him became scarce over time
characters.appearance:
Lei Di is a character from Perfect World, the fantasy novel written by Chen Dong, as well as its various adaptations. He is one of the Primordial Era’s “Ten Fiends,” the youngest among them and the only one with a human form. Known for his exceptional potential, he commands the power of Thunder Punishment and is regarded as an executor of Heaven’s will.

Lei Di is one of the Primordial Ten Fiends. As the youngest and only humanoid member, he controlled the Thunder Pool and presided over killing and destruction. His immense potential earned him the title “Thunder Emperor.” He wielded the power of lightning and was said to act on behalf of Heaven, embodying the will of the heavens. His origins are mysterious; he is suspected to be a peerless powerhouse of the Thunder Spirit lineage, originating in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths and surviving into the Chaotic Ancient era.

Near the end of the Immortal Ancient era, Lei Di was ambushed and besieged by multiple Immortal Kings from the foreign realm and died prematurely. His death was tied to karmic consequences involving heavenly tribulation, as his mastery of tribulation power conflicted with the laws of Heaven and Earth. One epoch after his death, the Thunder Spirit Clan discovered his remains. In the later part of the Chaotic Ancient era, they brought his body into the Immortal Domain and buried him in the Reincarnation Grounds, hoping for his eventual rebirth.

Lei Di had no fixed clan but once subdued the Thunder Spirit Clan. After his death, the Thunder Spirit Clan spent an entire epoch searching for his remains, and hundreds of Thunder Spirits eventually carried his body into the Immortal Domain for burial. His inheritance was left within his imperial palace until the Yuantian Supreme discovered it and relocated it to the Yuantian Secret Realm. Shi Hao later acquired the complete Thunder Emperor Divine Art and the Thunder Emperor Armor there, becoming Lei Di’s successor.

Lei Di’s power centers on his mastery of the supreme laws of thunder, earning him recognition as a sovereign of the Thunder Dao. His inheritance consists of the Thunder Emperor Divine Art and the Thunder Emperor Armor. The Thunder Emperor Divine Art is one of the Ten Fiends’ supreme techniques and represents the highest mysteries of the Thunder Dao. Known techniques include Nine Heavens Tribulation Light, Thunder Punishment, Lightning Transforming into Stars, and the Thunder Emperor Finger. When cultivated to the extreme, the practitioner can wield heavenly tribulation itself.

The Thunder Emperor Armor is Lei Di’s personal equipment. After his death, the armor absorbed his lingering resentment, developing a corrupting tendency that could influence prodigies of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths toward the foreign realm. The complete Thunder Emperor Divine Art was later retrieved from the Thunder Emperor Palace by the Yuantian Supreme and placed within the Yuantian Secret Realm, where Shi Hao eventually obtained both the art and the armor.
characters.personality:
In the ancient past, the Lightning Emperor rose as one of the Vicious Ten the youngest among them and widely regarded as one of the later experts with the greatest potential. His command over lightning was so profound that he was called the enforcer of heaven’s law, an incarnation of heaven’s will itself. He wielded lightning pools and fought with unmatched ferocity, earning the title “Lightning Emperor.” His talent was so extraordinary that if he had been allowed to reach his peak and become a king, even the undying kings of the other side would have felt great dread. Precisely because of this terrifying potential, they went all out against him, dispatching more than one undying king to ambush him on the battlefield. There, he died miserably at an early age an untimely and tragic fall, and a great pity to all who knew his name.

Yet even in death, the Lightning Emperor was not abandoned. The Lightning Spirits an exceedingly rare clan whose total numbers throughout history amounted to only a few hundred shared deep karma with him, for they fed on lightning and regarded him as their sovereign. Generation after generation, they searched for his remains, driven by unwavering loyalty. In the end, they succeeded. They placed his corpse on an ancient straw mat stained with blood and marked by the traces of time, and carried it through a void crack opened by their sincerity. They brought him to the Heaven Connecting Land, a mysterious realm said to connect heaven, spirit, past, and present, and laid him to rest in an ancient cave filled with primal chaos, immortal mist, and dense spiritual essence. There, for a thousand years, nearly the entire clan several hundred Lightning Spirits stood guard, weeping in incomparable sorrow. One of their golden leaders, several meters long, raised its head and roared in grief and fury toward the sky, while the others remained immersed in their mournful vigil.

When Shi Hao arrived, a thousand years after he first witnessed the Lightning Spirits carrying the blood-stained mat into the Immortal Domain, he found the cave unchanged. Inside, the little dog that once served the Without End Immortal King confirmed the identity of the corpse with only two words: “Lightning Emperor.” By that time, every drop of the Lightning Emperor’s essence blood had been lost, his life force was completely gone, and not a single soul fragment remained. The little dog stated plainly that any conventional attempt at revival would fail. The Restricted Region Lord agreed, noting that without essence blood or soul remnants, even the special properties of the Heaven Connecting Land could not restore him through ordinary means. He offered only a distant possibility: if the corpse were buried there and nurtured for endless ages, it might one day gain sentience and give rise to another unmatched expert a faint hope, but a hope nonetheless.

Shi Hao, who himself carried a remnant of the Lightning Emperor’s inheritance in the form of a broken piece of armor, walked forward and solemnly paid his respects to the fallen pride of heaven. The gesture created a silent bond between him and the grieving clan; the Lightning Spirits’ gazes softened slightly, acknowledging the respect shown to their fallen emperor. They continued their thousand-year vigil, remaining loyal even in death.

The name of this character is taken from the English translation of the novel, but it would actually be more accurate to call his  Heaven's Child (天子 - tiān zǐ).
"天" (tiān) means "Heaven".

"子 " (zǐ) means "child," "son,".

In Ep 163 of the donghua some translation had his name different from the novel which translate to Shi Guanwang they translated Ten Crown King (十冠王 - Shí guān wáng) with the pinyin.
"十" (shí): This character means "ten" in Chinese.

"冠" (guàn): This character primarily means "crown" or "championship." In this context, it refers to a title or a championship win.

"王" (wáng): This character means "king" or "ruler." It is often used metaphorically to indicate a person or team that is dominant or superior in a particular field.

In the Sacred Ruins the Ten Crown King was a fearsome Half-Immortal Emperor, capable of taking on many opponents at once. During the final battle of sacred ruins he fought crazily and with  overwhelming might that the Quasi-Immortal Emperors of the darkness dared not approach him. Had he not perished midway and instead remained in the world to recover and cultivate until the present era of sacred ruins, he would have been fully capable of advancing onto the Immortal Emperor path.

Shi Yi and the Ten Crown King are portrayed as possessing nearly equal talent and strength in both Perfect World and The Sacred Ruins, with Shi Yi barely holding a slight advantage due to his Double Eye Pupil, a trait that renders him nearly invincible among peers of the same realm. In the final chapter of The Sacred Ruins, both characters are depicted as having attained the  status of Immortal Emperor and engaging in a composed exchange and discussion of the Dao that is presented as a friendly confrontation.

In the final battle of the Sacred Ruins, he attempted to forcibly break through to the Immortal Emperor realm. However, he was besieged and stopped by many strange-race Half-Immortal Emperors wielding Immortal Emperor weapons, and his breakthrough was forceful and  violently interrupted and stopped leading to his dismiss.

Initially, she had a decaying, death energy-covered form with rotting wings, but upon entering the sacrificial holy land within the Ancient Burial Region, her appearance transformed to a divine and youthful state, eliminating the decaying aura.

She explained that this transformation was due to the sacrificial holy land reflecting her true self and that after leaving the burial region, she would revert to her death energy form

characters.title: Undying Being
characters.introText: Undying Being(bumie) or brother Eternal as Shi Hao would call him. Rumor has it that this existence is the posthumous child of an unmatched creature from the most ancient era, and perhaps related to the Kun Peng. The undying being was known for its viciousness and willing to take on many opponents, this confidence came from the fact he was Undying, unless both bodies destroyed at the same time, the other body would resurrect the other and the benefits of being resurrected was immeasurable.
characters.history:
Undying Being(bumie) or brother Eternal as Shi Hao would call him. Rumor has it that this existence is the posthumous child of an unmatched creature from the most ancient era, and perhaps related to the Kun Peng. The undying being was known for its viciousness and willing to take on many opponents, this confidence came from the fact he was Undying, unless both bodies destroyed at the same time, the other body would resurrect the other and the benefits of being resurrected was immeasurable.

He created and practices the true version of the Divine Split Fetus Technique , not the loose version Di Chong and Yue Chan currently has. Few differences that separate the real from the fake is when one of the undying body's is killed he gain further enlightenment that further his cultivation the loose version does not, also there is no issues with the Primordial spirit no matter how long both bodies are separated, cannot say the same for the loose version, There is a time limit both bodies need to recombined other wise both bodies spirit begins to harmed.

Shi Hao and Little Pagoda first came across the undying being after appearing at Immortal Mountain via Ancestral Gods' Decree, the pagoda sense its existence under Five Phase Mountain and gave it a helping hand. The Undying being was imprison there by many Upper Realm giants of the Three Thousand Province. During his escape he befriended Shi Hao, Pagoda and Willow Deity which saw them leave together to explore a mysterious entrance that opened, a road map that possible leads to the Primordial Gate Uninhabited region.

His goals where to become a powerful enough being to destroy the giants of the upper realms (Three Thousand Province) before leaving for the higher realms he help Shi Hao in battle a few times including killing all the Divine Flame Realm experts and accompanying him to the summit of geniuses from the upper realm at mount Heming. After a a few blows with Min Ru , Kun Ye ,Qin Shenhuo and Rattan Vine, the Undying made his appearance and killed them all.

Having the Split fetus technique and his first body imprison in the Lower Realms, his main body is disguise as an old man of a shabby Kun Gate Sect in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. Shi Hao needed a sect talisman to enter  Immortal Ancient and exchange the Golden Peng Technique he got Heaven Mending Pavilion for the talisman, The elder mention that the sect has connection to the Kun Peng Tribe and it was a shame it wasn't the Kun Peng Technique.

After entering the Upper realm  he had entered Desolate Boarder to look for opportunities as stated by Qi Daolin. During Immortal Ancient when Shi Hao was being chase frantically the Undying being projection appeared to all the sects powerhouses and said that if they killed Shi Hao he would take revenge and slaughter their sect as Hao was the younger generation he admire the most.

After the Immortal Ancient ended, Shi Hao was surrounded by all the powerful clans including Immortal Palace, Demonic Sunflower Garden, War Clan, Heavenly Kingdom, Demon Dragon Sect, Sword Valley, Underworld Earth’s sect, etc. He appeared alongside Qi Daolin and Willow Deity Imprint and Qin Clan, Heaven Mending Sect, Sky Severing Sect,  and others to protect him. He fought a great battle but was out match after being surrounded then his second body appeared the old man from the Kun Gate Sect. After the battle he left for the uninhibited regions and was never heard from again.

characters.title: Undying Mountain
characters.introText: While Shi Hao entered the Foreign Realm via Ye Fan true blood essence he would wonder around searching for the truth of the war between worlds. Later, an old eccentric daoist who was doing the same told him of the Undying Mountain and the carvings on the walls which tells some of the history.
characters.history:
While Shi Hao entered the Foreign Realm via Ye Fan true blood essence he would wonder around searching for the truth of the war between worlds. Later, an old eccentric daoist who was doing the same told him of the Undying Mountain and the carvings on the walls which tells some of the history.

Countless cultivators would try their luck by climbing the stir path in hopes of reaching the top and enter the Undying mountain in order to gain Natural Luck and get nurtured by an Undying Being.  Anyone from the younger generation can ascend the step but only those with Immortal Energy Strand are able to reach the top, the higher one goes the more difficult the pressure becomes until one releases their energy strand lessening the burden.

Shi Hao would meet Mo Xian at the top and she would explain that after ascending to the top There were a few monuments there with inscriptions and stone engravings on them. If one’s strength was great enough, they could activate immortal energy to activate the monument, open up a passage to see the undying being.

Once one goes to see the undying being, return may take countless years  all the way until one’s cultivation succeeds. Once this Undying Mountain activated, it could connect to another heaven and earth, forming an ancient path. Only those who cultivated immortal energy could enter. That was a pure land where undying beings resided, the world where unmatched creatures lived. Having the qualifications to enter, being guided by undying beings, this was undoubtedly tremendous natural luck.

characters.title: Unnamed Elder

When he and his companions were chasing Shi Hao to kill him they ended up falling into a trap of him, he was devoured by a Dragon Fish while his companion lost his both legs becoming a cripple while saving him.

characters.title: Venerable Minghe
characters.introText: He is an elderly man with long, slicked-back white hair that flows neatly behind his shoulders, giving him a dignified and authoritative presence. Thick white eyebrows frame his brown eyes, while a long, full white beard and mustache extend past his collar, reinforcing his venerable appearance. Deep wrinkles across his forehead and around his eyes and mouth reflect both his advanced age and the many years of experience he has accumulated.
characters.appearance:
He is an elderly man with long, slicked-back white hair that flows neatly behind his shoulders, giving him a dignified and authoritative presence. Thick white eyebrows frame his brown eyes, while a long, full white beard and mustache extend past his collar, reinforcing his venerable appearance. Deep wrinkles across his forehead and around his eyes and mouth reflect both his advanced age and the many years of experience he has accumulated.

His expression is solemn and intense, with his gaze directed slightly upward and his mouth partially open, as though he is speaking, reacting to a significant event, or expressing surprise. Despite his age, he carries himself with the bearing of a powerful and respected elder.

He is clad in ornate green and bronze armor adorned with intricate traditional motifs, scrollwork, and finely crafted metallic details, suggesting both high status and formidable strength. Behind him stands an elaborate throne or ceremonial structure decorated with matching metallic patterns, while large golden wing-like ornaments on either side create a majestic backdrop that further emphasizes his authority and prestige.

characters.history:
The Void God Realm Envoy Is the spirit that was given permission to  oversee the entire Void God Realm, he's responsible for law and order, protecting the individuals from external forces should they occurs, set battle match and so forth.

He made his first appearance when Shi Yi and Shi Hao exchanges blow at the Demon Spirit Lake Clan in the void realm. The battle were fierce that it causes destruction to the surrounding areas thus an official match was reschedule a month later at an official battle field.

The void envoy were the target of Shenyan Samsara, unbeknown to the envoy, samsara disguised his true intentions by targeting Yue Chan and Shi Hao but as their fight went on his true goals were revealed. Samsara and the envoy fierce battle ensued for many round but with the power from the void realm the envoy gain the upper hand, Samsara had no choice but to use his ultimate Six Path Reincarnation Technique killing the envoy and stealing his dao essence which gives a higher enlightenment furthering one cultivation.

The envoy master was furious and appeared with the intention of killing Shenyan Samsara and Shi Hao, both individual escape with their lives.

characters.title: Void King Beast
characters.introText: The Void King Beastis an awe inspiring and fearsome creature originating from the   “other side”  a Foreign Realm distinct from the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. Possessing a king level bloodline, it stands far above the impure descendants occasionally seen within the mortal realms. This race embodies the apex of spatial mastery and natural ferocity, their existence a fusion of savage physical might and divine control over the void itself.
characters.appearance:
The Void King Beast that battled Shi Hao was a colossal, sinister being, towering several hundred zhang tall like a living mountain of darkness and power. Its form combined aspects of several sacred beasts: the body of a rhinoceros, a monstrous head adorned with eighteen horns some black, some scarlet, and others pure white like jade six thick legs covered in gleaming Qilin scales and a long,bright red crocodile tail    that radiated dazzling light. This terrifying physique exuded endless might, while its every movement distorted the surrounding space.

This particular Void King Beast was a true Void King from the foreign realm, proud of its untainted lineage and contemptuous of all “lesser creatures.” Its arrogance knew no bounds, referring to the beings of Shi Hao’s world as “filthy bugs” with “lowly blood.” Cruel and confident, it delighted in slaughter, even killing other youngsters from Shi Hao’s side purely to provoke him. It also sought to uncover Shi Hao’s secrets especially after learning that he had once approached the border of its realm near the Undying Mountain.

characters.title: Void Sky Divine Vine
characters.introText: A divine herb found in the Immortal Ancient, possesses extraordinary power accompanied by its own intelligence and awareness. Endowed with potent healing power, it also has the ability to create illusions.
characters.appearance:
Etymology
"虚" (Xū): This character can mean "empty," "illusory," or "void." In various contexts, it can imply something intangible, ethereal, or even deceptive.

"天" (Tiān): This character means "heaven" or "sky." It often carries connotations of the celestial or the divine.

"神" (Shén): "神" can mean "god," "spirit," or "divine." It signifies something supernatural or otherworldly.

"藤" (Téng): This character refers to a "vine" typically a plant with long, winding stems that grow and spread.
characters.history:
After Shi Hao defeated the members of the Nether Clan who were pursuing Hong Huang, he stumbled upon a surreal scene: a white turtle carrying a lovely woman dressed in white, gracefully moving among the ruins. The air was filled with an enveloping medicinal fragrance.

The turtle, though extraordinary, could still be considered "normal" in appearance. It was white as snow and about the size of a palm. Its shell was adorned with intricate patterns, as if sculpted by the very laws of dao. On its back, the being was equally small, luminous, and delicate.

The woman, dressed in white, was extremely petite but exuded mature elegance. Her silvery hair framed her face, which, if enlarged, would surely be of extraordinary beauty, with its sinuous and curvaceous features.

A melodious voice, like a song, could be heard emanating from that woman. It was sweet and harmonious, a sound that could soothe even the gods themselves, penetrating into the hearts of men like an immortal melody from celestial realms.

Thanks to the help of the Martial Dao Heavenly Eye, newly awakened in Shi Hao, and also aided by the  dual-pupil eye, he managed to discern that it was an illusion. As he walked among the ruins of that place, he noticed the grand formations protecting the site. These formations had been set up to lure people as blood sacrifices. Shi Hao recalled the old bone texts given to him by Qi Daolin; that was surely the Void Sky Divine Vine, renowned for its extraordinary healing abilities, capable of healing any wound, even those near death, and advancing the dao. It was a divine medicine comparable to the Divine Lotus of the Goddess Academy, rarely seen in the world, so precious that it could drive Heavenly Deities mad and compel sect masters to undertake epic actions. It could determine the fate of a sect for thousands of epochs to come.

Determined to reach the Void Sky Divine Vine, Shi Hao ventured through the ruins, meanwhile gathering some sacred medicines along the way. Despite the challenges posed by the scattered formations along the path, he eventually caught sight of that divine medicine. It looked like a horned dragon as it snaked along the ground, but with extra-white leaves like snow, giving it an even more sacred aura.

The divine medicine had developed consciousness; it understood that the formations had failed to eliminate Shi Hao and Hong Huang, so it no longer hid, extending its vine stem. Suddenly, it burst forth with a radiant silver light, becoming akin to a snow-white sun, with a horned dragon coiling within. This scene was extremely impressive. The medicinal fragrance immediately intensified, relaxing the pores of the skin and giving the sensation that bodies were floating upwards.

Shi Hao attempted to collect it, but a formation suddenly activated, launching an attack capable of killing even a Heavenly Deities. Fortunately, Shi Hao managed to dodge the attack, though he had to retreat.

Not being an expert in formations, Shi Hao couldn't break the one guarding the Void Sky Divine Vine. So he sought help from Shi Batian, who, after many attempts and failures, succeeded in deactivating the formation, Shi Hao sent Lan Yichen ahead to retrieve the Void Sky Divine Vine, but he was cut in half. Fortunately, having a metal body, he survived, albeit consuming a great deal of divine energy.

characters.introText:
Immortal Wang is one of the most towering and influential figures in the history of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, a being whose existence spans from Immortal Ancient times to the present era. As the grandson of a true immortal, he was born carrying an extraordinary destiny. From the moment his name began circulating among ancient powers, he was rumored to be an immortal seed, an existence sealed by an immortal lineage and released after great chaos to stabilize and dominate a new era. Whether myth or truth, his rise confirmed these legends, as his power and presence quickly became synonymous with invincibility and authority.
Despite having lived for millions of years, Immortal Wang appears as a youthful young man of seventeen or eighteen, delicate in appearance yet terrifying in essence. This contradiction is explained by the legendary phenomenon of “living a second life,” in which he successfully restored his youth after reaching the limits of longevity. Such an achievement is almost unheard of even among immortals and allowed him to regain vitality, potential, and continued growth while retaining the wisdom, ruthlessness, and experience of an ancient monster. His youthful form only deepened the fear he inspired, as it masked a soul that had survived countless eras of bloodshed and upheaval.
characters.appearance:
Immortal Wang is one of the most towering and influential figures in the history of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, a being whose existence spans from Immortal Ancient times to the present era. As the grandson of a true immortal, he was born carrying an extraordinary destiny. From the moment his name began circulating among ancient powers, he was rumored to be an immortal seed, an existence sealed by an immortal lineage and released after great chaos to stabilize and dominate a new era. Whether myth or truth, his rise confirmed these legends, as his power and presence quickly became synonymous with invincibility and authority.
Despite having lived for millions of years, Immortal Wang appears as a youthful young man of seventeen or eighteen, delicate in appearance yet terrifying in essence. This contradiction is explained by the legendary phenomenon of “living a second life,” in which he successfully restored his youth after reaching the limits of longevity. Such an achievement is almost unheard of even among immortals and allowed him to regain vitality, potential, and continued growth while retaining the wisdom, ruthlessness, and experience of an ancient monster. His youthful form only deepened the fear he inspired, as it masked a soul that had survived countless eras of bloodshed and upheaval.

At the peak of his cultivation, Immortal Wang stood at the summit just below true immortality, later firmly entering the realm of an Immortal King. His aura alone could suppress generations of experts, and his presence exerted pressure across entire domains. Mountains and rivers reacted to his will, and even other immortal-level beings treated him with extreme caution. He wielded terrifying techniques, most notably the Chaos Calming Art, a supreme sword dao capable of severing order itself, as well as an ancestral war halberd that could be summoned from between his brows, radiating boundless immortal light and killing intent.
Immortal Wang was the great ancestor and living foundation of the Wang Family, a long-life clan that survived from Immortal Ancient times. Under his rule, the Wang Family reached unmatched glory, possessing vast territories, ancestral halls within the Immortal Domain, and countless experts. His nine sons, collectively known as the Nine Dragons, were each peerless figures capable of shaking the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. Together, they formed the clan’s ultimate backing, ensuring its dominance and intimidating even other long-life families. Later, a mysterious tenth son, Wang Shi, emerged from seclusion, possessing terrifying potential and drawing immense attention from all sides.

Although Immortal Wang was a clan patriarch, his rule was absolute and merciless. When darkness matter contaminated his lineage and an immortal decree descended, he chose the survival of the clan over blood ties. In a shocking and infamous act, he personally executed five of his own sons, each killed with a single strike. This bloody purge horrified observers but also revealed the brutal reality of long-life families: immortality demanded sacrifice, and weakness could doom entire lineages. His actions cemented his reputation as a ruler who would not hesitate, no matter the cost.

Immortal Wang and Meng Tianzheng share a relationship defined by rivalry, tension, and a deep, if reluctant, mutual respect. As peers and generation‑dominating figures, they stand at the pinnacle of their era, frequently mentioned in the same breath for their overwhelming strength and far‑reaching influence.Although they are technically old acquaintances, their relationship is anything but harmonious. Their interactions often erupt into conflict. One notable example is when Meng Tianzheng forcefully entered the Wang Family’s territory, provoking intense confrontations with the clan’s elites, including Immortal Wang himself and the famed Nine Dragons, his sons. These clashes demonstrated the seriousness of their rivalry and the terrifying power both sides could unleash.Yet beneath the hostility lies a clear recognition of each other’s stature. Meng Tianzheng once addressed Immortal Wang as “dao brother,” a term that acknowledges equality in cultivation and status. At critical moments, their interests have even aligned, such as when facing shared enemies or defending the Imperial Pass, where cooperation became necessary despite personal grievances.

As the era declined, Immortal Wang became entangled in the internal collapse of the Immortal Domain. During the withdrawal of its forces, betrayal and chaos erupted, leaving him and other ancient beings restricted and unable to act freely. The Wang Family was eventually forced to abandon its ancestral hall within the Immortal Domain after conflicts with other ancient inheritances, symbolizing the waning of once-dominant immortal lineages. This marked a turning point, as Immortal Wang’s demeanor grew increasingly solemn and contemplative, reflecting the erosion of the world he once ruled.

Despite decline and injury, Immortal Wang continued to involve himself in great conflicts. He mobilized his clan’s forces to support the Desolate Border War, refusing to abandon his world even as dangers multiplied. He later clashed with Shi Hao, attempting to seize sword intent and suppress him to protect his lineage. In these battles, Immortal Wang demonstrated that even when wounded, restricted, and surrounded by decay, his combat instincts and authority remained terrifyingly sharp.

The final fate of Immortal Wang is that Great Elder Meng Tianzheng now a fallen immortal king ultimately rebelled and killed him, severing his head and destroying his primordial spirit in a shocking betrayal that stunned the Immortal Domain. Other accounts suggest that only a body perished
