characters.introText: Wang Da is the eldest son of Wang Changsheng and the leader of the Nine Dragons (the nine sons of the Wang Family). As a Supreme Being (Zhizun) of the Wang Family—a Longevity Family in the Nine Heavens—he holds immense status and power. He is a recurring antagonist to Huang (Shi Hao) and the lineage of the Great Elder Meng Tianzheng. Unlike his father, who is often portrayed with a youthful appearance and a deceptive calmness, Wang Da is characterized by his arrogance, aggressive protection of the family's prestige, and eventual tragic downfall at the hands of Huang.
characters.appearance:
Wang Da is a prominent and extremely powerful figure of the Wang Family, one of the most ancient and long-lasting noble clans in the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. He is the eldest son of Immortal Wang and one of the Nine Dragons, granting him immense status, authority, and strength within the clan. His cultivation reaches the peak of the Self-Release Realm, and his advanced age is reflected in his gray hair streaked with white.

Wang Da first appears as a dominant ancestral figure clad in snow-white Daoist robes, possessing power great enough to shake the heavens and earth. From the beginning, he displays an arrogant, domineering temperament, typical of the Wang Family’s elite. He looks down on others, openly threatening and demanding submission, and even orders people to kneel and confess their sins .

He becomes deeply involved in the Wang Family’s conflicts with Great Elder Meng Tianzheng and Shi Hao. Although initially portrayed as overwhelmingly powerful, Wang Da soon suffers repeated humiliations. During his confrontation with Great Elder Meng Tianzheng, he is struck across the face, leaving a massive palm imprint and shocking onlookers who realize he is not invincible . Despite his fury, he continues commanding Wang Family members and opposing.

Later, Wang Da leads five dragons of the Wang Family and activates fragments of a magical decree to attack Shi Hao’s allies. However, he is ultimately overpowered, nailed to the ground by a war spear, and left bleeding profusely . His downfall reaches a climax when Shi Hao forcibly drags him out of a fort and captures him, an event that stuns everyone due to Wang Da’s exalted status.

Despite being repeatedly beaten, exploded into bloody mist, and humiliated by Shi Hao, Wang Da survives thanks to a life-preserving formation carved within his body, which grants rapid recovery and resurrection. Shi Hao later forcibly strips this formation from Wang Da and carves it into Cao Yusheng, leaving Wang Da alive but in extreme pain and greatly weakened .

Ultimately, Wang Da is completely subdued and dominated by Shi Hao. His former arrogance and authority are shattered, and he is reduced to a captive used for interrogation and the extraction of secrets and formations. Though he does not die immediately, he is left powerless, humiliated, and under Shi Hao’s control

characters.title: Wang Kan
characters.introText: Wang Kan is a Wang Clan patroller and Self-Release realm enforcer who arrives at the Heavenly Deity Institution after Shi Hao executes the clan members causing trouble. Appearing first in dragon form, he claims official authority and orders Shi Hao to release the captured Wang clansmen, threatening to burn their souls if he refuses. Shi Hao instead accuses the Wang Clan of attacking its own side while heroes are dying at the Desolate Border and commands the prisoners’ execution anyway.
characters.appearance:
Wang Kan is a Wang Clan patroller and Self-Release realm enforcer who arrives at the Heavenly Deity Institution after Shi Hao executes the clan members causing trouble. Appearing first in dragon form, he claims official authority and orders Shi Hao to release the captured Wang clansmen, threatening to burn their souls if he refuses. Shi Hao instead accuses the Wang Clan of attacking its own side while heroes are dying at the Desolate Border and commands the prisoners’ execution anyway.

Enraged, Wang Kan attacks, but the Little Heavenly Hornet Ant’s guardians activate the Seven Kills Formation and join Shi Hao in battle. They burn him with Immortal War Fire, sever his arm, and pierce his chest with a spear. Even while fatally wounded he threatens revenge from the Wang Clan and their ancestor Wang Changsheng, yet he cannot escape — the immortal flames refine his body and primordial spirit completely.

His death is the immediate trigger for the larger war, prompting the Wang Clan elders and later the Nine Dragons to march on the Heavenly Deity Institution.

characters.title: Wang San
characters.introText: Wang San is one of the ancestors of the Wang Family, described as one of Immortal Wang's children with exceptional talents and causing a sensation in the past. Along with Wang Da, Wang Er, and Wang Si, he appeared at a crucial moment to confront others, showing strong resolve to act ruthlessly. When Great Elder intervened, he kicked Wang San, causing severe injuries, indicating a tense and hostile interaction. Wang San angrily demanded to know Great Elder's intentions, to which Great Elder declared that all of them would be sent to kill enemies in Desolate Border

characters.title: Wang Xi
characters.introText: Wang Xi is a major supporting character in Chen Dong's novel Perfect World (完美世界). She is a core descendant of the Wang Family, one of the most powerful and ancient Long-Life Families in the Nine Heavens. Renowned for her exceptional talent and ethereal beauty, she is a supreme genius who successfully cultivated three strands of immortal energy, placing her at the absolute pinnacle of her generation.
characters.history:
Wang Xi (王曦) is a renowned first-generation genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, celebrated as one of her era's greatest beauties. She hails from the Wang Family, a prestigious and ancient "Long-Life Clan," meaning they are descended from a True Immortal King. Groomed for greatness, Wang Xi possesses exceptional talent in cultivation and carries herself with a calm, aristocratic grace. She rarely displays strong emotions, maintaining a composed demeanor even after Shi Hao repeatedly embarrassed her and her family.

The Wang Family was one of the most powerful and arrogant clans in the Nine Heavens. Their strength was immense, second only to the Great Elder, Meng Tianzheng. The family's patriarch, Immortal King Wang, had nine sons known as the "Nine Dragons," each more powerful than the last. A tenth son, Wang Shi, the most talented of all, was kept in seclusion as the family's secret weapon.

The family's power was built upon legendary techniques, most notably the Chaos Calming Art. This was one of the three great sword arts of the ancient era, so coveted that even the Foreign Realm desired it. Unlike other techniques, it not only served as a formidable weapon but also refined the user's Primordial Spirit. The Wang Family was the sole possessor of its complete version.

Wang Xi's destiny became intertwined with Shi Hao's when he, after escaping from her family's mining operations where he'd been forced to work, used his former status as a servant to gain entry into the Heavenly Deity Academy. Initially, Wang Xi treated Shi Hao with the detached respect she afforded her other servants, showing some concern for his well-being. An unlikely friendship almost blossomed between them.

However, the vast gap in their status, combined with Wang Xi's inherent arrogance and Shi Hao's unyielding pride, caused the relationship to sour. The conflict escalated when her family became involved. Refusing to step back or acknowledge Shi Hao's growing power, Wang Xi placed her faith in her betrothed, Jin Zhan of the Jin Clan, believing he was unrivaled among the younger generation and could easily suppress Shi Hao.

The feud transitioned from a personal rivalry to deep-seated hatred during the war at the Desolate Border. There, Shi Hao decisively defeated Jin Zhan, nearly killing him. Humiliated by this outcome, the Wang Family deemed Jin Zhan unfit to marry Wang Xi and broke the engagement.

Wang Xi also fought at the Desolate Border, growing in strength and earning a reputation as one of the war's survivors. However, during this period, the conflict with Shi Hao became irreconcilable. In the brutal battles that ensued, Shi Hao killed several members of the Wang Clan, including Wang Xi's own grandfather. This act cemented a blood feud between them.

As the Cultivation-less Era began and the Darkness Calamity threatened to consume the realm, the Wang Family grew desperate. Their clan in the Nine Heavens was merely a branch of a main family in the Immortal Domain. They attempted to contact their main clan for refuge but learned they had lost a power struggle and fled to an unmanned, desolate region.

With no other options, the Wang Family made a fateful choice: they began secretly colluding with the Fallen Immortals, enemies of the realm. Shi Hao discovered their treachery and recorded their interactions.

The final confrontation occurred at a farewell gathering for the geniuses departing to the Immortal Domain. Shi Hao, who had been missing for over a century and was now a young Supreme Being, appeared. A battle broke out between him and Wang Xi's tenth brother, Wang Shi. Outmatched, the Wang Family had no choice but to reveal their alliance by calling upon a Fallen Supreme Being for aid, shocking everyone present. After Shi Hao went on a killing spree against his enemies, Wang Xi barely escaped with her life. To end the battle, Shi Hao produced the recordings of their treason. In a desperate act to save the core of his clan from annihilation, Immortal King Wang executed many of his own sons, placing the blame squarely on them.

Wang Xi and the surviving members of her family eventually settled in the unmanned region of the Immortal Domain where their main clan had fled. This region was also home to other clans with complex histories, including the Immortal Qin and Immortal Mu.

During the final war, when the forces of Darkness launched their all-out assault on the Immortal Domain, the Wang Family's betrayal became absolute. Immortal King Wang, now an immensely powerful Immortal King, led his entire clan to the other side, officially joining the enemy as traitors.

Wang Xi succeeded in becoming a True Immortal, but as a member of a traitor clan, she never fought to defend the realm in its final, desperate war.

characters.title: Wang Yang

characters.title: Wang Zhen
characters.introText: Wang Zhen is one of the Wang Clan’s leading young powerhouses and a Self-Release realm expert, descended from one of the clan’s Nine Dragons (son of Wang Er). After Shi Hao destroys the clan’s strongholds, Wang Zhen personally leads the Wang Clan’s elite army to the Heavenly Deity Institution. Pretending to negotiate, he pressures Shi Hao to submit and hand over his secrets, but in reality he intends to suppress the academy and capture him. He commands qilin-drawn chariots and activates a large troop formation that manifests giant winged-tiger phantoms to overwhelm the Little Heavenly Hornet Ant’s guardians.
characters.appearance:
Wang Zhen is one of the Wang Clan’s leading young powerhouses and a Self-Release realm expert, descended from one of the clan’s Nine Dragons (son of Wang Er). After Shi Hao destroys the clan’s strongholds, Wang Zhen personally leads the Wang Clan’s elite army to the Heavenly Deity Institution. Pretending to negotiate, he pressures Shi Hao to submit and hand over his secrets, but in reality he intends to suppress the academy and capture him. He commands qilin-drawn chariots and activates a large troop formation that manifests giant winged-tiger phantoms to overwhelm the Little Heavenly Hornet Ant’s guardians.

The guardians counter with their immortal battle flag and Immortal War Fire, breaking the formation and routing the Wang Clan troops. Injured and coughing blood, Wang Zhen argues that only the survival of the Wang Clan matters, even if the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths fall, revealing his clan-first ideology. Realizing defeat, he transforms into a dragon and attempts to flee while calling for his father’s help. A guardian pursues and pierces him with a spear, slicing apart his dragon body, and Shi Hao finishes the battle by cutting down the remaining forces — Wang Zhen dies in the sky after his escape fails.

Within the War Race, only the most dazzling disciples that exceeded the youth of past generations could obtain the title of war emperor
characters.history:
War Emperor is the leader and highest authority in the War Clan. Being a former emperor clan, Any leader to achieved the current Monika has to be a strong individual.  Within the War Race, only the most dazzling disciples that exceeded the youth of past generations could obtain the title of war emperor

He established his reputation in the archaic legend, creating a legend and forming the base of the Emperor Clan legend. This was an unmatched ancient existence. No one expected him to still be alive. Based on the bone book’s records, he should have passed away a long time ago from the endless passage of time, becoming one with the earth.

The War Emperor was unmatched in battle, becoming an emperor through war. He had pressed forward unhindered his entire life, sweeping before everything in front of him

Not much is known about the current war emperor but he is from the later generation and over the years had many battles in order to achieved the war emperor title.

characters.trivia:
In its first appearance, it's mistaken for a True Dragon, but soon everyone realizes it can't be a real dragon because of its wings.

In Chinese, it's not called "Winged Dragon." Its name in Chinese is 应龙 (Yīng lóng), which can be translated as "Responding Dragon" or "Responsive Dragon." The character "应" (yìng) can mean "to respond," "to answer," or "to correspond to." But since it doesn't make much sense, the name translated into English was kept as is.

characters.introText:
She was born in the Three Thousand Provinces, with beautiful cheeks, enchanting and charming, possessing an extraordinary demeanor.
Even in death, she maintained a sense of humor; such was her nature, alluring yet cunning. She belonged to the Celestial Fox Clan, an heir of the Sect of Heaven Severing, and a rival to Yue Chan. Both bodies  in the lower realm Witch and Celestial Fox Fairy were spiritual bodies as her real body remains in the upper realms.
characters.appearance:
LOWER REALM: Eight Regions

Mo Nu is the inheritor of  the Sky Severing Sect, like the Heaven Mending Sect they were divided into three, from the lower realm it's called (Pavilion) the three thousand province is called(Sect) and the Nine Heaven Ten Earth is called(Dao).

She also owned a powerful inheritance that isn't from the Sky severing sect, as explained during the Heavenly Deity Institution trial after Shi Hao and the Witch appeared Exiled Immortal notice her and said she can be considered her junior sister as they both have half of that inheritance, She's also the owner of the God Suppressing Pearl- An artifact which implied that the Little Pagoda had some intimate relations with, In the past the pagoda also made a vow to never attack the one's that held the artifact.

She first met Shi Hao during the Kun Peng treasure hunt and then both cunningly scheme and participated in robbing the cultivators that came to the North Sea, even Mo Shang became a victim of their plan.

Both parties would soon become some what close acquaintances and with both still not fully trusting each other, at times their encounters while sharing information would sometimes revert in tit for tat ,but both still got along well. Shi Hao even became comfortable enough to flirt, though she mention that someone else already had her heart. At times when beneficial the Witch were very generous with many crucial information, some includes the info of the Divine split fetus Yue Chan and Di Chong own, they would again work together to discover the secret that is sealed inside Qing Yi body.

UPPER REALM: Three Thousand Provinces and Nine Heavens and Ten Earths

During the lower realm calamity, the  transport formation would soon become useless and difficult for creatures to travel back and forth between realms thus her spirit bodies decided to head back to the upper realm. With the Immortal Ancient fast approaching all the great geniuses of each sect are making preparations and taking risk to accumulate, she decided to enter the Yuan Tian Secret Realm where she would meet the disguised Huang, she were the first to see through his disguised and even help Cao Yusheng, Jade Lunar Rabbit and his disguised grandfather Shi Zhongtian to protect him from the barrage of attacks while injured.

During Immortal Aancient Shi Hao went to a secret Small World, where he found and captured the Heavenly Deity Tree and then came to a place with lightning, on entering he notice a place with an extremely valuable treasure the Universal Soil and inside buried an extremely beautiful woman in all white whom he didn't recognized, at first she gave him a feeling of immortal and when she woke he couldn't but help thinking she felt familiar. after sometime thinking and deducing he realist they have met before she was that cunning and flirty fox  the witch, Shi Hao was shocked and thought how all the time she claimed to be his friend she never reveled  her true identity, in any case her true self were so beautiful that it were the first time Shi Hao seen loosing his cool and outright flirting trying to attract her.

After some ups and down inside immortal ancient together, it was forcefully invaded and the contest ended, Shi Hao were surrounded by many clan elders in the Self-Severing, Self-Release and one of  Immortal Palace Supreme Being old monster, before Willow Deity imprint from immortal ancient natives reappears to protect Shi Hao, alongside Qi Daolin, Undying Being a few clans decided to protect Shi Hao and the witch were one of them that plead to his sect leader to step in and protect him.

During the recruitment of geniuses from the three thousand provinces from the Heavenly Deity Institution the witch met up with Shi Hao during the trial and travel the rest of the way, both facing many difficulties. At one point they fought against some powerful enemies and Shi Hao were shock, praising her strength, he stated when it was time to battle the usual flirty and cunning personality disappear and a different personality, a decisive and vicious individual took over. It was also during this arc it was revealed that she has obtained some inheritance related to the lineage of Exiled Immortal. This inheritance has no connection with her Sky Severing Sect, that is why Exiled Immortal said that she can be considered his junior sister. After entering Heavenly Deity Institution, she would keep a low profile inside and later would also enter the desolate border war.

IMMORTAL DOMAIN: Cultivation-less Era and great darkness calamity

During the cultivation less era and the start of the darkness calamity, various sects were willing to do anything to escape the disaster, immortal domain decided to take in clans and sect with the most powerful young individuals. After the desolate border war, apart from Shi Hao, Shi Yi, Tian Zi and Exiled Immortal were ranked as the three most powerful and decorated individuals from the war and all clans wanted them whether by adding favors or marriage, Sky severing sect send the witch to compel Shi Yi, this implied that even marriage wasn't off the table. She 
later entered Immortal Domain. After a thousand years she would see Shi Hao again at the peach garden battle and after parting she would again see Shi Hao after his return from a five-hundred-thousand-year slumber, they reunited in Pan King City. Tens of thousands of years later, the Dark Realm sent out the Ancient Hall of Induction and a large number of dark creatures to invade the Immortal Realm. Subsequently, two origin ancient artifacts suddenly attacked the Immortal Domain, emitting a destructive light that harmed the living beings there. The two artifacts transformed into Half-Immortal Emperors, engaging in a fierce battle with Shi Hao and were ultimately suppressed.

Fortunately, she survived the onslaught and, though severely injured, narrowly escaped complete destruction. When Shi Hao was searching through the pile of corpses, he found her and, against the odds, revived her as they mourned the fallen members of the Heavenly Burial Court. Shi Hao decided to seal her, along with the others from the Heavenly Burial Court, into the Three World Bronze Coffin, allowing them to drift through the universe (she agreed to let Shi Hao seal her).

During the invasion of the Immortal Domain by the Three Emperors and their massive army, the Witch fought fiercely against the dark creatures and died in battle. In the end, Shi Hao, after making a journey to the higher planes, found a way to revive her. In the conclusion of the Holy Ruins, on the desolate Daoist platform, everyone was resurrected. Liu Shen and Shi Hao played chess, and the Ten-Crown King and Shi Yi's Jade Lunar Rabbit also appeared.
characters.personality: The relationship between the witch and the Exiled Immortal is a complex mix of familiarity, mutual recognition, and shared history. The Exiled Immortal refers to the witch as her "junior sister," indicating a bond formed through shared involvement with a particular inheritance, which surprises others present and hints at a significant connection between them. This relationship is further underscored by the witch’s acknowledgment upon meeting the Exiled Immortal, showing a level of respect and recognition. Despite the witch's usual playful and crafty demeanor, her interaction with the Exiled Immortal is more serious and respectful, marking the importance of their connection within the broader context of powerful sects and legacies .

characters.history:
He is a lineage elder (宗老), a generation older than Master Fifteen Shi Zhongtian. He was called "fourth elder," meaning that he was ranked fourth in his generation in the Wu Palace, along with Second Elder, Shi Yuan, and Shi Li. He is one of the two elders in charge of the clan, with a very high seniority and the strongest strength. He rarely shows up in public. He had been cultivating alone and comprehending the profound principles in the ancient caves.

Fourth Elder seems to be a close friend with Shi Zhongtian's side of the family.  When Shi Ziling and Qin Yining left to look for Shi Zhongtian, many people in the Wu Palace were tasked with looking after the eight month old baby Shi Hao. Fourth Elder and another elder were the only people that knew about Shi Hao's secret Supreme Being Bones.

He later discovers that Shi Yi's Mother was trying to extract Shi Hao's bone. He strangles her throat, but young Shi Yi threatens to end his own life if his mother was harmed. Knowing the clan value for young Shi Yi, he didn't act rashly, especially after Shi Yuan's intervention. During the meeting at Wu Palace's main hall, many elders that haven't made a public appearance for two or three decades showed up. Fourth Elder stressed the Stone Clan's law that forbade clan members from killing each other. He was very vocal on handing down punishment for Shi Yi and his mother.

When Shi Zhongtian returned thirteen years later, Fourth Elder was very eager to see him, but felt guilty and blames himself for Shi Hao's situation.

In the novel, Shi Yi's collaboration was with Shi Li instead. They were defeated, and it took all four old ancestors to successfully suppress Ziling.
characters.personality: ↑ 2.0 2.1 Episode 7
characters.history:
When infant Shi Hao's Supreme Being Bones were taken by Shi Yi's Mother and she was caught by Fourth Elder, the clan held a meeting in the Wu Palace's main hall. Many elders that haven't made a public appearance for two or three decades showed up for the debate.

After hearing both sides of the debate, Old Ancestor decided to prioritize the safety of the Supreme Being Bones and find another way to compensate Shi Hao. With Shi Hao's body weakened and unable to take another transplant, the bone would be useless outside the body without their essence blood. Three year old Shi Yi was already born with the strongest Double Eye Pupil, so it made sense to allow him to keep the bone. Emotionally taking out the bone and risking the entire clan's future would've been unwise.

Afterwards, Shi Yi's maternal family from the Rain Clan and relatives from his great-grandfather Shi Yuan's lineage sent out their strongest men to assassinate Shi Hao's parents, but failed. After Shi Ziling and Qin Yining defeated Shi Yuan and killed Shi Yi's mother, Old Ancestor appeared and made concession to ease the tension by offering the clan leadership to Ziling after ten years. Ziling angrily declined. Very biased toward Shi Yi's family, Old Ancestor went all the way to ask Shi Yi for a collaboration to activate his double pupils and newly fused bone to suppress the couple.

characters.introText: Wu Shang (无殇, Wú Shāng), also known as Without Death, was one of the most ancient and powerful Immortal King Giants of the Foreign Realm and the progenitor of the Wu Shang Emperor Clan. Renowned throughout both the Foreign Realm and the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, he possessed the unparalleled innate talent of Magical Immunity, allowing him to neutralize or dissolve nearly all divine abilities and natural laws. This ability made him an almost invincible opponent among Immortal Kings, with even legendary figures such as Anlan and Yu Tuo considered inferior to him in battle.
characters.appearance:
Wu Shang was an imposing man with an awe-inspiring presence befitting one of the oldest Immortal King Giants. He wielded an enormous ancient bronze war halberd, his signature weapon, whose surface was covered in the aura of countless battles. His mere appearance radiated overwhelming pressure capable of making even Supreme Beings tremble.

His bronze war halberd was as famous as its master. Infused with Wu Shang's Magical Immunity, it could withstand the corrosive laws of the Heaven Abyss and even carve a path through its sea of natural laws, making it one of the most formidable Immortal King weapons in existence.
characters.personality: Wu Shang is an ancient and dignified Immortal King whose confidence stemmed from overwhelming strength rather than arrogance. Feared by allies and enemies alike, he carried himself with absolute composure and rarely displayed emotion, believing his innate Magical Immunity made him virtually invincible among Immortal Kings.
characters.history:
Without Death is the ancestor and namesake of the Without Death Clan (无死一族), one of the most ancient Emperor Clans in existence. He is rumored to possibly be half a generation older than even the undying kings themselves, his status and reputation described as respected and incredibly terrifying. He has already lived for more than a single great era, his magical force said to be unmatched below the heavens, making him a truly incomparable individual.

His reputation is so severe that even Imperial Pass' cultivators, upon recognizing him, did not dare speak his full name together as one phrase, instead breaking it apart into separate words out of fear that simply invoking a name could summon an undying king's projection to the battlefield

Without Death is remembered as an invincible figure who slaughtered his way throughout the world under the sky wielding a bronze war halberd. During the Immortal Ancient War, he was known to have massacred enormous numbers of enemies, described as someone who "broke the equilibrium" of that conflict through sheer violence. Imperial Pass' own supreme beings reacted to hearing his name with visible unease  even figures normally unshaken by the collapse of divine peaks behaved abnormally upon learning he was the one attacking.

characters.introText: Without Beginning is a powerful half-immortal emperor from the future who intervenes during a critical battle in the Immortal Ancient Era to aid Shi Hao (Heavenly Emperor Huang) against other half-immortal emperors. He explicitly introduces himself with the words, “My name is Without Beginning!” and is described as originating from the “lower reaches of the Great River of Time,” having arrived through a sealed ancient passage. This temporal displacement means he does not belong to the current time-space and his interventions are bound by the karmic consequences of interfering with the natural flow of time.
characters.appearance:
Without Beginning is a powerful half-immortal emperor from the future who intervenes during a critical battle in the Immortal Ancient Era to aid Shi Hao (Heavenly Emperor Huang) against other half-immortal emperors. He explicitly introduces himself with the words, “My name is Without Beginning!” and is described as originating from the “lower reaches of the Great River of Time,” having arrived through a sealed ancient passage. This temporal displacement means he does not belong to the current time-space and his interventions are bound by the karmic consequences of interfering with the natural flow of time.

Physically, Without Beginning is portrayed as a tall and sturdy figure, radiating the strength and authority of a half-immortal emperor. His cultivation and mastery of the profound dao set him apart as a supreme expert. Central to his power is his weapon, a majestic great bell that emits chaotic energy and creates ripples through time with every movement. The bell is capable of causing rapid aging and corrosion via the “great dao of time.” Shi Hao had previously perceived the profound meaning of “Without Beginning!” within bell waves, signaling the deep connection between the dao concept and this formidable figure.

Without Beginning’s primary purpose is to support Shi Hao during a desperate confrontation against seven other half-immortal emperors, some of whom have arrived from other eras. Motivated by the heroism and struggle of Heavenly Emperor Huang in the “darkest age,” he and others seeks to reduce Shi Hao’s burden and intervene decisively. However, engaging with enemies from eras outside his own causes severe karmic backlash, illustrating the immense risk inherent in meddling with temporal flows. Shi Hao warns him to avoid fighting such opponents to prevent serious harm from the temporal interference.

Despite the dire circumstances of the battle, Without Beginning maintains a hopeful outlook on the future, asserting that “the future presumably still has an opportunity of life, no longer leaving one in complete despair!” His actions embody both martial prowess and wisdom, demonstrating strategic restraint and a profound understanding of the cosmos and temporal laws.

Philosophically, Without Beginning represents the initiation of existence and the complementary counterpart to the “Without End” Immortal King, whose path alone was considered incomplete. Together, they embody the profound mysteries of beginnings and endings within the dao.

characters.title: Xi Hua
characters.introText: Xi Hua makes her first appearance alongside Yue Chan in the ancestral lands of the Fire Nation, presenting herself as an old woman. Her goal is to free the world from Shi Hao, who has refused to join the Heaven Mending Sect. She anticipates that this decision could pose a problem.
characters.history:
Xi Hua makes her first appearance alongside Yue Chan in the ancestral lands of the Fire Nation, presenting herself as an old woman. Her goal is to free the world from Shi Hao, who has refused to join the Heaven Mending Sect. She anticipates that this decision could pose a problem.

During Stones Brothers Battle, observing that Shi Yi is about to be defeated by Shi Hao, she decides to intervene by throwing a Soul Shattering Needles at Shi Hao's back to eliminate the problem once and for all. After such gesture, Yue Chan became deeply infuriated with her, reproaching her for the fact that her actions would compromise the credibility of the Heaven Mending Sect. She is later killed by Shi Hao with the assistance of the Soul Locking Pagoda.

characters.title: Xia Youyu
characters.introText: Her beautiful hair were draped over her shoulders, and her snow white sparkling skin were as exquisite as jade. She had long eyelashes on her oval face, and her eyes were as bright as crystals. A set of pure and white pearl-like teeth were lined behind her scarlet red lips.
characters.history: She is a member of the Heaven Mending Pavilion and was sent to the western border to fulfil a certain mission. She brought eight talismans in this journey that gave the bearer the right to enter the Heaven Mending Pavilion and with it would gain priority in all kinds of precious remedies and secret methods of using symbols.
characters.trivia: Out of the eight talismans the Heaven Mending Pavillion gave her, seven were given away earlier while the last one that was supposed to be given to Rain Country was given to Shi Hao instead.

characters.title: Xiang Feng

infobox.Aliases: Sacred Academy Great Elder’s Main Disciple
infobox.age: Not specified (cultivated for over one million years)
infobox.friend(s): Sacred Academy Great Elder (master)
infobox.death: Killed in battle by a Nine-Eyed Foreign Creature; after losing an arm and suffering severe injuries, his primordial spirit was crushed by the opponent’s grip

characters.introText: As the main disciple of the Sacred Academy’s Great Elder, Xiang Feng was regarded as peerless among his contemporaries and possessed the qualifications to represent his world’s generation from a million years ago. His cultivation spanned over a million years, earning him immense prestige and respect. However, during a decisive battle against a foreign humanoid creature bearing nine vertical eyes on its forehead, Xiang Feng met a tragic end. After roughly a hundred exchanges, he sustained catastrophic injuries, including the brutal loss of an arm torn away in a savage confrontation. Ultimately, the space between his brows was crushed by a single grip, shattering his primordial spirit and reducing it to ashes, thus ending his life.
characters.appearance:
As the main disciple of the Sacred Academy’s Great Elder, Xiang Feng was regarded as peerless among his contemporaries and possessed the qualifications to represent his world’s generation from a million years ago. His cultivation spanned over a million years, earning him immense prestige and respect. However, during a decisive battle against a foreign humanoid creature bearing nine vertical eyes on its forehead, Xiang Feng met a tragic end. After roughly a hundred exchanges, he sustained catastrophic injuries, including the brutal loss of an arm torn away in a savage confrontation. Ultimately, the space between his brows was crushed by a single grip, shattering his primordial spirit and reducing it to ashes, thus ending his life.

Xiang Feng’s death plunged the Sacred Academy’s Great Elder into profound grief. Carrying Xiang Feng’s corpse, the Great Elder attempted to repair his shattered primordial spirit using the Soul-Guiding Lotus, but the effort proved futile. The finality of his death shocked all who witnessed it, as a cultivator of his status and power was slain so decisively.

His fall dealt a severe blow to the morale of his allies and marked a pivotal moment in the ongoing conflicts. Xiang Feng’s immense strength and standing as a supreme-level figure underscored the brutality of the war and the terrifying nature of the foreign enemies they faced.

characters.title: Xiao Bai
characters.introText: Xiao Bai, also known as Little Qilin, is the descendant of the Archaic Vicious Ten. It is the only surviving pure-blooded Qilin, belonging to the White Qilin lineage.
characters.history:
Xiao Bai, also known as Little Qilin, is the descendant of the Archaic Vicious Ten. It is the only surviving pure-blooded Qilin, belonging to the White Qilin lineage.

Its entire body is snow-white. It has always followed the Jade Lunar Rabbit. Previously hiding in Panwang City, it came to reside in the headquarters of the Heavenly Court in the Immortal Realm after the desolation returned. The little fellow who was once held in the arms of the Jade Lunar Rabbit has now grown up.

Among the descendants of the Archaic Vicious Ten who did not disappear, it is the most useless and has very few appearances. It had just reached the level of the Archaic Vicious Ten when the Dark Three Emperors attacked with a large army, but it was killed by the dark giant, annihilating both form and spirit.

characters.title: Xiao Tian
characters.introText: Xiao Tian is an extremely strong and unforgiving person who participated Heaven Mending Pavilion's entrance trials together with Shi Hao. He killed and robbed many opponents, but in the end, he was struck by Shi Hao's sneak attack and framed for desecrating the mission tablet.
characters.history:
Xiao Tian is an extremely strong and unforgiving person who participated Heaven Mending Pavilion's entrance trials together with Shi Hao. He killed and robbed many opponents, but in the end, he was struck by Shi Hao's sneak attack and framed for desecrating the mission tablet.

He is seen traveling to Broken Sky City with Shi Hao and Xiong Fei, in preparation for the opening of the Hundred Shattered Mountains. Xiao Tian was really upset when he found out that Shi Hao was the Devil Brat he had been looking for this whole time. Nonetheless, he cherished their friendship and still helped Shi Hao and Big Red fight against Yu Zimo and the Rain Clan.

Later on, Shi Hao seeks him out and they renew their friendship due to Shi Hao's aspirations to revive the Heaven Mending Pavilion.
characters.trivia: When he was in the middle of breaking with the 8th passage of the Heavenly Passage Realm, he was attacked by two giant scorpions by surprise. Shi Hao intervened and killed them, and in the end, they became friends. However, he does not know that Shi Hao is the Devil Brat, the person he hated the most.

characters.title: Xiong Fei
characters.introText: When young Shi Hao and young Shi Qingfeng arrived at the orientation, they handed over the Heaven Mending Pavilion Talisman to him.
characters.history:
When young Shi Hao and young Shi Qingfeng arrived at the orientation, they handed over the Heaven Mending Pavilion Talisman to him.

During the new recruits' entrance trial, the Female War God arrived to look for the Devil Brat. Xiong Fei brought her over to search and reacted angrily to Shi Hao's antics upon discovering that the mission tablet that kept mission records since ancient times had been desecrated. Shi Hao framed Xiao Tian, which led Xiong Fei to yell at him in public.

Later on, he escorted Shi Hao and Xiao Tian to Broken Sky City. This city held the entrance to the Hundred Shattered Mountains which opens once in every hundred years.

During the sect invasion, Xiong Fei died protecting the sect he loves. When fighting among the chaos, he noticed that Yu Feng, a core disciple, was running. He did not realize it was a ploy set by the enemy and rushed to assist Yu feng. He was then shot in the back using the Soul Shattering Needles, surrounded and killed.

characters.introText: Xu Mingxuan is the Imperial Lord (or Emperor Xu) of the Xu Family, which reigns as a long life imperial court in the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. He is the revered father of Princess Yao Yue. He is an extremely powerful cultivator, recognized as having already reached the Supreme Being level of cultivation.
characters.appearance: Xu Mingxuan is portrayed as a supreme being–level creature whose cultivation has reached unfathomable depths, having attained his current realm tens of thousands of years ago. As the imperial lord of the Xu Family—one of the powerful long life imperial court lineages—he stands as a towering figure of authority, influence, and ancient heritage. His presence commands immediate respect, and even the most prominent clans hesitate to provoke him lightly.
characters.history:
He is first introduced within a majestic palace hall inside a vast divine city, where his demeanor surprises many. Despite his immeasurable cultivation and status, Xu Mingxuan carries himself in a relaxed and straightforward manner. During a gathering of powerful figures, he openly states that he has come to choose an outstanding youth who may become a dao companion for his daughter, Princess Yao Yue. The casual nature of this declaration shocks the crowd, as few would expect such openness from someone of his level. This moment highlights his decisive personality—unrestricted by formality, yet fully aware of his power and the weight of his actions.

Xu Mingxuan’s most iconic appearance occurs during a confrontation involving Shi Hao and the Wang Family. When Wang Manglong, a younger member of the Wang Clan, makes disrespectful remarks, Xu Mingxuan intervenes with decisive force. Without hesitation, he steps forward and delivers a slap across Wang Manglong’s face. This simple action carries immense symbolic meaning: it reaffirms his authority, protects Shi Hao, humiliates a rival clan, and asserts his refusal to tolerate chaos or insolence within his domain. When questioned about such a direct act, he responds by warning the Wang elder that such disrespect could spark a ten-thousand-year war between their clans. The atmosphere shifts instantly, and the Wang Family withdraws, unwilling to challenge the consequences of his wrath.

Beyond isolated incidents, Xu Mingxuan plays a significant role in the broader political and martial landscape. His family forms key alliances, lends powerful artifacts to trusted allies, and maintains influence across major factions. His decisions and actions shape the balance of power between clans and determine how other ancient families behave. Even his presence alone has the ability to tilt situations in favor of allies or suppress potential conflicts before they escalate.

characters.introText: Great Xu Tuo is a gifted genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths that is describe as one the the top power house of the younger generation. He has an ancient monk bloodline's that is said to be of True Immortal origins.
characters.history:
Great Xu Tuo is a gifted genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths that is describe as one the the top power house of the younger generation. He has an ancient monk bloodline's that is said to be of True Immortal origins.

He was describe as a person with an ordinary appearance, his skin wax yellow, as if a layer of golden paper was covered the surface. His figure was dried-up and wrinkled, his hands together, eyes closed, quietly chanting scriptures. Many people who saw him for the first time thought he was extremely ordinary, apart from his skin color, there wasn’t anything exceptional about him. However, he obtained the ashes of an immortal monk, merging it into himself, so he was destined to take a path that exceeded the imagination of ordinary people, perhaps achieving True Immortal realm.

Great Xu tuo in the past suppress a powerful red dragon and using it in battle. There was a legends told how after Great Xu Tuo obtained the ashes after cremation, he had previously journeyed the world, wishing to eliminate the demonic, suppressing an evil dragon. It was rumored that its cultivation was profound, strength frightening! After Immortal Academy’s old monsters learned of its existence, they didn’t allow it to be killed, feeling that it was a rare fighting strength! Even Immortal Academy’s old monsters saw it as a precious talent, one could see just how extraordinary it was! This was a red dragon that was retracing its ancestor’s power, bloodline already extremely pure.

He made his appearance alongside Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch ,Lan Xian at the Heavenly Deity Institution where the cave was opened that held the Heavenly Horned Ant. They look down on the institution and came to take the other student's spot to enter the cave . Huang had just came out of his three year selection cultivation the Body as a Seed.

Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch when previously heard how huang defeated Yu Wudi, he wanted to fight against him, words where exchange with all of them and huang challenge all of them together which they saw as a disrespect. they all fought a great battle, Great Xu Tuo was relentless and even used his Red Dragon but in the end all three of them was no match for huang body as a seed.

During the all out battle at Desolate Border among the younger generation from the Foreign Land, though he got his hands chop off he fought bravely and after the war were praised as one of the heroes who came back alive.

During the beginning of  the cultivation less era and the darkness Calamity spreading, Immortal Realm decided to take in the clans with the talented individuals, Xu Tuo was chosen. he would later become a True Immortal. After many battles during the chaotic era he was one of the few friends Shi Hao had that rejected being sealed up and in the final battle a chaotic event which Immortal Domain was outnumbered ten to one while Shi Hao fought the Half-Immortal Emperor's and the Witch, Shi Yi , Qin Hao ,Exiled Immortal, Yao Yue, Little Heavenly King , Dugu Yun and even the Undead Knights such as Shen Ming and San Zang they all fought for Immortal domain. he was killed and later revived.

With three natural energy strand his talent was apparent because even in the Nine heavens Tens Earth naturally cultivated three Immortal Energy Strand is a daunting task, there are many long life families with outstanding geniuses given top resources and still couldn't cultivate three strands, Though weaker, they used unnatural ways to cultivated the third energy strands for examples Immortal Azure Armor, Stealing ones Dao fruit in the form of body snatching etc.

He Later entered the Immortal academy but was unable to acquire any Perfect  Immortal Seeds from the elders or his time in Realm Tomb, so breaking into the Void Dao realm without a seed, practicing the ancient era method made him weaker than the top genius he used to be on par with.

characters.title: Xue Lin
characters.introText: Xue Lin is a member of the Divine Silver Phoenix clan, her clan is of a branch clan bloodline to the Powerful Archaic Vicious Ten True Phoenix Tribe bloodline. Her clan is located in the upper realms (3000 Provinces). Xue Lin made her appearance while being chased by various clans, revealing that she had accidentally come across information about a powerful inheritance, specifically the Supreme Hall Inheritance.
characters.appearance:
Shi Hao later met her again at Immortal Ancient  - While celebrating by drinking (intoxicated) and eating some of his opponent he slaughtered with Qing Yi, Cao Yusheng, Divine Striking Stone, Emperor Butterfly and the Jade Lunar Rabbit "why do I seem to have seen a snow-white phoenix?”

The little rabbit rubbed her eyes as she looked at the spiritual lakeshore. “A divine bird, snow-white and perfect, feathers resplendent. It’s too perfect.” Cao Yusheng sighed with admiration. “This… really is a phoenix?” Qing Yi was also shocked. “We aren’t seeing things, right? How can there be pure-blooded heavenly phoenixes left in this world?” Shi Hao mumbled. Only, when he raised his head and looked at the shore, he also became stupefied. There was a divine bird there, white and pure, like the most perfect work of art from the heavens. Elegant and graceful, snow white and mysterious, it was truly like a Snow Phoenix. “It’ll definitely be tasty…” Shi Hao’s skin was extremely thick, directly speaking on reflex. “What kind of nonsense are you speaking? That might very well be… a Snow Phoenix.” Qing Yi glared at him with a rather displeased look.  “What Snow Phoenix? No matter how I look at it, it looks a bit familiar. I’m pretty sure I caught one like it before…” Shi Hao felt like it was more familiar the more he looked at it. At the same time, his eyes became blurrier the more drunk he got. He then directly drank a cup and said, “It’s a bit different. This one has some golden patterns on its forehead.” “Bullshit!” The little rabbit rolled her eyes, not believing at all that he caught one before.“Is it impossible for you to be quiet?” Qing Yi even more so spoke out against him, because she thought back to the ‘drinking’ of wine from her face. Dark lines couldn’t help but appear on her forehead. “I swear I’m not lying!” Shi Hao now felt anxious, releasing wine fragrance from his mouth as he stated that he didn’t speak any falsehoods, that everything was real. “It’s absolutely true! When I first entered the higher realms, I really did happen to capture a silver phoenix, and I even helped name it, calling it Silver.” Shi Hao said. Right at the lakeshore, that snow-white phoenix bird’s plume feathers stood up, radiance shining in her eyes. It was currently staring deathly at him. While still under the effects of intoxication, he explained a step further, saying, “In the lower realm, I’ve raised a big red bird, subdued Second Baldy, and even captured Third Blackie, the mysterious tortoise, so I wanted to name this Silver Phoenix Fourth Whitie, but in the end, it absolutely hated that name, so i just named it Silver.” The Snow Phoenix descended by the shore, turning into an incomparably beautiful young lady with glossy and smooth silver hair. Her slim figure walked over gracefully.  “I really did capture a similar Snow Phoenix, only, that one didn’t have golden patterns on its head. Back then, I even carried it in my bosom, personally helping it treat its feathers. After several dozen cuts, its long feathers were shortened, and later on, it looked a bit like a white pigeon.” By the lake, that exceptional young lady’s glare could kill. However, her attitude was still graceful as she walked over elegantly. This was her innate noble temperament. Finally, the exceptional young lady closed in, her eyes spewing out flames. That type of aura was about to reach Shi Hao’s face. “Eh, why do you look the same as Silver?” Shi Hao’s drunk vision was hazy, pointing at the young lady while speaking. He really drank too much, about to collapse from intoxication.
The silver-haired young lady’s body was slender. Even though there were flames released from her eyes, her bearing was still graceful, her demenour elegant and wonderful. This was an innate type of noble temperament. “We’ve... met?” Shi Hao called out. Shi Hao released a cry of alarm. These were phoenix flames that originated from the Snow Phoenix bloodline. Normal people wouldn’t be able to endure it. However, symbols automatically appeared around his body, his single heavenly passage protecting him. “Silver, you really are the Silver I raised?” Shi Hao immediately sobered up a bit from his drunken state. When the silver-haired young lady heard the name Silver, she was immediately provoked. She gnashed her teeth in anger, dark lines appearing on her sparkling white forehead. She was truly angered badly. When she thought of the bitter experience she went through two years ago, she wanted to vomit blood. The proud heavenly lady of a glorious sect with the chance of evolving into the Snow Phoenix, someone who was known as a legendary genius girl, in the end unexpectedly landed in that monster’s hands. She had to go through the disastrous experience of having her feathers cut.
Eventually they calm down and had a conversation revealing why she were chase by the other clans back then etc. In later chapters while in the medicine field where shi hao was invited by the Long Life Medicine elder, he had the gang and Xue Lin brother other as he was afraid they would be attack while he was away. Xue in the medicine filed receive a great Natural Luck  in a nest left behind by a True Phoneix.

characters.introText: Yao Yi stood out as an extraordinary talent within the Demon Dragon Sect, regarded as the sect's first generation. Unlike his sect companions, who were weaker and in the Venerable Realm, he didn't need to cross the Sin Province to advance. Instead, he exploited the passage within his own province to access the Immortal Ancient. After spending several months there, he managed to ascend to the Divine Flame Realm, cultivating by a divine source.
characters.history:
Yao Yi stood out as an extraordinary talent within the Demon Dragon Sect, regarded as the sect's first generation. Unlike his sect companions, who were weaker and in the Venerable Realm, he didn't need to cross the Sin Province to advance. Instead, he exploited the passage within his own province to access the Immortal Ancient. After spending several months there, he managed to ascend to the Divine Flame Realm, cultivating by a divine source.

At a particular moment, he noticed a humanoid figure approaching, black as pitch and reduced to skin and bones. His eyes shone intensely, but according to those present, he was clearly someone who had failed in their path, damaging their dao while attempting to ignite a divine flame, ending up with their body in that atrocious state.

What was surprising was his complete lack of surrender, as his smile bloomed like a flower. A dry and burnt flower, however. His charred face was black as pitch, dry and cracked, but his teeth remained white as snow. His persistent attraction to Yao Yi deeply irritated the latter, leading many to think that the charred young man harbored romantic interests towards men.

This person revealed his true identity: he was the one who had murdered Yun Meng, Yao Yi's master, known as "Sin". Despite efforts to avenge the master, Shi Hao (Sin) proved invincible, with superhuman strength after reaching the Divine Flame Realm. Yao Yi died miserably, ending up as a meal for Shi Hao.

characters.title: Yao Yue
characters.introText: Princess Yao Yue is an exceptionally talented supreme young being and a prominent figure within the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, known for her unmatched beauty and formidable cultivation. She hails from the Xu Family, which commands an ancient imperial court and is recognized as a Long Life Family. She is an esteemed official disciple at the Heavenly Deity Institution (HDI). Yao Yue is renowned for cultivating three strands of immortal energy and maintains a fiercely competitive rivalry with Fairy Wang Xi. Her family, the Xu Family, is ruled by her father, Emperor Xu Mingxuan.
characters.appearance:
Yao Yue was celebrated as a world-toppling beauty, often described as a fairy walking on ripples or a goddess of the moon. She possessed a tall, slender, and elegant figure with perfect curves, often accentuated by her attire. Her skin was consistently described as snow-white, sparkling like fine ivory or jade.

Her defining feature was her association with moonlight; she was frequently surrounded by a pure, holy halo of soft light or bathed in water-like moonlight, even during the day. She typically wore white clothes that fluttered about her, enhancing her ethereal and aloof temperament. Her eyes were large, intelligent, and clear like limpid autumn waters, capable of swirling with divine multicolored light. When playing the zither or engaging in battle, she exuded a charm that could captivate both mortals and cultivators alike.
characters.personality:
Unlike her stoic rival Wang Xi, Princess Yao Yue was sociable, charming, and possessed a crafty, intelligent nature. She was known for her sweet, enchanting smile, which she often used to disarm opponents or tease her friends. She took great pleasure in the misfortunes of her rivals, particularly Wang Xi, often seizing opportunities to mock the Wang Family or incite disharmony between Wang Xi and Shi Hao.

Despite her playful exterior, she was a pragmatic and decisive cultivator. She understood the value of alliances, readily putting aside differences to cooperate with Shi Hao when necessary. She was also bold and unconstrained by traditional reserve; she openly tried to recruit Shi Hao to her family and even joked about becoming his dao companion to spite Wang Xi. Beneath her charm lay a fierce warrior's heart; she was unafraid of confrontation, willing to fight to the death against foreign Emperor Clans and the armies of darkness to protect her world.
characters.history:
Princess Yao Yue is a first generation genius from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths that is describe as one the the top beauties. She's from the Xu Clan Family a True Immortal or Rather Long life family.  Her Family is one of the leading families of this generation in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths which has the powerful Immortal Ancient Banner an attacking and defensive banner soaked from the blood of Immortal King that recently started to develop sentience.

The Xu Family has a long standing feud with the Wang Family, so naturally her rival is the Wang's family fairy Wang Xi. they're basically the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths copy of Yue Chan and the Witch from the Three Thousand Provinces, both beautiful and immensely talented, Wang Xi temperament is a bit like Yue chan/Qing Yi  while princess Yao Yue is flirty like the Witch.

With three natural energy strand her talent was apparent because even in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths naturally cultivated three Immortal Energy Strand is a daunting task, there are many long life families with outstanding geniuses given top resources and still couldn't cultivate three strands, Though weaker, they used unnatural ways to cultivated the third energy strands for examples Immortal Azure Armor, stealing ones Dao fruit in the form of body snatching etc.

She entered Heavenly Deity Institution and later Immortal Academy, during her time there she befriended Shi Hao and wanted to bring him over to their court.  She had many battles including a three way fierce fight between Feng Xingtian, Xuan Kun and herself, she then team up with Xuan Kun to eliminate Feng xingtian quickly while Shi Hao looks on, waiting for a chance to slaughter Feng Xingtian. During the battle an elder of xingtian clan illegally entered the competition and wanted to killed them all, he was attracted to Yao Yue beauty and wanted to do more than just body snatching.

Later, Her family (Father) while looking for her dao companion had Shi Hao, Shi Yi, Exiled Immortal, Tian Zi, Ning Chuan and others as potential companion for her.  She seems to appreciate the company of Little Heavenly King as seen when she stood proudly beside him when he visited the academy, after all, apart from Shi Hao only a handful of student from the academy could be his opponent.

She also went to Desolate Border with the other geniuses and had many battles, growing in strength and as one of the survivor from the war she gain much reputation among the younger generation.

As time went on during the cultivation-less Era and the darkness calamity her family was also chosen to enter Immortal domain, she would meet with Shi Hao and the others and fought during the chaotic war battles. At the Final battle where  Immortal Domain where largely out-numbered by the fallen Immortals she was also killed, She was one of the friends Shi Hao revived later on.

characters.title: Ye Luo
characters.introText: A genius from the Lower realm fraction of the Condensation Sect. Ye Luo along with fellow sect member Liao Fan appeared along side a few other clans, Qin Yi of Heaven Mending Sect and Immortal Mountain etc at the Stone Clan palace in the Stone Country after the great calamity and the disappearance of the Emperor Shi Guo.

characters.history:
The true identity of Ye Qingxian is Xiao Zi, the daughter of Ye Yishui and Ye Xian. Her name was given by her grandfather, Ye Fan, to safeguard future generations from the darkness that awaited them after the end of the Dharma era. Emperor Ye Tian intervened in time and space, leaving Xiao Zi in ancient times, hoping to seek help from Emperor Huang Tian. However, to avoid karmic consequences, she changed her name to Ye Qingxian.

Ye Qingxian, the extraordinary descendant of Ye Fan, was sent back to ancient times to bridge the gap between the Celestial Emperors Huang and Ye, bearing a tremendous karmic burden. Due to mysterious interference from the ancient ancestor resulting in continuous reductions in her cultivation, she eventually fell into ruin. Yet, Ye Fan resurrected her to fight alongside him in the final battle, completing her path.

In "Perfect World", Ye Qingxian is a mysterious character who appeared midway through the story, helping Shi Hao without revealing her true identity.
When Ye Fan entered the celestial realm, he deduced the reason for Emperor Huang Tian's disappearance. Years earlier, Emperor Huang Tian had sacrificed himself, embodying extreme evil for the sake of the celestial realm. Only a few, including Ye Fan, knew the truth. Together, they opened a temporal passage, allowing Ye Fan to kill the dormant extreme evil.

On the other side, Ye Yishui's daughter, Ye Qingxian, was sent to uncover the truth about Emperor Huang Tian during those years. Before Ye Qingxian's departure, she already knew that Ye Fan had faced extreme evil during that period, which had destroyed the soul and could only be revived with the third-cycle life medicine.
The news couldn't be transmitted, but by resurrecting Ye Fan, there was hope to convey the information to Emperor Huang Tian of that time, eliminating the danger at that critical moment. This vital information could determine destruction or salvation.

In the novel "Holy Ruins" Ye Qingxian's blood is influenced by the Empress, and her story intertwines with the blood-stained land. After millions of years, the demon's body reappears when Chu Feng, now the Immortal Emperor, stumbles upon her body and resurrects her with his immortal power.
After resurrection, Yao Yao regains some of Ye Qingxian's memories and, at the same time, reaches the Immortal King level due to her rebirth. After many eras spent meditating in the chaos, Yao Yao also becomes an Immortal Emperor just before Chu Feng's sacrifice ceremony. In the grand finale, Yao Yao and Ye Qingxian separate into two distinct individuals.

characters.title: Ye Tiandi
characters.introText: Ye Fan (Ye Tiandi) is the protagonist of the xianxia novel "Shrouding the Heavens" (遮天) written by Chen Dong. He makes a cameo appearance in "Perfect World" (完美世界). He was originally an ordinary person from Earth, but by chance, he was brought to the Beidou Star Region by the Nine Dragons pulling a coffin, starting his cultivation journey, and ultimately attaining the status of Heavenly Emperor.
characters.appearance:
Ye Fan is the Mysterious Expert who is an unidentified, immensely powerful figure who briefly crossed into Shi Hao's time-space during the climactic battle at Heaven Abyss, arriving by riding an ancient, blood-marked cauldron through a rupture in the long river of time. His true name, era of origin, and ultimate fate remain unknown. He is confirmed to be connected to the drop of blood Shi Hao previously obtained from the All Life Earth within the Immortal Ancient Remains.

The vessel he rides is described as vast and boundless, its aura "swallowing the sun and moon." Key details:
Forged from multiple types of Immortal Gold combined with all life source energy.

Its opening functions like a miniature cosmos, taking in and releasing streams of starlight; great stars visibly orbit and spin around its rim as it moves.

The cauldron wall and surrounding stars are described as being dyed entirely red with blood both The expert's own blood and that of his enemies.

Its surface bears blade marks, arrow holes, and other scars from what are implied to be countless prior world-shocking battles, some of them clearly very recent.

It possesses a self-healing property older scars on its surface were observed visibly fading and closing over time.

It is capable of independently absorbing scattered blood essence, corpses, and even stellar matter, refining them and drawing them inside.

Its power was great enough that its mere passage caused the golden-backed barbaric bull pulling Anlan's chariot to have its bones crack and break, forcing the beast to collapse, despite the cauldron and its rider making no direct move against it.
characters.history:

He was originally an ordinary person from Earth, but by chance, he was brought to the Beidou Star Region by the Nine Dragons pulling a coffin, starting his cultivation journey, and ultimately attaining the status of Heavenly Emperor.

In "Perfect World," Ye Fan and others crossed the river of time to help the Desolate Heavenly Emperor, Shi Hao, in his battle against powerful enemies. This indicates that after the events of "Shrouding the Heavens," Ye Fan’s strength further increased, reaching the level of a Quasi-Immortal Emperor.

characters.title: Yi Gu
characters.introText: Yigu (亦谷) is an antagonist introduced in the Perfect World (完美世界). He is an ancient and powerful cultivator from the Foreign Realm one of the most aggressive invading factions in the series. Like other Foreign Realm Supremes, he holds the title “Foreign Realm Supreme” (异域至尊), marking him as one of the highest-ranking combatants in the invasion force. He appears during large-scale conflicts at the Desolate Border, where the Foreign Realm launches repeated offensives against the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
characters.appearance:
Yigu is depicted as an elderly, venerable cultivator with a deeply intimidating and cosmic presence. He has long white hair, a flowing white beard, and a mustache, with his hair partially secured by a golden, crown-like ornament that emphasizes his ancient status.

He wears layered high-tier robes, combining jade-green inner garments with a dark outer robe and an elegant white overcoat featuring wide flowing sleeves. His shoulders are reinforced with ornate, gold-accented armor shaped with dragon-like motifs, reinforcing his high rank within the Foreign Realm hierarchy.

Surrounding his body are drifting ethereal blue ribbons inscribed with star-like patterns, giving the impression of cosmic energy flow. Behind him, a massive spatial phenomenon resembling a black hole or stellar rift forms, often accompanied by jagged constructs of ice or metallic energy, highlighting his overwhelming aura and spatial pressure.

characters.history:
One of the six Celestial Clan Heroes or rather young genius and ranked number one. This was before the the Three Stone Monarch Appeared. You Yu is ranked as one of this era young genius that overlooked his province, though not on par with the crown kings aka ancient young monsters but was ranked up there with the best such as Shan Dianzi (Child of lightning) Teng Yi, Zhan Tiange, Heavenly country number one genius Lang Hao and others. He was the descendant of an Emperor Race, merged with the Heavenly Fate Stone, and was even an ‘exceptional talent’, so many people predicted that You Yu’s future accomplishments would most likely surpass that of the archaic six great celestials.

You Yu was describe as His figure was tall and slender, sturdy like a dragon. His skin was sparkling and brilliant, looking like an immortal that descended into the secular world.  His eyes were clear, his eyebrows reaching the temples. He was handsome and heroic in appearance. You Yu was born with an innate ability known as the void dao special cage technique that has time and space applications and once captured in that cage world his opponents are like puppets as he controls all Laws in that cage world.

This was the Celestial Clan’s most powerful genius. He was an exceptional talent, already shocking originally. Now that he received the Heavenly Fate Stone’s approval, he became even more terrifying, now incomparable! Many young ladies screamed from both sides of the street, their eyes filled with great splendor. They were all looking towards him, because You Yu was already the number one expert of the Celestial Race before.

After merging with the Heavenly Fate Stone, his future accomplishments were impossible to assess! Just like how all the young men were looking at Yun Xi, all of the young women were looking at You Yu. Some people couldn’t hide their adoration and cried out from the sides.

Red Spider Lily aka Manzhu Shahua and Fu Qu sighed. When they saw Yun Xi and You Yu walk together, it really was an ideal combination. Their gaits were identical, walking shoulder to shoulder. They felt a bit of bitterness inside. They knew that if nothing unexpected happened, this would be like a pair of jade. There was always the tradition that the most powerful and perfect celestials would walk together.

Manzhu Shahua and Fu Qu also felt admiration for You Yu, but now, the two of them were powerless to compete for him. Yun Xi and You Yu’s relationship looked so close that it was hard for anyone else to walk between them.

Shi Hao great slaughter of the celestial clans geniuses in the Divine Flame Realm, True God along with destroying  their Caves force You Yu to take actions  they finally fought for supremacy, after many rounds of blows and powerful attacks Shi Hao was too much for You Yu and in the end Shi Hao crippled You Yu by take out his Heavenly Fate Stone.

characters.history:
Yu Lun  a talented  cultivator of the Celestial Clan, clothed in white clothes with a head of purple hair, an appearance like jade. Even though chosen to enter the clan secret realm where the Heavenly mandate stone was kept he wasn't chosen by the stone and never fused with one. He was one of Celestial Clan’s most outstanding disciples. His cultivation was high, someone who previously dared to challenge You Yu and fought great battles against him. He didn’t obtain the heaven’s mandate stone, but he was still ranked near the front of the six heroes, far greater than the Kun Mo that was squeezed out.

Yu Lun was immensely arrogant and hot tempered  as he said  “I truly want to break Huang’s corpse into tens of thousands of pieces. He actually dares to humiliate my clan, truly deserving death!” Yu Lun said.

“It is a pity that we are not his opponent. Even if You Yu fought against him, he still might not necessarily win.” Another person said. He was the last of the six heroes. “He killed True deities, so he definitely has a secret treasure and used special methods. His true fighting prowess might not be that great.” Another person deduced the truth.

“What are you scared of? I’ve seen Kun Mo's injuries and understand that person’s strength. He is definitely not stronger than me. Even if we take a step back and say that he can match me in strength, with the secret treasure I was bestowed by the Heavenly deity, killing him is too easy!” Yu Lun said.

“It’s still best if we don’t act too rashly. Many things happened to my clan, so it is still best if we act calmly.” The sixth hero said.

Yu Lun again replied

“That is precisely why I want to vent out a bit of my resentment. Even some random cat or dog can climb on top of my clan’s head. Intolerable!”

“I will ask senior brother You Yu to see how he feels.” The sixth hero said. Another person also nodded, expressing his agreement. In the end, they split apart in somewhat bad terms.

Yu Lun was proud and arrogant, feeling that if not for You Yu being an exceptional talent, he might not be more powerful than himself. He felt the same way towards the other party obtaining the heaven’s mandate stone, attributing it all to luck.

Yu Lun later headed over to Supreme Being Dao Rite to face off against Huang against the advice of others and was ruthless beaten and killed by huang.

Yu Meng was the number one expert of the Rain Clan. This time, he accepted orders from the clan elder to inspect the western border. This area was part of the clan’s property, and there were various uncommon metal ore mines, as well as various precious birds and strange beasts.

During this time, he also met with elders of the Rain Clan, discussing their disappointment for not finding Shi Ziling and Shi Hao after so many years. He met with Xia Youyu and received one of the Eight Heaven Mending Pavilion Talisman she brought with her to give out.

When Shi Hao entered the second ancestral land where he found Shi Qingfeng and butler grandpa, spies from the Rain Clan notified Yu Meng and his sister Yu Yan of Shi Hao's whereabouts. They left the Rain Clan's manor to slaughter Shi Hao. After a long battle, both siblings were killed by Shi Hao.

characters.introText: Yu Wudi (于无敌), widely known as Invincible Yu, was one of the most outstanding prodigies of the Immortal Academy and a renowned genius of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. His name, meaning “Invincible,” symbolized both his unshakable confidence and the immense expectations placed upon him. Alongside the Little Heavenly King, he was regarded as one of the two brightest stars of the academy’s new generation—both unmatched in potential, talent, and battle prowess.
characters.appearance:
Yu Wudi (于无敌), widely known as Invincible Yu, was one of the most outstanding prodigies of the Immortal Academy and a renowned genius of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. His name, meaning “Invincible,” symbolized both his unshakable confidence and the immense expectations placed upon him. Alongside the Little Heavenly King, he was regarded as one of the two brightest stars of the academy’s new generation—both unmatched in potential, talent, and battle prowess.

Despite his status as an Immortal Academy disciple, Yu Wudi was also connected to the Archaic Vicious Ten and the ancient Jiuyou Tribe, suggesting a complex lineage that blended archaic ferocity with immortal brilliance. This made him stand apart from ordinary cultivators, as he possessed both the battle instincts of ancient bloodlines and the refined cultivation arts of the Immortal Academy.

He was first mentioned during the events of the Realm Tomb, when students of the Immortal Academy competed with other top forces for Immortal Seeds—treasures essential for breaking through to the Void Dao Realm. While Shi Hao gained fame by defeating several of the Academy’s elites, Yu Wudi’s name was invoked with a mixture of awe and caution, being described as one of the few capable of matching or even surpassing the Little Heavenly King in battle when both were at the Heavenly Deity level.

After Shi Hao returned from the Realm Tomb, tensions between his group and the Immortal Academy escalated. When the Little Heavenly King refused to fight Shi Hao in the God Arena—claiming Shi Hao was still beneath his level—he instead called upon Yu Wudi, recognizing him as someone equal to himself and capable of testing Shi Hao’s limits.

characters.personality: Yu Yu is arrogant and does exactly as he pleases, described by Shi Hao as "wild and untamed." He is confident to the point of carelessness, willing to take on any opponent without feeling the need to boast beforehand, and he mocks weaker cultivators openly (for example, belittling the Nine Heavens' predecessors as having become his clan's slaves). Despite his arrogance, he keeps his word about fighting fairly, offering to "accept his loss" if defeated. He has a volatile temper that flares when humiliated, and holds deep resentment and killing intent toward Shi Hao after being publicly mocked by his fellow Emperor Clan geniuses and after nearly being killed by him.
characters.history: Yu Yu is one of the six (later seven, counting Gu Hong) "Young Emperors"  young geniuses from the Emperor Clans and allied ancient bloodlines of the foreign world that stands opposed to the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. He is a wielder of the Heaven Creation Fist, a well-known ancestral method exclusive to his clan, said to carry "the power of the world's creation."
