characters.title: Yu Zimo
characters.introText: Her name was Yu Zimo. Green clothes covered her body, fluttering about in the wind. Her skin was sparkling, and her eyelashes were long. Her pupils were quick-witted and deep, as if she came straight out of a picture. She was extremely beautiful, and carried a type of rarely seen spiritual nature.
characters.history:
Divine light enveloped the body, emitting a terrifying aura. Symbols were close and numerous, leaving marks in the heavens and submerging this area.

That individual was currently practicing breathing exercises. The sea of essence energy between the heaven and the earth bubbled forth, assembling together. Symbols endlessly undulated and flickered like a vast body of water. They rose and fell like the tides, intimidating the heavens.

If there was someone here, they would definitely be absolutely stunned. This type of youth was truly too terrifying and rarely seen in this world!

This was one of the Rain Clan’s two heroes. With astonishing strength, they passed through ten thousand li of the great wasteland in the past. After defeating a great number of noble children, they became well known even within the imperial family.

They all knew too well how talented the hero Yu Zimo was. She had a special type of psychic power, and would sometimes strangely understand the cause of indescribably things.

No one knew exactly what type of divine power this was. Everyone within the clan all admired her greatly. If not for the existence of Shi Yi, then she would inevitably become even more dazzling.

She was last seen when Shi Hao was fighting seven deities in the lower realm. After finishing Yang Li from Yin Yang Academy, Silver Pangolin, and Underworld Earth skeleton deity using the trap in Western Tomb Realm, Shi Hao saw Yu Zimo again  in the small town near Stone Country Capital. She was recognized by Shi Hao, but he decided to let her go. Then she told Shi Hao about her divination, "I peered into the future and only saw primal chaos. When I turned around, behind your body was an expanse of nothingness.”

When they met again, she once again made this type of prediction. It was the same as the time in Hundred Shattering Mountains. When Shi Hao heard this, he raised his head and looked at her. “What do you mean?” This wasn’t the first time he heard this. “I don’t know.” Yu Zimo wiped away the trace of blood from her forehead and said, “You… don’t seem to be a part of this collection of ancient history. Perhaps, you… will completely vanish from this world.”
characters.trivia: She fought against Shi Hao herself using her psychic powers and precious artifacts but in the end ended up being completely defeated by him and almost dying.

characters.title: Yuan Qing

infobox.realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)
infobox.relatives: Yuan Hong (3rd Son) Yuan Feng (grandson)
infobox.CauseOfDeath: Shattered primordial spirit, annihilating both body and soul.

characters.introText: Yuan Qing is a major antagonist in Shi Hao’s story, repeatedly obstructing his growth and shaping many of the hardships he faces. He is portrayed as domineering, ruthless, and cold-hearted, carrying an arrogance born from his strength and influence. Even though he is considered “young” compared to ancient freaks, he stands just a step away from the supreme being domain, making him one of the most formidable figures of his era.
characters.appearance: Yuan Qing is a major antagonist in Shi Hao’s story, repeatedly obstructing his growth and shaping many of the hardships he faces. He is portrayed as domineering, ruthless, and cold-hearted, carrying an arrogance born from his strength and influence. Even though he is considered “young” compared to ancient freaks, he stands just a step away from the supreme being domain, making him one of the most formidable figures of his era.
characters.personality: Yuan Qing died after a confrontation with Shi Hao. During their encounter, Shi Hao decisively defeated Yuan Qing by slicing off both of Yuan Qing's arms, dealing fatal injuries. Yuan Qing, realizing he had no chance to survive the fight, lowered his head and submitted to Shi Hao, hoping to preserve his life. However, Shi Hao showed no mercy and ultimately cut through Yuan Qing's primordial spirit, destroying his body and soul completely, resulting in Yuan Qing's death.Yuan Qing was a significant enemy to Shi Hao, having previously suppressed and exiled Shi Hao to the Origin Ancient Mine, hoping to eliminate him. Despite his ruthless actions against Shi Hao, Yuan Qing was ultimately unable to withstand Shi Hao's power and was killed in this decisive battle.
characters.history:
Yuan Qing’s past is surprisingly complex. In his youth, he entered both the Sacred Academy and the Immortal Academy, but was ultimately rejected by both institutions, branded an abandoned disciple. This humiliation became a deep scar in his heart and strongly influenced his personality making him bitter, ambitious, and determined to prove himself.

Despite this early setback, Yuan Qing rose to power and reputation. He aligned himself closely with the Wind Clan, an ancient long-life family, gaining political backing and influence across the Nine Heavens. His status later allowed him to send his own descendants and retainers into major institutions, including the Heavenly Deity Institution.

Yuan Qing is characterized by cold arrogance, cruelty, and a calculating nature. He often appears with a cold smile, masking intense grudges and a desire to dominate others. While he acts brashly, his actions are driven by fear, insecurity, and an obsessive desire to control all potential threats especially Shi Hao.He believes himself superior to most cultivators, yet beneath this pride lies deep caution. Several times, he hesitates to deal the final blow to Shi Hao, only to regret it later as Shi Hao grows stronger.Yuan Qing’s ruthlessness extends even to his own family. He has no qualms sending his descendants to the front lines of his vendetta, viewing them as pawns to maintain his status.

Yuan Qing emerges as Shi Hao’s most formidable early adversary, beginning from the moment Shi Hao ascends to the Nine Heavens. His hostility is immediate and calculated, driven by both personal ambition and external orders. Upon Shi Hao’s arrival, Yuan Qing captures him and covertly arranges for his transfer to the Origin Ancient Mine a perilous location from which few ever return. This ruthless act is executed under the directive of the Wind Clan, who seek to eliminate Shi Hao due to his “sinner’s blood” and extraordinary potential. Yuan Qing embraces the task with enthusiasm, viewing it as a chance to strengthen his own standing.

His vendetta against Shi Hao extends beyond direct confrontation, as Yuan Qing repeatedly deploys his descendants in attempts to destroy him. Yuan Feng, his grandson, was raised with immense resources and expectations, and was sent into the Heavenly Deity Institution with the sole purpose of assassinating Shi Hao. However, this plan backfired when Yuan Feng was slain by Shi Hao in the Immortal Ancient Battlefield, marking a humiliating defeat for Yuan Qing. Undeterred, Yuan Qing later dispatched his son, Yuan Hong, to interrogate Shi Hao. This too ended in disgrace, as Yuan Hong was publicly beaten and nearly killed, further tarnishing Yuan Qing’s reputation.
These repeated failures only intensified Yuan Qing’s hatred, driving him to adopt increasingly desperate and aggressive strategies in his pursuit of vengeance.

characters.title: Yue Chan

infobox.Title: Yue Chan
infobox.Aliases: Fairy Yue Chan

characters.introText: Yue Chan, utilizing a secret technique by separating her Dao Core into two, thereby giving life to two entirely identical entities. The first of them chose to dedicate itself to cultivation in the Upper Realm, emerging as the most powerful of the two and hence considered the main body. Meanwhile, the second embarked on a journey to accumulate valuable experiences.
characters.appearance: She was an exceptional beauty and possessed an incomparable charm. She was talking to Qin Yining with smiles, and now, she was still holding this holy senior lady's arm.
characters.history:
An extremely beautiful, cold hearted, and cunning woman. She’s always at odds with the Sky Severing Witch.
As the Precious Technique separated her Dao Core, she gained two bodies and the ability to die many times as long as one of the bodies was alive, as it could reconstruct the other body. This also gave her very similar personalities but different identities, although the main body could somewhat suppress the thoughts and actions of the second body, it was no longer the case after reaching Divinity.

Yue Chan pretending to be her other self, Qing Yi, ambushes Shi Hao and captures him. Yue Chan learned of His isolation place because she’d been fighting against Qing Yi, and they briefly merged enabling both of them to see into some of their secrets. Shi Hao was taken by surprise because Yue Chan used a secret item that masked her Soul Fluctuations making it seem as though it was Qing Yi, and the fact that Shi Hao had suffered great injuries due to the constant burning of the 10,000 dao.
In the ensuing confrontation between Yue Chan and Qing Yi, Shi Hao as a prisoner sees himself used as bait, but manages to fire off some of the remaining 10,000 Dao Flames in his body, causing damage to Yue Chan only to realise she’d made plans of her own using the Primordial Spirit Mirror Image Technique to plant a mirror image of herself into Shi Hao. Using the opportunity created by the shock of the Technique, Yue Chan once again fights with Qing Yi for supremacy over the complete body by merging. This action caused the Green Moon Flame in Qing Yi’s body to react, creating an Immortal Energy Strand. As Yue Chan and Qing Yi fight for the destruction of the others Soul Imprint, Shi Hao sees his only way of helping Qing Yi is by upsetting Yue Chan causing her mind to waver, which would benefit Qing Yi inherent losing momentum as she’s the Second Body. Qing Yi also uses this to her advantage and burns all of the clothes of their reunited body leaving it naked. After some insults and beatings, just as Yue Chan was about to win, Qing Yi takes possession of the body, leaving her imprint defenceless to drag her body into Shi Hao’s embrace. It is heavily implied that as Qing Yi presses herself against Shi Hao’s body (that was also naked because of the burning of the Green Moon Flame) they become “connected” at the hip. Effectively raping Yue Chan with Qing Yi’s help. Unable to accept the humiliation of being raped, Yue Chan separates herself from Qing Yi and runs away, tries to go back and attack only to be stopped by the Jade Lunar Rabbit and the Divine Striking Stone, at which point she uses a Realm Shattering Symbol and truly escapes. After escaping all she could think of was trying to wash herself in Mountain Range Realm’s many spiritual water hot springs.

characters.title: Yun Canghai
characters.introText: Yun Canghai, encountered Shi Hao and recognizing Shi Hao's power and talent, tried to recruit him to help Yun Xi (his granddaughter) and her comrades search the North Sea for the fabled Kun Peng's nest and the Kung Peng's precious technique hidden therein. Only after lending one of his magical armguards as collateral to Shi Hao and promising clues as to Shi Hao's parents' whereabouts, was Yun Canghai able to convince Shi Hao to join Yun Xi's quest.
characters.history:
Yun Canghai, encountered Shi Hao and recognizing Shi Hao's power and talent, tried to recruit him to help Yun Xi (his granddaughter) and her comrades search the North Sea for the fabled Kun Peng's nest and the Kung Peng's precious technique hidden therein. Only after lending one of his magical armguards as collateral to Shi Hao and promising clues as to Shi Hao's parents' whereabouts, was Yun Canghai able to convince Shi Hao to join Yun Xi's quest.

With the impending calamity that was about to hit the Lower Realm, all major clans and sects were searching for ways to escape to the Higher Realms. Celestial Clan was no exception and they had a Gate of Life leading to the Higher Realms in their Heavenly Divine Mountain.

Unfortunately the formation of this gate was broken and Er Tuzi was the only one with the expertise to fix it. Er Tuzi agreed to fix the gate on the condition that he and Yun Menglan would be reunited in the Celestial Clan. After Er Tuzi and Yun Menglan tearfully reunited, the wronged couple demanded compensation from Yun Canghai in the form of a betrothal between Yun Xi and Shi Hao. Yun Canghai needed Er Tuzi's help to repair the Gate of Life so he reluctantly agreed, and a horrified Yun Xi and a bewildered Shi Hao suddenly found themselves engaged.

As Er Tuzi and the Willow Deity investigated and repaired the Gate of Life, Shi Hao finally relinquished Yun Canghai's armguard which was used to help with the repairs. As for Yun Xi and Shi Hao's future marriage, it only became a distant possibility as Shi Hao decided to stay in the Lower Realm and deal with the calamity, while Yun Xi escaped with her family through the Gate of Life to take refuge in the Celestial Clan of the Higher Realms.

characters.title: Yun Meng

infobox.Title: Yun Meng
infobox.CauseOfDeath: Soul Shattering Needles in Spirit Realm
infobox.realm: Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText: Yun Meng, an elder of the Demon Dragon Sect, takes part in the attack against the mysterious individual known as Sin, who possesses a large quantity of sin blood, within the Spirit Realm. Just before being transported into No Man's Land, the young man manages to strike Yun Meng with the Soul Shattering Needles, bringing him to the brink of death. Subsequently, some of his disciples, including the genius of the Demon Dragon Sect, Yao Yi, seek vengeance for their master, but end up being killed and devoured by Shi Hao.
characters.history: Yun Meng, an elder of the Demon Dragon Sect, takes part in the attack against the mysterious individual known as Sin, who possesses a large quantity of sin blood, within the Spirit Realm. characters.title: Yun Menglan
characters.introText: Yun Menglan  is a member of the Celestial Clan  in the lower realm and was exiled or rather lock away in seclusion by force from the clan for a period of time. Like Yun Xi, she was to be wed to a member of the Roc Golden Clan but fell apart after meeting Er Tuzi.
characters.history:
Yun Menglan  is a member of the Celestial Clan  in the lower realm and was exiled or rather lock away in seclusion by force from the clan for a period of time. Like Yun Xi, she was to be wed to a member of the Roc Golden Clan but fell apart after meeting Er Tuzi.

Similar to how Shi Ziling and Qin Yining met,  she met Er Tuzi while cultivating but something when wrong with her cultivation practice and he help her, they then fell in love and she gave him her erring as a token of love but the Celestial Clan arrange her marriage to the Roc Golden Clan, rejected by her , she then stole the Peng formation map used for the teleportation device to travel between the lower and upper realm, they were both chase down by the elder of both clan, an battle took place leaving Er Tuzi seriously injured and cultivation abolished, life and death unknown to Yun Menglan.  She had rather threaten her own life  than marry another thus she was locked up for years, part willing and by force.

Years later during the pending lower realm calamity while the celestial clan fixed the teleportation formation, she and Er Tuzi finally reunited.

She was sealed in the Three World Bronze Coffin with her Husband because of the old Age and to avoid the Dark turmoil, as she was mostly a non combatant cultivator.

characters.title: Yun Xi

infobox.Title: Yun Xi
infobox.Aliases: Xi'er Junior Sister Yun Xi Fairy Yun Xi Sister-in-Law Plump Women Celestial Clans Maidan Mother (By Shi Fan) One of the six Celestial Clan Heroes
infobox.spouse(s): Shi Hao Huo Ling'er (Sister-wife) Qing Yi (Yue Chan) (Sister-wife)
infobox.relatives: Shi Fan (Son) Yun Canghai (Grandfather) Yun Menglan (Parental Grandaunt) Kong Qiuji (Parental Granduncle) Shi Ziling (Father-in-Law) Qin Yining (Mother-in-Law) Qin Hao (Brother-in-Law) Shi Zhongtian (Grand Father-in-Law)
infobox.realm: Eight Regions (Lower Realm) Nine Heavens and Ten Earths (Upper Realm)

characters.introText:
Yun Xi has a soft yet strong character, possessing the grace and gentleness of a classical woman.
In the lower realm, even though the two had personal grudges at the time, Yun Xi put aside the personal grudges and cooperated with Shi Hao in a sincere and friendly manner. 
Later in the trip to Medicine City, I could always see Yun Xi being knowledgeable and generous, providing Shi Hao with various aspects of knowledge many times.
characters.appearance:
Girlhood
The purple-haired girl spoke, her voice was as beautiful as the sound of nature, her back was soft and graceful, her purple clothes were fluttering, like a fairy about to fly away.Yun Xi a slender figure appeared, beautiful and out of the world, covered with a layer of divine radiance, and a purple dress fluttering, like a fairy descending into the world, transcending the world. The purple-clothed girl Lingbo chased her all the way like a fairy, her clothes fluttering, her graceful and slender fairy body trembling, her white skin glowing. A group of people came closer and naturally saw a beautiful girl with fluttering purple hair. Her beauty was undeniable. She was known as the most beautiful girl in the Celestial Race. Her skin was like gelatin, her eyes were like autumn water, her figure was slender and slender, and she was extremely beautiful.

Adulthood
The purple-haired girl nodded, and her aura faded, revealing her true body, with fluttering sleeves and swaying in the air. Her pretty face was white and angry, and her eyes were like gems. She was so beautiful that she could not be compared to others. No matter where she goes, she is always the center of attention, and her peerless beauty makes people feel ashamed and dare not look at her head-on. Her purple clothes are fluttering, her hair is shiny and smooth, her forehead is full and white, her eyebrows are curved, her eyes are as big as gems , her lips are bright, her figure is graceful and slender, her whole person is pure and beautiful, like a fairy walking out of a painting, she is incredibly beautiful things. Yun Xi Moreover, she has a unique charm, which is the result of fusion with the Destiny Stone. It is recognized by God, and the wisdom of Zhongtian and Earth is unparalleled.

Yun Xi (Destiny Stone)
Yun Xi's dress was raised, rustling in the wind, wrapped around her beautiful figure, outlining her curves, and her purple hair was also fluttering. Her face was as white as an oval, her pupils were like gems, and her nose was straight and very stunning. A girl in purple clothes walked into the palace. Her long purple hair fell naturally, her complexion was white and crystal clear, her eyes were big, and she was graceful.Needless to say, this kind of beauty made some elders look strange and shocked. You must know that these people are old monsters who have lived for countless years and have already stabilized their hearts.

Two worlds of mortals
Over the years, the clouds have been light and the wind has been light, giving people a sense of being out of this world. It is soft, peaceful and quiet. They are collecting medicines in the mountains calmly, like a female fairy who has been banished to the world. Yun Xi's complexion is as beautiful as jade, and her eyes are aura. After so many years, her grace has not diminished, her purple hair is crystal clear, her eyes are pure, and her beauty is peerless. Her complexion is fair, as crystal clear as jade, her eyes are lively, and everything she says and does is extraordinary. Yun Xi is as calm as a fairy. During these years, she seems to have returned to her girlhood, full of vigor, always with a gentle smile, and looking back, she has a peerless charm.
characters.personality:
Yun Xi has a soft yet strong character, possessing the grace and gentleness of a classical woman.
In the lower realm, even though the two had personal grudges at the time, Yun Xi put aside the personal grudges and cooperated with Shi Hao in a sincere and friendly manner. 
Later in the trip to Medicine City, I could always see Yun Xi being knowledgeable and generous, providing Shi Hao with various aspects of knowledge many times.

Yun Xi is a chic woman who values ​​friendship. After Shi Hao married Yun Xi and Shi Hao established the Heavenly Court, Yun Xi not only took care of her own children, but also took care of Shi Hao's parents. As Shi Hao's Taoist companion and the mother of the emperor's son, she guards the heavens and notifies Shi Hao of invasions from foreign lands in a timely manner, doing her part for the safety of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths .
Throughout Yun Xi's life, he made all the major decisions in life by himself, and he did a good job. He did what he should and could do to his relatives, family, and Shi Hao.

Regardless of her strength or status, Yun Xi has always had a heart to protect her family, relatives, and clan members.
characters.history:
She is the Purple-Haired Girl that a young and brash Shi Hao first met in the Hundred Shattering Mountains while competing for magical treasures. In their first encounter, while battling with her and others for the Immortal Spring water, Shi Hao believed the teenage Yun Xi to be a divine beast in human form. With this belief, Shi Hao announced his intention to conquer Yun Xi and drag her back to Stone Village and set her up as one of the guardian beasts for the village. He further infuriated Yun Xi by throwing out with all his might the newly acquired Divine Striking Stone, painfully hitting her forehead with it. Before escaping with the Immortal Spring water, Shi Hao nailed her again with the Divine Striking Stone, leaving her with a pair of blisters on her forehead. Yun Xi's second encounter with the mischievous and bratty Shi Hao was even worse. While Yun Xi was searching a secluded nest for treasure, Shi Hao ambushed her - intent on capturing her again for the village. He tackled her, fiercely wrestled with her on the ground and ended up biting down on her left ear and stealing her left earring pendant with his teeth. Although the capture attempt was unsuccessful, Shi Hao escaped from an outraged Yun Xi with her earring pendant and a shining cocoon treasure.

Yun Canghai, Yun Xi's grandfather, later encountered Shi Hao and recognizing Shi Hao's power and talent, tried to recruit Shi Hao to help Yun Xi and her comrades search the North Sea for the fabled Kun Peng Nest and the Kun Peng Technique hidden therein. Only after lending one of his magical armguards as collateral to Shi Hao and promising clues as to Shi Hao's parents' whereabouts, was Yun Canghai able to convince Shi Hao to join Yun Xi's quest. During the ocean trip to the Kun Peng's nest, Shi Hao was mistreated by Qing Yun, one of Yun Xi's comrades, and was separated from Yun Xi's group when facing an octopus monster. Shi Hao took refuge on a nearby deadly Ghost Ship. Much to Yun Xi's dismay, her group abandoned Shi Hao - with Qing Yun even purposefully exacerbating the dangerous situation for Shi Hao before departing. Yun Xi and her group later encountered Shi Hao at the island of the Kun Peng's nest, shocked that Shi Hao had survived and was able to make his own way to the island. Shi Hao cut off all ties with Yun Xi and her group, even severely injuring Qing Yun before fleeing and searching for the Kun Peng's precious techniques on his own. Shi Hao's tenacity, talent and ability to cause mayhem and chaos to the many competing forces on the island of the Kun Peng's nest earned a begrudging respect from Yun Xi. However any type of reconciliation was complicated by the fact that Shi Hao later took vengeance upon, killed, cooked and ate the Green Luan divine bird beast Qing Yun... the aforementioned comrade of Yun Xi.
Yun Xi and Shi Hao's next several encounters (at the Stone Emperor's birthday gathering or in the middle of a high-pressure wooing attempt by a Golden-Winged Peng genius to Yun Xi) generally consisted of Yun Xi unsuccessfully trying to get her grandfather's magical armguard back from Shi Hao and Shi Hao unsuccessfully trying to convince Yun Xi to be a guardian beast for the Stone Village.

To escape the Golden-Winged Peng's advances, Yun Xi pretended to be involved with Shi Hao and left with him. They were later joined by Huo Ling'er and the Nine-headed Lion and the party of four proceeded to have an adventure in the Medicine Capital. During this time Yun Xi's hard attitude towards Shi Hao started to soften. With the Nine-headed Lion in tow, Shi Hao ironically brought an embarrassed Yun Xi and Huo Ling'er to visit Stone Village and they were able to see a gentler and more caring side of Shi Hao. It was also at Stone Village that Yun Xi encountered one of Shi Hao's sworn brothers, the featherless divine bird beast, Er Tuzi. Er Tuzi was originally hiding within the shining cocoon that Shi Hao stole during his second raucous encounter with Yun Xi in the Hundred Shattering Mountains. Er Tuzi was in fact Kong Qiuji, a former great formation expert from the Peacock Clan who was star-crossed lovers with Yun Xi's aunt, Yun Menglan of the Celestial Clan. Yun Canghai was originally responsible for driving the two lovers apart.

With the impending calamity that was about to hit the Lower Realm, all major clans and sects were searching for ways to escape to the Higher Realms. Yun Xi's Celestial Clan was no exception and they had a Gate of Life leading to the Higher Realms in their Heavenly Divine Mountain. Unfortunately the formation of this gate was broken and Er Tuzi was the only one with the expertise to fix it. Er Tuzi agreed to fix the gate on the condition that he and Yun Menglan would be reunited in the Celestial Clan. Shi Hao's party of four added Er Tuzi and (secretly) the Willow Deity of Stone Village to their number, and the six headed off to the Heavenly Divine Mountain. The Willow Deity was able to restore Er Tuzi's previous human form before meeting with Yun Menglan.  After Er Tuzi and Yun Menglan tearfully reunited, the wronged couple demanded compensation from Yun Canghai in the form of a betrothal between Yun Xi and Shi Hao. Yun Canghai needed Er Tuzi's help to repair the Gate of Life so he reluctantly agreed, and a horrified Yun Xi and a bewildered Shi Hao suddenly found themselves engaged. As Er Tuzi and the Willow Deity investigated and repaired the Gate of Life, Shi Hao finally relinquished Yun Canghai's armguard which was used to help with the repairs. As for Yun Xi and Shi Hao's future marriage, it only became a distant possibility as Shi Hao decided to stay in the Lower Realm and deal with the calamity, while Yun Xi escaped with her family through the Gate of Life to take refuge in the Celestial Clan of the Higher Realms.

After the calamity, Shi Hao also found his way to the Higher Realms. Yun Xi and Shi Hao then by chance ran into each other in the Blood Plains of the Demon Province.  Shi Hao escorted Yun Xi back to the Celestial Clan of the Higher Realms, saving her from the War Clan Especially from the attack by Zhan Tiange, the War King of the War Clan, who attempted to steal the Yun Xi' Heavenly Fate Stone.

The Celestial Clan, even after they learned that Shi Hao had saved Yun Xi from imminent death, later imprisoned him as they coveted his Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique and Kun Peng Technique. They claimed that Shi Hao escorted Yun Xi with ulterior motives, but in reality they wanted to detain and force him to reveal his methods and techniques. At this point, Yun Xi was brought away so that she could not publicly defend Shi Hao. News of Shi Hao's capture lured in many great inheritances, all of them coming for his techniques. This later brought out the Peacock Clan's divine lord (who had close ties with the Willow Deity) and the enigmatic Ye Qingxian; both of whom interfered with the Celestial Clan's plan which resulted in Shi Hao's release.

Yun Xi met Shi Hao again later at the Supreme Being Dao Rite. The Celestial Clan's younger generation had come to fight the mysterious Huang. During the fight with You Yu, the number one younger generation genius of the Celestial Clan, it was revealed that Huang was in fact Shi Hao. The Celestial Clan's Heavenly Deities intervened so that they could eliminate Shi Hao. They first ordered Yun Xi to kill Shi Hao with a Heavenly Fate Stone, she suggests that Shi Hao should escape before the arrival of the Heavenly Deity. Shi Hao refused her goodwill saying that he didn't blame her for what happened in the Celestial Clan. Yun Xi's refusal to kill Shi Hao confirmed to the public the rumor of the Celestial Clan's duplicity towards Shi Hao. Then the Celestial Clan's Dao Protector came to the Supreme Being Dao Rite to kill Shi Hao, but was stopped by Qi Daolin.

The next time Yun Xi saw Shi Hao was from a distance as he battled in the Immortal Ancient World. However at that time she didn't have the courage to face him. After the Immortal Ancient World's battle concluded, Shi Hao later traveled to the Celestial Clan for revenge. The Celestial Clan once again sent out Yun Xi, this time to ask Shi Hao what it would take to settle things between Shi Hao and the Celestial Clan. Shi Hao refused Yun Xi, saying that there was nothing that could be done to erase what they did to him. In the ensuing battle, Shi Hao killed some of the Celestial Clan's Heavenly Deities and caused the death of the clan's Dao Protector.

"From today forth, even if he becomes a mortal, his cultivation disappearing, I will still follow him into the lower realms to take care of him.” Yun Xi

Years later, Yun Xi found herself falling in love with Shi Hao, willingly following him to take care of him in the Lower Realm when he was afflicted with and recovered from the Immortal Breaking Curse. Shi Hao had previously exchanged marriage vows with Qing Yi and Huo Ling'er, and had very complicated relationships with both these women. However, Shi Hao made Yun Xi his first true Dao companion, acknowledging her devotion to him and finally completing the marriage arranged all those years ago by Er Tuzi and Yun Menglan in the Heavenly Divine Mountain.
The Cultivationless Age arrived making it very difficult for cultivators to improve their level. Because of this, Shi Hao did not spend much time with Yun Xi as he continuously left Stone Village to furiously cultivate and find opportunities to reach immortality. Yun Xi understood his pursuit towards becoming a supreme being and did not begrudge the little time he spent with her. Shi Hao was also torn because he still had Huo Ling'er and Qing Yi (Yue Chan) in his heart even though he was separated from them both. After many adventures and centuries of painstaking cultivation, Shi Hao achieved immortality. However because Yun Xi's cultivation level was not as high as Shi Hao's, she was painfully aware of her mortality and her continued aging. Yun Xi and Shi Hao had spent hundreds of years trying to conceive a baby without success and Yun Xi felt that her best years were behind her as she was already thousands of years old.

“No matter how you change, I still won’t leave you. Don’t think too much, don’t feel bad!” Shi Hao embraced her.

Shi Hao acquired for Yun Xi the Sunrise Brilliance flower which allowed Yun Xi to keep her youthful beauty, no matter how old she aged. Coincidentally, six months later Yun Xi became pregnant. Yun Xi eventually bore Shi Hao a son. However another impending catastrophe was approaching and Shi Hao did not wish to raise his son in such a dangerous and chaotic time. He made a decision to seal the baby in stasis inside a magical white cauldron until a new, more peaceful era arrived. Yun Xi couldn't accept this decision and begged to be sealed along with the baby in the white cauldron. Shi Hao compromised by saying he would let the baby sleep inside the cauldron but every so often would wake their son up. Yun Xi was satisfied with this arrangement and kept the white cauldron constantly by her side, periodically waking up their son to bond with her.
In order to extend the life span of Yun Xi and his parents, Shi Hao would transfuse his immortal blood into their bodies. However after thousands of more years, Shi Hao still could not stop the ravages of time on his loved ones.  Although Yun Xi retained her youthful appearance, she still felt the end of her life approaching. Even though Yun Xi was unwilling to let go of this life, she told Shi Hao how grateful she was to have had the time she had with him and that once she passes away, he should not be alone and go seek out Huo Ling'er.

"You don’t need to think too much. I won’t go anywhere, I will just remain by your side!” Shi Hao said to her.

Yun Xi's only regret was that she would leave behind their son, who was now a young child that could speak. Shi Hao could not accept the thought of Yun Xi or any of his loved ones dying.  Instead he sealed Yun Xi within the Stone Village in stasis to preserve her waning longevity along with his family and many of his friends.

After many trials, tribulations and titanic battles, Shi Hao successfully crossed into the Full Immortal Emperor level, becoming a supreme being. Shi Hao then discovered and entered a new realm even more vast and dangerous than the Higher Realms. He temporarily returned to the Higher Realms and released Yun Xi and the rest of Stone Village from stasis and vowed to find a way to resurrect all his friends and loved ones who died fighting on his behalf -  including Shi Hao and Yun Xi's grown son who had somehow earlier escaped the seal of Stone Village and became a mighty warrior fighting and sacrificing himself for Shi Hao in the last battle of the Higher Realms.

At the insistence of Huo Ling'er, she accompanied Shi Hao back to the new realm as he fought a great war there. Shi Hao sealed the Higher Realms in order to protect his Perfect World from potential enemy invasion.  Inexplicably years afterwards, many of Shi Hao's friends and family were resurrected from the dead one-by-one.  In the end, Yun Xi and the others could not yet follow and join Shi Hao as they needed to fulfill the almost impossible task of attaining Full Immortal Emperor level to be able to leave the Perfect World and cross into the new realm. In the The Sacred Ruins Shi Hao built YunXi Palace for her.

Zhuque (朱雀), the Vermilion Bird, is one of the four symbols of the Chinese constellations. It is a red bird that resembles a pheasant with a fire-colored plumage and is perpetually covered in flames. In myths and legends, it is described as having the ability to be reborn from the ashes. It is more similar to the western Phoenix than the more well-known Fenghuang (凤凰).

He serves as one of the elite vanguard commanders during large-scale invasions of the Desolate Border, where the Foreign Realm wages war against the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
characters.appearance:

He wears layered battle armor in dark indigo and violet tones, combined with a purple sash-like lower garment. His right shoulder and chest are reinforced with spiked, beast-themed armor pieces that glow faintly with internal energy.

Constant arcs of purple and blue lightning surround his body, especially around his limbs and weapon bindings. Behind him, a massive rotating lightning halo manifests, often taking the shape of a spectral beast such as a dragon or wolf-formed from condensed tribulation lightning.

characters.appearance:
Zi Tong is a powerful and handsome attendant serving under the Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch. Surrounded by auspicious purple energy, he exudes confidence and authority. At around twenty-five or twenty-six years of age, he is described as having red lips, white teeth, and a refined appearance.
Through diligent study of scriptures and ancient heavenly arts alongside his master, Zi Tong’s cultivation advanced rapidly, surpassing many outstanding young geniuses of various clans. Within both the Immortal Academy and the Sacred Academy, he was known as a heroic expert and one of the few young cultivators believed to have the potential to ascend to true immortality.

Loyal and proud, Zi Tong often acted with a domineering or mischievous attitude, confident in his master’s favor. He once intervened to protect Jin Jiaoxi from Shi Hao, but was reprimanded and ordered to stand down by the Purple Sun Heavenly Monarch himself. Despite his arrogance and impressive strength, Zi Tong was no match for Shi Hao, who defeated him effortlessly on multiple occasions — suppressing him with a single finger and later crippling him again with a kick that shattered his bones and muscles. These encounters left Zi Tong deeply humiliated and fearful, though he later appeared again with a restored aura and composure, delivering invitations from the Immortal Domain and demonstrating power strong enough to restrain Zhu Lin, who had not yet reached the "Supreme Being Realm".

cultivation.title: Becoming the Seed
cultivation.introText: A cultivation system inspired by Shi Hao's mentor Meng Tianzheng. Called The Five Secret Realms by later generations of the Shrouding the Heavens (Zhetian) world. The Dao Ancestor (Daozu) is Huāng when he had trouble cultivating during his Supreme Being period. Becoming the Seed is a humanoid body secret realm cultivation system that all living beings can practice. It is a completely different "dead end" from the fusion of Dao seed and the path of becoming an immortal. It regards oneself as a small world, excavating one's own potential, opening one's own "door", and driving alongside or even surpassing the vast universe, not bound by the rules of the heavens and earth of this realm. It is the true origin of the cultivation system in the Era of Concealment after the Chaos Era.
cultivation.appearance:

It fits humanoids because of Huāng's foodie habit: cook and eat all non-humanoid creatures.

The true cultivation system establishment lead it to have the potential Immortal Emperor when Huāng was a True Immortal facing his Nine Lives Immortal Ascension. Through the Immortal Ascension, Huāng marks his Five Secret Realms he created long ago onto the Great Dao to prove his path to Immortality. From then on, this Dao seed is planted in all races and creatures born afterwords, therefore his inheritors.

The Archaic Vicious Ten Treasure Techniques provided foundational support for this new cultivation system.

Huāng's repeated deaths and experience with new lives from before Supreme Being to after becoming an Immortal are secretly marked within the cultivation system: only true hard work and life-death can bring quality improvement for those who walk on his system.
cultivation.history:
Originally called Becoming the Seed to use Huāng's Dao seed (Qitian Seed absorbed long ago, body experienced several deaths) to open a different path for future Supreme Beings (Great Emperor) to ascend to the Immortal Realm. Later, Huāng improved this old project (cultivation system) to re-cultivate and bring his Supreme Being Realm to the extremity.

It is the Heavenly Passages merged into One, suddenly compressed to a point, and then exploded, accompanied by the two qi of yin and yang. The [Wheel and Sea] is the source of life in the abdomen of the human body, giving birth to magic power and controlling life and death.

Archaic Vicious Techniques: Kun Peng Technique, Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique and Willow Deity Precious Technique (Yin and Yang, Life-Death-Rebirth).

Location: Abdomen.

Age: Opened up during Huāng's twenties.

Heaven and Earth are divided into yin and yang, which is the most simple element. All things generate five qi, and the five elements are mutually reinforcing and interfering, and they are the fundamental elements that evolve all phenomena in the world. Shi Hao sat in seclusion for more than ten years, bringing the qi of the five elements into the five internal organs, to unlock their "gates" of potential. The five internal organs are spiritual! In addition to the soul, maybe the deity of the human body also lives here! All the deities are me. The Great Dao is boundless, but it is within the number of three. Dao births One, One births Two, Two births Three, Three births All Things. Past, Present and Future Huāng enter the [Dao Palaces]. For invincibility! By creating this, even if the world dries up and the shackles fall, Huāng's Dao will still improve.

Huāng's head filled with Immortal energy, the three flowers of the Great Dao formed then turned into a platform, with vague creatures sitting on them. They are Huāng's Past, Present and Future that enter the [Dao Palace]. The Past chants scriptures, the Present declares the Dao and the Future exists as an unclear variable.

Location: Five Internal Organs.

Archaic Vicious Techniques: True Phoenix Treasure Technique (Fire), God Stone Treasure Technique (Earth), rest of Five Elements etc.

Age: Built during Huāng's hundreds.

Born from Heaven and Earth, break through reality. The strongest attack power circulates in the limbs, which can sustain eternity. The four arms are like the Four Poles, and the extreme power is infinite!

Archaic Vicious Techniques: Kun Peng Technique, Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique, Willow Deity Precious Technique, True Primordial Record and etc.

Location: Four Limbs.

Age: Established during Huāng's hundreds.

Huāng imprisoned a star from outside Chaos. He refined it into his back and fused it with the vertebrae to feel the change. The power of the endless stars turns into essence and steams here. He returned to Stone Village and was inspired by the 9 bone true dragons of the Three World Bronze Coffin. Nine true dragons were fighting in the mortal world and struggling in the nine heavens. There are endless changes, this is the dragon. He grabbed a keel and tried to integrate it into his spine to feel some kind of change. Then repeated with the other true dragon skeletons. The spine is like a dragon, leaping up, transforming into the nine heavens, reaching the sky and moving the earth, invincible in the world! With nine dragon bones entering his body and fused with his spine, his feeling was completely different, as if many epochs ago, there were endless wars, and real dragons roamed the sky and the earth, bleeding the world. Dragons are rising one after another. Nine is the ultimate number, which represents transcendence. The nine dragons pull the coffin and penetrate the sky! Nine for Extremity, Alive yet Changed! The variables are gone, the ultimate leap is made, the possibilities are endless. The human spine is like a big dragon, connecting the trunk and the soul. From physical transformation to spiritual transformation, this dragon is a bridge. There were nine rays in total, like nine steps, climbing up the steps and entering the skull and the former 9 keels were expelled by the body.

Star's Essence and 1 keel from each of the 9 true dragon skeletons of the Three World Bronze Coffin.

The last secret realm, the seat of the soul, is like the [Immortal Platform]. Climb here. If you are perfect in the future, when your whole body is penetrated, you will become a True Immortal in one final leap! This is the place where the soul is nurtured. It is also the most critical place, where the soul of the body is hidden. To be truly immortal, one needs to have the soul to be flawless and the immortal light to shine everywhere.

The nine-step ladder to heaven goes up along the spine. When the dragon ascends, the immortal light blooms and the chaotic energy comes out. With [Dragon Transformation], Huāng submerges into the soul, which is like ascending to Immortality.

cultivation.title: Dharma Ending Age
cultivation.introText: The Dharma Ending Age, also known as the Cultivationless Era, represents the final stage of a great cultivation epoch—a time when the world enters irreversible decline. It is often described as a quiet dusk before total darkness, where the once-flourishing cultivation civilization begins to collapse. The Great Dao weakens, natural laws deteriorate, and the spiritual foundation of the world becomes unstable, signaling the end of an era of prosperity and the beginning of hardship and decay.

cultivation.title: Divine Flame Realm
cultivation.introText: To ascend to the Divine Flame Realm, one had to implant a Dao seed into their own body. The majority of cultivators from the Three Thousand Provinces opted for the Divine Flame Pill, which allowed them to ignite the divine fire without the need for a Dao seed. However, this method yielded inferior results compared to the standard procedure. Only the talents of the major sects could afford to avoid using this pill, as they aspired to become the next leaders of their respective sects and required a solid foundation to compete with their rival sects. Shi Hao was also offered this pill during his first encounter with the Heavenly Deity of the Celestial Clan, but he decided to refuse it.
cultivation.appearance:
To ascend to the Divine Flame Realm, one had to implant a Dao seed into their own body. The majority of cultivators from the Three Thousand Provinces opted for the Divine Flame Pill, which allowed them to ignite the divine fire without the need for a Dao seed. However, this method yielded inferior results compared to the standard procedure. Only the talents of the major sects could afford to avoid using this pill, as they aspired to become the next leaders of their respective sects and required a solid foundation to compete with their rival sects. Shi Hao was also offered this pill during his first encounter with the Heavenly Deity of the Celestial Clan, but he decided to refuse it.

Shi Hao wasn't convinced by the traditional method of attaining the divine fire. Throughout his journey, he had never relied on external forces to improve himself and had even tried to limit the use of his Supreme Bone. Following this philosophy, he didn't want to depend on Dao seeds. He began studying the bone texts donated by his master and concluded that he needed to use his own body as fuel for the divine flame.

“With the world as a furnace, ten thousand dao as the flame to ignite the self, burn the primordial spirit, construct the true self.”

Many people from the three thousand provinces were aware of this procedure, but due to its high mortality rate and the extreme pain it caused to those who attempted it, it became a sort of taboo. No one would risk it with such an uncertain method. However, Shi Hao didn't share this view. When he crossed the gates of the Immortal Ancient, he decided it was time to put his studies into practice. He used the energy of the Great Dao of the three thousand paths of blue stone within the Ancient Immortal to burn himself. The process was long and painful; several times Shi Hao doubted if he was proceeding in the right direction. However, after intense suffering, he began to ignite his body with a hundred and eight flames. He managed to complete the first combustion and ascend to the realm of the divine flame. Nevertheless, he didn't consider himself satisfied and, after a pause to allow his wounds to heal, he continued with the process.

cultivation.title: Engravement Realm
cultivation.introText: The Engravement Realm was when one truly had access to the profound mysteries of the bone text. After treading onto this path, one no longer had to rely on the symbols of vicious beasts or fierce birds. They could instead engrave within their body some of their own symbols.

Of course, the so called one’s own symbols was still just a simple arrangement. It was impossible for them to be too innovative at this stage, because this was something that only the most powerful could do.

This cultivation realm was extremely difficult. One had to carve on their own bones and heavenly passages, and every step of the way was incredibly difficult. It was entirely possible not to see any change after many years.

There were even some who claimed that every improvement in the Engravement Realm was just as difficult as cultivating through a great cultivation realm, so one could see how terrifyingly difficult it was.

cultivation.title: Half-Immortal Emperor

They can obscure the secrets of heaven by their own existence whether in the past, present, or even after falling, they remain shrouded in mist, impossible to discern. At this level, they have already transcended the domains of time and space; order and rules lose their meaning. Wherever their imperial body passes, the timelines fall into chaos, from ancient times to the present and into the future, all beyond calculation.

They can manifest simultaneously across multiple spacetime continua, or sit beyond the River of Time, overlooking the rise and fall of eras. Even a single drop of their blood falling can sever the long river of ages. Beings of this level can manipulate the fate of all living things and alter endless lines of causality.

A half immortal emperor is someone who looked down on all life, a single glance covering all realms, completely unmatched, he can destroy a realm  With a single thought, realms would be eradicated and born, able to affect the rise and fall of years. Past, present and future would tremble as a result. and he can deceive the heavens himself. No matter in the past, present or after death, there will be a fog.

The author suggests that there should be other intermediate levels after the half-Immortal Emperor, similar to sub-levels in the immortal king giants. His strength increased, and his body underwent another sublimation. That day, he transformed again, this time reaching not only the threshold but almost successfully entering the realm of the Immortal Emperor. However, he still stopped at the most crucial step. If he had tried to force the breakthrough, he would probably have died, as he still lacked some maturity and the conditions were not yet entirely suitable.  However, the process had already begun. It is worth noting that if Shi Hao had not undergone this transformation in cultivation, he would have died after the awakening of the Corpse Immortal Emperor and the attack directed at him. Thanks to this level increase, he managed to defend himself. He would still have needed another two hundred thousand years after being injured by his own words and crossing the river of time to fully enter the realm of the Immortal Emperor.

cultivation.title: Half-True Immortal
cultivation.introText: The Half True Immortal Realm is a critical and extremely difficult stage located between the Supreme Being Realm and the True Immortal Realm. It represents a profound threshold, often described as a “heavenly chasm”, that has halted nearly all Supreme Beings throughout history. Although it is technically considered part of the Supreme Being Realm, this half-step is so difficult and rare that it is often treated as a distinct level of cultivation. The vast majority of Supreme Beings, nearly ninety-nine percent, are unable to reach it.
cultivation.appearance:
The Half True Immortal Realm is a critical and extremely difficult stage located between the Supreme Being Realm and the True Immortal Realm. It represents a profound threshold, often described as a “heavenly chasm”, that has halted nearly all Supreme Beings throughout history. Although it is technically considered part of the Supreme Being Realm, this half-step is so difficult and rare that it is often treated as a distinct level of cultivation. The vast majority of Supreme Beings, nearly ninety-nine percent, are unable to reach it.

Reaching the Half True Immortal Realm signifies that a cultivator has approached the pinnacle of the Mortal Dao, the highest level of cultivation achievable without fully transcending mortality. At this stage, a cultivator’s magical power becomes immensely vigorous, their aura vast and overwhelming, and their presence so profound that outsiders cannot easily perceive their true strength or nature. Their understanding of the Dao becomes extremely deep, and attempts to probe their divine consciousness are often repelled by the natural laws of the Dao itself.

Despite its immense power, the Half True Immortal Realm remains a barrier rather than the final destination. Beyond it lies the True Immortal Realm, which exists outside the normal framework of mortal cultivation and represents a fundamental transcendence beyond mortal limits. The Half True Immortal Realm therefore functions both as the highest peak within mortal cultivation and as the final gateway leading toward true immortality.

cultivation.title: Heaven's Core Imprint
cultivation.introText: The Heaven's Core Imprint (天心印记) is a unique mark formed by the Great Dao of a world when its damaged laws gradually recover and become complete. It represents the highest level of recognition that heaven and earth can grant to a cultivator. Through the imprint, an individual becomes harmonized with the world's fundamental laws, allowing their Dao to merge with the world's core and making them the sole supreme existence of the current age. It is not a cultivation realm, technique, or innate ability, but an authority bestowed by heaven and earth.
cultivation.trivia: This is the reason that in Shrouding the Heavens, which takes place in the future during the cultivation-less era of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, there can only be one Great Emperor at a time: by then, the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths had already merged into a single vast universe.

cultivation.title: Heavenly Deity
cultivation.introText: After cultivating the ancient method, the most crucial step is fusing with an immortal seed. Anyone who embarks on this path must find a seed of their own. In the years to come, the two must grow and evolve together, achieving the strongest state upon final union with the Dao. Capable of regenerating severed limbs; a single drop of blood can collapse mountain ranges; its aura pressure can suppress all lower realms. This is the minimum qualification to enter the Imperial Pass Battlefield. A Heavenly God who has passed through the Sacrificial Realm is a Divine King.

cultivation.title: Heavenly Passage Realm
cultivation.introText: Heavenly Passage was a Realm, but it was also a method of cultivation. It drew in the essence between the Heaven and Earth to comprehend the symbols’ true meanings. It allowed one to comprehend the order of the world, as well as how these rules change. It was similar to one developing one’s own miniature world.
cultivation.appearance:
Heavenly Passage was a Realm, but it was also a method of cultivation. It drew in the essence between the Heaven and Earth to comprehend the symbols’ true meanings. It allowed one to comprehend the order of the world, as well as how these rules change. It was similar to one developing one’s own miniature world.

This was precisely the Heavenly Passage Realm, and from the body’s interior and exterior, it opened up an immortal passageway. It could also be called a ‘Pure Land’(Dantian), or even its own world.

Establishing the Heavenly Passage and entering this realm was equivalent to stealing the fortunes of heaven and earth. One constantly absorbed the essence energy of the outside world to supplement the internal body.

After reaching this point and connecting the two boundless voids, one can refine the divine essence of the world. This was equal to allowing the divine strength from within the symbols to greatly increase in strength. It will far surpass one’s former strength, and naturally become extremely powerful.

From this point on, there would be a continuous and never-ending source where one could collect power from, allowing one to maintain their body’s exuberance and vitality. As long as the battle wasn’t too bitter and desperate, it was nearly impossible to completely exhaust one’s energy, and one will be able to continuously maintain an optimal condition.

cultivation.title: Holy Sacrifice
cultivation.introText: A special transitional realm. In the early stage, spiritual power is unstable, fluctuating between the Divine Fire Realm and the Heavenly God Realm. It becomes relatively stable when cultivated to the later stage. It is possible to skip this realm entirely and not cultivate it. If cultivated, the path ahead may be smooth, allowing one to undergo the Divine King Tribulation. It is rare to first condense a Dao Flower within the Sacrificial Realm before reaching the Heavenly God Realm; such individuals are destined to shine brilliantly in the future.

cultivation.title: Immortal Ancient Methods
cultivation.introText: Immortal Ancient Methods refer to the cultivation systems, techniques, and philosophies that originated during the Immortal Ancient Great Era — a time when true immortals walked the earth and the dao flourished in its purest form. These methods are fundamentally different from the cultivation systems of the modern era. They begin directly from the most fundamental dao, simple yet profound, whereas modern methods start from techniques and gradually trace back toward the roots of the dao. The essence of Immortal Ancient cultivation lies in the immortal seed, the nurturing of immortal energy, and the mastery of supreme scriptures such as the Imperishable Scripture for physical refinement or the Mind Forging Method for tempering the primordial spirit.
cultivation.appearance:
Immortal Ancient Methods refer to the cultivation systems, techniques, and philosophies that originated during the Immortal Ancient Great Era — a time when true immortals walked the earth and the dao flourished in its purest form. These methods are fundamentally different from the cultivation systems of the modern era. They begin directly from the most fundamental dao, simple yet profound, whereas modern methods start from techniques and gradually trace back toward the roots of the dao. The essence of Immortal Ancient cultivation lies in the immortal seed, the nurturing of immortal energy, and the mastery of supreme scriptures such as the Imperishable Scripture for physical refinement or the Mind Forging Method for tempering the primordial spirit.

The Immortal Ancient paths are revered because they represent the most direct route to immortality, a goal long sought by countless cultivators. In those ancient times, some sacred lands were even said to naturally nurture immortals from birth. The inheritances of the Immortal Ancient era reached the pinnacle of cultivation refinement — even damaged fragments of these inheritances were powerful enough to give rise to top-tier sects and scriptures in later ages. The dao energy cultivated through these methods was boundless in potential, capable of producing transformations beyond comprehension.

Techniques such as the Imperishable Scripture embody this ideal, allowing the practitioner’s body to remain undecaying and even recreate the divine soul after death. These methods could awaken hidden depths within the body, revealing flaws or “impurities” even in those considered physically perfect by modern standards. For cultivators who have already attained immortal energy, continuing the Immortal Ancient path offers a way to perfect and elevate their current foundation to the highest peak. When paired with precious pills and ancient treasures, advancement through this route could be vigorous and unparalleled.

Beyond individual pursuit, some cultivators — notably Shi Hao — see Immortal Ancient Methods as a means of strategic integration. By combining these systems with modern cultivation or even forging an entirely new path, they aim to achieve comprehensive mastery capable of contending with the powerful foreign invaders who once destroyed the ancient era. For others, such as Shi Hao himself, the motivation is deeply personal: a conviction to protect loved ones, rewrite history, and surpass the failures of the past, no matter the cost.

The ancient world also left behind vast resources that still nourish these paths — ancestral veins, immortal relics, immortal mist, and sacred medicines. Even a single ancient pill, like the Vessel Cleansing Pill, could awaken untapped potential and allow the flesh to harmonize with the dao once more.

Despite their glory, Immortal Ancient Methods are rarely practiced in the present world. The most decisive reason lies in the drastic environmental transformation of the universe itself. The current age has become increasingly barren, hostile to the very foundation of ancient cultivation. The world’s essence has decayed, making it nearly impossible to nurture immortal energy or achieve immortality through those methods. Original systems are suppressed, and even the most gifted geniuses struggle to advance through these outdated ways.

The Immortal Ancient and modern systems operate on fundamentally different principles, forcing anyone wishing to learn the former to abandon all prior progress and start anew. Cultivators must also make choices carefully, as attempting to master both paths simultaneously is considered unfeasible for most — the energy and comprehension required are simply too vast.

Even the value of Immortal Ancient Methods is questioned by some elders, who argue that they are not necessarily superior to the methods of the modern era. Exceptional heroes of the current age have reached heights equal to, or even surpassing, those who cultivated immortal energy in the past. Certain ancient techniques are also inherently limited or incompatible with human physiology, such as burial or undead methods that demand inhuman conditions to function.

Finally, the historical defeat of the Immortal Ancient era itself serves as a grim reminder of the path’s limits. Despite their power, its immortals were ultimately annihilated by foreign enemies, proving that even the most exalted cultivation system could fall. Thus, many believe that blindly following the old ways is not only dangerous but futile — true transcendence requires surpassing the past and forging a new dao beyond both the ancient and modern systems.

cultivation.title: Immortal Emperor
cultivation.introText: The Immortal Emperor (仙帝) represents the ultimate realm of cultivation in Perfect World, standing above the Quasi-Immortal Emperor (准仙帝) and the ordinary Immortal Kings of the endless ages. Reaching this realm is not merely a matter of accumulating power; it requires creating and walking a supreme Dao capable of transcending the limits of heaven, earth, time, and all conventional cultivation systems.
cultivation.appearance:
The Immortal Emperor (仙帝) represents the ultimate realm of cultivation in Perfect World, standing above the Quasi-Immortal Emperor (准仙帝) and the ordinary Immortal Kings of the endless ages. Reaching this realm is not merely a matter of accumulating power; it requires creating and walking a supreme Dao capable of transcending the limits of heaven, earth, time, and all conventional cultivation systems.

An Immortal Emperor is a being who stands at the summit of the Dao. Their existence is sufficient to influence the fate of entire epochs, and their power can extend across endless time and space. At this level, ordinary concepts of life, death, worlds, and eras lose much of their meaning. Their Dao can illuminate the heavens, suppress countless realms, and leave an imprint upon the eternal river of time.-

Among the supreme paths associated with the Immortal Emperor realm, the True Primordial Record (元始真解), connected with the Corpse Immortal Emperor, is one of the most profound inheritances. However, the Corpse Immortal Emperor himself was ultimately corrupted by darkness, and his path became associated with tragedy, darkness, and the catastrophic consequences of falling under the influence of the ultimate darkness.

In contrast, the  Embodiment Transformation Great Method  (他化自在法), created by Huang (Shi Hao), represents one of the most extraordinary supreme methods in Perfect World. It is not simply a technique for increasing one's cultivation. It embodies a supreme concept of Dao: transforming the self through all beings, all eras, and all possible paths. It carries the accumulated hopes, brilliance, and potential of countless living beings and can be regarded as a method standing at the pinnacle of all cultivation arts.

At the level of an Immortal Emperor, a supreme being may stand beyond the restrictions that govern lesser cultivators. With a single thought, they can influence endless realms; with a single gesture, they can shake the heavens, disturb the river of time, and determine the fate of worlds. The Immortal Emperor realm therefore represents not only absolute strength, but also the culmination of one's unique Dao and one's ability to transcend the established order of heaven and earth.

Only 2 known Immortal Emperor Realm in Perfect World

Corpse Immortal Emperor
cultivation.trivia: Reaching this level is extremely difficult, and all who attain it can be considered geniuses in their own right. A battle at this realm cannot be decided in mere minutes, for it is extraordinarily hard for one Immortal Emperor to kill or defeat another when both stand at the same level. It is not possible to instantly overwhelm or “one‑shot” another Immortal Emperor if you yourself are still only at the Immortal Emperor realm. Victory and defeat between combatants of this level are determined after fighting for hundreds or even thousands of years.

cultivation.title: Immortal King

The Immortal King Realm is a supreme cultivation level representing the peak of power before becoming an emperor. Cultivators at this level are truly eternal, possessing immense strength and magical abilities, with immortal flesh and indestructible primordial spirit, they are everlasting and imperishable, existing in the world without decay. Their words become law. They can prop open a world and recreate the cosmos. Their dharma bodies are boundless and infinite, capable of suppressing countless universes. Cultivating an Immortal King Body can make their physique even stronger.

Their primordial spirits are typically everlasting, and their bodies and magical techniques are extraordinarily powerful. They are extremely difficult to kill unless by special means. They can take time as a ring, stepping into the River of Time, traversing the past and future, ignoring the power of the years, and making small-scale modifications within the River of Time. The Archaic Vicious Ten only tempered Immortal King Bodies without achieving Immortal King primordial spirits.

Breaking through to the Immortal King Realm is extremely difficult and dangerous. Many who attempt this path fail and die, as the process involves overcoming great tribulations and reaching a state where one can establish an imperishable dao foundation. The path is so challenging that some believe no one has truly transcended beyond the immortal king level, and thus the realm is considered the peak for most cultivators. Achieving this realm requires profound insight into the great dao and the creation of unique cultivation methods or secrets.

cultivation.title: Modern Era Cultivation
cultivation.introText: Modern Era Cultivation represents a distinct cultivation system, offered as an alternative to the Immortal Ancient methods in an era where the world's environment has changed, making it exceptionally difficult to learn ancient ways or achieve immortality through them. Cultivators in the Heavenly Deity Institution were presented with a crucial choice between these two paths, with the understanding that this decision would affect their entire lives. While cultivating immortal energy in the modern era is considered a continuation of ancient methods, the true meaning of Modern Era Cultivation lies in an entirely different approach — one that is not merely about accumulating immortal energy.
cultivation.appearance:
Modern Era Cultivation represents a distinct cultivation system, offered as an alternative to the Immortal Ancient methods in an era where the world's environment has changed, making it exceptionally difficult to learn ancient ways or achieve immortality through them. Cultivators in the Heavenly Deity Institution were presented with a crucial choice between these two paths, with the understanding that this decision would affect their entire lives. While cultivating immortal energy in the modern era is considered a continuation of ancient methods, the true meaning of Modern Era Cultivation lies in an entirely different approach — one that is not merely about accumulating immortal energy.

Elders emphasized that modern era methods are not inferior to ancient methods, stating that “exceptional heroes at the very forefront” of this path are “not any weaker than people who cultivated immortal energy.” The path is described as “enticing” and “worth betting on” for those seeking to transcend. It builds upon fundamental cultivation realms such as Blood Transformation, Heavenly Passage, Engravement, and Formation Arrangement, aiming to push each to its absolute limits and potentially surpass all predecessors. The goal is to cultivate a “good foundation” and find a “new path” rather than merely treading an old one.

The Sacred Academy is recognized as the holy land for Modern Era Cultivation, a place that cultivates “exceptional heroes” who “break through the limits of the great cultivation realms.” Even “imperfect personal letters” or partial insights from Sacred Academy’s experts are considered immensely powerful, demonstrating the profound understanding and advanced state of this system. Exemplars include individuals like Yuan Teng, who purposely scattered his cultivated immortal energy to fully commit to the modern path, nurturing his flesh and primordial spirit, and achieving Engravement Realm patterns that could affect space and time. Shi Yi also embraced Modern Era Cultivation as the “foundation, the source” of his dao, being one born in the modern world.

Explained in Episode 227

cultivation.title: Reincarnation(Perfect World)
cultivation.introText: Reincarnation in the context of this world and narrative is a deeply complex, mysterious, and heavily debated phenomenon. It is not simply a matter of belief or disbelief but involves numerous theories, experiences, and philosophical interpretations that have puzzled experts, cultivators, and supreme beings across countless eras. The concept of reincarnation intertwines with the cycle of life and death, the nature of the spirit, primordial forces, and the great cosmic order. Its precise mechanisms are uncertain, its existence disputed, and its manifestations rare and often enigmatic.

cultivation.title: Sacrifice to the Dao Realm
cultivation.introText: Burn all the rules and order, and sacrifice the supreme Great Dao. The ultimate state that the Immortal Emperor can reach after his ultimate sublimation. It is the end of all evolutionary paths so far. This state can make the Immortal Emperor eternally silent. This is what the original ancestors of the plateau achieved after absorbing the original matter left behind by the mysterious existence after eternal silence.

Those who achieve this realm have all karma annihilated, can see clearly through past, present, and future, and its might transcends the limitations of time and space, achieving an invincible state that represents the ultimate sublimation of the Immortal Emperor realm. The cultivator's True Body can reside in the Eternal Unknown Land, never perishing, and only uses an Avatar to participate in battles.
cultivation.personality:
Dao Sacrifice, also known as Path's End Sublimation, is the state reached after a Immortal Emperor undergoes ultimate sublimation. It transcends the Immortal Emperor but does not constitute a separate major realm; it fundamentally remains within the Immortal Emperor category. Although it belongs to the same major realm as the Immortal Emperor, the disparity in combat power is immense. The relationship between them is somewhat analogous to that between the Nine Lives Great Emperor and an Ordinary Supreme in Shrouding the Heavens. It incinerates all rules and order, sacrifices the supreme Dao, comprehends the past, present, and future, and annihilates all karma. Possessing boundless might, it can observe and interfere with Timelines, existing beyond time and space.

At this level, so-called Dao Principles and the like are useless to them. Beings of this tier have long since incinerated all Daos, making them even more powerful than Path's End Level/Immortal Emperor beings. Even an Avatar possesses invincible, peerless might, not inferior to the True Body. The Avatar is used for combat, while the True Body sits cross-legged in an eternal, unknown place, unreachable by conventional means, ensuring it never perishes.

Although this realm fundamentally remains within the domain of the Immortal Emperor, it stands above the ordinary Immortal Emperor level and can only be attained after undergoing the ultimate transformation of Path's End Sublimation.

cultivation.title: Self-Severing
cultivation.introText: Full name: Slay the Self, Illuminate the Dao Realm. Slaying the self means severing the shackles of the self, or perhaps, one's obsessions. The best and strongest achievement is to sever the Heavenly Heart, battle the Heavenly Will, cut off one's own physical body, transcend the self, and achieve clear enlightenment of one's own Dao and techniques.
cultivation.appearance:
Full name: Slay the Self, Illuminate the Dao Realm. Slaying the self means severing the shackles of the self, or perhaps, one's obsessions. The best and strongest achievement is to sever the Heavenly Heart, battle the Heavenly Will, cut off one's own physical body, transcend the self, and achieve clear enlightenment of one's own Dao and techniques.

The Self-Severing Realm is a significant cultivation stage, often considered one of the final great cultivation realms above the Void Dao Realm, making cultivators at this realm rarely seen experts. Entering this realm can be dangerous, potentially leading to one's dao being cut short.

The Self-Severing Realm represents a crucial and profound stage in cultivation in which the practitioner focuses on cutting away the shackles of the self. This severing is not merely physical but deeply mental and spiritual, involving the removal of attachments, obsessions, limitations, and even preconceived notions about one’s existence. It marks a major transformation, as the cultivator seeks to transcend the ordinary boundaries of selfhood.

At this stage, cultivators undergo intense internal struggle and refinement, attempting to remove all restrictions that bind their spirit and mind. The process is inherently dangerous, as severing these ties can destabilize one’s entire being. As a result, the realm is filled with risks, and a cultivator may lose themselves entirely if they fail. Only through great perseverance and insight can one endure and continue progressing.

The highest expression of the Self-Severing Realm is often described as the “severing of the Heavenly Heart” and the “battling of the Will of Heaven.” This symbolizes a confrontation with the fundamental forces of fate and cosmic order. In this stage, the cultivator challenges the predetermined will of the heavens, which may manifest as divine chains or blades attempting to suppress or erase their ambition and identity. Successfully resisting the Will of Heaven signifies that the cultivator has begun to shed even their attachment to the physical self, moving beyond ordinary existence toward transcendence.

Through this process, the cultivator attains profound enlightenment and gains a clearer understanding of their personal Dao—their unique path and the intrinsic laws that govern it. This realization allows them to harmonize more deeply with the Great Dao, freeing themselves from both external constraints and internal limitations.

During his journey to Immortal Mound in search of Evil Warding Divine Bamboo and Yellow Springs Fruit, Shi Hao faced a life-and-death trial to surpass the ancients. He concentrated the heavenly passage into a point in his abdomen, resembling a golden immortal pill, and triggered an explosion to defeat the humanoid Darkness Immortal Gold, securing the Divine Bamboo. Hovering between life and death, he created a life-and-death disk around the contracted passage, unlocking hidden potential and understanding Dao, though he only formed a rough yin-yang diagram.

Later, while following the 'body as the seed' path, he encountered a lightning tribulation that depicted a foreign race invasion threatening Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. To combat the foreign Emperor Clans born from this lightning, he collapsed his heavenly passage again, creating a new life-and-death disk. He inscribed mysteries from Kun Peng, Lightning Emperor, and Willow Deity into his divine diagram and transferred his three strands of immortal energy into his abdomen for protection. Ultimately, he detonated the point, establishing the first secret realm, the Sea of Reincarnation. When he forcefully opened the gates, it was perilous, and without the attacks from foreign Emperor Clans' youths (formed by lightning tribulation) neutralizing the explosion, he could have died.

During his time as Supreme Being, he found out that five viscera have spirits or deities which chant scripture sound by themselves. Then he lets the three creatures above dao flowers: his past self, present self, and future self to enter the dao palaces.

Dragon transformation, nine flights of heavenly stairs, ascending along the vertebra. As the dragon soared, immortal light blossomed, chaotic energy scattered, extremely terrifying and astonishing.

The head was precisely the fifth secret realm that he attached importance to-- immortal platform.

This was a place that contained the primordial spirit, as well as where the most crucial point was. It carried the soul of the body. In order to be truly imperishable before endless calamities, the primordial spirit needed to be flawless, immortal light shining glorious.

That sphere of light above him could scatter out a rain of light, protect him, make his body impervious to all methods. However, this shouldn’t be the final secret realm. The deity above his head contradicted Shi Hao's idea of relying on his own body rather than external means.

By fusing his 'Deity Three feet Above the Head' with his body, Shi Hao truly became imperishable and flawless in both body and spirit. Even after this, he can only step into the peak of half-Immortal Emperor level. Afterwards, after killing the three half immortal emperors, he cultivated further in the depth of Ancient Final Destination, rederive his own scripture by taking a lot of risks there and became a True Immortal Emperor by deriving Embodiment Transformation Great Method: Transform All Ages.
