cultivation.title: Spirit Transformation Realm
cultivation.introText: The Spirit Transformation Realm was a realm where one had to understand the meanings of each word. It could evolve as well as reconstruct itself, making this stage a crucial stage of cultivation.
cultivation.appearance:
The Spirit Transformation Realm was a realm where one had to understand the meanings of each word. It could evolve as well as reconstruct itself, making this stage a crucial stage of cultivation.

Everything had its own spirit, whether it be a blade of grass, a towering tree, a speck of dust, or even a grain of sand. They all had their own spiritual nature, and needless to say, this was even more true for living creatures.

As such, the Spirit Transformation Realm is the transformation of all types of spiritual natures. It is the formation of one’s spirit, and in doing so, reconstructing oneself into being the most powerful one could be.

If the heavenly passage was an unshakeable foundation that reflected one’s endless potential, then the Spirit Transformation Realm was an additional layer of reform and transformation. It was the pursuit of wings that could allow one’s ‘true self’ to fly towards divinity.

It was for the sake of creating the self, forging one’s spiritual body. The process was no longer only about the flesh, but now also involved venturing into the profound mysteries of the soul. If they were able to search deep inside and gain enlightenment, then their entire being would advance, transforming themselves into a divine embryo.

However, there were many mortals who were able to obtain great success in this realm, and all of them would place huge emphasis on the remodeling of their own self. There were even a few individuals that would carry out an evolution within their great heavenly passages, forming a divine spirit with fighting power not inferior to their true body.

If one was able to reach the true extremes of this realm, then they would gain unspeakably wondrous changes and benefits.

For Shi Hao to enter the Spirit Transformation Realm, all he head to do was transform the symbols within his body and activate the spirituality within them. As a result, every strand of divine light contained a spiritual nature that allowed him to surpass his previous self.

To transform one step further, not only did he have to activate the spirituality within himself, he still had to mold his spiritual self. Every single symbol had to seem as if they possessed life, and he had to then use those living symbols to nourish his both body and soul, constructing his true self.

cultivation.title: Supreme Being
cultivation.introText: To enter the Supreme Realm, one must comprehend the myriad aspects of human life, struggle within the torrents of the mortal world, and continuously refine the heart. In the end, with the liberation of the heart and the moment the shackles are unlocked, one stands at the pinnacle of the human path, becoming a Supreme. Standing atop the pinnacle of the human path, merely radiating aura pressure forces those of lower realms to bow their heads. With a mere thought, one can slay powerhouses of the Self-Release Realm; a single drop of blood can purge top-tier orthodoxies; a raise of the hand can destroy star domains and refine suns, moons, and stars. If killing intent arises, groups of Self-Release cultivators can be annihilated in an instant. By relying on longevity substances, one can live for millions of years or longer.

The Emperor in the mortal world, some of them have already become immortals, while others are still striving within the mortal realm. They possess the highest combat power in the current Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, capable of plucking stars and capturing the moon with a casual lift of their hand.

Just the pressure of their supremacy makes lower-level cultivators unable to lift their heads. Relying on the longevity of their life essence, they can live for millions of years without dying. The protagonist, Shi Hao, underwent the scrutiny of heaven and earth, broke free from constraints, ascended to the status of the Supreme Being. After Shi Hao experienced and Spent millions years in the Dharma End Age during  the Fallen Emperor Era, He became a Supreme among Supremes that could kill True Immortals with a wave of his hand.

cultivation.title: Transcendence
cultivation.introText: Since the dawn of creation, only four individuals have achieved this supreme state: the four Masters of the Bronze Coffin, Shi Hao, Ye Fan, and Chu Feng. Those who have fully transcended become truly immortal.
cultivation.appearance:
Since the dawn of creation, only four individuals have achieved this supreme state: the four Masters of the Bronze Coffin, Shi Hao, Ye Fan, and Chu Feng. Those who have fully transcended become truly immortal.

To enter this extraordinary realm, one must possess indelible experiences etched into their very being. Within this state, all concepts — such as destiny, creation, cause and effect, and even the heavens themselves — are as fragile as bubbles, collapsing effortlessly at the slightest touch.

The Realm Above the Sacrificial Dao is portrayed as a transcendent domain that lies beyond death, sacrifice, and even the eternal silence of the sacrificial path. It is not bound by time or space, nor by the great daos that govern the cosmos. In this place, past, present, and future coexist simultaneously, and all laws of fate, karma, and heavenly order are reduced to fragile illusions that collapse at a mere thought. It is a realm that surpasses eternity itself, existing beyond primal chaos and the great thousand worlds, omnipresent and absolute.

Reaching this realm is nearly impossible. It requires not only a body strong enough to endure the corrosion of primordial substance but also an indomitable will. One must be willing to abandon everything self, dao, and path of evolution and face annihilation without hesitation. Lofty sentiments, courage to sacrifice, and unshakable conviction are essential. Without all three, even complete sacrifice leads only to death. This is why other dao sacrificers of strong races throughout history have failed to reach it, despite yearning for it in their dreams.

Within this domain, death is not the end but a gateway to nirvana. Those who succeed revive from ashes, transcending history and returning to the mortal world with unparalleled power. Celestial Emperor Huang and Celestial Emperor Ye both reached this realm after dying heroically in battle, their courage and conviction carrying them beyond sacrifice. Chu Feng, who charged alone into the vile land and gave everything to open a path for those who came after, also ascended here. The Empress nearly qualified, though her accumulations were not yet deep enough at the time of her sacrifice.

The realm itself is described as timeless and spaceless. Countless ages appear as one instant, and all great dao are like water, evaporating at a single thought. From this vantage, one can see the past, present, and future simultaneously, and even reproduce what has dried up or erase what exists. It is the culmination of sacrifice, where the self is abandoned and reborn, where conviction and courage transform annihilation into transcendence.
cultivation.personality:
It transcends time, space, causality, and logic, exists in a dimension without temporal or spatial concepts, and can manifest simultaneously in the past, present, and future. This realm can ignore all rules of the Great Dao, can reconstruct worlds and destinies with a mere glance, and possesses omniscient and omnipotent power. Breaking through to it requires sacrificing one's own evolutionary path and reviving from annihilation.

This realm is exceptionally unique, transcending the concepts of time and space. Whether one stepped into it in the ancient past, the present era, or the future, all seem visible, all seem to converge at this moment. It can arbitrarily define past and present, unbound by the constraints of time. Even a wisp of gloomy mist born from its negative emotions can reshape the entire worldview, possessing infinite possibilities and transformations, rewriting countless destinies and divergent worldviews.

A single glance back can give rise to endless time-space and causal threads, without concern for disturbing the future, because at this level, what meets the eye is inherently endless time-space and infinite possibilities. The Great Dao, time and space, all lose their meaning to it. In this special existence, all Daos are like flowing water, evaporable with a single thought. Fate, creation, causality, the Heavenly Dao, and the like are but the most fragile bubbles, shattering before one can even reach out to touch them. It surpasses the Great Dao, surpasses eternity, surpasses the immeasurable, and reigns supreme over all. The great thousand worlds, all time-space, beyond the universe, beyond chaos, it is omnipresent. From ancient times to the present, and into the future, all can vanish at the whim of a being standing in this domain. Wherever its gaze falls, all withers, and all is recreated.

It is unimaginable, ineffable, unseeable, defying logic and subverting reality. It holds all truths; past, present, and future hold no secrets before it. All unknown domains lie within the grasp of Above the Sacrificial Dao. A single thought can condense the immeasurable cosmic time-space, the endless sea of universes, sea of worlds, sea of time—essentially the entire worldview—into a primordial origin. There are endless such primordial origins, which then converge into one. Endless ones then converge again into a greater one. Endless greater ones converge once more, iterating and converging infinitely into one, boundless and limitless.

Simply put, it is an infinite number of worldviews converging into a larger worldview, infinite larger worldviews converging into an even more immense worldview, repeating this process infinitely. It is an infinite iteration of transcendence, an endless cycle, infinitely expanding and upgrading the worldview. With each iteration, the worldview becomes countless times more powerful than before. Furthermore, the Above the Sacrificial Dao possesses the logical characteristic of Causal Reversal, meaning the effect precedes the cause. For those at the Above the Sacrificial Dao level, all this is accomplished in an instant, and no matter to what degree the worldview is upgraded, it can be created and annihilated by them in a moment. The concept of time becomes entirely meaningless, surpassing all conceivable notions.

cultivation.trivia:
In the chapter (The final chapter, the second grand finale! of Holy Ruins), which should correspond to chapter 1669 of Holy Ruins, it is mentioned that the protagonist reaches a state beyond the Dao sacrifice. Here, he encounters both Shi Hao and Ye Fan, suggesting that they too have reached this realm.

Text translated from Chinese:

"He transforms freely, transcending the ages... One day, I shall return. How can I stand idly by and witness the decline of the mortal world?"

A clear voice echoed from within one of the glowing light clusters.

Then, Chu Feng saw a figure emerge — it was none other than the legendary Huang Emperor.

"I am the Celestial Emperor, destined to suppress all adversaries. The worlds are shrouded in darkness, and the threat of the 'Strange' still looms. How can I silently fade away into nothingness....?"

Another figure appeared — the Ye Emperor, stepping forth from a separate light cluster.

To Chu Feng's astonishment, he then saw himself within yet another light cluster, radiating an immense vitality. Hadn’t he already perished in battle?

No, he had indeed fallen. Yet, in that moment of clarity, Chu Feng realized he now existed in a domain beyond sacrificial paths — a realm that transcended even the most profound of cultivation stages.

This realm was unlike anything else. Here, time held no meaning — past, present, and future all unfolded as if they were occurring simultaneously.

Chu Feng understood that his death was not the end. In this realm, he was sacrificing not just his Dao, but the very essence of evolution — even his own being. Everything had returned to emptiness, fading into an eternal silence. Yet from that silence, revival emerged — a new cycle of life, one that truly transcended all limitations.

cultivation.title: True God Realm
cultivation.introText: Many people transform into divine beings by planting Tao seeds in the Divine Fire Realm, possessing power that transcends the mundane. Having truly ignited the Divine Flame, one undergoes a metamorphosis in life level, achieving a sublimation. The body's treasure troves open spontaneously, unleashing potential freely. This is a True God. On this path, one must have a clear goal, focusing on a single path or Dao. The True Self Realm requires setting a defining tone—one's grand objective for the future—and striving forward on the journey, which also serves as a declaration of intent, introspection, and dedication to one path. The Divine Flame extinguishes only after death.

cultivation.title: True Immortal
cultivation.introText: True Immortal (The Undying, The Everlasting): Immortal and undying, they are beings in the realm of the Dao of Immortality, with strengths far surpassing the human realm.
cultivation.appearance:
True Immortal (The Undying, The Everlasting): Immortal and undying, they are beings in the realm of the Dao of Immortality, with strengths far surpassing the human realm.

The era in which they are known as True Immortals is referred to as the True Immortal Era in the Immortal Ancient Epoch, boasting nearly a hundred formidable True Immortal experts. In the Immortal War, the intact grand boundary was shattered, transforming into the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, and the passage between the Immortal Domain and the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths was sealed. The laws of heaven and earth were incomplete, causing the entire Immortal Ancient Epoch to lack individuals capable of achieving immortality.

Having washed away the foundation of mortal form, the flesh becomes flawless, the primordial spirit indestructible, and their magic power never withers. Enveloped in immortal energy, they transcend the constraints of a great world. With a mere gesture, they can shatter the universe, wander across various worlds, free and unfettered. True Immortals are shielded by a layer of Immortal Light that covers their bodies, protecting them from the erosion of time and leaving no traces of its passage. Their own origin can give generate Immortal Matter, granting them an eternal lifespan. Their flesh and primordial spirit do not decay with the passage of time but instead remain in a perpetually powerful state. A single drop of their blood can remain undying for several eras.

Even if their body is shattered and their flesh perishes, they can reappear with a single thought. Even if their soul light is pierced, torn, or their primordial spirit is destroyed, they will not die. As long as a trace of their true spirit imprint remains, they have the chance to revive. When they inhale and exhale the essence of heaven and earth, it is enough to dry up star seas and exhaust the cosmos. In a single deep breath, they inhale and exhale the most fundamental energy of the world, and the force of their respiration can crack worlds. Therefore, only an ancient universe can sustain a single True Immortal. Mortal World Immortals at this level possess combat power greater than that of True Immortals.

After many years as Supreme Being that killed True Immortal,  He encountered with Dark Huo Ling'er and Dark little wolf ( trap set by Foreign to catch Him) that made him  Defying fate battle against his own self within the Void Immortal Monument  achieving immortality. His heavenly Tribulation lasted nearly a 100years.

When they inhale and exhale the essence of heaven and earth, it can dry up the star seas and exhaust the cosmos; a single breath draws in and releases the most fundamental qi of the universe, its power capable of splitting worlds. In Shi Hao Becoming the Seed cultivation system they are called Immortal in the Mortal World or Red Dust Immortals but possesses combat power greater than that of a True Immortal.

cultivation.title: Venerable Realm
cultivation.introText: Venerable is not only the pinnacle among ordinary cultivator in the Lower Realm, marked by detachment from the mundane world, but also holds the profound potential to ascend to God. This esteemed title is dual in nature, extending its significance to a powerful figure respected among mortals. A Venerable in this context commands great reverence for their strength, and the impact of the Great War further underscores their authority, rendering the vast expanse of a hundred thousand miles barren and devoid of any sign of life.

cultivation.title: Void Dao
cultivation.introText: Communing with the Dao, using a perfect seed as a medium to connect with the Grand Dao. By touching the Grand Dao, one can comprehend the subtle and wondrous principles between heaven and earth, experiencing the first comprehensive contact with the Dao, even giving the illusion of transforming into the heavenly and earthly Dao itself, touching the source of the Dao. Individuals at this realm can generally establish their own sect and are revered as Sect Masters.
cultivation.appearance:
Communing with the Dao, using a perfect seed as a medium to connect with the Grand Dao. By touching the Grand Dao, one can comprehend the subtle and wondrous principles between heaven and earth, experiencing the first comprehensive contact with the Dao, even giving the illusion of transforming into the heavenly and earthly Dao itself, touching the source of the Dao. Individuals at this realm can generally establish their own sect and are revered as Sect Masters.

The essence of the Void Dao Realm involves harmonizing with the Great Dao, allowing the cultivator to sense the intricate reasonings and profound mysteries of heaven and earth. Practitioners at this level are interacting with the true greatest profound mysteries.

A common experience within this realm is the development of a powerful illusion: cultivators frequently feel as though they themselves have transformed into the Great Dao.

techniques.title: 89 Heavens Technique
techniques.introText: The racial inheritance of the Demon Ape Clan, including techniques such as the Seventy-Two Transformations and the Three-Headed, Six-Armed Technique, is in no way inferior to the Ten Evil Arts, and may even surpass them.
techniques.history:
The racial inheritance of the Demon Ape Clan, including techniques such as the Seventy-Two Transformations and the Three-Headed, Six-Armed Technique, is in no way inferior to the Ten Evil Arts, and may even surpass them.

The so-called 89 Heavens Technique also encompasses scriptures for mastering the Arts, emphasizing the unique combat methods of the Demon Ape Clan. It is a martial scripture prepared for humanoid beings. Practicing this technique makes it impossible to live peacefully; strength can only be gained through combat. Shi Hao learned a pseudo-script from his second mentor, Qi Daolin, and later received the complete teachings from his fourth mentor, the Lord of the Forbidden Zone.

techniques.title: Becoming the Seed
techniques.introText: A cultivation system inspired by Shi Hao's mentor Meng Tianzheng. Called The Five Secret Realms by later generations of the Shrouding the Heavens (Zhetian) world. The Dao Ancestor (Daozu) is Huāng when he had trouble cultivating during his Supreme Being period. Becoming the Seed is a humanoid body secret realm cultivation system that all living beings can practice. It is a completely different "dead end" from the fusion of Dao seed and the path of becoming an immortal. It regards oneself as a small world, excavating one's own potential, opening one's own "door", and driving alongside or even surpassing the vast universe, not bound by the rules of the heavens and earth of this realm. It is the true origin of the cultivation system in the Era of Concealment after the Chaos Era.
techniques.appearance:
The first five realms are used as the basis of cultivating the world of Shrouding the Heavens, the End of Dharma/Law Era. Combat during these realms secretly induce greater progress of the cultivation system.

It fits humanoids because of Huāng's foodie habit: cook and eat all non-humanoid creatures.

The true cultivation system establishment lead it to have the potential Immortal Emperor when Huāng was a True Immortal facing his Nine Lives Immortal Ascension. Through the Immortal Ascension, Huāng marks his Five Secret Realms he created long ago onto the Great Dao to prove his path to Immortality. From then on, this Dao seed is planted in all races and creatures born afterwords, therefore his inheritors.

The Archaic Vicious Ten Treasure Techniques provided foundational support for this new cultivation system.

Huāng's repeated deaths and experience with new lives from before Supreme Being to after becoming an Immortal are secretly marked within the cultivation system: only true hard work and life-death can bring quality improvement for those who walk on his system.
techniques.history:
Originally called Becoming the Seed to use Huāng's Dao seed (Qitian Seed absorbed long ago, body experienced several deaths) to open a different path for future Supreme Beings (Great Emperor) to ascend to the Immortal Realm. Later, Huāng improved this old project (cultivation system) to re-cultivate and bring his Supreme Being Realm to the extremity.

It is the Heavenly Passages merged into One, suddenly compressed to a point, and then exploded, accompanied by the two qi of yin and yang. The [Wheel and Sea] is the source of life in the abdomen of the human body, giving birth to magic power and controlling life and death.

Archaic Vicious Techniques: Kun Peng Technique, Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique and Willow Deity Precious Technique (Yin and Yang, Life-Death-Rebirth).

Location: Abdomen.

Age: Opened up during Huāng's twenties.

Heaven and Earth are divided into yin and yang, which is the most simple element. All things generate five qi, and the five elements are mutually reinforcing and interfering, and they are the fundamental elements that evolve all phenomena in the world. Shi Hao sat in seclusion for more than ten years, bringing the qi of the five elements into the five internal organs, to unlock their "gates" of potential. The five internal organs are spiritual! In addition to the soul, maybe the deity of the human body also lives here! All the deities are me. The Great Dao is boundless, but it is within the number of three. Dao births One, One births Two, Two births Three, Three births All Things. Past, Present and Future Huāng enter the [Dao Palaces]. For invincibility! By creating this, even if the world dries up and the shackles fall, Huāng's Dao will still improve.

Huāng's head filled with Immortal energy, the three flowers of the Great Dao formed then turned into a platform, with vague creatures sitting on them. They are Huāng's Past, Present and Future that enter the [Dao Palace]. The Past chants scriptures, the Present declares the Dao and the Future exists as an unclear variable.

Location: Five Internal Organs.

Archaic Vicious Techniques: True Phoenix Treasure Technique (Fire), God Stone Treasure Technique (Earth), rest of Five Elements etc.

Age: Built during Huāng's hundreds.

Born from Heaven and Earth, break through reality. The strongest attack power circulates in the limbs, which can sustain eternity. The four arms are like the Four Poles, and the extreme power is infinite!

Archaic Vicious Techniques: Kun Peng Technique, Lightning Emperor Treasure Technique, Willow Deity Precious Technique, True Primordial Record and etc.

Location: Four Limbs.

Huāng imprisoned a star from outside Chaos. He refined it into his back and fused it with the vertebrae to feel the change. The power of the endless stars turns into essence and steams here. techniques.title: Embodiment Transformation Great Method
techniques.introText: The "Embodiment Transformation Great Method" is a future  Immortal Emperor technique created by Shi Hao, Reasons why they thought it was  an unmatched technique originating from the Age of Emperor Collapse because when Shi Hao completed the techniques, he was cut down by Great Luo Sword and millions of his bloods drop  traveled back in the river of time . It is a powerful cultivation method that allows the user to transform their body and even create multiple "true bodies" or embodiments of themselves. These embodiments are not mere magical or puppet bodies but actual true bodies capable of fighting with immense power and strength comparable to half immortal emperors. The method can temporarily divide one's primordial spirit, produce additional true bodies with great fighting capability, and even borrow the Dao fruits or powers of others to create present embodiments.
techniques.appearance:
He Transforms into Freedom Great Method (他化自在大法, Tā Huà Zì Zài Dà Fǎ) is the supreme Emperor-level technique of Shi Hao in the novel Perfect World. Also known as He Transforms into Freedom Technique (他化自在法), it is the greatest Dao art Shi Hao created and perfected over the course of his 2.6-million-year cultivation journey, ultimately becoming the core foundation of his combat system and the decisive support for his ascension to Immortal Emperor.

The technique first appeared during the Battle of the Imperial Pass, where Shi Hao used a drop of ancient blood from the Era of the Fallen Emperor—later revealed to be his own future essence blood—to activate it. In its essence, the method allows the user to manifest any being, object, or Dharma body that has ever existed within the River of Time. These manifestations are not ordinary clones; they possess characteristics nearly identical to the true body and can even perform techniques themselves. At its peak, Shi Hao can manifest multiple supreme figures—including versions of himself—and fight shoulder to shoulder with them. In theory, the technique has no numerical limit: as long as something has existed in time, it may be “transformed into” and brought forth. This gives it a conceptual potential of raising combat power from one to infinity.

The meaning of “He” (他) within the technique is profound and multi-layered. It can refer to the caster himself, Heaven and Earth, the Heavenly Dao, all living beings, or even all logic and phenomena. “Transformation” does not mean creating something from nothing; rather, it means evolving and reenacting what has already appeared within endless time and space. Thus, the technique cannot violate the principle of existence—it draws upon what has been, not what has never existed. Because of this, simply describing it as a cloning method is far too narrow; it is fundamentally a supreme art of temporal omnipresence and causal evolution.

In its early stage, however, the technique was incomplete. It was originally transmitted by Shi Hao’s future self to his past self through a drop of essence blood, meaning it was not yet fully his own creation. As a result, it had two major flaws: first, the manifested Dharma bodies were constrained by time and could not exist permanently; second, after being used once, the technique required a cooldown period before it could be activated again. These limitations prevented it from being truly invincible.

To overcome these defects, Shi Hao entered long seclusion in the Ultimate Ancient Land. There, by studying Immortal Emperor scriptures and deducing the Dao from its very root, he completely reconstructed the technique from its source. Like a phoenix undergoing nirvana, the method passed through repeated transformations and great sublimations before revealing its true profundity. When Shi Hao finally succeeded, he realized that the peerless, invincible Dao he had newly pioneered was in fact the fully perfected form of He Transforms into Freedom. After this completion, the previous flaws disappeared entirely, and the technique became a flawless Emperor Dao art that belonged solely to him.

In battle, the He Transforms into Freedom Great Method proved decisive on multiple occasions. During the Imperial Pass war, it enabled Shi Hao to resist the foreign Immortal King An Lan. In later confrontations against supreme enemies and in the final thirty-thousand-year battle in the Ultimate Ancient Land, he pushed the method to its absolute extreme, manifesting countless figures through “He Transforms into Eternity.” After perfecting it, he could even divide three streams of pure qi into independent battle bodies, simultaneously fighting three quasi–Immortal Emperors. The technique also demonstrates deep mastery over time, space, and causality, and scattered traces of Shi Hao’s blood across different eras repeatedly guided and saved his past self and others.

Beyond its raw power, the technique represents Shi Hao’s life Dao. Having endured bone extraction, the destruction of his sect, and the sacrifice of loved ones, his pursuit of “freedom” embodies the desire to protect companions and liberate all beings from bondage. The He Transforms into Freedom Great Method is therefore not merely a combat art—it is the manifested Dao fruit of Shi Hao’s existence, symbolizing absolute transcendence across time and the ultimate realization of boundless, unrestrained freedom.

Shi Hao gradually came to understand that the Embodiment Transformation Great Method was not merely a mysterious technique granted to him, but the ultimate crystallization of his own Dao. When it first appeared during the Battle of the Imperial Pass, it was believed to originate from the Emperor Fall (Emperor Collapse) Era, because Shi Hao activated it using a drop of ancient blood said to come from that distant epoch. In truth, that blood was his own future essence blood, sent back across time. At the beginning, therefore, the method was regarded as an ancient, lost supreme art from the Emperor Fall Era—but its true source was Shi Hao himself.

Because it was transmitted by his future self to his past self through that drop of blood, Shi Hao initially practiced the method without fully understanding its origin or deepest principles. It functioned as an incomplete inheritance: astonishingly powerful, yet not entirely his own creation. Over tens of thousands of years—and ultimately across 2.6 million years of cultivation—he continuously refined his comprehension of time, causality, and existence itself.

During his seclusion in the Ultimate Ancient Land, Shi Hao began deducing his Dao from the very root and source. He studied Immortal Emperor scriptures, contemplated the structure of the River of Time, and sought to pioneer an invincible technique that would truly belong to him. Rather than merely inheriting what was passed down, he broke apart the conceptual foundation of the method—examining the meaning of “embodiment,” the logic of transformation, and the principle that anything which has existed in time can be reenacted. He then reconstructed it step by step so that it resonated perfectly with his own Dao heart.

The essence of the Embodiment Transformation Great Method lies in temporal omnipresence. It allows the user to manifest any being, object, or battle body that has ever existed within the endless River of Time. These are not ordinary clones; they are manifestations nearly indistinguishable from the true body and may even possess the capacity to wield techniques themselves. The method does not create something from nothing—it cannot violate the principle of existence. Rather, it draws upon what has already appeared in time. From one to infinity is itself a qualitative transformation; as long as something once existed, it belongs to the realm of “being,” and thus can be embodied. In theory, this gives the technique limitless potential, capable of raising combat power from a single self to an infinite convergence of selves.

However, in its early stage, the technique had two major flaws because it was not yet fully derived by Shi Hao himself. First, the manifested bodies were constrained by time and could not exist for long. Second, after being used once, the method required a recovery interval before it could be activated again. These weaknesses revealed its incomplete state.

In the Ultimate Ancient Land, Shi Hao pushed the method through cycles of destruction and rebirth, like a phoenix undergoing nirvana. Through countless derivations, evolutions, and profound sublimations, he reconstructed it from its very origin. When he finally reached the pinnacle of enlightenment, he experienced a shocking realization: the peerless, invincible Emperor technique he had painstakingly pioneered from scratch was none other than the perfected Embodiment Transformation Great Method itself. The art once believed to be an ancient inheritance from the Emperor Fall Era was, in truth, the ultimate expression of his own Dao across time.

After this final perfection, the previous flaws vanished. The manifested bodies were no longer limited by short duration, and the method no longer suffered from a cooldown period. It became a flawless, invincible Immortal Emperor Dao technique that belonged entirely to Shi Hao.

The Heavenly Horned Ant’s most defining trait lies in its Extreme Strength Blood, a bloodline power revered as world-shaking and unparalleled. This precious essence is said to contain inexhaustible spiritual energy, functioning as both a reservoir of vitality and a treasury of raw strength. Cultivators who refine their bodies with this blood gain unimaginable benefits, their resilience and physical might soaring to heights beyond ordinary comprehension. In battle, the blood can ignite a berserk state, amplifying the ant’s strength to terrifying levels. Yet this gift is not without consequence: overuse leaves lingering effects, a reminder that even divine blood carries a price. Still, the legacy of this bloodline ensures that the Heavenly Horned Ant remains unmatched in sheer physical dominance.

The Ant Fist is the clan’s most famous divine ability, a combat technique that embodies tyrannical force and unyielding resilience. Each strike of the Ant Fist is described as capable of shattering mountains, splitting rivers, and cracking the very fabric of space itself. The battlefield trembles under its blows, chaotic energy surging outward in waves of destruction. What makes this technique extraordinary is its paradoxical growth through injury: when the fists are damaged, they do not weaken but instead flourish, becoming tougher and more formidable. This regenerative resilience symbolizes the Heavenly Horned Ant’s philosophy of strength through struggle, a race that thrives in combat and grows stronger with every wound endured.

When driven to fury or pressed into extreme battle conditions, the Heavenly Horned Ant undergoes a berserk transformation that magnifies its power to unfathomable levels. In this state, its body shines with golden brilliance, blood energy surges like a tornado, and its primordial spirit power expands to dominate the battlefield. The transformation is not an external technique but an innate gift of the race, a natural eruption of divine force that allows the ant to overwhelm foes far beyond its normal capacity. This berserk state is both awe-inspiring and terrifying, a spectacle of radiant destruction that cements the ant’s reputation as one of the most fearsome beings in existence.

Even in its youth, the Heavenly Horned Ant demonstrates an ability that defies expectation: the formation of a domain purely through physical strength. Unlike other creatures who rely on cultivated techniques or spiritual arts, the ant’s raw power alone generates a protective and oppressive field around its body. This domain bends the environment to its will, shielding it from harm while simultaneously suppressing opponents caught within its radius. The feat underscores the ant’s extraordinary nature, proving that its strength is not merely destructive but also capable of shaping the very fabric of battlefields.

The Heavenly Horned Ant’s fists are not only instruments of destruction but also vessels of regeneration. During combat, injuries to its fists heal with astonishing speed, manifesting as layers of dead skin peeling away to reveal even stronger divine fists beneath. This cycle of damage and renewal ensures that the ant can fight relentlessly, sustaining its offensive power without pause. The regenerative quality of its fists transforms them into symbols of eternal resilience, a living testament to the ant’s ability to endure hardship and emerge stronger with every clash.

Among all creatures, the Heavenly Horned Ant is hailed as the strongest in physical strength, surpassing even the legendary True Dragons. Its body is a weapon capable of smashing through mountains, enduring catastrophic damage, and continuing to fight without faltering. This extreme stamina ensures that the ant can withstand prolonged battles against the most formidable opponents, its endurance rivaling its destructive power. In every clash, the ant proves that its physical body alone is a force of nature, a living embodiment of indomitable strength.

When enraged, the Heavenly Horned Ant unleashes a blood energy whirlwind that shakes the heavens, earth, mountains, and rivers. This tornado of divine force is both a manifestation of its fury and a weapon of unparalleled destruction. The sight of this raging storm is said to terrify even the bravest of opponents, as the ant’s blood energy surges outward in waves that destabilize the battlefield itself. The whirlwind is not merely an attack but a declaration of dominance, a reminder that the ant’s wrath is as boundless as its strength.

techniques.title: Imperishable Scripture
techniques.introText: The Imperishable Scripture is one of the most profound, mysterious, and powerful canonical texts of the Immortal Ancient Era, famed for its unmatched body refinement techniques. Its origins are lost to time; not even the most ancient experts know its true source or the era of its creation. It is described as a scripture that embodies the dao itself eternal, elusive, and beyond the comprehension of ordinary cultivators.
techniques.history:
The Imperishable Scripture is one of the most profound, mysterious, and powerful canonical texts of the Immortal Ancient Era, famed for its unmatched body refinement techniques. Its origins are lost to time; not even the most ancient experts know its true source or the era of its creation. It is described as a scripture that embodies the dao itself eternal, elusive, and beyond the comprehension of ordinary cultivators.

As one of the supreme body cultivation scriptures under heaven, the Imperishable Scripture was said to be vastly superior to most methods, such as the Bone Tempering Method, which was deemed shallow and insufficient by comparison. The characters engraved within this divine text are not written in any mortal script they are said to be manifestations of the dao, transcending the limits of eras. Those with deep enough comprehension can understand them regardless of the age they live in, making it an immortal and universally comprehensible heavenly book.

At its core, the Imperishable Scripture focuses on tempering the flesh, bones, and blood to a divine level. When cultivated, it makes the body spiritual, Undecaying, and unbreaking imperishable and everlasting. Legends state that a perfected body cultivated from this scripture could coexist with the world itself, capable of withstanding the collapse of stars. In ancient sayings, such a body was described as one that “heaven would find difficult to bury, and the earth hard to extinguish.” This scripture grants cultivators power far beyond normal limits, allowing even the weak to challenge the strong. It was said that with a perfected imperishable golden body, a small cultivator could defeat a well-known expert.

The scripture’s miraculous nature extends even further through the legendary claim of Primordial Spirit Reconstruction. According to ancient tales, if cultivated to its utmost limit, even if one’s divine soul is completely destroyed, the flesh alone could, after centuries of accumulation, reconstruct a new primordial spirit, restoring one’s memories and consciousness achieving true imperishability. This claim, however, was never conclusively proven in the Immortal Ancient Era. Despite its incredible powers, the scripture’s major limitation is that it primarily refines the body and lacks methods to strengthen the primordial spirit, which prevented it from being universally ranked as the single greatest scripture under heaven.

Nevertheless, some cultivators found ways to overcome this flaw. Shi Hao, the later possessor of the scripture, managed to innovate beyond its boundaries. At first, he temporarily applied the scripture to his primordial spirit, treating it as flesh so that it could reassemble and recover when damaged. Later, by referencing numerous other divine texts and establishing his own cultivation system, Shi Hao succeeded in extending the scripture’s influence to the soul as well. His primordial spirit, divided into ten parts and hidden within his reincarnation imprints, became sturdy and imperishable, mirroring the eternal resilience of his physical body.

The Imperishable Scripture is incomplete, divided into two parts totaling nine golden beast-skin sheets. The upper part, consisting of four sheets, was found engraved upon Imperishable Peak in the northern sea of Immeasurable Heaven. The scripture is not written on paper but rather etched into the living mountain itself, which is said to be immortal and indestructible. To access it, one must obtain both the mountain’s acknowledgment and a scripture key, a jade-like white bone relic capable of unlocking the scripture’s divine barrier. Shi Hao and the little Heavenly Horned Ant used such a key to open the mountain, revealing the golden sheets condensed from dao symbols. However, the scripture could not be physically taken; once memorized, it vanished from the mountain and would only reappear after countless years, possibly millions or even an entire great era.

The lower part, composed of five remaining sheets, is rumored to lie hidden within the most dreadful restricted land of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earthsthe Land of Undying. Few dare to approach it, and fewer still have survived to speak of what they saw. Ancient legends state that once the scripture is completely cultivated to perfection and both halves united, the Imperishable Scripture will vanish from existence forever, its purpose fulfilled and its dao eternally sealed.

Throughout history, several extraordinary cultivators have obtained or cultivated portions of this divine text. The Heavenly Horned Ant, father of the Little Heavenly Hornet Ant, was one of the earliest beings known to practice it. Despite its incompleteness, it allowed him to achieve an awe-inspiring level of power, though he ultimately perished before reaching full perfection. He himself suspected that the scripture was flawed or missing key parts. He Wushuang, an expert from the Foreign Realm, also acquired the four upper sheets but failed to reach consummation. His descendants, such as He Ziming, continued to study and use the scripture in later eras.

Shi Hao eventually acquired the upper half of the Imperishable Scripture after a perilous struggle on Imperishable Peak, where he faced a reflection of history of He Wushuang. With the assistance of the little Heavenly Horned Ant, he successfully remembered and integrated the scripture into his own cultivation. During battles, his body would shine like immortal gold, displaying unimaginable resilience and strength. The scripture even manifested within his shattered flesh, reconstructing his body from fragments, a miraculous feat that awed all who witnessed it. Later, he revisited Fallen Immortal Ridge, where he studied further engravings of the scripture, harmonizing its Great Dao with his own and elevating his understanding. To Shi Hao, it became one of the most important scriptures of his life the key to perfecting his physical immortality and bridging the divide between body and soul.

At the end of the Immortal Ancient Era, Bai Yunzi a prodigy from the Bai family of the South Sea lost his father Bai Enshan in battle against He Wushuang. Inheriting his father's will, Bai Yunzi fought He Wushuang in the ultimate trial grounds, sacrificing his life and his Dao. His fighting spirit resonated with the Undying Scripture, creating the illusionary trial realm that would unlock this inheritance.

Early on, Huāng obtained scattered techniques such as the Azure Sky Peng Treasure Technique, Illusionary Peng Technique, Divine Peng Wind, and other Peng-related Technique, and later learned the Golden Xuan Ripple Technique at the Sky-Repairing Pavilion.

Later, Huāng independently deduced a Kun Peng technique (name unknown). Subsequently, Huāng arrived at the Kun Peng Nest in the North Sea, where he practiced the cultivation methods of Kun Peng's youth, eventually obtaining its complete inheritance in the Demon Transformation Cave. It was the first complete malevolent Technique set that Huāng collected and one of his strongest Techniques in the early stages.
techniques.history:
Shi Hao and a group of genius-level characters entered the Kun Peng Nest in the North Sea. The purpose of this group of people is the same, which is to obtain the Kun Peng Technique and the treasures in the Kun Peng nest. But from the current point of view, the competition is still very fierce, especially the descendants of Poseidon (Mo shang) are very strong against Shi Hao, and Yun Xi and the Mermaid Princess also come for the Technique. Shi Hao is beaten by many because he has the Ten Passage (Heavenly Passage ring).

Because Kun Peng's Nest was probably opened because of Shi Hao's Ten Passage, Shi Hao probably had a great advantage in Kun Peng's Nest. Shi Hao discovered the Chaos Tower in Kun Peng's Nest, and the small tower also absorbed the energy from the Chaos Tower. The power and chaotic soil, Shi Hao also fought with the descendants of Poseidon because of this. Later, the Kun Peng treasure bones appeared, and Shi Hao fought with the descendants of Poseidon again. 
In the end, after he rescued Yun Xi and the mermaid princess, he fell into a magic circle and ended up in the Demon Transformation Cave.

There is a real Kun Peng Technique in the Demon Transformation Cave. The Technique that Shi Hao has practiced since he was a child is similar to the path Kun Peng has taken. He has obtained the Qingtian Peng Technique and the Huanpeng Technique. The Ripple Technique was inherited from the Kun Peng Treasure Technique and created its own Kun Peng Technique, but its power is naturally far inferior to the full version of the Kun Peng Treasure Technique.

Moreover, he also obtained Kun Peng's precious blood in the Demon Transformation Cave and understood the secret of Kun Peng's Technique. Although he did not fully understand the Kun Peng's Technique, he possessed the Kun Peng's bones, which contained the complete Kun Peng's Technique. In time, Shi Hao It can definitely be practiced.

Shi Hao is not the only person who has obtained the complete Kun Peng magic. Besides him, there are many people who have obtained this magic. Among them, the Kun Peng treasure technique of Liu Shen. When Liu Shen got the Kun Peng treasure technique, they were very surprised. After all, this is the complete inheritance of the Kun Peng treasure technique of one of the ten evils. It is unique in the world.

Not only that, this treasure technique can also be combined with other ancient ten evil techniques to form the Six Paths of Reincarnation Heavenly Technique.

Later, Shi Hao also obtained the ten evil techniques of True Dragon, Divine Phoenix, Thunder Emperor, Sky Horn Ant, Qilin, etc. to form the Six Paths of Reincarnation Technique. The Six Paths of Reincarnation Heavenly Power is infinitely powerful.
techniques.trivia: Kun Peng Chinese mythology:It is said that there is a big bird called Peng, which evolved from a big fish called Kun. Legend has it that there is a large fish named Kun, who is unknown how long and how many miles wide. It soars into the sky in one day and turns into a large bird that can fly tens of thousands of miles. It is named Peng.

techniques.title: Single Heavenly Passage
techniques.introText: To fully understand the capacity and uniqueness of the Single Heavenly Passages, first educate yourselves on the basics -Here: 10-Heavenly Passage Realm.

To fully understand the capacity and uniqueness of the Single Heavenly Passages, first educate yourselves on the basics -Here: 10-Heavenly Passage Realm.

In the Perfect World there is the ancient cultivation method which an Immortal Seeds are instrumental to one's future power as the seeds directly draw power from the heavens, they are heaven gifts or ways of distributing controlled powers to an individual. It was believe that all other ways were inferior. Since the seeds are limited a new cultivation method was practice and it can be powerful as those with immortal seeds. Breaking barriers by pushing one's self to the limit then overcoming that limit, doing unconventional methods such as reshaping the Ten Heavenly passages into one were just one of many ways.

In chapter 653, Shi Hao had always thought about trying to restructure and reshape his Ten Heavenly passage into one, this was something he spoke with Willow Deity about in the past . He was always studying the Ten Thousand Spirit Diagram, using it to understand the True Primordial Record. He obtained a lot of benefit from this. He wanted to use this to reconstruct the heavenly passages.

After finding the Silver Worm King he now had the final piece to the puzzle in order to take that legendary step. Restructuring the Ten Heavenly Passage into one wasn't a simple matter. The cauldron he acquire from Fire Demon Palace, which came with over a hundred stalks of spiritual medicines. It was a divine level medicinal cauldron and good enough to refine himself and precious medicines. He place one medical herb after another into the cauldron. The golden ginseng is important for enriching the blood. It could allow precious blood to evolve, then added a stalk of holy medicine with a true holy medicine, a treasure sealed within the pill furnace he fished up from the Immortal Tomb’s Sky River earlier. Shi Hao also placed the black jade lotus, scarlet orchid, golden grass, and all types of precious medicines inside over a hundred spiritual medicines were placed inside, refined in the same cauldron, In the end, Shi Hao removed his clothes and entered the cauldron to refine himself. Shi Hao sat in the cauldron while silently reciting the True Primordial Record. The bone texts all appeared in his mind, giving him great insights. Since he obtained the Ten Thousand Spirit Diagram and compared this true map with the bone text, he comprehend the true meaning.

Inside the medicinal cauldron, apart from various types of precious medicines, there were a few ores and medicinal bugs, for example, scarlet centipedes, palm-sized silver pangolin, entirely golden scorpions… all types of wondrous bugs were floating up and down. the most precious thing was still the divine bug. It was entirely silver white, and on its surface was a qilin diagram. It possessed world shocking medicinal effects. It was precisely the Black Scaled Bug Race’s Silver Worm King. Of course, all of the precious medicines were only to assist in this process. The true test still depended on himself. Ever since he revived, he carefully studied the True Primordial Record. He gained extraordinary insights.

He used the True Primordial Record’s recorded bone text as the ‘needlework’, merging these broken heavenly passages and making them connect, becoming one. Then, Shi Hao used his own body’s insights as the dao flame, forging, refining, and re-establishing the heavenly passages, The ten great heavenly passages disappeared, merging together with the heavenly passage inside of him, turning into a terrifying and hazy ‘immortal domain, The reconstruction is finished. There is only one domain.

When the Single Heavenly Passage is activated endless spiritual essence enters his body through the single heavenly passage. It drew in the essence between the Heaven and Earth to comprehend the symbols’ true meanings. injuries brought about had natural spiritual essence quickly flowing through them. After they were completely replenished, the natural spiritual essence even went a step further, entering his flesh.

The Most important feature of the Single Heavenly Passage is that it became the domain he is most known for. It can restrict others and moreover store up all his treasure techniques. Also he can alter the size of the domain making it bigger or smaller, he even went further to discover that, he can compress the domain into a single point/dot and then explode it. With the number of techniques and energy stored in it, this action is more than enough to kill opponents.

In addition, the Single heavenly passage makes him impervious to all methods. It is also to be known that he has another technique that dissolves all laws when the get to him if activated.

The improvement was not limited to spiritual essence both also physically as his body and flesh would become stronger, speed becomes faster and his energy consumption took half the effort.

techniques.introText: Huang's strongest trump card (relied upon multiple times to resolve crises and save himself), it is the most powerful technique created by Huang up to the conclusion, first appearing before the Emperor's Passage, an extraordinary secret technique unleashed with the power of the ancient blood drop from the Emperor's Falling Era (actually Huang's own blood from the future).
techniques.history:
Huang's strongest trump card (relied upon multiple times to resolve crises and save himself), it is the most powerful technique created by Huang up to the conclusion, first appearing before the Emperor's Passage, an extraordinary secret technique unleashed with the power of the ancient blood drop from the Emperor's Falling Era (actually Huang's own blood from the future).

It can manifest powerful law bodies to assist in battle (borrowing the power of fruits).

It transforms into various formidable beings such as He Who Transforms at Will, He Who Transforms Through Eternity, He Who Transforms Time, He Who Transforms Reincarnation, He Who Transforms the Emperor's Footprints, He Who Transforms into the God of Willow, He Who Transforms into the World-Evil Ape, He Who Transforms into the King of Kunpeng, He Who Transforms into the Thunder Emperor, He Who Transforms into the True Phoenix, He Who Transforms into the Heaven's Horn Ant, He Who Transforms into the Qilin, He Who Transforms into the Nine-Leaved Sword Grass, He Who Transforms into the True Dragon, and so on (currently, the strongest state is when Huang transforms into four versions of himself, with faint shadowy figures surrounding him, not mere avatars or clones, these condensed forms are indistinguishable from the true self and are capable of deploying avatars as well), these supremely talented and powerful beings emerge to stand side by side with Huang and fight against enemies. This profound technique requires strict conditions for success and requires suitable reference points (observers).

It gradually becomes thoroughly understood by Huang, enabling the manifestation of an unsurpassed battle body, yet it is not invincible and has two flaws (the first being that when transforming into oneself or other strong beings, it becomes trapped in time and cannot persist indefinitely (meaning that the duration of the manifested form is limited and will disappear after a period of time), and the second being that it cannot be used again for a short period of time after being deployed), Huang only discovered this after it became his invincible Emperor's Law, initially, it was the future Huang teaching it to his past self, but not completely, and not truly belonging to himself, hence the presence of these two flaws, after Huang formally perfected and created it, these two flaws were eliminated, becoming a completely invincible law of his own.

During his seclusion in the ultimate ancient land and the observation of the scriptures of the Immortal Emperor, Huang forged his own path, deducing an invincible technique from the fundamental and original sources, undergoing various transformations and interpretations, until the moment of success, Huang discovered that the unparalleled invincible technique he created turned out to be the commonly used Supreme Art of Spontaneous Transformation? Huang was puzzled, shocked, and somewhat dazed.

This technique is very special, starting from the source, evolving during creation, undergoing phoenix-like transformations, experiencing numerous metamorphoses before revealing its true mysteries, reaching the pinnacle of sublimation, only then can it succeed, after becoming an Immortal Emperor, Huang further refined this technique through countless time and space trials, baptized by the river of time, and interpreted it to its utmost, becoming an unparalleled invincible Emperor's Law. There is also a branch, similar to the One Qi Transforms Three Clears, where three streams of clear qi transform into battle bodies, engaging in intense battles even against three declining quasi-Immortal Emperors.

This time, they finally found a chance, There was a corpse that was extremely close to the river side, his right hand grabbing a small cauldron. Perhaps it could be called a pill furnace. It was only the size of a fist and earthen yellow in color. It was grinded from precious bones.  Cauldrons and furnaces were often combined together and called a cauldron furnace. This one was precisely like this. It could be called a cauldron, but it could also be called a pill furnace

This item could be called a cauldron, but it could also be called a furnace. “This is a true treasure!  the pill furnace is carved from the bones of an Immortal Phoenix and True Dragon?, Its three curled feet had a True Dragon curling about it, and at the lid was an Immortal Phoenix. It was an earthen yellow in color, and it was unknown what type of precious bone it was carved out from. It was sparkling and translucent, gentle and crystalline.

Inside of the fist sized pill furnace, auspicious multicolored light surged and fragrance assailed the nostrils. There was a majestic wave of life force that immediately rushed out. The pill furnace looked small, but there were unexpectedly several dozen stalks of precious medicines inside. The precious medicines here varied from emerald green, entirely yellow, blood red, and some that even had purple energy. The most important thing was that these medicines still possessed vitality, carrying dewdrops. They were all alive, as if they were just uprooted from a medicinal field. Etymology
金 (Jīn): This character means "gold." In Chinese culture, gold symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and abundance. It's highly valued and often associated with nobility and divinity.

精 (Jīng): This character has multiple meanings, including "essence," "spirit," or "energy." It can also refer to refined substances or refined quality.

族 (Zú): This character translates to "tribe" or "clan." It denotes a group of people sharing a common ancestry or culture.

符 (Fú): This character refers to a "talisman" or "charm." In traditional Chinese belief systems, talismans are objects imbued with spiritual power or protective qualities. They are often used to ward off evil or bring good fortune.

骨 (Gǔ): This character means "bone." It signifies the physical structure of the body.

artifacts.title: Golden Bodhi Fruit
artifacts.introText: Golden Bodhi Fruit, was discovered in the 3000 province by Shi Hao while escorting Yun Xi back to her clan. They came across a bone mountain and there was a golden expanse there with a golden flame jumping about. A rich fragrance entered their mouths and noses, making them feel intoxicated.
artifacts.history:
Golden Bodhi Fruit, was discovered in the 3000 province by Shi Hao while escorting Yun Xi back to her clan. They came across a bone mountain and there was a golden expanse there with a golden flame jumping about. A rich fragrance entered their mouths and noses, making them feel intoxicated.

There was a small tree about half a meter in height. It had three branches that were covered in golden leaves. However, they seemed a bit dim, and the tree itself was about to wither away as well. Between the branches was a golden fruit the size of a fist that was releasing a fragrance. It released a blazing radiance, the golden light it released resembling a pulsing flame.

Heavenly treasure! the legendary Golden Bodhi fruit. This fruit when combined with blood soul grass x Tribulation Crossing Divine Lotus will create Magic Power Immunity and All methods become useless for a period of time .

The fruit was ripe, but the small tree was about to wither. It was because it had exhausted its spiritual essence, all for the sake of producing this Golden Bodhi fruit, concentrating all of its essence. “Golden Bodhi fruit is the holy object countless times more precious than the Blood Soul Grass?.”  Golden Bodhi fruit, that was something that could be stumbled upon but not begged for. It was too rare, and it was difficult to pick as well, because they were all in the most dangerous places with powerful creatures protecting them. Rumors had it that this thing similarly couldn’t be eaten alone, as it will result in one’s self exploding. The medicinal fragrance was too intense, making it even more dangerous than the Blood soul grass

Based on what she said, this type of fruit was rare throughout the world and extremely precious. It was a true heavenly treasure. Countless people wished to purchase them in the outside world, yet are unable to satisfy their wishes. When refined with other spiritual medicines, the leftover essence could strengthen one’s soul. It was much more powerful than the Blood soul grass. Of course, it could even strengthen one’s magical force a step further and carry out a type of consolidation! If it is refined, the Blood soul grass can nourish one’s soul, but this Golden Bodhi fruit’s medicinal effects are even more extraordinary, able to directly increase the strength of one’s divine senses.
artifacts.trivia:
Magic Power Immunity in the Donghua is called "Law Power Immunity"

Bodhi, (Sanskrit and Pāli: “awakening,” “enlightenment”), in Buddhism, the final Enlightenment, which puts an end to the cycle of transmigration and leads to Nirvāṇa, or spiritual release.

artifacts.title: Golden bone Scissors
artifacts.introText: Its entirety was a golden yellow, and its splendid light was dazzling. Needless to say, this was a rare treasure with a value that was difficult to quantify.
artifacts.appearance:
Its entirety was a golden yellow, and its splendid light was dazzling. Needless to say, this was a rare treasure with a value that was difficult to quantify.

As it sat within his hands, its weight surpassed all the metals within this world. It was created from the bones of both the upper and lower jaw, however if one did not observe carefully, they would not have recognized this. Due to the polishing and nurturing it had undergone, its was sparkling and translucent, and had already gone through great changes a long time ago.

In reality, it was extremely beautiful. It looked as if it was forged meticulously by an outstanding master who imbued all his heart and soul into it. Two vivid and lifelike Horned Dragons that seemed as if they appeared straight out of legends intertwined together

The pair of bone scissors did not look that sharp, and felt incredibly smooth as well. However, it was astonishingly terrifying in battle, and it could easily cut a mountain peak in half.

A few mysterious patterns were embedded on the golden bone. They were indistinct and also very ancient. They were precisely the terrifying Archaic Vicious Beast, the Horned Dragon, but they were not symbols, but rather simply a beautiful decoration.

artifacts.title: Great Luo Sword
artifacts.introText: The Great Luo Sword Fetus is a powerful weapon created by the Corpse Immortal Emperor using the edge materials of the Three World Bronze Coffin for refinement. This weapon can be regarded as a true imperial weapon, containing unparalleled powerful force. However, precisely because of this, very few people in the world can truly master it.
artifacts.history:
The Great Luo Sword Fetus is a powerful weapon created by the Corpse Immortal Emperor using the edge materials of the Three World Bronze Coffin for refinement. This weapon can be regarded as a true imperial weapon, containing unparalleled powerful force. However, precisely because of this, very few people in the world can truly master it.

After the Corpse Immortal Emperor was corroded by darkness, the subsequent owners of the Great Luo Sword Fetus would also face a dark settlement. Almost none of these individuals survived, and over time, the Great Luo Sword Fetus became a notorious ominous object.
Fortunately, later on, Shi Hao obtained the Great Luo Sword Fetus from the hands of the Five-Crowned King. Although Shi Hao also faced a dark settlement due to the Great Luo Sword Fetus, his strength was exceptionally powerful. Therefore, ordinary settlements had little effect on him.

It wasn't until Shi Hao encountered the Corpse Immortal Emperor that the Great Luo Sword Fetus truly chose to betray him. The Corpse Immortal Emperor, utilizing the Great Luo Sword Fetus, cut Shi Hao into countless blood showers with a single stroke, scattering him across different time points.

Fortunately, Shi Hao fully comprehended the "Heavenly Transformation Art," thereby ascending to the realm of Immortal Emperor and defeating the Corpse Immortal Emperor. After Shi Hao killed the Corpse Immortal Emperor, the Great Luo Sword Fetus was integrated into his own weapon.

artifacts.introText: This fruit was an extremely rare Divine Medicine found in the Immortal Ancient, containing immense divine power. Even an ordinary person who consumed a single one could immediately ascend to the Heavenly Deity. Moreover, after consuming the Heavenly Deity Fruit, one would become immune to a hundred calamities, untouched by impurities, and able to avoid disasters such as lightning tribulations, fire calamities, and floods. However, Shi Hao wished to temper himself through tribulations, so he chose not to consume the Heavenly Deity Fruit.
artifacts.history:
This fruit was an extremely rare Divine Medicine found in the Immortal Ancient, containing immense divine power. Even an ordinary person who consumed a single one could immediately ascend to the Heavenly Deity. Moreover, after consuming the Heavenly Deity Fruit, one would become immune to a hundred calamities, untouched by impurities, and able to avoid disasters such as lightning tribulations, fire calamities, and floods. However, Shi Hao wished to temper himself through tribulations, so he chose not to consume the Heavenly Deity Fruit.

When Shi Hao ventured into the Immortal Ancient Land again, he obtained even more Heavenly Deity Fruits. He even took the Heavenly Deity Tree, which bore these miraculous fruits, with him.

After leaving the Immortal Ancient, Shi Hao distributed the Heavenly Deity Fruits among his loved ones, including his wife, Huo Ling'er. To ensure Huo Ling'er gained a powerful means of self-protection, he urged her to consume the Heavenly Deity Fruit immediately.

Under its divine baptism, Huo Ling'er was reborn—her cultivation surged rapidly, and even her magical power expanded tremendously. In just one day and one night, the Heavenly Deity Fruit further awakened the Vermilion Bird bloodline within her. Empowered by this bloodline, Huo Ling'er successfully ascended to the Heavenly Deity realm.

artifacts.history:
Yu Lun, upon learning the whereabouts of the individual who had injured Kun Mo and offended the Celestial Clan, was frustrated by the news that Huang had managed to kill True God. Recognizing the insurmountable rivalry between them, he decided to vent his frustration on the person who had harmed Kun Mo.

Upon reaching the Supreme Being Dao Rite and encountering the culprit, he began to mock the structure, stating that they had a too presumptuous name. During the battle, he realized that the opponent has a Law Power Immunity. Immediately understanding that the person before him was Huang, before he could even comprehend what had happened, he was pierced by Shi Hao's Halberd. The Heavenly Fate Stone gets its name because it is an extraordinary stone that represents the fate, recognized by the gods. Once fused with the Heavenly Fate Stone, it is possible to gain the approval of heaven and earth. Some prodigies with extraordinary talent, after merging with the Heavenly Fate Stone, can undergo unimaginable transformations, acquiring divine powers not inferior to the first generations of magical arts.

This change is known as the Myth of Destiny, and once fused with the Heavenly Fate Stone, it is also equivalent to having different lives, as its presence allows for rapid healing from injuries.

Since all four Heavenly Fate Stones have an owner, it was impossible for Shi Hao to obtain one through normal channels. Therefore, after You Yu, the number one genius of the current generation of the Celestial clan, attacked Shi Hao, his Heavenly Fate Stone was obtained by Shi Hao. However, the Heavenly Fate Stone had already initially fused with You Yu and recognized its owner. So, after Shi Hao extracted it, he couldn't achieve the perfect transformation even after merging with it. Although the Heavenly Fate Stone lost its greatest value, it is still equivalent to a sacred model and has healing effects. Therefore, Shi Hao directly split the Heavenly Fate Stone in two and gave half to the Great Demon God.

artifacts.introText:
The Blue armor is an item of the Cultivator's Little Heavenly King in the Heavenly Deity Institution. When the Little Heavenly King went to the Boundary Tomb to search for Dao seeds, he lent this item to Wu Tai. Taking advantage of the Little Heavenly King's authority, Wu Tai continuously targeted Shi Hao and others from the Divine Academy. Unable to tolerate any longer, Shi Hao quickly took action, captured Wu Tai, and took away his Blue armor. The Blue armor is indeed quite powerful; it not only enhances the cultivator's strength but also adds a layer of celestial energy. If a cultivator already possesses three layers of celestial energy, it cannot be increased further.
Later, the Little Heavenly King tried to reclaim the Blue armor from Shi Hao. Unfortunately, he lost in a gambling match against Shi Hao.

artifacts.title: Immortal Dao Flower Bud
artifacts.introText: In the heart of No Man's Land resided the legendary Immortal Dao Flower Bud, guardian of access to the mysterious Immortal Ancient. Only at the moment of its blossoming did the passage open, revealing the path to the Immortal Ancient. This unique event occurred within three days of its appearance.
artifacts.appearance:
Etymology
仙(xiān): In Chinese mythology and Taoist philosophy, "仙" refers to an immortal being or transcendent figure.

道(dào): "道" represents the Dao, which is the fundamental principle or way of the universe according to Daoist philosophy. It encompasses the natural order, the flow of life, and the path to harmony and balance.

花蕾 (huā lěi): "花" means flower, and "蕾" means bud. Together, they signify the budding or blossoming stage of a flower, symbolizing growth, potential, and development.
artifacts.history:
In the heart of No Man's Land resided the legendary Immortal Dao Flower Bud, guardian of access to the mysterious Immortal Ancient. Only at the moment of its blossoming did the passage open, revealing the path to the Immortal Ancient. This unique event occurred within three days of its appearance.

The Immortal Dao Flower Bud, a millennia-old embodiment of its power, has already blossomed two thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine times, progressively consuming its vast dao with each flowering. Now, in a rare and perfect occasion, it would bloom for the last time; when it would bloom for the three-thousandth time, it would wither away. Each petal required the power of a sect master to activate it. The endeavor required a titanic effort, with activators having to operate from an infinite distance. One could well imagine how difficult it was.

In reality, every time this moment arrived, giants from different sects descended. Experts from each province would then work together, each province being able to grasp only a single flower petal, using it to probe the unknown. When the Immortal Dao Flower Bud revealed its three-thousandth petal, it emitted a rain of light charged with immortal Dao energy, extending the life of those who received it by at least a century. Sect masters who were left out were very envious of this scene because even if the Supreme Experts couldn't enter the Immortal Ancient, they still received a great gift.

A powerful Winged Dragon attempted to force access to the Immortal Dao Flower to penetrate the Immortal Ancient but was repelled with severe injuries. Finally, the Immortal Dao Flower Bud fully bloomed, spreading a celestial fragrance and illuminating the sky with three thousand golden stripes of light, each leading to a different region, with each petal capable of carrying about a thousand people. One could imagine how enormous it was.

In a tumult of emotions, the supreme experts hurried, eager to be chosen. Ge Qian was the first to be designated, followed by another five million cultivators, in the epic moment when the Immortal Ancient opened its doors.
