artifacts.title: Immortal Hand Bones
artifacts.introText: The relic known as the Immortal Hand Bones lay guarded within a chest carved from the wood of the World Tree, an ancient tree now extinct. The sole casket contained traces of the majestic Celestial Dao, belonging to the Tree of Life itself, a treasure that could illuminate the understanding of the Dao. Possessing such an artifact would have been of immeasurable advantage to those engaged in their cultivation path.
artifacts.appearance:
The relic known as the Immortal Hand Bones lay guarded within a chest carved from the wood of the World Tree, an ancient tree now extinct. The sole casket contained traces of the majestic Celestial Dao, belonging to the Tree of Life itself, a treasure that could illuminate the understanding of the Dao. Possessing such an artifact would have been of immeasurable advantage to those engaged in their cultivation path.

Inside this invaluable chest lay the bones of a hand, seemingly simple and ancient, devoid of their ancient luster. Their white, faded by the passing centuries, retained only a modest brightness. These were the authentic bones of an immortal, a rare and precious treasure, now turned into legend and disappeared from the current world, lost in the depths of the Ancient Immortal Era. In an era where texts engraved on bone were sovereign, the value of these hand bones was simply priceless.
artifacts.history:
Ning Chuan pricked his finger, and then a few drops of blood dripped down, splashing onto the dull bone of the hand. The hand bone immediately underwent shocking changes. It became instantly perfectly white and sparkling, exuding a kind of vitality. Bone texts intertwined on it, symbols densely covering it, releasing startling fluctuations. Ning Chuan remained extremely calm. He seemed to deeply understand this bone, having kept it by his side for who knows how many years. Then he fiercely opened his left hand, merging this bone inside. It was an extremely strange process.

That hand bone unexpectedly fused with Ning Chuan's bones, emitting a gentle radiance. It was incomparably holy. The flesh in that area began to move, wounds healing rapidly. Soon after, that hand gleamed. Bone texts intertwined, then extended along his arm, releasing the sacred radiance that surrounded the place.

artifacts.title: Immortal King Corpse Wrapping Cloth
artifacts.introText: The Immortal King Corpse Wrapping Cloth is a profoundly significant and ancient magical artifact originating from the Immortal Ancient era. More than just a cloth, it is a supreme treasure imbued with immense power and historical weight, having been used in critical battles during that time. Originally an iron-blood war banner wielded by true immortals, it symbolized leadership and the rallying of clans against formidable enemies. Over time, it evolved beyond a mere banner to become a sacred relic that carried the essence of two Immortal Kings, whose corpses it once wrapped after they fell in battle. Their blood and essence soaked into the cloth, imbuing it with unparalleled spiritual power and making it a treasured artifact sought after by many.
artifacts.appearance:
The Immortal King Corpse Wrapping Cloth is a profoundly significant and ancient magical artifact originating from the Immortal Ancient era. More than just a cloth, it is a supreme treasure imbued with immense power and historical weight, having been used in critical battles during that time. Originally an iron-blood war banner wielded by true immortals, it symbolized leadership and the rallying of clans against formidable enemies. Over time, it evolved beyond a mere banner to become a sacred relic that carried the essence of two Immortal Kings, whose corpses it once wrapped after they fell in battle. Their blood and essence soaked into the cloth, imbuing it with unparalleled spiritual power and making it a treasured artifact sought after by many.

Through refinement by later generations, the banner transformed into a magical artifact that combines the properties of both a formation and a weapon. Its material, originally woven from precious threads, became infused with the immortal kings' essence, elevating it to a rare and divine state. The cloth developed spirituality and a soul-like presence due to the concentrated grievances, bloodshed, and heroic sacrifices of countless generations. This spiritual depth enables it to release immortal light and a powerful aura that can dramatically affect the battlefield, providing both protection and offensive capabilities beyond ordinary magical artifacts.

The Immortal King Corpse Wrapping Cloth carries immense symbolic and practical importance. Recognized as a supreme treasure of the Nine Heavens, it has the power to stop undying beings and suppress powerful enemies and magical decrees. Its ability to absorb immortal blood and other potent energies allows it to evolve further and grow even more divine in times of need. On the battlefield, it can be wielded like a great banner, unleashing overwhelming killing intent that sweeps across the skies, crushing opponents and breaking through formations. Its presence symbolizes the will and power of ancient immortal kings, linking past heroism with present conflicts.

Beyond its martial power, the cloth embodies the history and tragedies of the Immortal Ancient battles. It witnessed the deaths and heroic falls of immortal kings and great warriors, carrying the weight of their grief and determination. Its connection to the immortal kings whose blood it holds gives it an aura of invincibility, reacting to threats and resonating with the legacy of ancient struggles. As a living artifact, it continues to influence battles, protect allies, and assert the enduring strength of the Immortal Ancient era.

artifacts.title: Immortal Smelting Pot
artifacts.introText: The Immortal Smelting Pot is an extraordinarily formidable and ancient magical artifact, infamous for its terrifying reputation and unmatched destructive power. Despite its small size, less than a foot in height it floats ominously in the void, producing a sorrowful, weeping sound that unsettles the hearts of all who hear it. Its appearance is deceptively simple and ancient, covered in cracks and infused with primal chaos, which lends it a mysterious and profound aura. Forged from Dark Immortal Gold, a heavenly material so rare that even immortals find it nearly impossible to obtain, the pot embodies both rarity and menace, standing as one of the most enigmatic artifacts ever created.
artifacts.appearance:
The Immortal Smelting Pot belongs to the "other side," a foreign realm, and it was considered a legendary item even during the Immortal Ancient Great Era, as very few beings knew of its existence, and it never appeared openly during the battles of that era. It is speculated to be connected with the Desolate Border, a dangerous frontier where ancestors of certain clans fought .
This artifact's main function is to refine and smelt true immortals to death, making it a uniquely terrifying weapon designed for the destruction of immortals. It can absorb and devour blood essence from the battlefield, including the essence of supreme individuals and immortal blood, which it refines inside itself. The pot's mouth opens wide to suck in this essence blood, making it a ruthless collector of life force. However, when brought into the current world, the natural laws and the great cosmos severely restrict its power, weakening it and causing it to suffer retaliation from the immortal blood it seeks to consume

The Immortal Smelting Pot is powerful enough to suppress and kill immortal kings and undying beings. Its pot body is sturdy, and the space inside the pot is boundless, a mysterious realm that can trap and refine immortals. It is said that the existence inside the pot is incomparably powerful, one of history’s most potent beings, possibly its original owner, who is currently dormant or waiting for a chance to rebirth .During battles, the pot releases a gray mist capable of wiping out immortal divine blood and produces an undying energy vortex that can resist threats from the outer world. It can also block and absorb attacks and essence from powerful enemies, and its mouth opening can act like a sharp sword to pierce through foes. Despite its immense power, it is sometimes unable to fully break or destroy certain undying entities, such as a pile of white bones that remain intact after an attack.

Its revival releases overwhelming power, capable of tearing apart the heavens and earth, and it is associated with ancient war god imagery. The pot is deeply connected to ancient formations and rituals, and it can be hindered or supported by the environment and those who control it.

artifacts.title: Immortality Armor

When Shi Hao was preparing to go to the Devil's Island and met his grandfather and A'man, Immortal Qin lent him this battle armor. This battle attire could help cultivators at lower realms advance by a significant level, but this was limited to below the Supreme Realm. Even if a cultivator at the Transcendent Realm wore the Immortality Armor, they couldn't reach the Supreme Being. Nevertheless, the Immortality Armor was considered a quite decent piece of battle attire, especially since its defensive capabilities were nearly on par with the Lightning Emperor’s Battle Armor.

The Thunder Emperor Armor is the personal armor left by the Thunder Emperor, one of the ten evils. After the Thunder Emperor fell in no man's land, he was brought to the Yuantian Secret Realm by Yuantian Supreme.

Later, by chance, the Thunder Emperor The armor was seized by Shi Hao. From the outside, the Thunder Emperor Armor was in tatters and stained with rust. Because of this, no more people discovered the power of the Thunder Emperor Armor. The Thunder Emperor Armor not only had defensive power It is extremely strong and can block the attacks of the powerful true immortals. Moreover, during the battle, those holes will continuously deliver sacred mana to the holder to help the holder resist the enemy's attack. Not only In this way, the Thunder Emperor's armor can also isolate the breath, making it the best partner for Shi Hao to pretend to be a pig and eat the tiger.

In addition, the Thunder Emperor Armor also has its own consciousness. Because of an unjust case that occurred in the Imperial City, the Thunder Emperor Armor's will almost fell into darkness in order to help this genius redress his injustice. Fortunately, the great power of the Imperial City It took action to stop it in time. Later, when Shi Hao was harmed by others in the Imperial City, it also quickly turned into the Dark God Armor and took Shi Hao to a foreign land to surrender to the enemy. Fortunately, someone stopped him, so that the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths were not completely lost. Shi Hao, but just when the surrender faction of Diguan handed over Shi Hao to a foreign land in exchange for a hundred years of peace in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, the Thunder Emperor Armor turned into a real dark divine armor out of pity. After returning from a foreign land, it can still be used by Shi Hao.

artifacts.title: Ten Realms Diagram
artifacts.introText: The Ten Realms Diagram is a supreme magical artifact of immense power, comparable to the Heaven and Earth Pouch. It is an immortal dao secret treasure that played a prominent role during the Immortal Ancient War, shaking the heavens and earth and causing massive devastation across countless creatures and civilizations. The diagram possesses the ability to release vast divine force and radiance, demonstrating power capable of making stars tremble and altering the balance of great worlds.
artifacts.appearance:
The Ten Realms Diagram is a supreme magical artifact of immense power, comparable to the Heaven and Earth Pouch. It is an immortal dao secret treasure that played a prominent role during the Immortal Ancient War, shaking the heavens and earth and causing massive devastation across countless creatures and civilizations. The diagram possesses the ability to release vast divine force and radiance, demonstrating power capable of making stars tremble and altering the balance of great worlds.

When activated and combined with the Heaven and Earth Pouch, the Ten Realms Diagram undergoes a dramatic transformation, releasing intense divine light and eventually merging with the Pouch to create a mysterious small world. This fusion forms a wondrous space full of life, with flourishing mountains, ancient forests, divine waterfalls, auspicious beasts, and precious birds. The newly created world functions as a battleground for powerful cultivators, providing both protection and overwhelming pressure during conflicts.

The diagram’s power is so great that clashes with the Heaven and Earth Pouch can make the heavens and earth tremble, producing blinding radiance that destroys weapons, artifacts, and formations. Although the two supreme treasures rarely engage in full battle due to the catastrophic consequences such a clash could bring, their interactions demonstrate the immense destructive potential they possess, capable of fracturing worlds and testing the limits of reality itself.

Beyond its offensive capabilities, the Ten Realms Diagram serves as a critical defensive tool. It can create protective domains that shield allies and repel powerful attacks. It has been wielded by figures such as Great Elder Meng Tianzheng, who used it to defend their forces, oppose supreme enemies, and control the battlefield during large-scale conflicts. The artifact can also generate a contained battlefield within its space, a realm so complete and resilient that retreat is impossible once entered, turning the diagram into both a domain and a testing ground for warriors’ strength and skill.

The origins of the Ten Realms Diagram trace back to ancient lands within the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, making it a relic of profound historical and mystical significance. Its connection to ancient legacies, immortal kings, and supreme formations cements its status as one of the most formidable magical artifacts in existence, with only a few items capable of rivaling its power.

artifacts.history:
The Emperor-Destroying Sword is a powerful weapon personally crafted by Shi Hao. This sword is forged with the primordial spirit of an Immortal King and an Undying King as the furnace fire, supplemented by various immortal crystals, world stones, and a large number of Immortal King artifacts.

After countless years of refinement, Shi Hao's first weapon law pool finally materialized. However, within Shi Hao's Sword Law Pool, there was an immense killing intent. 
Taking advantage of the situation, he poured his own Emperor's blood into the pool, causing these murderous energies to converge into an immensely powerful Sword of Annihilation. When Shi Hao first forged this Emperor-Destroying Sword, he was already a Half-Immortal Emperor.

Later, after defeating formidable opponents such as the Old Man of Doomsday and the Corpse Emperor, he incorporated powerful weapons like the Great Luo Sword Embryo and the Purple Thunder Hammer into the Sword of Annihilation, turning it into a formidable immortal weapon that condensed the treasures of the world.

artifacts.title: Three World Bronze Coffin
artifacts.introText: Driven by curiosity, he decides not only to approach the copper coffin but even to lift one of its corners. From within, roars and the ceaseless tumult of endless battles emanate.
artifacts.history:
The Coffin of the Nine Dragons, also known as the Third World Bronze Coffin, was created by an unparalleled individual whose cultivation level reached the Sacrifice grade.

Having lived for so long that no one could match his level, he still harbored the desire to pursue a higher realm without losing everything. But one day, he fell ill. His illness was so severe that it resisted even the cultivation of the sacrificial path, manifesting as red spots all over his body and emitting an unpleasant odor, imbued with strange and eerie atmospheres. His only solution was to self-immolate and bury himself.

Three coffins of different sizes wrap around each other, representing respectively the past, present, and future, also corresponding to the three Emperors  Huang, Ye and Chu like three similar flowers of the avenue.

Many ages after the Third Generation Bronze Coffin was buried in the Outer World Plateau, it was attacked due to the upheaval of heaven and earth, as well as the struggle between heaven and earth. The ashes of the owner of the bronze coffin scattered, contaminating the plateau and giving rise to its own consciousness, capable of protecting it.

When the four emperors collaborated with the three future emperors to besiege Desolate Heavenly Emperor (or Heavenly Emperor Huang), the trio Zhetian intervened through the long river of time. 
Both Wu Shi and Wu Ren (Ruthless Empress) could manifest their true bodies, but only Ye Fan's figure was blurred, shrouded in the power of time and could not be revealed. It is said that the true body has a great cause and effect with Desolate Heavenly Emperor. Xiao Yudian analyzed that Ye Fan's path to immortality might be a corner of Desolate Heavenly Emperor's vision in the future small coffin. The operation of the other two coffins of the Third World Copper Coffin is also entrusted to Desolate Heavenly Emperor, who controls it, only to guide Ye Fan so that he can fight alongside him in the celestial future.
artifacts.trivia:
After Desolate Heavenly Emperor (荒天帝 - Huāngtiāndì) went to heaven to express hope for his deceased relatives, someone heard some Taoist scriptures in the Three World Bronze Coffin. Desolate Heavenly Emperor was able to convey some information between the two worlds through the copper coffin of the third generation. Apparently, Three World Bronze Coffin had three coffins. The connection is very close, regardless of space, so it is quite necessary for Desolate Heavenly Emperor to take away a coffin.

The original work explains that there is a mysterious connection between the three coffins, and information can even be transmitted between the two great realms through this connection.Desolate Heavenly Emperor decided that after eternity, he must leave some back-up to pass information to future generations, and obviously took away one coffin. The coffin is the best choice; secondly, the original work also shows that after Shi Hao achieved the throne of Immortal Emperor, he could easily destroy the other two coffins.However, the defensive power of the small coffin is suspected to have reached the emperor level and can be used as a defensive weapon for Desolate Heavenly Emperor, ​​so he chose The small coffin was taken away; moreover, the small coffin could reflect Shi Hao's image of becoming the Emperor of Huang Tian before he grew up. Obviously, Huang also needed such help when he was fighting in the sky.

The Nine-Dragon Coffin serves as the introduction for Ye Fan to enter the world of immortality in the world of Zhetian.

It is rumored that the real main ingredients were made into a coffin, and the leftover materials were made into the Great Luo Sword. The small coffin that fell from the Imperial Sword, the Great Luo Immortal Sword, can reflect the future scene of Shi Hao after he becomes the Immortal Emperor.

Etymology
"虚" (Xū): This character can mean "empty," "illusory," or "void." In various contexts, it can imply something intangible, ethereal, or even deceptive.

"天" (Tiān): This character means "heaven" or "sky." It often carries connotations of the celestial or the divine.

"神" (Shén): "神" can mean "god," "spirit," or "divine." It signifies something supernatural or otherworldly.

"藤" (Téng): This character refers to a "vine" typically a plant with long, winding stems that grow and spread.
artifacts.history:
After Shi Hao defeated the members of the Nether Clan who were pursuing Hong Huang, he stumbled upon a surreal scene: a white turtle carrying a lovely woman dressed in white, gracefully moving among the ruins. The air was filled with an enveloping medicinal fragrance.

The turtle, though extraordinary, could still be considered "normal" in appearance. It was white as snow and about the size of a palm. Its shell was adorned with intricate patterns, as if sculpted by the very laws of dao. On its back, the being was equally small, luminous, and delicate.

The woman, dressed in white, was extremely petite but exuded mature elegance. Her silvery hair framed her face, which, if enlarged, would surely be of extraordinary beauty, with its sinuous and curvaceous features.

A melodious voice, like a song, could be heard emanating from that woman. It was sweet and harmonious, a sound that could soothe even the gods themselves, penetrating into the hearts of men like an immortal melody from celestial realms.

Thanks to the help of the Martial Dao Heavenly Eye, newly awakened in Shi Hao, and also aided by the  dual-pupil eye, he managed to discern that it was an illusion. As he walked among the ruins of that place, he noticed the grand formations protecting the site. These formations had been set up to lure people as blood sacrifices. Shi Hao recalled the old bone texts given to him by Qi Daolin; that was surely the Void Sky Divine Vine, renowned for its extraordinary healing abilities, capable of healing any wound, even those near death, and advancing the dao. It was a divine medicine comparable to the Divine Lotus of the Goddess Academy, rarely seen in the world, so precious that it could drive Heavenly Deities mad and compel sect masters to undertake epic actions. It could determine the fate of a sect for thousands of epochs to come.

Determined to reach the Void Sky Divine Vine, Shi Hao ventured through the ruins, meanwhile gathering some sacred medicines along the way. Despite the challenges posed by the scattered formations along the path, he eventually caught sight of that divine medicine. It looked like a horned dragon as it snaked along the ground, but with extra-white leaves like snow, giving it an even more sacred aura.

The divine medicine had developed consciousness; it understood that the formations had failed to eliminate Shi Hao and Hong Huang, so it no longer hid, extending its vine stem. Suddenly, it burst forth with a radiant silver light, becoming akin to a snow-white sun, with a horned dragon coiling within. This scene was extremely impressive. The medicinal fragrance immediately intensified, relaxing the pores of the skin and giving the sensation that bodies were floating upwards.

Shi Hao attempted to collect it, but a formation suddenly activated, launching an attack capable of killing even a Heavenly Deities. Fortunately, Shi Hao managed to dodge the attack, though he had to retreat.

Not being an expert in formations, Shi Hao couldn't break the one guarding the Void Sky Divine Vine. So he sought help from Shi Batian, who, after many attempts and failures, succeeded in deactivating the formation, Shi Hao sent Lan Yichen ahead to retrieve the Void Sky Divine Vine, but he was cut in half. Fortunately, having a metal body, he survived, albeit consuming a great deal of divine energy.
artifacts.trivia:
Etymology
"虚" (Xū): This character can mean "empty," "illusory," or "void." In various contexts, it can imply something intangible, ethereal, or even deceptive.

"天" (Tiān): This character means "heaven" or "sky." It often carries connotations of the celestial or the divine.

"神" (Shén): "神" can mean "god," "spirit," or "divine." It signifies something supernatural or otherworldly.

"藤" (Téng): This character refers to a "vine" typically a plant with long, winding stems that grow and spread.

Etymology
The term "冥土" (míngtǔ) in Chinese can be translated to "the netherworld" or "the underworld"
"冥" (míng) refers to darkness, obscurity, or the underworld.

"土" (tǔ) usually means soil or earth, but in this context, it represents the land of the dead or the underworld.

"族" (zú) means clan, tribe, or group.

clans.title: Rain Clan
clans.introText: Rain Clan and Military King’s Manor are connected through marriage.What kind of clan is the Rain Clan? They are an ancient and glorious clan with an ancient history that is even older than Stone Country.
clans.history:
Rain Clan and Military King’s Manor are connected through marriage.What kind of clan is the Rain Clan? They are an ancient and glorious clan with an ancient history that is even older than Stone Country.

"Oblique Wind and Fine Rain Beheads the Moon and Stars!”

The Rain clan has formed an irresolvable hatred with the the Shi Hao family.

On the one hand, because their daughter was shot dead by Shi Ziling, on the other hand, the Yu clan kept tracking Shi Hao's whereabouts in order to ensure that their grandson Shi Yi's absolute genius status, and later hunted him again and again, and he was also When it comes to Shi Hao's various counter-attacks and revenge.

First, the Rain Clan ordered people to go to the Void God Realm to encircle and suppress them, but they were killed in reverse. Shi Hao transformed into a naughty child and went straight to the Pure Land of the Rain Clan in the Cave Heaven City of the Void God Realm. The Rain Clan people could not resist, and they did not hesitate to use the clan's treasure. The fragments of the Rain God's decree and the soul-suppressing tower. Unexpectedly, the fragments of the decree not only failed to kill Shi Hao, but instead inspired the rebirth of the Supreme Bone in his body. The fragments were also swallowed by Shi Hao, and the Soul Calming Tower was forcefully taken away by him. On the other hand, for the Yu Clan, in this disaster in the Virtual God Realm, not only was their pure land razed to the ground, but they also lost their treasures. Shi Hao also used the soul-killing needle to kill many important figures in the clan in real life. The losses were not unbearable.

As for the Rain Prince's Mansion in the Stone Kingdom, the gate tower was destroyed by the anger of the returning Great Demon God, making the entire Rain Clan unable to hold their heads up. After the disaster, the Yu tribe was extra cautious, polished the talisman bones of the eight types of relics, and carefully laid out the terrifying killing array "Eight Evil Sword Array" outside the gatehouse. Unexpectedly, Shi Hao came again, and the Eight Evil Sword Array had not yet been used. When the power came out, he directly opened ten holes in the cave and closed them all in one breath. He even violently demolished the Yuwang Mansion again, making everyone in the Yuwang Mansion turn pale with anger.

In order to prevent Shi Hao from causing havoc in the Rain Palace, many members of the Rain Clan joined forces and worked together to activate the clan's magical power "Rain Path Ninth Level". From one to nine, each level was more powerful than the last. When it was superimposed to the ninth level, it was actually Summoned the Rain God projection. Unexpectedly, as the protagonist of Shi Hao, with the aura attached to him, he would be stronger when he was strong. He directly used the Kunpeng treasure technique and cooperated with the ghost master's broken sword to completely wipe out the lotus.

Everyone in the Rain Clan was completely furious, and the ancestor of the seclusion also woke up from the Taoist realm. After learning through the bone-penetrating mirror that Shi Hao was actually a child whose bones were dug out many years ago, they decisively used the Rain God's decree with the intention of killing Shi Hao. . However, Shi Hao and Xiaota, two foodies, didn't even say a word. They opened their mouths and bit like radishes. They directly chewed up half of the decree that everyone in the Rain Clan paid homage to. They were so shocked that the eyes of all the important people in the Rain Clan were about to burst. Regret.

Although the Supreme Bone is rare in the eight realms of the lower realm, it is not very rare in the upper realm where the "first generation" emerged in large numbers. However, Shi Yi's double pupils, which the Yu clan cultivated with all their heart, are not better than those in the entire "Perfect World" number. Originally, Shi Yi's double eyes were not inferior to Shi Hao's supreme bones, but the greedy Yu clan wanted to monopolize all the benefits. Unexpectedly, he paid a heavy price later.

He also forged an indissoluble feud with the future Emperor of Heaven. Later, in order to improve his cultivation to a higher level, Shi Yi actually had to choose to melt the Supreme Bone on his own, which he had acquired at a great price with his mother's life and his family. If they had known that the price would be so high, would the Yu Clan still choose to dig up Shi Hao's Supreme Bone? Unfortunately, there is no regret medicine to sell.

clans.title: Stone Clan
clans.introText: The Lower realms, Stone Village was located within a vast mountain range. All around it were tall peaks and huge ravines, and endless groups of mountains towered over the sunlight passed through the dyed clouds, and it scattered a golden radiance as the people warmly bathed within, Dozens of children gathered together in a group, and the ages varied from 4 years old to those over 10 years old. They faced the sunlight in an empty courtyard in front of the village, and were training their bodies with hmph and ha sounds. The young and tender little faces were all serious.
clans.history:
The Stone Clan is a former powerful clan and first powerhouse of the three Crowned Human kings in Ancient times, they had so much glory that the clan leader were bestowed title king with the Stone Clan Divine Inheritance (Extreme  art Double Eye Pupil and Supreme Being Bones) but later on the stone country was wipe out  due to a mistake cause from a powerful king descendant but the truth was reveal as a plot  of the fallen descendants of the darkness calamity. The stone clans  after being wipe out spread across the continents like leaves, it is said that a main group was chosen and send to the lower realm prison in order to truly save the clan blood line.

The Stone clan along with 30 other clans were mark with letters "SIN" on their forehead that is rooted in their blood and pass on by their genes through blood descendants  from generations to generations and in current times known as Sinners blood descendants. Titled, Sin and Glory explain that, the clans of thirty sinners blood descendants are categorize and even though there are many sinning clans, they are still divided into primary and secondary sinners. Since ancient times, it had long been accepted that Stone Clan, Fire Clan, and others, a total of thirty clans, were the main descendants of sinners!

It is explained that there were seven kings figures in ancient times fighting the darkness calamity(Fallen Dark creatures) and apart from Stone clan king all the others were corroded by the darkness and ask the stone king to decapitated them, the king did not hesitate but due to this decision a long and political scheme was in place to destroyed the stone clan and thus ended the glorious rain of the stone clan.

It was said that the crippled immortal place (true immortal), and the 3 other true immortals currently injured and secluded in the 3000 province were there during the events but decided not to testify on the stone clan behalf in the end scheme against the clans and then put in place Sin province for all thirty clans and have Wind Clan, Demon Dragon Sect,Sword Valley .Fire Cloud Cavern. Under world clan (FYI: the hidden truth is that they are all descendants of the darkness creatures bloodline) they were task with the role of suppression and torture of the clans.

The thirty clans only survive to this day due to the fact they were all scared that the powerful members of the sinners blood were still alive and would one day return from fighting at the imperial pass(desolate region) against the Foreign Realm and didn't dare completely destroy the sinners descendants.

In truth the stone clan at the desolate border was very bad, due to the events the clans especially the stone clan were treated as fiends, despise as traitors and they were always sent to the front line of the battle as cannon fodders, the stone clan members in desolate border decline rapidly where millions become just one thousand as the strong members all died in battle and every one that rises would soon die its wasn't farfetched to call it genocide.

In a certain ancient period, there was a grand occasion of bestowing great titles, clans with matchless contributions given the title of Kings. As long as one was the head of a clan, then they could receive the title of King. As such, in the past, there was the Vermilion Bird King, Human King, Dragon King. Moreover, there were more than one Human King, they were divided into three surnames.

There were two or three individuals who were called kings, but now, their clans have most likely been eradicated “In the past, the title of King was a type of acknowledgment, a type of brilliant inheritance, something obtained with the blessing of all clans. That is why that type of imprint is a type of glory.the original kings had great divine abilities, received the blessing of all clans, thus forming even more powerful divine abilities. The glory was merged into their bones, forming patterns

These patterns were a type of blessing, having immeasurable abilities. When they were completely activated, they could protect the clans’ people. Apart from this, there were other inheritances, as well as unmatched great divine abilities! This was the most crucial part. The glorious imprint formed from the King title patterns contained the clans’ divine treasury, storing the highest extreme arts. Shi Hao thought for a bit, recalling some things. His supreme being bones, as well as Shi Yi’s dual pupils, were they the past divine abilities of the clans? Did some exceptional talents have inner secrets? Could this be used to explain this? Otherwise, why would a child’s body produce unique wondrous techniques.

“Those seven kings, just how ancient of existences were they? Could they really live that long?” Shi Hao was doubtful. However, Shenming’s following words made him understand some things.

“The original kings had long died, fought until their divine consciousness faded. It is because this ancient city had previously been captured, and then the residents were completely slaughtered. This is why Immortal Domain thus cut off their connection. The later kings might be successors, people of later times.” The past glory, the extreme brilliance, in later generations, the clans that were bestowed the title of King’s most powerful individual became their kings. According to what Sanzang said, the original kings and the seven kings were separated by endless time, they should be later generations."

clans.title: Wang Clan
clans.introText: The Wang Clan stands as one of the most powerful and illustrious Long Life Families of the Nine Heavens Ten Earths, tracing its origins to the Immortal Ancient Great Era. Their existence is marked by longevity, immense backing, and an inherent belief in their superiority. The clan’s foundation rests upon their ancestor who was an immortal dao figure, rumored to have touched the Immortal King domain. Their most renowned ancestor is Immortal Wang, the grandson of a true immortal, who is regarded as a matchless figure capable of dominating the Nine Heavens Ten Earths. The family’s influence is strongly concentrated in Immeasurable Heaven.
clans.history:
The Wang Clan foundation dates back to the Immortal Ancient Great Era, boasting an ancestor who was a true immortal dao figure, rumored to have touched the Immortal King domain. This ancestor personally created the clan’s spiritual symbol, the ancestral palace. The clan peaked when they produced an "immortal". The great ancestor, Immortal Wang, is the grandson of a true immortal and is himself a matchless figure. Immortal Wang produced nine extraordinarily powerful sons, known as the Nine Dragons, with the youngest, Wang Jiu, being blessed by heaven and regarded as the strongest. Their power was further cemented by their exclusive possession of the Chaos Calming Art.

The Wang Clan harbors a profound, ancient enmity toward the Stone Clan, stemming from a conflict between their old ancestor and one of the Desolate Border’s seven great kings (the Stone Clan ancestor).

Viewing Shi Hao as an existential threat tied to their ancient enemies, the Wang Clan actively worked to suppress his rise. They were the principal instigators, colluding with the Wind Clan, who ordered Yuan Qing to suppress Shi Hao for ten years and exile him to Origin Ancient Mine upon his arrival in Immeasurable Heaven.

During Shi Hao's time in Heavenly Deity Institution, the conflict escalated dramatically. Wang Family members affixed a Diamond Band upon Shi Hao’s head, declaring him the servant of Wang Xi. Shi Hao fiercely resisted this humiliation, culminating in him subduing and capturing Wang Xi, forcing the Wang Family elders to concede and remove the band, causing the clan to lose all face.

The Great Elder of Heavenly Deity Institution, Meng Tianzheng, intervened on Shi Hao's behalf. Meng Tianzheng invaded the Wang Clan's ancestral land, shattered their decorated archway, and executed Wang Manglong, a clan member who had attempted to kill Shi Hao. Meng Tianzheng defeated the clan’s Ninth Generation Ancestor easily. He then confronted Immortal Wang's five eldest sons, the Nine Dragons, threatening their lives. Despite Immortal Wang’s apprehension, compelled by Meng Tianzheng’s might and possession of the Xu Family’s Corpse Wrapping Cloth, he was forced to issue a decree forbidding further hostility toward Shi Hao.

The clan ignored the decree. Wang Zhen, the eldest son of Wang Er, led several hundred war chariots and thousands of elite troops to invade Heavenly Deity Institution. Shi Hao and his allies successfully routed the invasion, resulting in the capture of thousands of soldiers and the death of Wang Zhen. As retribution, Meng Tianzheng captured five of the Nine Dragons—Wang Da, Wang Er, Wang San, Wang Si, and Wang Wu—and banished them to Desolate Border to serve as penal soldiers, an act of extreme humiliation for the Long Life Family.

Later, Wang Xi’s grandfather attempted to murder Shi Hao in Imperial Pass by deploying Lightning Spirits during his tribulation, creatures intended to seize Shi Hao’s Dao fruit. This attempt failed, leading to the death of Wang Xi’s grandfather and the subjugation of the Lightning Spirits by Shi Hao.

The clan’s treachery was confirmed when Wang Ba (Old Eight) guided a creature of darkness to Broken Xumi Mountain in an attempt to ambush Shi Hao, a plot exposed by Cao Yusheng.

In preparation for the exodus to Immortal Domain, Immortal Wang, determined to secure the clan’s passage through means of the Chaos Calming Art, took decisive action. To distance the clan from the taint of darkness, Immortal Wang personally executed five of his sons—Wang Er, Wang San, Wang Si, Wang Wu, and Wang Qi—who were already banished to the Desolate Border. This brutal self-purge stabilized the clan’s position, allowing them to depart for Immortal Domain successfully, unlike the Jin and Wind Clans who suffered severe penalties.

clans.history:
In the ancient times, the Celestial Clan and the War Clan were among the top ten royal families in the Three Thousand Provinces, and were the top forces in the Three Thousand States. There were several war emperors and ancient ancestors who were fused with the Destiny Stone in the clan. However, since the ancient times, the two clans have gradually They have declined, and now only one of their ancient ancestors is alive.

Besides, the Celestial Clan and the War Clan already have grudges, and now four more people from the Celestial Clan have initially fused with the Destiny Stone. If left unchecked, they are likely to achieve the state of unity between nature and man, and recreate the glory of the ancient times.

As the opponent, the War clan naturally could not tolerate such a thing, so they united many mercenary groups and set up an ambush in Mozhou to intercept the Celestials who had integrated the Destiny Stone. They wanted to strangle these four people in the cradle. At that time, the War clan was very powerful, and the Celestial clan was beaten back and forth. In the end, this incident alarmed the ancient ancestors of the two clans, and the two ancient ancestors had no choice but to show up to settle the matter.

It's just that the old war emperor and the old man are both in the first realm of escape, and their life span is approaching. Once they start fighting, no matter who wins, the other one will die due to the exhaustion of blood, so they were just showing off at the time. Although the War Clan has lost its former glory, with the cultivation of the old War Emperor and its affiliated forces, it is still considered a first-rate force in the Three Thousand Provinces, and no one is willing to antagonize them.

clans.introText: Based in the lower realm in one of the eight regions, this was one of the clan recruited by the Fire Emperor to help protect the empire before and after lower realm calamity.
